function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	for i = 1, 3 do
		for n = 1, self.lab_section_count[i] do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_knight(), self.get_entrance_name(i, n)) then
				self.current_lab = i
				self.last_local_step[i] = math.max(self.last_local_step[i], n)
				self.current_local_step[i] = n

				if self.current_state < n then
					self.current_state = n
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if not self.is_alarm_active and self.current_state == self.event_states.event_1 and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_zone_name(1, 1)) then

		self.is_alarm_active = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lab_1_1_entrance_event, self)
		return true
	end

	if not self.is_alarm_active and self.current_state == self.event_states.event_3 and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_zone_name(1, 3)) then

		self.is_alarm_active = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lab_1_3_entrance_event, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_knight(), self.get_zone_name(1, 2))
			and self.current_state == self.event_states.event_2 and not self.is_alarm_active then
		self.is_alarm_active = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lab_1_2_event, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'lab_1_3_speech_event')
			and self.lab_1_3_speech_event_flag then
		self.lab_1_3_speech_event_flag = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lab_1_3_speech_event, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_end_cabinet()) and self.current_state == self.event_states.event_4 then
		self.current_state = self.event_states.finish
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lab_1_4_event, self)
	end

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_card_reader()) then

		if self.current_state < self.event_states.finish then
			-- 카드를 아직 획득 못 했을 때

			-- 카드키 획득 전 카드 리더기와 상호작용 시
			-- 카드 리더기: 접근 거부. 출입 권한이 부족합니다.

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_card_reader(), { key = 'ds_main_s19_lab1_4_15' })

		elseif self.current_state == self.event_states.finish then
			-- 카드를 아직 획득 했을 때
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_card_reader, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'lab_1_1_start' then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, true, self.get_end_cabinet())

function local_class:thrown_move_call(target, pos, duration, height)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.thrown_move, self,
			target, pos, duration, height))
end

function local_class:thrown_move(target, pos, duration, height)
	local init_pos = target.Position
	local distance = pos - init_pos
	height = lua_helper.get_or_default(height, 4)

	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = timer / duration
		local process = math.sin(math.pi * progress)

		target.Position = init_pos + distance * progress + vector(0, height, 0) * process

		coroutine.yield()
		timer = timer + dt
	end

	target.Position = init_pos + distance
end

function local_class:move_to_ease_out(target, pos, duration, speed, is_fo)
	local init_pos = target.Position
	local distance = pos - init_pos
	if duration == nil then
		duration = distance.magnitude / speed
	end

	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = timer / duration
		local process = math.sin(math.pi * 0.5 * progress)

		if is_fo then
			target.Position = init_pos + distance * process
		else
			character_util.set_position(target, init_pos + distance * process)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
		timer = timer + dt
	end
	if is_fo then
		target.Position = init_pos + distance
	else
		character_util.set_position(target, init_pos + distance)
	end
end


function local_class:move_to_ease_in(target, pos, duration, speed, is_fo)
	local init_pos = target.Position
	local distance = pos - init_pos
	if duration == nil then
		duration = distance.magnitude / speed
	end

	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = timer / duration
		local process = 1 - math.cos(math.pi * 0.5 * progress)

		if is_fo then
			target.Position = init_pos + distance * process
		else
			character_util.set_position(target, init_pos + distance * process)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
		timer = timer + dt
	end

	if is_fo then
		target.Position = init_pos + distance
	else
		character_util.set_position(target, init_pos + distance)
	end
end

function local_class:time_reset_event(reset_routine)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_worldmap_loop_01')
	self.loop_controller:on_loop_effect()
	wait_for_sec(0.72)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.05, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	yield_return_func(reset_routine)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.05, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.72)
end

--- 연구동 1_1 초입 이벤트 추가
function local_class:lab_1_1_entrance_event()
	-- 카메라 좌측으로 패닝하고, 최초 정렬하는 지점을 행이 중앙에 오는 곳까지 이동.
	local reset_pos = self.get_reset_pos(1, 1).position
	local camera_pos = reset_pos + vector(-8, 0, 0)
	camera_util.move(camera_pos, 1)
	party_util.align_party(reset_pos + vector(-3.5, 0, 0), 'right', 1, 'linear')

	local sohee = self.get_sohee()

	-- 소히  : 뭐야. 둘 다 막혔는데?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s19_lab1_1_10', skip = true })

	-- 이후 선택지 출력.
	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 위로 진입한다.
		{ 'ds_main_s19_lab1_1_11', 'mercy' },
		-- 아래로 진입한다.
		{ 'ds_main_s19_lab1_1_12', 'mercy' }
	})

	-- 플레이어 일행 선택한 선택지에 따라 이벤트 위치로 run으로 이동.
	-- 이동하는 시간동안 카메라는 상 or 하로 이동하여 플레이어가 중심에 오도록 배치.

	if player_choice == 1 then
		camera_util.move(camera_pos + vector(0, 0, 3), 1)

		self:lab_1_1_event(true)

	elseif player_choice == 2 then
		camera_util.move(camera_pos + vector(0, 0, -3), 1)

		self:lab_1_1_event(false)
	end
end

function local_class:lab_1_1_event(correct)
	--연구동 1_1 이벤트
	self.current_state = self.event_states.event_1
	--
	--왼쪽 경비병 ds_demon_royalguard
	local upper_guard = self.get_guard(1, 1)
	local lower_guard = self.get_guard(1, 2)

	local talk_name = self.talk_name .. 'lab1_1_'
	local player = self.get_knight()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()

	--오른쪽 경비병 ds_vampire_royalguard
	--오른쪽 경비병 ds_vampire_royalguard
	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀린 상태.
	--상단 / 하단 길 선택 가능


	if correct then
		--상단 길 선택시 (성공)
		--존 엔터 진입 시 강제 이벤트 발생
		local guard_pos = upper_guard.Position

		--빨강 : 가디언 최초 위치 / 연출마다 이동 위치
		--파랑 : 소히

		local player_waypoint = {
			vector(player.Position.x, 0, guard_pos.z),
			guard_pos + vector(4, 0, 0)
		}

		local sohee_waypoint = {
			vector(sohee.Position.x, 0, guard_pos.z),
			guard_pos + vector(4.75, 0, 0)
		}

		character_util.move_waypoint(sohee, sohee_waypoint, 7, true)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(player, player_waypoint, 7,
			true, nil, nil, 'left', true)

		character_util.stop(upper_guard)
		character_util.normal_jump_async(upper_guard, true)

		--경비병 (right, scared, attack) : 히익! 근무 첫날부터 침입자라니…!
		character_util.set_emotion(upper_guard, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.shake(upper_guard, 0.03, 9999)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

function local_class:lab_1_2_event()

	local talk_name = self.talk_name .. 'lab1_2_'

	local sohee = self.get_sohee()

	local newbie = self.get_guard(1, 1)

	--

			character_util.set_animation_n_times(player, {name = 'dualgun_attack_left'})

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(sohee, 0, delay)

			self.get_blink_effect():Instantiate(sohee.Position)

--- 연구동 1_3 초입 이벤트 추가
function local_class:lab_1_3_entrance_event()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()

	local center_pos = self.get_guard_pos(1, 4).position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)

	party_util.align_party(center_pos + vector(2.5, 0, 0), 'right', 1, 'linear')
	-- 해당 말풍선은 화면 우측에서 실행하고, 플레이어 일행 동시에 right, attack, jump 1회 실행.
	party_util.set_direction('right')
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'attack' })
	party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_police_01')
	-- 경비원  : [shout] 침입자 발견! 내부로 들어간 것 확인했다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
		{ key = 'ds_main_s19_lab1_3_3', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(150, 0) })

	-- 이후 플레이어 일행 맵 중앙까지 달리고, 맵 중앙에서 up으로 고개를 돌리는 타이밍에 슬로우 모션 실행.
	-- 슬로우모션 1초 실행 후 화면 정지하며 선택지 출력.

	local waypoint = {
		center_pos,
		center_pos + vector(0, 0, 3.5)
	}

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_run', state = 'event' })

	-- 중앙으로 이동
	character_util.move_waypoint(sohee, waypoint, 4, true)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, waypoint[1], 4,
		true, nil, nil, 'up', true)

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	character_util.move_waypoint(leader, waypoint[2], 4, true)

	-- 위를 볼 때 슬로우
	time_util.mod('slow_move', 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	time_util.unmod('slow_move')

	party_util.stop()

	-- 정지 연출
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'sword_run', scale = 0 })
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'rifle_run', scale = 0 })

	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 폭탄통을 든다.(초록)
		{ 'ds_main_s19_lab1_3_5', 'mercy' },
		-- 폭탄꽃을 든다.(초록)
		{ 'ds_main_s19_lab1_3_4', 'mercy' }
	})

	party_util.remove_animation()

	character_util.move_waypoint(sohee, waypoint[2] + vector(0, 0, -0.75), 4, true)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, waypoint[2], 4, true)

	local bomb_flower = get_field_object('lab_1_bomb_1')
	local barrel = get_field_object('lab_1_bomb_4')

	if player_choice == 1 then
		-- 폭탄통 선택 시 이벤트
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader,
			barrel.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 4, true)

		command_util.execute_holdup(leader, barrel, leader.Position, nil, true)

		self:lab_1_3_event(false)

	elseif player_choice == 2 then
		-- 폭탄꽃 선택 시 이벤트
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader,
			bomb_flower.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 4, true)

		command_util.execute_holdup(leader, bomb_flower, leader.Position, nil, true)

		self:lab_1_3_event(true)
	end
end

function local_class:lab_1_3_event(is_flower)
	--연구동 1_3 이벤트
	--
	local talk_name = self.talk_name .. 'lab1_3_'
	local player = self.get_knight()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()

	local flowers = {
		get_field_object('lab_1_bomb_1'),
		get_field_object('lab_1_bomb_2'),
		get_field_object('lab_1_bomb_3'),
	}
	local barrel = get_field_object('lab_1_bomb_4')

	local guards = {
		self.optimized_vampires.guard_1,
		self.optimized_vampires.guard_2,
		self.optimized_vampires.guard_3,
		self.optimized_vampires.guard_4,
		self.optimized_vampires.guard_5,

	local reset_pos = self.get_reset_pos(1, 3).position

		character_util.hide_weapon(player, true, 'bomb_act')
		character_util.hide_weapon(sohee, true, 'bomb_act')

		--폭탄꽃 인터렉트 시
		bomb = flowers[1]
		--플레이어 폭탄꽃 홀더블 상태.
		bomb.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsExplodeTimerStop = true

				7, true, nil, nil, 'left')

		-- 대사와 함께 플레이어 일행 right, attack, jump 1회 실행.
		party_util.set_direction('right')
		party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'attack' })
		party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)

		character_util.normal_jump_async(guards[1], true)
		character_util.set_direction(player, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 이전 연구동 퍼즐 퀘스트를 클리어 했는지 여부 체크
	local before_puzzle_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.before_quest_id)
	self.is_before_quest_clear = before_puzzle_quest ~= nil and before_puzzle_quest.IsComplete

	if self.is_before_quest_clear then
		-- 이전 연구동 퍼즐 퀘스트를 클리어 했다면 바로 퀘스트 활성화
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.progress_section, self))
	else
		-- 아니라면 QuestClearedEvent 구독
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent), 'on_quest_cleared_event')
	end

	return true

end

function local_class:exit()
	-- 이전 연구동 퍼즐을 클리어해서 바로 exit가 호출 될 수 있으므로 체크
	if self.is_before_quest_clear then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_quest_cleared_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent) then
		if e.QuestId == self.before_quest_id then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.progress_section, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end
--endregion

-- 문이 열린 시점에서 상태 저장하고 퍼즐 진행 시작
function local_class:progress_section()
	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_progress < self.progress.lab_2_2 then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_lab_2_2_console_interact()) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lab_2_2_event, self)
				return true
		end
	end

	if self.current_progress < self.progress.lab_2_4 then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_end_cabinet()) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lab_2_4_event, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_end_card_reader()) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.open_end_gate, self))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_progress < self.progress.lab_2_1 and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_zone_name(2, 1)) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lab_2_1_event, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress < self.progress.lab_2_2 and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.lab_2_2_event_zone_name) then
		self:lab_2_2_start()
		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress < self.progress.lab_2_3 then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_zone_name(2, 3)) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lab_2_3_start, self))
			return true
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.lab_2_3_left_zone_name) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lab_2_3_event, self, true))
			return true
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.lab_2_3_right_zone_name) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lab_2_3_event, self, false))
			return true
		end
	end

	if self.current_progress < self.progress.lab_2_4 and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_zone_name(2, 4)) then
		self:lab_2_4_start()
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'lab_2_1_speech_event')
			and self.zone_event_1_state == self.zone_event_state.none then
		self.zone_event_1_state = self.zone_event_state.activated
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.zone_event_1_routine, self))
		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'lab_2_3_speech_event')
			and self.zone_event_2_state == self.zone_event_state.none then
		self.zone_event_2_state = self.zone_event_state.activated
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.zone_event_2_routine, self))

		if not self.is_alarm_active then
			self.is_alarm_active = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.screen_alarm_wave, self))
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'lab_2_3_speech_grid')
			and self.zone_event_2_state == self.zone_event_state.activated then
		self.zone_event_2_state = self.zone_event_state.done
		self.is_alarm_active = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

			return true
		end

	return false

function local_class:screen_alarm_wave()
	local timer = 0
	local alarm_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_siren_oneshot_04', loop = true})
	while self.is_alarm_active do
		field:Tint(self.security_alarm_event, unity_class.color.red, 0.25, 0.7)
		timer = 0
		while self.is_alarm_active and timer < 0.5 do
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end
		if not self.is_alarm_active then break end
		field:RemoveTint(self.security_alarm_event, 0.25)
		timer = 0
		while self.is_alarm_active and timer < 0.5 do
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	alarm_sfx:FadeOut(1)
	alarm_sfx = nil
	field:RemoveTint(self.security_alarm_event, 0)
end

function local_class:thrown_move(target, pos, duration, height, is_fo)
	local init_pos = target.Position
	local distance = pos - init_pos
	height = lua_helper.get_or_default(height, 4)

	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = timer / duration
		local process = math.sin(math.pi * progress)

		if is_fo then
			target.Position = init_pos + distance * progress + vector(0, height, 0) * process
		else
			character_util.set_position(target, init_pos + distance * progress + vector(0, height, 0) * process, true)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
		timer = timer + dt
	end

	if is_fo then
		target.Position = init_pos + distance
	else
		character_util.set_position(target, init_pos + distance, false)
	end
end

function local_class:move_to_ease_out(target, pos, duration, speed, is_fo)
	local init_pos = target.Position
	local distance = pos - init_pos
	if duration == nil then
		duration = distance.magnitude / speed
	end

	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = timer / duration
		local process = math.sin(math.pi * 0.5 * progress)

		if is_fo then
			target.Position = init_pos + distance * process
		else
			character_util.set_position(target, init_pos + distance * process)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
		timer = timer + dt
	end
	if is_fo then
		target.Position = init_pos + distance
	else
		character_util.set_position(target, init_pos + distance)
	end
end


function local_class:move_to_ease_in(target, pos, duration, speed, is_fo)
	local init_pos = target.Position
	local distance = pos - init_pos
	if duration == nil then
		duration = distance.magnitude / speed
	end

	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = timer / duration
		local process = 1 - math.cos(math.pi * 0.5 * progress)

		if is_fo then
			target.Position = init_pos + distance * process
		else
			character_util.set_position(target, init_pos + distance * process)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
		timer = timer + dt
	end

	if is_fo then
		target.Position = init_pos + distance
	else
		character_util.set_position(target, init_pos + distance)
	end
end

function local_class:bouncing_item(target, duration, height)
	local state = 1
	local init_pos = target.Position
	local timer = 0
	while self.radio_on_playing do
		local progress = timer / duration
		local process = math.sin(math.pi * progress)
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if state == 1 then
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = vector(1, unity_class.mathf.Lerp(1, 0.7, process), 1)
			target.SpriteTransform.position = init_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.15 * process)
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = vector(1, unity_class.mathf.Lerp(1, 0.7, process), 1)
			target.ShadowTransform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(init_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.15 * process), 0.01)
			if timer > duration then
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
				target.SpriteTransform.position = init_pos
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
				target.ShadowTransform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(init_pos, 0.01)

				state = 2
				timer = 0
			end
		elseif state == 2 then
			target.Position = init_pos + vector(0, height * process, 0)
			if timer > duration then
				target.Position = init_pos

				state = 1
				timer = 0
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	target.Position = init_pos
	target.SpriteTransform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
	target.SpriteTransform.position = init_pos
	target.ShadowTransform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
	target.ShadowTransform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(init_pos, 0)

	if self.radio_item ~= nil then
		self.radio_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.radio_item = nil
	end
end

	}

	}

	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'down')

	while arrow_ongoing do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local min_dist = 99
		local active_count = 0
		timer = timer + dt
		for i, arrow in ipairs(active_arrows) do

				arrow.progress = (arrow.progress * dist + 10 * dt) / dist
				arrow.arrow.transform.localPosition = vector_util.lerp(arrow.pos, arrow.target, arrow.progress)

				active_count = active_count + 1
			elseif arrow.progress < 1.2 then
				arrow.progress = arrow.progress + dt

			camera_util.move(player.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 1.5), 0.2)

--- 점프 타일 밟고 날아가는 연출
function local_class:jump_action(jump_tile_index, target, mult)
	local jump_tile = get_field_object('lab_2_3_jump_tile_' .. jump_tile_index)
	local jump_tile_animator = jump_tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	local jump_tile_data = jump_tile.FieldObjectBehaviour
	mult = lua_helper.get_or_default(mult, 1)

	if not lua_helper.type_compare(jump_tile_data, CS.Oak.JumpTileBehaviour) then
		return
	end


	local jump_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(jump_tile.Direction)
	local dir = jump_tile_data.HorizontalSpeed * jump_dir + jump_tile_data.JumpSpeed * unity_class.vector3.up

	-- 점프 타일 밟고 날아감
	local jumpInfo = CS.Oak.JumpInfo()
	jumpInfo.jumper = target
	jumpInfo.jumpSource = jump_tile
	jumpInfo.jumpType = CS.Oak.JumpType.JumpTileJump
	jumpInfo.speed = dir.magnitude * mult
	jumpInfo.direction = dir.normalized
	jumpInfo.jumpStartPos = target.Position
	jumpInfo.jumpTimeScale = 1.75
	jumpInfo.gravity = CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity

	local cmd = CS.Oak.JumpCommand.Create(jumpInfo)
	command_util.execute_cmd(cmd)

	-- 점프 타일 애니메이션 실행
	jump_tile_animator.speed = 1.5
	jump_tile_animator:Play('on')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		jump_tile_animator:Play('off')
	end))

end

			character_util.set_anim(guard, {name = 'sword_run', scale = 0.02})
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard, guard.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),

		end))

		end))

	character_util.hide_weapon(sohee, true)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

			start_pos + vector(-2, 0, 1.5),
		}, 7, true, nil, nil, 'up', true)

			start_pos + vector(-2, 0, 1.5),
		}, 7, true, nil, nil, 'up')

		character_util.stop(sohee)

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		--field_ui_manager:Show()

		end

		time_util.mod('wrong_jump', 0.5)

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(player, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		end
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(player, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})

		while sohee.Direction == character_util.get_direction('up') do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})

			start_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 2),
		}, 7, true, nil, nil, 'up', true)

			get_field_object('lab_2_3_accel_tile_3'),
			get_field_object('lab_2_3_accel_tile_4'),
		}

			local tile = tiles[idx]
			local tile_behaviour = tile.CrashBehaviour

			if lua_helper.type_compare(tile_behaviour, CS.Oak.AccelerateCrashBehaviour) then
				local cmd = CS.Oak.StartAccelTileEffectCommand.Create(
						target, tile, tile_behaviour.SpeedMultiplier, tile_behaviour.AccelerateDuration, target.Position + offset)
				command_util.publish_cmd(target.Owner, cmd)
			end
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		character_util.stop(player)
		accel_tile_step(player, 4, vector(0, 0, 0.5))
		wait_for_sec(0.15)
		character_util.stop(sohee)
		accel_tile_step(sohee, 4, vector(0, 0, 0.5))

		--party_util.reset_controllers()
		--field_ui_manager:Show()
		--
		--coroutine.yield()
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)
	for i, guard in ipairs(guards) do
		character_util.stop(guard)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard)
		character_util.set_position(guard, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

end

-- 연구동 2_3 이벤트

		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(player)

		self:move_to_ease_out_call(player, player.Position + vector(-0.7, 0, 0.3), 0.5, nil)
		wait_for_sec(0.35)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(sohee)

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'damaged'})

		--로얄가드 모여있는 공간이고, 그 한복판에 떨어진 후  surprised, eambrrassed 상태.(착지 지점 이미지에 표시)

		--떨어질 때 가디언과 소히 피격 모션, 빨간 틴트 처리. FX_Common_SmokeScreen
		--떨어진 즉시 맨 위의 대장 로얄가드는 왼쪽을 보고 첫 대사, (이 시점 도열한 병사들은 up 상태로 일제히 물음표 버블 출력)
		--대장 로얄가드 (left, idle, attack x 2) : 그런 이유로 연구소의 경비를 강화하고…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guards[1], {key = talk_name .. 3, skip = true})

		character_util.set_direction(guards[1], 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(guards[1], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
		--대장 로얄가드 뒤돌아서  right, idle, release x 2 상태로 아래의 대사.
		--대장 로얄가드 : 수상한 자를 보면 즉시…
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
		character_util.normal_jump(player)
		character_util.normal_jump_async(sohee)

		for i = 2, 7 do
			local guard = guards[i]
			character_util.set_direction(guard, 'right')
		end
		for i = 8, 13 do
			local guard = guards[i]
			character_util.set_direction(guard, 'left')
		end
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_costume_equip_01')

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(player, {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'scared'})
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'scared'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guards[1], {key = talk_name .. 4, skip = true})
		--대장 로얄가드  down 방향으로 전환 뒤, jump x 1 , 느낌표 버블 (이 시점 도열한 병사들은 가디언과 소히 방향 바라봄)
		character_util.set_direction(guards[1], 'down')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guards[1])
		--대장 로얄가드 down, attack, attack x 2 : 당장 잡아아아!!!!!
		character_util.normal_jump(guards[1], true)
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(guards[1], nil, 'notice')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(player, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(guards[1], {name = 'cast2'}, {name = 'attack'})
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		local siren_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_siren_oneshot_01', loop = false })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guards[1], {key = talk_name .. 5, skip = true,
																scale = 1.2, bubble_type = 'shout'})
		--도열한 병사들이 한 명씩 샌드위치처럼 가디언과 소히 덮치며 페이드아웃.
		--병사들 덮치는 연출 참고
		-- https://youtu.be/Zv-mj9LP1Gw?t=671

		local get_dumped = false

		local offsets = {
			vector(-0.9, 0, 0.3),
			vector(-0.5, 0.1, 0.5),
			vector(0, 0.2, 0.3),
			vector(-0.5, 0.1, -0.1),
			vector(-0.7, 0.2, -0.3),
			vector(-0.2, 0.3, -0.3),
			vector(0.9, 0, 0.1),
			vector(0.6, 0.2, -0.1),
			vector(0.6, 0.1, -0.3),
			vector(0.4, 0.3, 0.4),
			vector(0.6, 0.4, -0.4),
			vector(0.7, 0.2, 0.2),
		}

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_09')
		for i = 2, #guards do
			local delay = (i % 3) / 3 + i / 12
			local guard = guards[i]
			local dir = i < 8 and 'right' or 'left'
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(guard, {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'mad'})
				wait_for_sec(delay)
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(guard, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'mad'})
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
				character_util.jump_move(guard, player.Position + vector(0.3, 0, -0.2) + offsets[i-1], 7, 1.3, true, dir)
				character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(guard)
				get_dumped = true
			end))
		end

		while not get_dumped do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(player)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(player)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(sohee)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(sohee)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(player, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'damaged'})
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'damaged'})

		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		--다만 위 영상처럼 높게 쌓이지 않고 둥그렇게 쌓이는 형태
		--대여섯명 쌓였을 때 페이드아웃.
		--이후 루프 연출 이후 회귀.

		self:time_reset_event(function()
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

			character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(guards)

			siren_sfx:Stop()
			siren_sfx = nil
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field'})

			for i = 10, 22 do
				local guard = self.optimized_vampires['guard_' .. i]
				local pos = self.get_guard_pos(2, i + 9)
				character_util.stop(guard)
				character_util.set_active_state(guard, 'enabled')
				character_util.set_position(guard, pos.position)
				character_util.set_direction(guard, 'up')
			end

			character_util.hide_weapon(player, false)
			character_util.hide_weapon(sohee, false)

			party_util.align_party(self.get_reset_pos(2, 3).position, 'down', 0, 'linear')
			camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
			camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

		end)

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	else
		--가속 발판을 밟는다. 선택 시, 이벤트 발생.
		--
		--가디언과 소히가 액셀 타일 밟으면 1, 2, 3 거치는 동안 점점 빨라지며 가속 붙음. 소히, 가디언 surprised, embrrassed 상태.
		--그 상태로 4 가운데에 도달 시, right로 방향 바꿔서 가속 붙은 상태로 돌진.
		--병사들은 가디언이 3을 밟은 시점부터, 위 이미지에 표시된 위치에서 왼쪽으로 이동 시작 평속으로 left, walk.

		--(+ 가속 발판 코스에 사용되는 병사들과 연구원NPC들은 ‘가속 발판을 밟는다’ 선택지 선택 시점에 위 이미지 위치에 스폰됨)

		local guards = {}

		for i = 10, 27 do
			local guard = self.optimized_demons['guard_' .. i]
			table.insert(guards, guard)
		end

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})

		local running = true

		local state = 1

		while running do
			if state == 1 then
				if player.Position.z > start_pos.z + 8 then
					state = 2
					for i = 1, 8 do
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
							local guard = guards[i]
							character_util.set_direction(guard, 'left')
							character_util.move_waypoint(guard, guard.Position + vector(-12, 0, 0),
									5, true, nil, nil)

							while guard.Position.x - 0.7 > player.Position.x do
								coroutine.yield()
							end

							if i == 1 then
								music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_victim_scream_02')
								speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(player, {key = talk_name .. 6,
																			   bubble_type = 'shout', scale = 1.3,
																			   world_pos = guard.Position + vector(2, 1, -2)})
							end

							while guard.Position.x - 0.3 > player.Position.x do
								coroutine.yield()
							end
							character_util.stop(guard)
							local dist = i < 5 and vector(0, 0, 2) or vector(0, 0, -2)

							music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
							self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(guard.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
							character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(guard)
							character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(guard)
							character_util.air_spin(guard, { offset = dist })
						end))
					end
				end
				character_util.set_position(sohee, player.Position + vector(0, 0, -2))
			elseif state == 2 then
				if player.Position.x > self.get_guard_pos(2, 32).position.x + 3 then
					state = 3
					for i = 9, 18 do
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
							local guard = guards[i]
							character_util.set_direction(guard, 'left')
							character_util.move_waypoint(guard, guard.Position + vector(0, 0, 5),
									5, true, nil, nil)

							while guard.Position.z + 0.8 < player.Position.z do
								coroutine.yield()
							end

							if i == 18 then
								speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(player, {key = talk_name .. 7,
																			   bubble_type = 'shout', scale = 1.3,
																			   world_pos = guard.Position + vector(-2, 1, -5)})
							end
							while guard.Position.z + 0.3 < player.Position.z do
								coroutine.yield()
							end

							character_util.stop(guard)
							local dist = i < 14 and vector(-2, 0, 2) or vector(2, 0, 0)

							music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
							self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(guard.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
							character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(guard)
							character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(guard)
							character_util.air_spin(guard, { offset = dist })
						end))
					end
				end
				if player.Direction == character_util.get_direction('up') then
					character_util.set_position(sohee, player.Position + vector(0, 0, -2))
				elseif sohee.Position.z < player.Position.z then
					character_util.set_position(sohee, player.Position +
							vector(-1 * (player.Position.x - sohee.Position.x), 0, -2 + (player.Position.x - sohee.Position.x)))
				else
					character_util.set_emotion(sohee, {name = 'surprise'})
					character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')
					character_util.set_position(sohee, player.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0))
				end
			elseif state == 3 then
				if player.Position.z < self.get_guard_pos(2, 34).position.z + 3 then
					running = false
					character_util.stop(player)
					character_util.stop(sohee)
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
					player.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
					sohee.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
				end
				if player.Direction == character_util.get_direction('right') then
					character_util.set_position(sohee, player.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0))
				elseif sohee.Position.x < player.Position.x then
					character_util.set_position(sohee, player.Position +
							vector(-2 + (sohee.Position.z - player.Position.z), 0, 1 * (sohee.Position.z - player.Position.z)))
				else
					character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'down')
					character_util.set_position(sohee, player.Position + vector(0, 0, 2))

--region pooled_arrow
-- 2_2 이벤트에서 사용될 화살 풀 생성
function local_class:create_arrow_pool(pool_size)
	pool_size = lua_helper.get_or_default(pool_size, 50)

	if self.pooled_arrow then
		return
	end

	self:create_res_holder()

	self.pooled_arrow = {}

	local custom_atlas = nil

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
		self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
			custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
			custom_atlas:Initialize()
		end)

	for i = 1, pool_size do
		local arrow_object = self.get_custom_sprite_pool():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local custom_sprite = arrow_object.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

		custom_sprite.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		custom_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
		custom_sprite.SpriteName = 'arrow'
		custom_sprite:Rebuild()

		local arrow = {
			object = arrow_object,
			sprite = custom_sprite,
			is_used = false
		}

		table.insert(self.pooled_arrow, arrow)
	end
end

function local_class:clear_arrow_pool()
	for i = 1, #self.pooled_arrow do
		self.pooled_arrow[i].object:Dispose()
	end

	self.pooled_arrow = nil
end

function local_class:get_arrow(dir_vector)
	for i = 1, #self.pooled_arrow do
		if not self.pooled_arrow[i].is_used then
			self.pooled_arrow[i].is_used = true
			self.pooled_arrow[i].sprite.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.up, dir_vector)
			self.pooled_arrow[i].sprite:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects')
			self.pooled_arrow[i].sprite:SetSortingOrder(900)
			self.pooled_arrow[i].sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.white
			self.pooled_arrow[i].sprite:Rebuild()

			return self.pooled_arrow[i].sprite
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:dispose_arrow(arrow)
	for i = 1, #self.pooled_arrow do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.pooled_arrow[i].sprite, arrow) then
			self.pooled_arrow[i].sprite.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			self.pooled_arrow[i].is_used = false

			break
		end
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:thrown_move(target, pos, duration, height)
	local init_pos = target.Position
	local distance = pos - init_pos
	height = lua_helper.get_or_default(height, 4)

	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = timer / duration
		local process = math.sin(math.pi * progress)

		target.Position = init_pos + distance * progress + vector(0, height, 0) * process

		coroutine.yield()
		timer = timer + dt
	end

	target.Position = init_pos + distance
end

function local_class:rotate_ease_out(target, rotate, duration)
	if duration == nil then
		duration = distance.magnitude / speed
	end

	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = timer / duration
		local process = math.sin(math.pi * 0.5 * progress)

		local cur_rotation = process * rotate

		target.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)
		target.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)

		coroutine.yield()
		timer = timer + dt
	end
	target.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
			unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(rotate, unity_class.vector3.forward)
	target.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
			unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(rotate, unity_class.vector3.forward)
end


function local_class:move_to_ease_out(target, pos, duration, speed, is_fo)
	local init_pos = target.Position
	local distance = pos - init_pos
	if duration == nil then
		duration = distance.magnitude / speed
	end

	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = timer / duration
		local process = math.sin(math.pi * 0.5 * progress)

		if is_fo then
			target.Position = init_pos + distance * process
		else
			character_util.set_position(target, init_pos + distance * process)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
		timer = timer + dt
	end
	if is_fo then
		target.Position = init_pos + distance
	else
		character_util.set_position(target, init_pos + distance)
	end
end

function local_class:move_to_ease_in(target, pos, duration, speed, is_fo)
	local init_pos = target.Position
	local distance = pos - init_pos
	if duration == nil then
		duration = distance.magnitude / speed
	end

	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = timer / duration
		local process = 1 - math.cos(math.pi * 0.5 * progress)

		if is_fo then
			target.Position = init_pos + distance * process
		else
			character_util.set_position(target, init_pos + distance * process)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
		timer = timer + dt
	end

	if is_fo then
		target.Position = init_pos + distance
	else
		character_util.set_position(target, init_pos + distance)
	end
end

		character_util.set_position(figure, player.Position + vector(0.2, 0.4, -0.2))
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--소히 (플레이어 바라보며, attack, idle) : 뭐야? 그런 건 어디서…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.look_at(sohee, player)
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s19_lab3_1_5', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(player)
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(player, {name = 'attack'})
		self:move_to_ease_out(figure, player.Position + vector(0, 0.8, -0.1), 0.3, nil)
		--이후 attack 애니메이션과 함께 피규어 gem_field의 위에 올려지도록 던진다. 이때 카메라 스프라이트를 비추면서 이동.
		camera_util.move(guard_pos, 1.2)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.2, 1.2)
		character_util.spine_rotate(figure, 360, 1.2)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
		self:thrown_move(figure, guard_pos + vector(0, 0.3, 0), 1.2, 3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
		self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(figure.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0, -0.5))

		if self.gem_twinkle_effect ~= nil then
			self.gem_twinkle_effect:Dispose()
		end

		self.gem_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.gem_item = nil

		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		--안착한 순간 좌하단, 우상단에 배치된 기믹들 일제히 shake 1회 실행하며 빠르게 줌 아웃.

		camera_util.move(guard_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5), 0.5)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5.2, 0.5)

		figure.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		local cabinet_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_interact_greenland_01', parent = player,
			loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc',
		})
		for i = 1, iter_num do
			local obj = self.lab_3_1_breakables[i]
			obj:Shake(0.07, 0.4)
		end
		cabinet_sound:Stop()
		wait_for_sec(0.4)

		field:RemoveTint('night', 0.2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
		for i = 1, iter_num do
			local obj = self.lab_3_1_breakables[i]
			obj.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(obj.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))

			local guard = guards[i]
			local jump_to = self.get_ambush_guard_pos(i, 2)
			character_util.set_active_state(guard, 'enabled')
			character_util.set_anim(guard, { name = 'get' })
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(guard, 1, 0.1)
			character_util.move_to(guard, jump_to, 0.5, nil, true, false)
			character_util.jump(guard, 1, 0.5)
		end

		character_util.remove_group_anim(guards)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		wait_for_sec(0.1)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		--경비들 (각 방향, attack, idle) : [shout] 잡았…!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(player, {
			key = 'ds_main_s19_lab3_1_6', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout',
			scale = 1.15, screen_pos = vector(-50, 300) })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		for i = 1, iter_num do
			local guard = guards[i]
			character_util.set_emotion(guard, {name = 'love'})
			character_util.jump(guard, 0.8, 0.4)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.55)
		local dash_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_dash_06', parent = player,
			loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc',
		})
		for i = 1, iter_num do
			local obj = self.lab_3_1_breakables[i]
			local diff = guards[i].Position - guard_pos
			local dir = (diff.x < 0) and 'right' or 'left'
			local dist = (diff.x < 0) and 3.5 - diff.z or -3.5 - diff.z
			local guard = guards[i]

			character_util.move_waypoint(guard, {
				obj.Position + vector(dist, 0, 0),
				obj.Position + vector(dist, 0, dist),
			}, 6, true, nil, nil, dir)
		end
		for i = 1, iter_num do
			local guard = guards[i]
			local wp = {
				self.get_ambush_guard_pos(i, 3),
				self.get_ambush_guard_pos(i, 4)
			}

			character_util.move_waypoint(guard, wp, 7, true)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.8)
		dash_sound:Stop()

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')

		--이후 좌하단, 우상단  기믹들 일제히 fx_dead로 사라지며 경비원이 heart, cast 상태로 등장.
		--이후 경비원들 heart, run 으로 일제히 달려오지만, 보석 주변에 도착하면 각자 로프 묶이는 연출 실행됨. 해당 연출을 하며 줌 복귀.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ropetrap_activate_01')
		for i = 1, iter_num do
			local obj = self.lab_3_1_breakables[i]
			local diff = obj.Position - guard_pos
			local dir = (diff.x < 0) and 'right' or 'left'
			local guard = guards[i]
			character_util.set_emotion(guard, {name = 'surprise'})
			self:caught_by_rope(guard, guard.Position, dir)
		end

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_05')

		for i = 1, iter_num do
			local guard = guards[i]
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(guard, 0, 1)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, self.rope_states[i]:Up(1, 1))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, self.rope_states[i]:RopeAlpha(0, 1))
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		self:release_all_rope()

		for i = 1, iter_num do
			local guard = guards[i]
			character_util.set_position(guard, vector(999,0,999))
			character_util.set_active_state(guard,'disabled')
		end

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(player)

		wait_for_sec(1.2)
		--https://youtu.be/exxLlr0vX0U?t=341

		-- 이후 소히 머리 위로 emoticon_bubble_silence 출력. 종료하면 컨트롤 복귀.
		character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'tired' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(sohee, nil, 'silence')

		self.current_state = self.event_states.event_1

		camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

		character_util.hide_weapon(player, false)
		character_util.hide_weapon(sohee, false)
	end
end

function local_class:lab_3_2_event()
--연구동 3_2 이벤트
	--길을 막고 있는 로얄가드 (ds_demon_royalguard)
	--
	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀린 상태.
	--트리거존 진입 시 강제 이벤트 발생

	local talk_name = self.talk_name .. 'lab3_2_'
	local player = self.get_knight()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()

	local guard_pos = self.get_guard_pos(3, 2).position
	local reset_pos = self.get_reset_pos(3, 2).position
	local center_pos = vector(guard_pos.x, 0, reset_pos.z)

	local guard = self.get_guard(3, 1)

	character_util.hide_weapon(player, true)
	character_util.hide_weapon(sohee, true)

	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(player, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_emotion(player, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.normal_jump(sohee, '01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(player, '01_player_jump_01')

	camera_util.move(center_pos, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	camera_util.move_async(player.Position, 1)
	--플레이어 선택지 출력.

	character_util.set_direction(player, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

	--플레이어 선택지 출력
	--예비용 투구를 던진다. (보라)
	--소히를 던진다. (빨강)
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{talk_name .. 1, 'mercy'},
		{talk_name .. 2, 'brutal'},
	})

	if result == 1 then
		--
		character_util.set_direction(player, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')
		--투구를 던진다 선택시 (성공 선택지)
		--가디언 (right, smile, cast 혹은 가슴 앞에 들고 있는 자세 ) (guardian_helmet)을 손에 든다.
		local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player'
		})
		character_util.set_anim(player, {name = 'eat'})
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		equipping_sfx:Stop()

		self.helmet_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = 20678, pos = player.Position + vector(0.3, 0.4, 0),
														showoncharacter = true, sprscale = 0.7,
														notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'})
		character_util.set_anim(player, {name = 'cast'})
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_holdup_01')
		character_util.set_anim(player, {name = 'cast2'})
		self:thrown_move(self.helmet_item, player.Position + vector(0, 1.3, 0), 0.2, 0.5)

		wait_for_sec(1)
		camera_util.move(center_pos, 0.5)
		self.helmet_item:SetSortingLayer(false)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')

		character_util.set_animation_n_times(player, {name = 'throw'})
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')
		local spin_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default'
		})
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rotate_ease_out, self,
				self.helmet_item, -720, 2))
		self:thrown_move(self.helmet_item, center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1, 2)
		spin_loop_sfx:Stop()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ui_grid_02')
		self:move_to_ease_out(self.helmet_item, center_pos + vector(2, 0, 0), 1, nil, true)
		--가디언 (right, smile, guardian_helmet 홀더블)을 머리 위에 들어올린다.
		--가디언이 (guardian_helmet)을 오른쪽으로 던져, (guardian_helmet)이 경비원 시야 안쪽까지 한바퀴 굴러 멈춘다.
		--로얄가드 (up, idle,idle) 머리에 emoticon_bubble_question 띄운 뒤, up, jump 1회 실행.
		character_util.normal_jump(guard, '01_player_jump_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(guard, nil, 'question')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_little_princess', state = 'event', fade_in_time = 2 })

		--배경음으로 꼬마공주 bgm이 나오며 로얄가드가 투구를 향해 run으로 이동한다.
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard, center_pos,
				5, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)
		wait_for_sec(1)
		--투구까지 2타일 남은 시점에 로얄가드 정지.
		character_util.shake(guard, 0.03, 0.3)
		character_util.set_emotion(guard, {name = 'tired'})
		character_util.move_distance_async(guard, vector(0.8, 0, 0), 1, nil, true, true)
		wait_for_sec(1)
		--로양가드 1타일 씩 느리게 walk하여 투구 앞에 right로 선다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(guard, 0.03, 0.5)
		character_util.set_emotion(guard, {name = 'damaged'})
		character_util.move_distance_async(guard, vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1, nil, true, true)
		wait_for_sec(1)
		--로얄가드 (right, cry, frustration) 울며 천천히 투구를 향해 다가가 주저 앉는다
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(guard, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'cry'})
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(guard)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		--경비 (right, cry, frustration) : 어, 어째서 눈물이…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard, {key = talk_name .. 3, skip = true})
		--플레이어, 소히 일제히 right, tired, question을 실행하머 머리 위로 emoticon_bubble_question을 출력.

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

		camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		party_util.set_emotion({name = 'tired'})
		party_util.set_anim({name = 'question', loop = false})
		character_util.show_emoticon(sohee, nil, 'question')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(player, nil, 'question')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

		character_util.hide_weapon(player, false)
		character_util.hide_weapon(sohee, false)

		self.current_state = self.event_states.event_2
	else

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		character_util.set_direction(player, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(player, { name = 'doyagao' })
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_emotion(player)
		character_util.set_anim(player, { name = 'throw' })
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		character_util.set_anim(player, { name = 'cast2' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_holdup_01')
		self:thrown_move(sohee, player.Position + vector(0, 1.0, 0), 0.2, 0.5)

		character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'embarrassed' })

		--소히 (right, surprise, embrrassed) : [shout] 무, 무슨 짓이야…!!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee,
				{ key = talk_name .. 6, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(player, 'right')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		local time_scale = 0.3
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
		time_util.mod('lab_3_2', time_scale)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_02')
		character_util.set_emotion(player, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim(player, { name = 'throw', loop = false  })

		local sohee_rotate = -360
		character_util.spine_rotate(sohee, sohee_rotate, 0.3)

		camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 0.3)
		self:thrown_move(sohee, player.Position + vector(0.3, 1, 0), 0.3, 0.5)

		-- -360 == 0
		character_util.spine_rotate(sohee, 0, 0)

		local sohee_rotation = -180
		character_util.spine_rotate(sohee, -180, 0.2)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
		character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'throw', loop = false })
		self:thrown_move(sohee, sohee.Position + vector(0.3, -0.75, 0), 0.2, 0)

		time_util.unmod('lab_3_2')

		--4단계 : 이후 두 캐릭터 모두 mad로 바뀌며
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(player, { name = 'mad' })
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'mad' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = talk_name .. 7, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

		local start_center_pos = (sohee.Position + player.Position) / 2
		-- FIXME : 마커로 계산
		local target_center_pos = vector(-165, start_center_pos.y, center_pos.z)
		local duration = 1.2
		local time_passed = 0
		local total_angle = -480

		local sohee_diff = sohee.Position - start_center_pos
		local player_diff = player.Position - start_center_pos

		local guard_jumped = false

		camera_util.move(center_pos, duration)

		character_util.set_active_shadow(player, false)
		character_util.set_active_shadow(sohee, false)

		local gather_duration = 0.1
		local is_gathered = false

		character_util.spine_rotate(player, total_angle, duration)
		character_util.spine_rotate(sohee, total_angle + sohee_rotation, duration)
		character_util.set_anim(player, { name = 'prostrate', mix_duration = duration })
		character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'prostrate', mix_duration = duration })

		local spin_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_air_spin_03', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default'
		})

		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local cur_center_pos = start_center_pos * (1 - progress) + target_center_pos * progress

			if not is_gathered then
				if time_passed < gather_duration then
					local gather_progress = time_passed / gather_duration
					sohee.Position = cur_center_pos + (sohee_diff * (1 - gather_progress))
					player.Position = cur_center_pos + (player_diff * (1 - gather_progress))
				else
					is_gathered = true
					sohee.Position = cur_center_pos
					player.Position = cur_center_pos
				end
			else
				sohee.Position = cur_center_pos
				player.Position = cur_center_pos
			end

			if math.abs(cur_center_pos.x - guard.Position.x) < 1.5 and not guard_jumped then
				character_util.normal_jump(guard, '01_player_jump_01')
				guard_jumped = true
			end

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if not guard_jumped then
			character_util.normal_jump(guard, '01_player_jump_01')
		end

		sohee.Position = target_center_pos
		player.Position = target_center_pos

		spin_loop_sfx:Stop()

		--5단계 : 벽에 부딪히며 두 캐릭터 모두 damaged 표정을 짓고 1타일 벽에 부딪힌 충격으로 물러난다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(target_center_pos + vector(1, 0.5, 0))
		self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(target_center_pos + vector(1, 0.5, 0))
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

		local move_left_count = 0

		sohee.LockedDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

		local spin_move = function(npc, target_pos, speed, height)
			move_left_count = move_left_count + 1

			local move_dur = (npc.Position - target_pos).magnitude / speed

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
			character_util.set_direction(npc, 'left')
			character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'damaged' })
			character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'prostrate', mix_duration = move_dur / 2 })
			character_util.jump(npc, height, move_dur)
			character_util.spine_rotate(npc, 0, 0)
			character_util.spine_rotate(npc,  360 * 3, move_dur)

			wp_util.move_way_points(npc, {
				waypoints = target_pos, speed = speed, callback = function(wp_index)
					if wp_index == 0 then
						move_left_count = move_left_count - 1
						self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(target_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
						character_util.spine_rotate(npc, 0, 0)
						character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, true)
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
					end
				end
			})
		end

		spin_move(player, center_pos + vector(-0.7, 0, 0), 4, 3)
		spin_move(sohee, center_pos + vector(0.7, 0, 0), 4, 2.5)

		while move_left_count > 0 do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		--이후 하단의 연출 진행.
		--
		local guards = {
			self.optimized_demons.guard_1,
			self.optimized_demons.guard_2,
			self.optimized_demons.guard_3,
		}

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(guard, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' },
				{ name = 'attack' })
		--경비원 (left, attack, release 2회) : 침입자다!!!
		character_util.set_emotion(player, {name = 'surprise'})
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, {name = 'surprise'})

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard, {key = talk_name .. 4, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})
		--경비원의 대사와 함께 화면 붉은 틴트로 빠르게 변경.
		--경비원 release끝나면 각 통로에서 경비가 run으로 달려와 좌, 우 3명 정도가 에워싼다. 이때 소히, 주인공은 서로 0.5타일로 붙어 좌우를 바라본 상태로 scared, cast 상태로 정렬한다.
		character_util.remove_anim(guard)

		character_util.set_emotion(guard, {name = 'attack'})
		character_util.set_group_emotion(guards, {name = 'attack'})
		character_util.set_position(guards[1], vector(reset_pos.x - 6, 0, center_pos.z))
		character_util.set_position(guards[2], vector(reset_pos.x - 6, 0, center_pos.z + 0.7))
		character_util.set_position(guards[3], guard_pos + vector(0.7, 0, -5))

		local gather_pos = {
			center_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0),
			center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1),
			center_pos + vector(2, 0, 0),
			center_pos + vector(0, 0, -1),
		}

		move_left_count = 4
		local move_done_cb_generator = function(wp_count)
			return function(wp_index)
				if wp_index == wp_count - 1 then
					move_left_count = move_left_count - 1
				end
			end
		end

		local guard_run_speed = 7

		--local dash_loop_sfxs = {}
		--
		--local dash_sfx_delays = {
		--	0.1,
		--	0.5,
		--	0.3,
		--}
		--
		--for i = 1, 3 do
		--	dash_loop_sfxs[i] = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		--		sfx_name = '01_dash_01', delayed_time = dash_sfx_delays[i], fade_in_time = 0.5,
		--		loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc'
		--	})
		--end

		local dash_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_dash_01', fade_in_time = 0.5,
			loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc'
		})

		wp_util.move_way_points(guards[1], {
			waypoints = gather_pos[1], speed = guard_run_speed, run = true, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right,
			callback = move_done_cb_generator(1), play_sfx = true,
		})
		wp_util.move_way_points(guards[2], {
			waypoints = {
				vector(reset_pos.x + 2.5, 0, guards[2].Position.z),
				vector(reset_pos.x + 2.5, 0, gather_pos[2].z),
				gather_pos[2]
			}, speed = guard_run_speed, run = true, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down,
			callback = move_done_cb_generator(3),
		})
		wp_util.move_way_points(guards[3], {
			waypoints = {
				vector(guards[3].Position.x, 0, guard.Position.z),
				vector(gather_pos[3].x, 0, guard.Position.z),
				gather_pos[3]
			}, speed = guard_run_speed, run = true, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left,
			callback = move_done_cb_generator(3),
		})
		wp_util.move_way_points(guard, {
			waypoints = gather_pos[4], speed = 4, run = true, callback = move_done_cb_generator(1),
		})

		character_util.set_emotion(player, {name = 'scared'})
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, {name = 'scared'})

		character_util.remove_anim(player)
		character_util.remove_anim(sohee)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
		character_util.mario_jump_new(player, 'left')
		character_util.mario_jump_async(sohee, 'right')

		sohee.LockedDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.None
		sohee.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

		character_util.set_anim(sohee, {name = 'cast'})
		character_util.set_anim(player, {name = 'cast'})

		while move_left_count > 0 do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		dash_loop_sfx:Stop()

		-- FIXME : 시간상 wp 안씀
		character_util.move_to(sohee, center_pos + vector(0.25, 0, 0),
				0.7, nil, false, true)
		character_util.move_to_async(player, center_pos + vector(-0.25, 0, 0),
				0.7, nil, false, true)

		--경비원 4명 일제히 표정 mad 되며 상, 하, 좌, 우, 순서로 빠르게 attack을 실행.
		--최초 attack이 실행 타이밍에 맞춰 플레이어 일행 damaged, prostrate 로 변경되고,
		--attack 에 맞춰 피격 이펙트가 반복 출력.
		--맞고있는 상태에서 슬로우 모션 실행.
		local temp_guards = {
			guards[1],
			guards[2],
			guards[3],
			guard
		}

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
		for i = 1, #temp_guards do
			local temp_guard = temp_guards[i]
			character_util.set_emotion(temp_guard, { name = 'mad' })
		end

		local offset = {
			vector(-1, 0, 0),
			vector(0, 0, 0.4),
			vector(1, 0, 0),
			vector(0, 0, -0.4),
		}
		local hit_effect_on = true
		local party_prostrated = false

		wait_for_sec(1)

		for i = 1, #temp_guards do
			local temp_guard = temp_guards[i]
			local pos = center_pos + offset[i]

			-- FIXME : Animtation Callback 쓰면 코루틴 없이 되지않을까...?
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				character_util.move_to_async(temp_guard, pos, 0.3, nil, true, true)

				-- 다음 순서까지 대기 시간 부여
				wait_for_sec(0.15 * (i - 1))

				local hit_pos = pos + direction_util.to_4way_vector3(temp_guard.Direction) * 0.3
						+ vector(0, 0.25, 0)

				character_util.set_anim(temp_guard, { name = 'attack' })
				while hit_effect_on do
					wait_for_sec(0.2)
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
					self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(hit_pos)
					character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(player)
					character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(player)
					character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(sohee)
					character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(sohee)

					-- 굳이 여러 번 부르지 않도록 함
					if not party_prostrated then
						party_prostrated = true
						character_util.set_group_anim_and_emotion({ player, sohee },
								{ name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
					end
					wait_for_sec(0.3)
				end
			end))
		end
		wait_for_sec(2)

		time_util.mod('slow_zoom', 0.5)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_evolve_result_01')
		field:Tint(self.security_alarm_event, unity_color({1, 0.6, 0.8, 1}), 0, 1)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 1)
		wait_for_sec(0.6)
		hit_effect_on = false
		wait_for_sec(0.4)
		for i = 1, #temp_guards do
			local temp_guard = temp_guards[i]
			character_util.set_anim(temp_guard, { name = 'attack', scale = 0 })
		end
		time_util.unmod('slow_zoom')

		--이후 틴트 연회색으로 바뀌며 천천히 줌 인.
		--1초가 지난 시점에서 틴트 진회색으로 바뀌며 플레이어 2타일 시점 위쯤으로 붉은색 wasted 문자 출력.
		--작업 예시입니다.
		--https://youtu.be/LKySCTQGZBI?t=225
		field:Tint(self.security_alarm_event, unity_color({ 0.8, 0.55, 0.35, 0.8 }), 0, 1)
		camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.2)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.2, 0)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_01')
		self:show_subtitle(talk_name .. 5)

		self:time_reset_event(function()
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

			character_util.hide_weapon(player, false)
			character_util.hide_weapon(sohee, false)

			character_util.stop(player)
			character_util.stop(sohee)

			character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(guards)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard)

			character_util.set_position(guards[1], vector(999, 0, 999))
			character_util.set_position(guards[2], vector(999, 0, 999))
			character_util.set_position(guards[3], vector(999, 0, 999))
			self:lab_3_setting()
			field:RemoveTint(self.security_alarm_event, 0)

			coroutine.yield()

			party_util.align_party(self.get_reset_pos(3, 2).position, 'left', 0, 'linear')
			camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
			camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:show_subtitle(key)
	yield_return_func(self.typing_text.SetTypedText, self.typing_text, game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(key), 1000, 0)
end

			util.cs_generator(function()
				wp_util.move_way_points_async(leader, {waypoints = self.get_3_3_leader_left_pos(10), speed = 5, run = true, play_sfx = true})

											  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'})
	--eat 모션 멈추면 책장에서 paper_piece가 드랍되면서 먹어짐

	local duration = 1
	local timer = 2
	local init_pos = sohee.Position + vector(-0.3, 0.5, 0)
	local dist = sohee.Position

	local ease_in_out = function(progress)
		if progress < 0 then progress = 0 end
		if progress > 1 then progress = 1 end
		return 0.5 - math.cos(math.pi * progress) * 0.5
	end

	local mv_level = 1
	local target_data = {
		{ pos = init_pos, duration = 0},
		{ pos = sohee.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0), duration = 0.6},
		{ pos = sohee.Position + vector(-0.6, 0.1, -0.1), duration = 0.8},
		{ pos = sohee.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, -0.2), duration = 0.5},
	}

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')
	while true do
		if timer > duration then
			init_pos = target_data[mv_level].pos
			paper.Position = init_pos
			mv_level = mv_level + 1
			if mv_level > 4 then break end
			if mv_level == 4 then
				paper.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			end
			duration = target_data[mv_level].duration
			dist = target_data[mv_level].pos - init_pos
			timer = 0
		end

		local prog = timer / duration
		paper.Position = init_pos + dist * ease_in_out(prog)

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	paper.ConsumeTarget = sohee

	character_util.remove_emotion(player)
	--선택지(초록색): 우리가 막는다.
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{talk_name .. 15 , 'mercy'}
	})
	--가디언 right, attack, victory_get
	character_util.set_emotion(player, {name = 'attack'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')

	if self.time_loop_text == nil then

	end

	self.time_loop_text.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self.time_loop_text.Label.width = 2000
	self.time_loop_text.Label.text = game_string:Format(string_key, '[ff0000]0[-]')
	self:fade_type_loop_text_in(self.time_loop_text, text_fade_duration)

	local cur_wait_time = 1.5
	wait_for_sec(cur_wait_time)

	-- 태양제까지 1시간 ~ 24시간
	local time_count = 24
	local acceleration = 0.75
	local acceleration_limit = 0.05
	for i = 1, time_count do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_number_01')
		self.time_loop_text.Label.text = game_string:Format(string_key, i)
		cur_wait_time = cur_wait_time * acceleration
		if cur_wait_time <= acceleration_limit then
			cur_wait_time = acceleration_limit
		end
		wait_for_sec(cur_wait_time)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	wait_for_sec(2)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(2)

function local_class:show_promiscuous_time_loop_text()
	if self.time_loop_text == nil then
		return
	end

	self.time_loop_text.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	-- 태양제까지 0시간
	local text_fade_duration = 2
	local string_key = 'ds_main_explosion_1'
	self.time_loop_text.Label.pivot = CS.UIWidget.Pivot.Top
	self.time_loop_text.Label.width = 2000
	self.time_loop_text.Label.text = game_string:Format(string_key, '[ff0000]0[-]')
	self:fade_type_loop_text_in(self.time_loop_text, text_fade_duration)

	local cur_wait_time = 1.5
	wait_for_sec(cur_wait_time)

	-- 태양제까지 1시간 ~ 5시간
	local time_count = 5
	local acceleration = 0.75
	local acceleration_limit = 0.05

	for i = 1, time_count do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_number_01')
		self.time_loop_text.Label.text = game_string:Format(string_key, i)
		cur_wait_time = cur_wait_time * acceleration
		if cur_wait_time <= acceleration_limit then
			cur_wait_time = acceleration_limit
		end
		wait_for_sec(cur_wait_time)
	end

	-- 1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 20부터 99 까지 랜덤한 숫자 50번 돌림
	time_count = 50
	cur_wait_time = 0.05
	for _ = 1, time_count do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_number_01')
		local rnd_value = random_util.get_random_int(20, 99)
		self.time_loop_text.Label.text = game_string:Format(string_key, '[ff0000]' .. rnd_value .. '[-]')
		wait_for_sec(cur_wait_time)
	end

	-- 20부터 29까지 랜덤한 숫자 20번 돌림
	time_count = 20
	cur_wait_time = 0.05
	for _ = 1, time_count do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_number_01')
		local rnd_value = random_util.get_random_int(20, 29)
		self.time_loop_text.Label.text = game_string:Format(string_key, '[ff0000]' .. rnd_value .. '[-]')
		wait_for_sec(cur_wait_time)
	end

	-- 23으로 1초 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_number_01')
	self.time_loop_text.Label.text = game_string:Format(string_key, '[ff0000]23[-]')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 24로 2초 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	self.time_loop_text.Label.text = game_string:Format(string_key, '[ff0000]24[-]')
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(2)
end

-- 시간 플 텍스트 페이드
function local_class:show_time_text(time_count, wait_time, fade_out_time)
	if self.time_loop_text == nil then
		return
	end

	self.time_loop_text.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	-- 태양제까지 24시간
	local text_fade_duration = 2
	local string_key = 'ds_main_explosion_1'
	self.time_loop_text.Label.pivot = CS.UIWidget.Pivot.Top
	self.time_loop_text.Label.width = 2000
	self.time_loop_text.Label.text = game_string:Format(string_key, time_count)
	self:fade_type_loop_text_in(self.time_loop_text, text_fade_duration)

	wait_for_sec(wait_time)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(fade_out_time, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.time_loop_text.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:fade_type_loop_text_in(typing_text, duration)
	local cur_time = 0
	typing_text.Label.alpha = 0
	while cur_time < duration do
		cur_time = cur_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		typing_text.Label.alpha = cur_time / duration
		if typing_text.Label.alpha >= 1 then break end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	typing_text.Label.alpha = 1
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's10_enter_vampire_town') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_vampire_town, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.entrance_vampire_town and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's10_start_puzzle') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_puzzle, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.starting_puzzle and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's10_end_puzzle') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.end_puzzle, self))

		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.ending_puzzle and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's10_hide_in_fence') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.hide_in_fence, self)

		return true
	end

	if not self.is_show_npc_talking_event and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's10_npc_talking_event') then

		self.is_show_npc_talking_event = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_npc, self))

		return true
	end

	if not self.is_detected and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.hiding_in_fence and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's10_detected_with_steward') then

		self.is_detected = true

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.detected_with_steward, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_hole()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_hole, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- FieldObjectDestroyedEvent
function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if not self.is_showing_breakable_event_1 and self:check_destroyed_pos(e.OldPosition, self.event_zone.part_1) and
		string.find(e.FieldObject.Name, 's10_breakable_1_') then

		self.is_showing_breakable_event_1 = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.destroy_breakable_part_1, self))

		return true
	end

	if self:check_destroyed_pos(e.OldPosition, self.event_zone.part_2) and
		string.find(e.FieldObject.Name, 's10_breakable_2_') then

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.destroy_breakable_part_2, self))

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- GotCrashedEvent
function local_class:on_got_crashed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Crash.other, user_party.Leader) and
		string.find(e.Crash.self.Name, 'vampire_town_guard_') then

		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		character_util.look_at(e.Crash.self, user_party.Leader)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.is_qte_success = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	-- 프리실라 (left, idle, idle) : 볕이 잘 들지 않는 고급 주택가예요. 뱀파이어들이 모여 사는 곳이죠.

		leader.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), CS.Oak.Direction.Left, game_string:GetString(stage.Name))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

--- 뱀파이어 거주지역에 입장
function local_class:enter_vampire_town()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local sohee = user_party[1]

	sohee:HideWeapon(true)

	local align_pos = self.get_entrance_align_pos()
	party_util.align_party(align_pos, 'right', 1, 'arc')

	-- 소히 (left, attack) : 잠깐! 저길 봐!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s10_1', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)

	-- 마을 중앙으로 카메라 이동해서, 열 맞춰 진입하는 로얄가드 보여줌.
	local town_center_pos = self.get_town_center_pos()

	local guards = {}
	local guard_speed = 1.5
	local move_dist = 5

	local guard_1 = self.get_guard(1)
	local guard_1_end_pos = guard_1.Position + vector(move_dist, 0, 0)

	for i = 1, 8 do
		local guard = self.get_guard(i)
		character_util.move_waypoint(guard, guard.Position + vector(move_dist, 0, 0), guard_speed)
		table.insert(guards, guard)
	end

	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	camera_util.move(town_center_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0), 2)

	while not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(guard_1.Position) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_soldiers_01')

	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.stop(guard_1)

	-- 로얄가드1 : 반역자들이 이곳으로 향했다는 본부의 연락이다!
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(
			character_util.move_waypoint_async, guard_1, guard_1_end_pos, guard_speed),
		util.cs_generator(
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, guard_1, { key = 'ds_main_s10_2', skip = true })
	})

	character_util.set_direction(guard_1, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(guard_1, { name = 'cast2' })
	-- 로얄가드1 (left, cast2) : 출구를 막고 샅샅이 뒤져라!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_1, { key = 'ds_main_s10_3', skip = true })

	-- 로얄가드1 right, release x 2, 이후 병사들 흩어지며 카메라 원위치.
	character_util.remove_anim(guard_1)
	character_util.set_direction(guard_1, 'right')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(guard_1,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	for index, guard in pairs(guards) do
		local detect_pos = self.get_guard_detect_pos(index)
		local detect_dir = self.get_guard_detect_dir(index)

		local guard_waypoint = {
			vector(guard.Position.x, 0, detect_pos.z),
			detect_pos
		}

		character_util.move_waypoint(guard, guard_waypoint,
			5, true, nil, nil, detect_dir)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 소히와 가디언 surprised, jump x 1
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(sohee)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, '01_player_jump_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })
	-- 소히 (right, attack) : 어떻게든 놈들 포위망을 뚫어야 해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s10_4', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)

	-- 가디언 nod
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'nod' })

	character_util.set_direction(guards[2], 'left')

	for index, guard in pairs(guards) do
		if index ~= 1 then
			if index ~= 2 then
				local detect_pos = self.get_guard_detect_pos(index)

				character_util.stop(guard)
				guard.Position = detect_pos
			end

			local detect_dir = self.get_guard_detect_dir(index)
			character_util.set_direction(guard, detect_dir)
		end

		local sight_distance = self.sight_distance
		local sight_angle = self.sight_angle

		if index >= 3 and index <= 4 then
			sight_angle = self.sight_angle + 10
		end

		self.stop_detecting[guard] = false
		self.detecting_data[guard] = {
			sight_distance = sight_distance,
			sight_angle = sight_angle
		}

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.detect_update, self, guard))
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
		util.cs_generator(self.change_detecting_direction, self, guard_1, { 'right', 'down' }))

	sohee:HideWeapon(false)
end

function local_class:end_puzzle()

	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(count_daughter, 'right')

	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'smile' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s10_7', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		-- 가디언 : victory 모션
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })

		-- 프레실라 : smile, nod

		character_util.set_emotion(count_daughter, { name = 'smile' })
