		wait_for_sec(2)

		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
		character_util.remove_emotion(count_daughter)
	end))

	-- 병사들은 병사들대로 서칭 끄고 down 상태로 물음표 버블 출력. 0.5초 후 왼쪽 병사가 방향 전환+대사
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local guard = self.get_guard(i)
		self.stop_detecting[guard] = true
	end

	character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(guard_3, nil,
		'question', nil, { emoticon_time = { 0.5, 1, 0.2 } })
	character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(guard_4, nil,
		'question', nil, { emoticon_time = { 0.5, 1, 0.2 } })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(guard_3, 'right')
	-- 로얄가드1 (right, idle, idle) : 이뭐가 이렇게 소란이지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_3, { key = 'ds_main_s10_8', skip = true })

	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(count_daughter, 'down')

	-- 로얄 가드 두 명 동시에 up 으로 방향 전환, 이후 딜레이 없이 아래 진행
	character_util.set_direction(guard_3, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(guard_4, 'up')

	-- 로얄가드1, 2 (느낌표 버블, jump x 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon(guard_3, nil, 'notice')
	character_util.normal_jump(guard_3, '01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon(guard_4, nil, 'notice')
	character_util.normal_jump(guard_4, '01_player_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	party_util.set_direction('down')
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'surprise' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_anim(guard_4, { name = 'attack', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	-- 로얄가드2 (up , attack x 1) : 저기다! 반역자를 찾았다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_4, { key = 'ds_main_s10_10', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard_4)

	-- 가디언 일행 down, suprised 1초 이후 컨트롤 풀림.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.7)

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	self.detecting_data[guard_3].sight_distance = 3
	self.detecting_data[guard_3].sight_angle = 120
	self.detecting_data[guard_4].sight_distance = 3
	self.detecting_data[guard_4].sight_angle = 120

	self.stop_detecting[guard_3] = false
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.detect_update, self, guard_3))
	self.stop_detecting[guard_4] = false
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.detect_update, self, guard_4))

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, vector(91.5, 0, 21.5), true)

	sohee:HideWeapon(false)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	self:move_detecting_guard()
end

--- 담장에 숨는 이벤트
function local_class:hide_in_fence()
	self.is_detected = true

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local sohee = user_party[1]
	local count_daughter = user_party[2]

	local guard_3 = self.get_guard(3)
	local guard_4 = self.get_guard(4)

	character_util.stop(guard_4)

	local moving_guard_end_pos = self.get_moving_guard_end_pos()

	if guard_3.Position.z < moving_guard_end_pos.z - 2 then
		wp_util.move_way_points(guard_3,
				{ waypoints = vector(guard_3.Position.x, 0, moving_guard_end_pos.z - 2), speed = 1.5})
		wp_util.move_way_points(guard_4,
				{ waypoints = vector(guard_4.Position.x, 0, moving_guard_end_pos.z - 2), speed = 1.5})

		coroutine.yield()

	character_util.stop(guard_3)
	character_util.stop(guard_4)

	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

	time_util.unmod(qte_time_key)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	local party_hiding_pos = self.get_party_hiding_pos()

		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(fo)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	end

	self.stop_detecting[guard_3] = true
	self.stop_detecting[guard_4] = true

	local wait_routines = {
		util.cs_generator(
				character_util.move_waypoint_async, guard_3, vector(guard_3.Position.x, 0, moving_guard_end_pos.z), 3),
		util.cs_generator(
				character_util.move_waypoint_async, guard_4, vector(guard_4.Position.x, 0, moving_guard_end_pos.z), 3),
	}

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(wait_routines, util.cs_generator(jump_move_routine, user_party[i],
				party_hiding_pos + vector(1, 0, 0) + 0.75 * i * unity_class.vector3.right, 0.6 + i * 0.1))
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	wait_all(wait_routines)

	--character_util.move_waypoint(guard_3, vector(guard_3.Position.x, 0, moving_guard_end_pos.z), 3)
	--
	--wait_all({
	--	util.cs_generator(
	--		character_util.move_waypoint_async, guard_4, vector(guard_4.Position.x, 0, moving_guard_end_pos.z), 3),
	--	util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, leader, waypoint[leader], 4, false, nil, nil, 'left'),
	--	util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, sohee, waypoint[sohee], 4, false, nil, nil, 'left'),
	--	util.cs_generator(
	--		character_util.move_waypoint_async, count_daughter, waypoint[count_daughter], 3, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	--})

	-- 저택 담장 앞에 당도해 좌우 두리번 거린 후 로얄 가드 대사.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(guard_3, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(guard_4, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(guard_3, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(guard_4, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'walk4leg', scale = 0 })
	sohee.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

--- 구멍으로 들어가는 이벤트
function local_class:enter_hole()
	self.is_detected = true

	local hole = self.get_hole()

	local dir_vector = unity_class.vector3.right
	local dir = 'left'

	if hole.Position.x > user_party.Leader.Position.x then
		dir_vector = unity_class.vector3.left
		dir = 'right'
	end

	-- 구멍으로 빠지는 연출
	local hole_in_func = function(target)
		character_util.move_to_async(target, hole.Position + dir_vector,
			0.2, nil, true, true)

		character_util.set_locked_dir(target, dir)
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'get' })
		character_util.jump(target, 1, 1)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(target, hole.Position + 0.3 * dir_vector, 1)

		character_util.spine_scale(target, unity_class.vector3.zero, 0.5)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(target,
			hole.Position + vector(0, 0.13, -0.2), 1)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(hole_in_func, user_party[i]))
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	local guard_3 = self.get_guard(3)
	self.stop_detecting[guard_3] = true

	local guard_4 = self.get_guard(4)
	self.stop_detecting[guard_4] = true

	-- npc 상태 리셋
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		character_util.stop(party_member)
		character_util.set_locked_dir(party_member, 'none')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(party_member)
		character_util.spine_scale(party_member, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	end

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
end

--- 가드들의 감시에 걸렸을 때
function local_class:on_detected(guard)
	self.attack_range_renderer[guard]:Update(guard)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	if self.is_showing_breakable_event_2 then
		character_util.stop(user_party.Leader)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 집사 감시에 걸렸을 때
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(guard, self.get_steward()) then
		self:detected_with_steward()

		self:restart_detecting_setting(guard)
		return
	end

	local guard_3 = self.get_guard(3)
	local guard_4 = self.get_guard(4)

	character_util.stop(guard_3)
	character_util.stop(guard_4)

	party_util.look_at(guard)
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'surprise' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'embarrassed' })
	party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

	-- 찾았다!
	character_util.set_emotion(guard, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(guard, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard, { key = 'ds_main_s10_43', bubble_type = 'shout' })

	self:restart_detecting_setting(guard)
end

--- 감시 재시작 세팅
function local_class:restart_detecting_setting(guard)
	local guard_3 = self.get_guard(3)
	local guard_4 = self.get_guard(4)

	character_util.stop(guard_3)
	character_util.stop(guard_4)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard)

	local reset_pos = self.get_detecting_reset_pos(1)
	local reset_dir = self.get_detecting_reset_dir(1)

	-- 이벤트가 추가 되어 상황에 따른 예외 처리 추가
	if self.is_showing_breakable_event_2 and lua_helper.reference_equals(guard, guard_3) then
		reset_pos = vector(86, 1, 2)
		reset_dir = 'left'

		character_util.set_direction(guard_3, 'down')
		self.attack_range_renderer[guard_3]:Update(guard_3)

		local switch = get_field_object('s10_breakable_reset_2')
		message_system:SendSync(switch, CS.Oak.FloorSwitchStepOnEvent.Create(user_party.Leader))

	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.starting_puzzle then
		-- 가장 가까운 리셋 지점으로 리셋
		local dist = (user_party.Leader.Position - reset_pos).sqrMagnitude

		for i = 2, 3 do
			local new_reset_pos = self.get_detecting_reset_pos(i)
			local new_dist = (user_party.Leader.Position - new_reset_pos).sqrMagnitude

			if new_dist < dist then
				dist = new_dist
				reset_pos = new_reset_pos
				reset_dir = self.get_detecting_reset_dir(i)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.ending_puzzle then
		reset_pos = self.get_puzzle_ending_pos()
		reset_dir = 'down'

	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.hiding_in_fence then
		reset_pos = self.get_party_hiding_pos() + vector(4, 0, 0)
		reset_dir = 'left'
	end

	-- 분기별 세팅
	if self.current_progress <= self.progress_enum.starting_puzzle then
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local detecting_guard = self.get_guard(i)
			character_util.set_direction(detecting_guard, self.get_guard_detect_dir(i))

			if i == 8 and self.is_show_breakable_event_1 then
				character_util.set_direction(detecting_guard, 'left')
			end
		end

		self.attack_range_renderer[guard]:Update(guard)

	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.ending_puzzle then
		guard_3.Position = self.get_guard_detect_pos(3)
		guard_4.Position = self.get_guard_detect_pos(4)

	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.hiding_in_fence then
		local steward = self.get_steward()
		character_util.set_emotion(steward, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim(steward, { name = 'question', loop = false })

		guard_3.Position = self.get_moving_guard_end_pos() + vector(-1.5, 0, 0)
		character_util.set_direction(guard_3, 'left')
		self.attack_range_renderer[guard_3]:Update(guard_3)

		guard_4.Position = self.get_moving_guard_end_pos() + vector(1.5, 0, 0)
		character_util.set_direction(guard_4, 'right')
		self.attack_range_renderer[guard_4]:Update(guard_4)
	end

	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.align_party(reset_pos, reset_dir, 0, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	self.is_detected = false
	self.is_showing_breakable_event_2 = false

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	-- 가드 움직임
	self:move_detecting_guard()
end

--- 방향 전환 감시 루틴
function local_class:change_detecting_direction(fo, directions)
	while not self.stop_detecting[fo] do
		for _, dir in pairs(directions) do
			character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)
			wait_for_sec(2)

			while self.is_detected do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if self.stop_detecting[fo] then
				break
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

--- 감시 체크 업데이트
function local_class:detect_update(fo)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	local sight_distance = self.detecting_data[fo].sight_distance
	local sight_angle = self.detecting_data[fo].sight_angle
	local custom_checker = self.detecting_data[fo].custom_checker

	local attack_range_renderer = CS.Oak.GhostGuardAttackRangeRenderer(fo, sight_distance, sight_angle)
	self.attack_range_renderer[fo] = attack_range_renderer
	attack_range_renderer.AttackRange:Show(0)

	while not self.stop_detecting[fo] do
		if not self.is_detected and self:is_in_sight(fo, leader) then
			if custom_checker == nil or custom_checker() then
				self.is_detected = true

				self:on_detected(fo)
			end
		end

		attack_range_renderer:Update(fo)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	attack_range_renderer:Dispose()
	self.attack_range_renderer[fo] = nil
end

--- 플레이어가 감시에 보이는지 체크
function local_class:is_in_sight(fo, target)
	local diff = target.Position - fo.Position

	local sight_distance = self.detecting_data[fo].sight_distance
	local sight_angle = self.detecting_data[fo].sight_angle

	-- 2층 거리 차이는 감시 제외
	local offset = 0.8
	if math.abs(diff.y) > offset then
		return false
	end

	if diff.magnitude > sight_distance then
		return false
	end

	diff.y = 0

	if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized, direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)) > sight_angle / 2 then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:check_destroyed_pos(old_pos, event_zone)
	if old_pos.x > event_zone.min.x and old_pos.z > event_zone.min.z and
		old_pos.x < event_zone.max.x and old_pos.z < event_zone.max.z then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

		if self.current_state == self.event_state.paper_bag then
			self.current_state = self.event_state.enter_kitchen
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.s11_scene_1, self)
		end
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.player, self.serving_zone_name) then
		if self.current_state == self.event_state.serving then
			self.current_state = self.event_state.food_served
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.s11_scene_2, self)
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.player, 'kitchen_table_zone') then
		if not self.missing_item_oneline_seen then
			self.missing_item_oneline_seen = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.missing_something, self))
		end


	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage then return end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, self.player, self.kitchen_name) then
		if self.current_state == self.event_state.enter_kitchen then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.chef_blocks, self, false))
			return true
		elseif self.current_state == self.event_state.serving then
			if self.player.Position.z > self.chef.Position.z + 1 or self.player.Position.x > self.chef.Position.x + 2 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.chef_blocks, self, true))
			end
			return true
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, self.player, self.main_hall_name) then
		if self.current_state == self.event_state.serving then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sohee_blocks, self))
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	local target = self.item_holders[1].fo
	if not self.is_hold then return false end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.player) then
		local ydiff = self.player.Hitbox.size.y * 0.7 + 0.45
		target.Position = self.player.Position + vector(0, 1, 0) * ydiff
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage then return end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.item_holders[1].fo) and
			self.current_state == self.event_state.enter_kitchen then
		self.current_state = self.event_state.serving
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_food_hold_up, self, e.Target))
	end

end

		c.CustomWalkAnimationName = hide and 'walk' or nil
	end
end

function local_class:opening_scene()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	--지하 식료품 창고 페이드 인
	--
	--위에서 떨어지는 일행. (left, damaged, prostrate)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	camera_util.move_async(self.default_start_pos + vector(-3, 0, 0), 0)

	local ff_routine = function(target, offset, delay)
		local aIn = 16/0.49
		local d = 8
		local v = 0
		local progress = 0
		--free_fall:SetParameters(0.7, 8, 0)
		character_util.set_position(target, self.default_start_pos + vector(0, d, 0))
		character_util.set_anim(target, {name = 'get'})
		character_util.set_direction(target, 'left')

		character_util.set_active_shadow(target, false)
		wait_for_sec(delay)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

		while d > 0 do
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
			character_util.set_position(target, self.default_start_pos
					+ offset * progress + vector(0, d, 0))

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			v = v + aIn * dt
			d = d - v * dt

			progress = progress + dt
		end

		if delay == 0 then
			camera_util.shake(0.04, 0.6)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_02')
		character_util.set_active_shadow(target, true)
		character_util.set_position(target, self.default_start_pos	+ offset)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(target, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'damaged'})
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(target)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)

		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		character_util.shake_and_wakeup(target, 'left', 1, nil, true)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.player = user_party.Leader
	camera_util.move_async(self.default_start_pos + vector(-3, 0, 0), 0)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	self:hide_weapons_for_party(true)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	local offsets = {
		vector(-1.3, 0, 0.3),
		vector(-0.3, 0, 0.7),
		vector(0.2, 0, -0.2),
		vector(0, 0, 0.3),
	}
	local ffs = {}
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(ffs, util.cs_generator(ff_routine, user_party[i], offsets[i+1], i * 0.3))
	end

	wait_all(ffs)
	--이후 get 점프하며 일행들 일어남.
	--소히 right, left 본 뒤

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.sohee, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.sohee, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(self.player, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--소히(left, idle, idle): 여긴…저택 지하인가…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sohee, {key = self.talk_name .. 1, skip = true})
	--프리실라(left, tired, idle) : 이렇게 몰래 들어와도 되는 걸까요…
	character_util.set_emotion(self.daughter, {name = 'tired'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.daughter, {key = self.talk_name .. '1_0', skip = true})
	--소히(right, attack, bomb_idle) : 높은 사람 집이라면서? 당연히 안 되겠지.
	character_util.set_direction(self.sohee, 'right')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.sohee, {name = 'bomb_idle'}, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sohee, {key = self.talk_name .. '1_1', skip = true})
	--소히(left, attack, idle) : 걸리면 좋은 꼴은 못 볼 테니까... 몰래 빠져나갈 방법이나 찾아보자고.
	party_util.remove_animation()
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sohee, {key = self.talk_name .. '1_2', skip = true})

	party_util.remove_emotion()

	self.current_state = self.event_state.paper_bag

	yield_return_func(self.breadcilla_joins, self)

	character_util.set_direction(self.player, 'left')
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	self:hide_weapons_for_party(false)

	if self.start_this_progress then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

		music_player:PlayStageIntroMusic()
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		character_util.set_anim(self.player, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		character_util.remove_anim(self.player)
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	end

	--컨트롤 풀림
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:breadcilla_joins()
	local talk_name = self.talk_name .. 'paper_'
	local bag_pos = field:GetMarker(self.paper_bag_marker_name).position
	local pos = bag_pos + vector(1.5, 0, -1)
	--트리거 존 진입 시, 가디언과 프리실라 상단 위치까지 천천히 걸어가고 소히는 파란점까지 걸어가다 멈춤
	self:hide_weapons_for_party(true)

	character_util.move_waypoint(self.daughter, { vector(self.daughter.Position.x, 0, bag_pos.z - 1),
												  bag_pos + vector(2, 0, -1) }, 2, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.4)
	character_util.set_direction(self.sohee, 'left')
	character_util.move_waypoint(self.player, { vector(self.player.Position.x, 0, bag_pos.z),
													  bag_pos + vector(2, 0, 0) }, 2, false)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--이후 가디언, 프리실라 상단 위치에 도착하자마자 소히 대사 출력

	--소히(down, attack, jumpx1) : 잠깐!
	character_util.set_emotion(self.sohee, {name = 'attack'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(self.sohee)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sohee, {key = talk_name .. 1, skip = true})
	--소히 상단 대사 후 가디언, 프리실라에게 0.5타일 다가가서 (down, attack, shoot) + shake 자세로 가디언, 프리실라 위로 1타일 옮긴다.
	character_util.move_to_async(self.sohee, bag_pos + vector(2.5, 0, -0.5), nil, 4, true, true)
	character_util.set_anim(self.sohee, {name = 'shoot', upper = true})
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	--가디언, 프리실라 down, surprise, embrassed 상태로 위로 한 타일 이동. (소히에게 끌려가듯이)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'damaged'})
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.daughter, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'damaged'})
	character_util.move_to(self.player, bag_pos + vector(3, 0, 0), nil, 1.5, false, false)
	character_util.move_to(self.daughter, bag_pos + vector(3, 0, -1), nil, 1.5, false, false)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.sohee, bag_pos + vector(4, 0, -0.5), nil, 1.5, false, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.sohee, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.player)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.daughter)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	--이후 가디언 프리실라 up
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.player)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.daughter)
	character_util.set_direction(self.player, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(self.daughter, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	--소히(down, attack, attack 1회) :  [small]설마 이대로 가려는 건 아니지?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sohee, {key = talk_name .. 2, skip = true, scale = 0.85})
	--가디언 (up, idle) emoticon_bubble_question
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.player, nil, 'question')
	--소히(down, attack, release2) : 백작의 딸이 돌아다니면 모두가 알아볼 텐데, 몰래 나갈 수나 있겠어?!
	character_util.set_anim(self.sohee, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sohee, {key = talk_name .. 3, skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(self.sohee)
	--프리실라(up, jumpx1)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(self.daughter, true)
	--프리실라(right, tired, idle) : 그럼 어떻게 해야…
	character_util.set_direction(self.daughter, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(self.player, 'right')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.daughter, {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.daughter, {key = talk_name .. 4, skip = true})
	--소히(right - > left -> up, attack, idle) : 뭔가 방법이 있을 텐데…
	local wait_token = true

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(self.sohee, 'right')
		wait_for_sec(1)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(self.sohee, 'left')
		wait_for_sec(1)
		wait_token = false
	end))

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sohee, {key = talk_name .. 5, skip = true})

	while wait_token do coroutine.yield() end

	--이후 소히 (up) emoticon_bubble_exclamtion
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.sohee, nil, 'notice')
	--
	camera_util.move(pos, 1)
	--파란점(소히)
	--소히 상단 위치에서 (left, attack, eat)
	character_util.set_direction(self.daughter, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(self.player, 'left')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.sohee, {
			bag_pos + vector(1, 0, -0.5), bag_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)},
			5, true, nil, nil, 'left', true)
	--소히 eat 하기 시작하면 프리실라가 1.5타일 앞으로 나오면서 대사

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.sohee, {name = 'eat'}, {name = 'attack'})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.move_waypoint(self.player, {
		bag_pos + vector(3, 0, -1), bag_pos + vector(2, 0, -1)},
			2, false, nil, nil, 'up', false)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.daughter, {
		bag_pos + vector(2, 0, -1), bag_pos + vector(2, 0, -2), bag_pos + vector(1, 0, -2)},
			2, false, nil, nil, 'up', false)
	--프리실라(up) : 뭘 찾으시는 건가요…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.daughter, {key = talk_name .. 6, skip = true})
	--소히(left, attack, eat) : 기다려 봐!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sohee, {key = talk_name .. 7, skip = true})
	--소히 eat모션 1초 유지, eat모션 동안 사방으로 아이템들이 드랍된다. (dropitem으로 남아 있지 않고, 날아가는 연출만)

	local item_dispose = function(target)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(target, 0, 0.5)
			target:ConsumeComplete()
		end))
	end

	local item_airdrop = function(duration)
		local remain = duration
		local item_pool = {
			20665,
			20666,
			20667,
			20666,
			20665,
			20667,
			20665,
			20666,
		}
		local offset_pool = {
			vector(2, 0, 0),
			vector(1.8, 0, -0.3),
			vector(1.5, 0, -0.7),
			vector(2.1, 0, -0.3),
			vector(1.2, 0, -1),
			vector(2.6, 0, -1),
			vector(3.2, 0, -0.2),
			vector(2.8, 0, -0.5),
		}
		local items = {}
		local timer = 0
		local index = 1
		while remain > 0 or #items > 0 do
			if timer > 0.2 and remain > 0 then
				remain = remain - timer
				timer = 0

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
				local drop_pos = random_util.get_random_int(1, 8)
				local item = drop_item_util.create_item({itemid = item_pool[index],
														 pos = bag_pos + vector(0.5, 0.4, 0), target = bag_pos + offset_pool[drop_pos],
														 sprscale = 0.6, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'})

				table.insert(items, item)
				index = index + 1
				if index > 8 then index = 1 end
			end

			if #items > 0 and items[1].SpriteTransform.position.y < 0.2 then
				item_dispose(items[1])
				character_util.set_direction(self.player, 'left')
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'damaged'})
				table.remove(items, 1)
			end
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	--날아가는 아이템 스프라이트
	--바나나(Banana), 햄(ham), 핫소스(hot_sauce)
	yield_return_func(item_airdrop, 1.8)

	--이후 소히(left, attack, eat) emoticon_bubble_exclamtion
	eat_sfx:Stop()
	eat_sfx = nil
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player, {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'tired'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.sohee, {name = 'eat', loop = false}, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.sohee, nil, 'notice')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.player)

	character_util.hide_weapon(self.sohee, false, 'party_on_event')

	--소히(left, smile, victory_get)으로 빵 봉투 꺼내면서 대사 출력
	self.sohee.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'paper_bag')
	self.sohee.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')
	--소히(left, smile, victory_get) : 좋아! 이거면 되겠어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.sohee, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sohee, {key = talk_name .. 8, skip = true})
	--아이템 스프라이트 : paper_bag
	--빵 봉투
	--소히가 프리실라 왼쪽 0.5타일 간격으로 다가가서 (right, attack, shoot) + shake 자세로 가디언, 프리실라 좌측으로 1타일 옮긴다.
	character_util.move_to_async(self.sohee, self.daughter.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), nil, 4, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.sohee, self.daughter.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 1), nil, 4, true, true)

function local_class:chef_blocks(is_hold)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local pos_diff = self.player.Position - self.chef.Position
	local mov = vector(0,0,0)

	--쉐프: [shout] 서빙 안 하고 어디 가!
	character_util.look_at(self.chef, self.player)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.chef, {key = self.talk_name .. 'block_chef', skip = true,
															 bubble_type = 'shout'})

	if pos_diff.z > 1 then
		mov = vector(0,0,-1)
	elseif pos_diff.x < 1 then
		mov = vector(1,0,0)
	else
		mov = vector(-1,0,0)
	end
	character_util.move_distance_async(self.player, mov, 0.5,
			nil, true, true, nil)

	character_util.set_direction(self.chef, 'left')
	--음식을 들지 않고 주방 밖으로 나가려고 하면 트리거 존. 하단 대사 출력 후 주방쪽으로 2걸음
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	if is_hold then

		local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
		manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
		message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('DemonShireMainSection12')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DemonShireMain @
		Comment = DemonShireMain 퀘스트 섹션 12 @
		Index = 11 @
		NextSections = 12 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.event_state = {
		init = 1,
		corpse = 2,
		steward = 3,
		to_lobby = 4,
		lobby = 5,
		lobby_revealed = 6,
		lobby_sneak = 7,
		rep = 8,
		rep_findway = 9,
		rep_openway = 10,
		rep_sneak = 11,
		aide = 12,
		son = 13,
	}
	self.current_state = self.event_state.init

	self.target_stage = 'demonshire_2_4'

	self.start_this_progress = false

	self.default_marker_name = 'default_start'

	self.player = nil
	self.sohee = nil
	self.daughter = nil

	self.chef = nil

	self.drink_item = nil
	self.bottle_item = nil

	self.elder = nil
	self.elder_son = nil
	self.nobles = {}
	self.rep = nil
	self.aide = nil
	self.demons = {}
	self.blocker_demon = nil

	self.get_twinkle_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle') end

	self.get_vampire_steward = function(idx)
		return get_character('s11_vampire_steward_' .. idx)
	end

	self.twinkle_fx = nil

	self.talk_name = 'ds_main_s12_'
	self.front_sneak_zone = 's12_sneak_front'
	self.rep_sneak_zone = 's12_sneak_rep'
	self.front_reveal_zone = 's12_path_reveal_zone'

	self.item_holder_name = 'invisible_item_holder_'
	self.item_holders = {}

	self.missing_item_oneline_seen = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == self.target_stage then
		if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 10 then
			self.start_this_progress = true
		end

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

		self.get_twinkle_effect()
		self:s12_npcs_setting()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self.sohee = user_party[1]
	self.daughter = user_party[2]
	--
	--self.current_state = self.event_state.rep_findway
	--sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.s12_interact_rep, self, true)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name == self.target_stage then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

		if self.twinkle_fx ~= nil then
			self.twinkle_fx:Dispose()
			self.twinkle_fx = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage then return end

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.wine_steward) and self.current_state == self.event_state.corpse then
		self.current_state = self.event_state.steward
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.s12_interact_wine_steward, self)
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.front_clerk) then
		if self.current_state < self.event_state.lobby_sneak then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.s12_interact_front, self, false)
		elseif self.current_state == self.event_state.lobby_sneak then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.s12_interact_front, self, true)
		end
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.rep) and self.current_state == self.event_state.rep then
		self.current_state = self.event_state.rep_findway
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.s12_interact_rep, self, true)
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_vampire_steward(6)) and self.current_state == self.event_state.rep_openway then
		self.current_state = self.event_state.rep_sneak
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.open_the_path, self, true)
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.aide) and self.current_state == self.event_state.aide then
		self.current_state = self.event_state.son
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.s12_interact_aide, self, true)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage then return end

	self.player = user_party.Leader
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.item_holders[1]) and self.current_state == self.event_state.init then
		self.current_state = self.event_state.corpse
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.s12_interact_glass, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage then return end

	self.player = user_party.Leader
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.player, self.front_reveal_zone) then
		if self.current_state == self.event_state.steward then
			self.current_state = self.event_state.to_lobby
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s12_path_repairing, self))
			return true
		elseif self.current_state == self.event_state.lobby then
			self.current_state = self.event_state.lobby_revealed
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.s12_path_revealed, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.player, self.front_sneak_zone) then
		if self.current_state == self.event_state.lobby_revealed then
			self.current_state = self.event_state.lobby_sneak
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s12_sneak_front_man, self))
			return true
		end

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.player, self.rep_sneak_zone) then
		if self.current_state == self.event_state.rep_sneak then
			self.current_state = self.event_state.aide
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s12_sneak_rep_scene, self))
			return true
		end

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.player, 'main_hall_zone') then
		if self.current_state == self.event_state.rep_findway then
			self.current_state = self.event_state.rep_openway
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.s12_lets_sneak_in, self)
			return true
		end

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.player, 'kitchen_table_zone') then
		if not self.missing_item_oneline_seen then
			self.missing_item_oneline_seen = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.missing_something, self))
		end

	end

	return false
end

function local_class:s12_interact_glass()
	self:hide_weapons_for_party(true)
	self.item_holders[1].fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	local fo = self.item_holders[1].fo

	character_util.move_to(self.player, fo.Position + vector(-0.1, 0, 0.7), 1, nil, true, true)
	character_util.move_to(self.sohee, fo.Position + vector(-0.7, 0, -0.2), 1, nil, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.daughter, fo.Position + vector(0.7, 0, 0.7), 1, nil, true, true)

	character_util.set_direction(self.player, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(self.sohee, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(self.daughter, 'down')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	--술잔 인터렉트 시 나리에션 박스 출력
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = self.talk_name .. 1})
	--술잔에서 희미한 아몬드 향이 난다.
	--나레이션 박스 종료 후, 소히 (가디언 방향으로, idle, cross_arm)
	--소히(idle, cross_arm) : 술을 마시고 봉변을 당한 건 확실해.
	character_util.set_anim(self.sohee, {name = 'cross_arm'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sohee, {key = self.talk_name .. 2, skip = true})
	--소히(idle, cross_arm) : 역시 원로와 가장 가까이 있던 대표가 가장 의심스럽긴 한데…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sohee, {key = self.talk_name .. 3, skip = true})
	--소히(sleep_deep, cross_arm) emoticon_bubble_silence
	character_util.set_emotion(self.sohee, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.sohee, nil, 'silence')
	--소히(idle, idle) : 술에 미리 독을 탄 거라면… 다른 사람도 용의자가 될 수 있어.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.sohee)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sohee, {key = self.talk_name .. 4, skip = true})

	--가디언 (idle, idle) emoticon_bubble_exclamtion
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.player, nil, 'notice')

	--소히(attack, idle) : 원로의 술에 손을 댄 사람부터 조사해 봐야겠어!
	character_util.set_emotion(self.sohee, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sohee, {key = self.talk_name .. '4_0', skip = true})
	--소히(attack, cast2) : 첫번째  용의자는… 원로에게 술을 서빙한 사람…!
	character_util.set_anim(self.sohee, {name = 'cast2'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sohee, {key = self.talk_name .. '4_1', skip = true})
	--대사 종료 후 집사에 마커
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.sohee)
	fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	character_util.add_listener(self.wine_steward, self.controller)
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.wine_steward, true)
	self:hide_weapons_for_party(false)
end


function local_class:s12_interact_wine_steward()
	self:hide_weapons_for_party(true)
	--
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.wine_steward, self.controller)
	party_util.align_to_target(self.wine_steward, 'left', 1, 'arc')
	--집사(빨간점) left, tired, idle
	--가디언(초록점)
	--집사 인터렉트 시, 가디언 초록점에 정렬. 이후 선택지 출력
	--수사에 협조 부탁드립니다.
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.talk_name .. 5 , 'intellect' }})

	--집사(left, idle, idle) : ...수사?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.wine_steward, {key = self.talk_name .. 6, skip = true})
	--집사(left, idle question) : 당신들은 주방의 하수인 아닌가요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(self.wine_steward, {name = 'question', loop = false})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.wine_steward, {key = self.talk_name .. 7, skip = true})
	--집사(left, idle question) : 여기서 뭘 하고 계신 건지...?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.wine_steward, {key = self.talk_name .. 8, skip = true})
	--대사 종료 후 가디언 left로 돌아 소히를 바라본다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.player, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	--소히(right, idle, release 1회) : 빨리 아무 말이나 해봐!
	character_util.set_emotion(self.sohee, {name = 'attack'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.sohee, {name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 1})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sohee, {key = self.talk_name .. 9, skip = true, scale = 0.8})
	--가디언 다시 right로 돌아 attack, release 2회
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.sohee)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.player, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.player, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(self.player, {name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2})
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.player)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--집사(left, idle, cross_arm)...도련님의 지시로 사건을 조사하는 중이라고요?
	character_util.remove_anim(self.wine_steward)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.wine_steward, {key = self.talk_name .. 10, skip = true})
	--집사(left, idle, cross_arm) : …정말인가요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(self.wine_steward, {name = 'bomb_idle'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.wine_steward, {key = self.talk_name .. 11, skip = true})
	--가디언과 소히 서로 마주보고 1초 후, 가디언과 소히(rightt, smile nodx2)
	character_util.set_direction(self.player, 'left')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	--가디언(left, idle, idle)
	--소히(right, idle, idle)
	character_util.set_direction(self.player, 'right')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.player, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.sohee, {name = 'smile'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.sohee, {name = 'nod', count = 2})
	character_util.nod_twice(self.player)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	--집사(left, tired, question) : 주방 하수인한테 조사를 맡기시다니…
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.player)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.sohee)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.wine_steward, {name = 'tired'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_anim(self.wine_steward, {name = 'question', loop = false})

function local_class:s12_interact_front(revealed)

	--
	--명부를 확인하고 싶습니다.
	local ask = {{self.talk_name .. 27, 'intellect'}}
	if revealed then
		--도둑이다!
		table.insert(ask, {self.talk_name .. 29, 'brutal'})
	end
	--남성1 원라인(붉은1) right, tired, cross_arm : 벽에서 바람이 새는 것 같은데…

		--직원(right, idle, idle) : 개인 정보이기 때문에 보여드릴 수 없습니다.

			self.current_state = self.event_state.lobby

		self.current_state = self.event_state.rep

		character_util.normal_jump_async(self.front_clerk, true)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.front_clerk, {key = self.talk_name .. 30, skip = true})


		--직원(right, attack, idle) : ……

		character_util.set_anim(self.front_clerk, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		--직원(right, attack, idle) : 증거도 없이 그렇게 사람을 몰아가도 되는 겁니까?!

			pos = self.front_clerk.Position + vector(0.25, 0.25, 0),
			target = self.player.Position,
			itemid = 20599, notforinven = true,
			showoncharacter = true
		})

		paper.ConsumeTarget = self.sohee
		wait_for_sec(0.75)

function local_class:s12_path_revealed()
	--직원과 초회 인터렉트하여 위 대사 본 후 붉은 선 트리거 존 진입 시 정지. 카메라 살짝 위로 패닝
	camera_util.move_async(self.player.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5), 1)

	self.blocker_demon[1].Interactable.Talk = nil
	self.blocker_demon[2].Interactable.Talk = nil

	--집사 1,2 eat모션 중, 1초 후 하단 대사 출력
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	--집사(left, tired, bomb_idle) : 이거 구멍이 너무 커서 안 되겠는데?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.blocker_demon[1], {name = 'bomb_idle'}, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.blocker_demon[2], {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.blocker_demon[1], {key = self.talk_name .. '38_1', skip = true})
	--집사(left, tired, nodx2) : 나무 판자가 더 필요하겠어. 같이 가서 가져오자.
	character_util.nod_twice(self.blocker_demon[2])
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.blocker_demon[2], {key = self.talk_name .. '38_2', skip = true})
	--이후 집사 1,2 화면 위로 퇴장(npc 삭제)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')

	end
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(butler, {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'scared'})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.player)
	--이후 공통 대사

	character_util.set_direction(self.sohee, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(self.daughter, 'left')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.player, {name = 'nod'})
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.sohee, {name = 'nod'})
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(self.daughter, {name = 'nod'})

	party_util.align_party(entrance, 'right', 0.5, 'linear')
	--가디언 일행 구멍 앞에서 (left, idle, walk4leg)로 0.5초 후, 다시 화면 우측에서 대사 출력
	party_util.set_anim({name = 'walk4legs'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	--[shout] 깜빡했다!

	party_util.remove_animation()
	character_util.set_emotion(self.sohee, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.player, {name = 'surprise'})

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	camera_util.move(self.player.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 1)
	--대사 출력 후 화면 우측에서 집사 빠르게 등장
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(butler,
		self.player.Position + vector(5, 0, -1),
		7, true, nil, nil, 'left', true)
	--
	--초록점(집사)
	--집사 상단 위치 도착 시 대사 출력
	--집사(left, scared, release) : 거기 위험하니까 절대 들어가면 안 돼!
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(butler, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'scared'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(butler, {key = talk_name .. 18, skip = true})
	--가디언 일행(right, smile, nodx2)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.player, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.sohee, {name = 'smile'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.player, {name = 'nod', count = 2})
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.sohee, {name = 'nod', count = 2})
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(self.daughter, {name = 'nod', count = 2})
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	--이후 집사 다시 화면 우측으로 매우 빠르게 퇴장

	character_util.remove_anim(butler)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(butler,
			self.player.Position + vector(17, 0, -1.5),
			7, true, nil, nil, 'left')

	character_util.stop_shake(butler)
	character_util.set_position(butler, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(butler)
	character_util.set_active_state(butler, 'disabled')
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

function local_class:s12_sneak_rep_scene()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local wind_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', loop = true })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })
	self:hide_weapons_for_party(true)
	--이후 비밀길을 통해 대기실 엿보기 시, 트리거존 이벤트

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.rep, {key = self.talk_name .. 56, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	--보좌관(left, idle, idle) : …
	--보좌관(left, idle, idle) : …전 추천 받은 술을 사왔을 뿐입니다.
	character_util.set_emotion(self.aide, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.aide, {key = self.talk_name .. '56_0', skip = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.aide, {key = self.talk_name .. 57, skip = true})
	--마족 대표(right, mad, idle) : 원로가 그 술을 먹고 죽었다잖아! 가뜩이나 내가 의심받고 있는데…!

	character_util.set_emotion(self.rep, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.rep, nil, 'silence')
	--마족 대표(right, attack, idle) : …네가 술을 사왔다는 얘기, 아무한테도 하지 마.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.rep, {key = self.talk_name .. 59, skip = true})
	--마족 대표(right, mad, release) : 이거 알려지면 난 꼼짝없이 범인으로 몰릴 거라고!
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.rep, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'mad'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.rep, {key = self.talk_name .. 60, skip = true})
	--보좌관(left, idle, idle) : …알겠습니다.
	character_util.remove_anim(self.rep)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.aide, {key = self.talk_name .. 61, skip = true})
	--마족 대표(right, attack, idle) : 쓸모 없는 놈…혼자 있고 싶으니까 당장 꺼져!
	character_util.set_emotion(self.rep, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.rep, {key = self.talk_name .. 62, skip = true})
	character_util.set_anim(self.rep, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.rep, {key = self.talk_name .. '62_0', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(self.rep)
	--

	character_util.move_distance(self.aide, vector(0, 0, -8), nil, 4, true, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.6)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1.5)

	character_util.set_position(self.aide, field:GetMarker('s11_drink_pos').position + vector(-1, 0, -0.4))
	character_util.set_direction(self.aide, 'left')
	--이후 보좌관이 대기실에서 퇴장해서 연회장(하단 빨간점 위치)으로 이동,
	--이벤트 종료 후 보좌관에게 마커.

	self.controller:remove_drop_item('elder_drink')
	--character_util.remove_color(self.elder, 'elder_dead', 0)
	--character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.elder)
	--character_util.set_position(self.elder, vector(999, 0, 999))
	--character_util.set_position(self.corpse_steward, vector(999, 0, 999))

	character_util.add_listener(self.aide, self.controller)
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.aide, true)
	self:hide_weapons_for_party(false)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 1 })
	wind_sfx:FadeOut(1)
	wind_sfx = nil

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)
end

	while not move_end do

	character_util.set_direction(sleeping_male, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(sleeping_male, vector(-65.5, 0.5, 30.8))

	character_util.add_listener(elder_son, self.controller)

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 12 then
		local corpse_tint_color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 })
		local elder = self.get_elder()
		character_util.set_active_state(elder, 'enabled')
		character_util.add_color(elder, 'dead_tint', corpse_tint_color, 1, 0)
		character_util.set_direction(elder, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(elder, { name = 'dead', loop = false, scale = 9999 })
		character_util.set_position(elder, self.get_elder_corpse_pos())
	end

	-- 기본 퀘스트 마커 설정
	self.quest_marker_target = self.get_elder_son()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.quest_marker_target, true)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))

	if self.touch_handler ~= nil then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.touch_handler = nil
	end
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	local elder_son = self.get_elder_son()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(elder_son, self.controller)

	local chef = self.get_chef()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(chef, self.controller)

	local sleeping_male = self.get_sleeping_male()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(sleeping_male, self.controller)

	if self.twinkle_fx ~= nil then
		self.twinkle_fx:Dispose()
		self.twinkle_fx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_elder_son()) and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_elder_son_before_investigating, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_chef()) then
		if self.cur_progress == self.progress.talk_elder_son_before_investigating then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_chef, self)
			return true
		elseif self.cur_progress >= self.progress.talk_chef then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.chef_online_after_talking, self))
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_storage_door()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.check_storage_door, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_sleeping_male()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.wake_sleeping_male_up, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_secret_bookshelf()) and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.mouse_ran_away then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.check_secret_bookshelf, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_hidden_evidence_storage_box()) and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.overhear_aide then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.find_evidence, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local exception = stage.Name ~= self.stage_name or e.FieldObject ~= leader or not e.FullEnter
	if exception then
		return
	end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
	local wp_idx = self.aide_start_moving_zones[zone_name]
	if wp_idx ~= nil and self.cur_progress == self.progress.talk_chef then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.aide_start_moving, self)
	elseif self.overhear_aide_zone == zone_name and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.check_secret_bookshelf then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.overhear_aide, self))
	elseif self.mouse_zone == zone_name and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.check_storage_door then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mouse_ran_away, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		local grid_name = e.CameraGrid.name
		local quest_marker_fo_name = self.quest_marker_by_grid[grid_name]
		if quest_marker_fo_name ~= nil then
			local quest_marker_fo = get_field_object(quest_marker_fo_name)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, quest_marker_fo, true)
		elseif self.quest_marker_target ~= nil then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.quest_marker_target, true)
		end
	end
end
--endregion

--- 보좌관 이동 시작 연출 함수
function local_class:aide_start_moving()
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.aide_start_moving

	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local aide = self.get_aide()
	local aide_pos = self.get_aide_wp(2)
	local paper_bag_daughter = self.get_count_daughter_paper_bag()
	camera_util.move_async(aide_pos, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	local aide_dirs = { 'right', 'left', 'right' }
	for i = 1, #aide_dirs do
		local cur_aide_dir = aide_dirs[i]
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(aide, cur_aide_dir)
		wait_for_sec(0.75)
	end

	local aide_move_to = aide_pos + vector(-20, 0, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.move_waypoint(aide, aide_move_to, 3, false)

	while screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(aide.Position, { bonus_distance = 2 }) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.stop(aide)
	character_util.set_active_state(aide, 'disabled')

	character_util.hide_weapon(sohee, true)
	character_util.hide_weapon(paper_bag_daughter, true)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--소히 (left, attack, idle) : 보좌관…?
	character_util.set_direction(paper_bag_daughter, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(paper_bag_daughter, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(paper_bag_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s13_48', skip = true })

	--소히 (left, attack, question) : 어딜 가는 걸까요…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(paper_bag_daughter, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(paper_bag_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s13_49', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(paper_bag_daughter)

	character_util.hide_weapon(sohee, false)
	character_util.hide_weapon(paper_bag_daughter, false)

	local storage_door = self.get_storage_door()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(storage_door.Name))
	storage_door.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

--- 창고 문과 상호작용 연출 함수
function local_class:check_storage_door()
	local storage_door = self.get_storage_door()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local paper_bag_daughter = self.get_count_daughter_paper_bag()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	--원로 아들 인터렉트 시 플레이어 일행 좌측 정렬, 대화 시작.
	local door_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(storage_door.Bounds.center)
	local leader_align_pos = door_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -1.75)
	local sohee_align_pos = door_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -1.75)
	local count_daughter_align_pos = door_pos + vector(0, 0, -2.5)
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				leader, leader_align_pos, 2.5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				sohee, sohee_align_pos, 2.5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				paper_bag_daughter, count_daughter_align_pos, 2.5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')
	})

	if self.cur_progress == self.progress.aide_start_moving then
		self.cur_progress = self.progress.check_storage_door

		local mouse = self.get_mouse()
		character_util.set_active_state(mouse, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_scale_factor(mouse, 'cute_little_mouse', 0.5)
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(mouse, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

		character_util.hide_weapon(sohee, true)
		character_util.hide_weapon(paper_bag_daughter, true)

		--소히 (left, idle, idle)  : 여기가 원래 막혀 있었나…?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s13_50', skip = true })

		--가디언 소히 방향으로 right, idle, release
		character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'left')
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s13_51_1', skip = true })

		--가디언 right, tired, idle
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })

		--소히 (left, idle, idle) : 데이터 수집 전 이론화하는 건 좋지 않지만 조사할 필요가 있어 보여.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s13_51_2', skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'question', loop = false })

		--소히 (right, idle, question) : 안으로 들어갈 다른 방법을 찾아보자고.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s13_52', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ leader, sohee })

		character_util.hide_weapon(sohee, false)
		character_util.hide_weapon(paper_bag_daughter, false)
	else
		--소히 (right, idle, question) : 안으로 들어갈 다른 방법을 찾아보자고.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s13_52', skip = true })
	end
end

--- 쥐 도망치는 연출 함수
function local_class:mouse_ran_away()
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.mouse_ran_away

	local mouse = self.get_mouse()

	character_util.look_at(mouse, user_party.Leader)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_mouse_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(mouse, '01_small_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(mouse, nil, 'notice')

	local mouse_wp = {
		self.get_mouse_wp(1),
		self.get_mouse_wp(2)
	}
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_die_mouse_01')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(mouse, mouse_wp, 6, true,
			'stop', 'floor', 'left')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_grass_slide_02')

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(mouse, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(mouse, 0, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local storage_door = self.get_storage_door()
	storage_door.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	local sleeping_male = self.get_sleeping_male()
	character_util.add_listener(sleeping_male, self.controller)

	self.quest_marker_target = self.get_secret_bookshelf()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.quest_marker_target, true)
end

--- 자는 남자 깨우는 함수
function local_class:wake_sleeping_male_up()
	local paper_bag_daughter = self.get_count_daughter_paper_bag()
	local count_daughter = self.get_count_daughter()
	local sleeping_male = self.get_sleeping_male()
	local secret_bookshelf = self.get_secret_bookshelf()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	local sleeping_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_sleep_02', parent = sleeping_male,
		loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc',
	})

	-- 위치 정렬
	local secret_bookshelf_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(secret_bookshelf.Bounds.center)
	local count_daughter_align_pos = secret_bookshelf_pos + vector(0.9, 0, -1)
	local sohee_align_pos = secret_bookshelf_pos + vector(0.2, 0, -1)
	local leader_align_pos = secret_bookshelf_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -1)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				leader, leader_align_pos, 2.5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				sohee, sohee_align_pos, 2.5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				paper_bag_daughter, count_daughter_align_pos, 2.5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')
	})

	if self.sleeping_male_interact_cnt < 3 then
		self.sleeping_male_interact_cnt = self.sleeping_male_interact_cnt + 1
	end

	-- 선택지
	local choices = {
		--[초록색] 흔들어 깨운다
		{ 'ds_main_s13_78', 'mercy' },

		{ 'ds_main_s13_79', 'intellect' },
		--[붉은색] 목을 자른다
		{ 'ds_main_s13_80', 'brutal' }
	}
	local cur_choices = {}

	for i = 1, self.sleeping_male_interact_cnt do
		table.insert(cur_choices, choices[i])
	end

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(cur_choices)
	if choose_result < 3 then
		if choose_result == 1 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		end
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'shoot' })
		wait_for_sec(2)
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	character_util.shake(sleeping_male, 0.03, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(sleeping_male)

	character_util.set_direction(sleeping_male, 'down')

--- 비밀 통로 막고있는 책장 조사 연출 함수

	local paper_bag_daughter = self.get_count_daughter_paper_bag()
	local secret_bookshelf = self.get_secret_bookshelf()

	self.cur_progress = self.progress.check_secret_bookshelf

	--(정렬 위치 : 1번 가디언 / 2번 소히 / 3번 프리실라)
	local secret_bookshelf_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(secret_bookshelf.Bounds.center)
	local leader_align_pos = secret_bookshelf_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5)
	local sohee_align_pos = secret_bookshelf_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
	local count_daughter_align_pos = secret_bookshelf_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				leader, leader_align_pos, 2.5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				sohee, sohee_align_pos, 2.5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				paper_bag_daughter, count_daughter_align_pos, 2.5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')
	})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	for i = 1, #party do
		local member = party[i]
		character_util.set_anim(member, { name = 'push', upper = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(member, { name = 'damaged' })
	end

	-- QTE
	local qte_complete = false

	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
				qte_complete = true
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}
	message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('right')

	while not qte_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	self.touch_handler = nil

	for i = 1, #party do
		local member = party[i]
		character_util.set_anim(member, { name = 'walk' })
	end

	local duration = 3
	character_util.move_distance(leader, vector(1.5, 0, 0), duration, nil, false, false)
	character_util.move_distance(sohee, vector(1.5, 0, 0), duration, nil, false, false)
	character_util.move_distance(paper_bag_daughter, vector(1.5, 0, 0), duration, nil, false, false)
	local push_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_push_rock_01', parent = leader,
		loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc',
	})
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = secret_bookshelf.Position
	local target_pos = start_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0)
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		secret_bookshelf.Position = cur_pos
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	push_sound:Stop()

	for i = 1, #party do
		local member = party[i]
		character_util.remove_anim(member, true)
		character_util.remove_anim(member)
		character_util.remove_emotion(member)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(leader, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim(sohee, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(sohee)
	character_util.remove_anim(paper_bag_daughter, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(paper_bag_daughter)

	-- 미리 보좌관 방에 배치
	local aide = self.get_aide()
	local storage_room_aide_pos = self.get_storage_room_aide_pos()

	character_util.set_active_state(aide, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(aide, storage_room_aide_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(aide, 'right')

	secret_bookshelf.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self.quest_marker_target = self.get_storage_door()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.quest_marker_target, true)
end

		character_util.normal_jump(member, '01_player_jump_01')
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')

	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'cast2' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, {
		key = 'ds_main_s13_73', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'rb' })

		key = 'ds_main_s13_74', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'rb' })
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ leader, sohee, paper_bag_daughter })

	coroutine.yield(nil)

		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_vampire_steward()) and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_steward_uncover_culprit, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_chef()) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.chef_online_after_talking, self))
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_mansion_inner_1()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.exit_mansion, self)
		return true
	end
	return false

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		local grid_name = e.CameraGrid.name
		local quest_marker_fo_name = self.quest_marker_by_grid[grid_name]
		if quest_marker_fo_name ~= nil then
			local quest_marker_fo = get_field_object(quest_marker_fo_name)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, quest_marker_fo, true)
		elseif self.quest_marker_target ~= nil then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.quest_marker_target, true)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pushed_routine(target, duration, distance, hit_sfx)
	local time_passed = 0
	local original_pos = target.Position

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(hit_sfx)

	character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_projectile_01')

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutExpo(unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration), 0, 1, 1)
		local cur_pos = original_pos + progress * distance

		character_util.set_position(target, cur_pos)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:pushed_normal(target, duration, distance)
	local time_passed = 0
	local original_pos = target.Position
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutExpo(unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration), 0, 1, 1)
		local cur_pos = original_pos + progress * distance

		character_util.set_position(target, cur_pos)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('DemonShireMainSection15')

--[[QuestAttribute

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.get_captain_guard = function(index) return get_character('captain_guard_' .. index) end

	self.door_name = 'research_institute_door_1'

	self.section_progress = {
		none = 1,
		enter_pyramid = 2,
		battle_end_caption = 3,
		find_researcher = 4,
		escape_research_institute = 5,
		ending = 6,
	}
	self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.none

	-- 엘레베이터 환경음
	self.elevator_sfx = nil

	-- 2_4 스테이지 exit 이름
	self.exit_name = 'exit_passage_14_2'

	self.is_play_underground_battle = false

	self.paper_pieces = nil

	self.typing_loop_sfx = nil

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	if self.stage_name ~= stage.Name then
		return
	end

	self.get_fx_last_hit()
	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_ghost_buster_magiton()
	self.get_fx_jump_smoke()
	self.get_fx_landslide_brown_small()

	screen_util.preload_boss_title()

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:enter()
	if self.stage_name == stage.Name then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

		-- 이벤트 진행을 위해 ExitInteractable -> PublishInteractable
		self:changed_exit_interact_fo(1)
	elseif self.before_stage_name == stage.Name then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event_2_4')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event_2_4')

		-- 이전 섹션에서 넘어왔다면 원라인 npc 세팅
		local is_prev_section = self.controller.starting_inner_progress <= 13
		if is_prev_section then
			self:set_oneline_npc_after_event()
		end

		-- 이벤트 진행을 위해 ExitInteractable -> PublishInteractable
		self:changed_exit_interact_fo(2)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.stage_name == stage.Name then
		-- 섹션진행중에 나갔을수도 있으니 문 닫는 이벤트 퍼블리시
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.door_name, true))

		-- 피라미드 입구 히트박스 늘려줌
		local exit_fo = get_field_object('pyramid_inner_1')
		exit_fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(4, 1, 1))

		self.paper_pieces = {}
		local paper = nil
		local paper_piece_id = 20631
		local paper_table = get_field_object('ds_s15_interactable_1')
		paper = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = paper_table.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
			itemid = paper_piece_id,
			notforinven = true,
			sprscale = 1,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
		})
		table.insert(self.paper_pieces, paper)

		paper_table = get_field_object('ds_s15_interactable_2')
		paper = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = paper_table.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
			itemid = paper_piece_id,
			notforinven = true,
			sprscale = 1,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
		})
		table.insert(self.paper_pieces, paper)

		-- 엘레베이터 애니메이터 세팅
		local layer = field.Tilemap.Transform:Find('obj_rift').gameObject
		local elevator_object = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(layer.transform, 'floor_rift_1')
		self.elevator_ani = elevator_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		-- 세이브 포인트 체크
		local cur_save_point = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.controller.save_point_key)
		if cur_save_point == 3 then
			-- 발렌시아 2차전 승리 후 이벤트
			self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.enter_pyramid
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.eliminated_captain_guard, self)
		elseif cur_save_point == 4 then
			-- 발렌시아 3차전 하기 바로 전 이벤트
			self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.enter_pyramid
			local leader = get_party_leader()
			local daughter = self.controller.get_count_daughter()
			local sohee = self.controller.get_sohee()
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_cargo_elevator, self, leader, daughter, sohee)
		elseif cur_save_point == 5 then
			-- 발렌시아 3차전까지 끝나고 재접속 했을 때
			self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.battle_end_caption
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.eliminated_captain_guard_elevator, self)
		else
			-- 퀘스트 마커 세팅
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.exit_interact_fo[3], true)
		end
	elseif self.before_stage_name == stage.Name then
		-- 퀘스트 마커 세팅
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.exit_interact_fo[1], true)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.typing_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.typing_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.typing_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.paper_pieces ~= nil then
		for i = 1, 2 do
			self.paper_pieces[i]:ConsumeComplete()
			self.paper_pieces[i] = nil
		end
	end

	if self.before_stage_name == stage.Name then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

		quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

		-- ExitInteractable 원복
		self:restore_exit_interact_fo()

	elseif self.stage_name == stage.Name then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

		quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

		if self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.escape_research_institute then
			message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
		end

		-- 터치 이벤트 구독중이면 해지
		if self.touch_handler then
			message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
			self.touch_handler = nil
		end

		if self.game_pad_handler then
			message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
			self.game_pad_handler = nil
		end

		-- 소히 마기톤 버스터 이팩트가 있다면 dispose
		if self.fx_sohee_laser_effect then
			self.fx_sohee_laser_effect:Dispose()
			self.fx_sohee_laser_effect = nil
		end

		-- 동적생성한 몬스터가 남아있다면 dispose
		if self.optimized_npc_list then
			load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npc_list)
			self.optimized_npc_list = nil
		end

		self.elevator_ani = nil

		-- ExitInteractable 원복
		self:restore_exit_interact_fo()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local researcher = self.get_researcher()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, researcher) then
		if self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.find_researcher then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_researcher, self)
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(researcher, { key = self.string_key .. 85 })
		end
		return true
	end

	-- exit 상호작용
	for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.exit_interact_fo[i]) then
			self:teleport_party_for_marker_routine(i)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.pyramid_enter_zone_name)
			and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.enter_pyramid
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.pyramid_enter_event, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.enter_top_floor_zone_name)
			and self.cur_progress >= self.section_progress.escape_research_institute then
		self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.ending
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_top_floor_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event_2_4(e)
