			and not self.is_show_zone_trigger_event then
		self.is_show_zone_trigger_event = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_auto_event, self))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's15_sewer_battle')
			and not self.is_play_underground_battle then
		self.is_play_underground_battle = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.underground_waterway_battle, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 's15_captain_guard_battle' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.eliminated_captain_guard, self)
		return true
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == 's15_captain_guard_battle_2' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.eliminated_captain_guard_elevator, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event_2_4(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'sewer_battle_1' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.eliminated_underground_waterway, self)
		return true
	end

	return false

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.cur_progress ~= self.section_progress.escape_research_institute then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, get_party_leader()) then
		if e.HpBefore - e.Info:GetTotalDamage() <= 1 then
			if self.is_resetting == false then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.fail_escape_research_institute, self)
			end
			return true
		end

		local required_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap

		if (e.Info.type & required_damage_type) == required_damage_type then
			if lua_helper.type_compare(e.Info.sender.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.SpikeBehaviour) then

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				local knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(
						vector_util.to_direction(user_party.Leader.Position - e.Info.sender.Position))
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
				damage_info.sender = user_party.Leader
				damage_info.target = e.Info.target
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorNormalStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = 33000
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
						* (0.3 - CS.Oak.ConstantsData.Value.GimmickSpikeDamage:GetDecrypted()))
				command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	return true
end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('right')

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 0)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	-- 입력 시 슬로우 소히,프리실라 (right, attack, run)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do

	, { name = 'attack' })

	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0.1, 0))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_03')
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.75
	local start_pos = leader.Position
	local end_pos = leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 3
	local height = 1.5
	local is_jump = false
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
		character_util.set_position(leader, cur_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0), true)
		local cur_rot = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 360 * 4, progress)
		character_util.spine_rotate(leader, cur_rot, 0)

		if not is_jump and time_passed > 0.25 then
			is_jump = true
			for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
				character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = i == 1 and 'attack' or 'surprise' })

				if i == 2 then

				end
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

		self.optimized_npc_list['left_royal_guard_2'], self.optimized_npc_list['left_royal_guard_3'],
		self.optimized_npc_list['down_royal_guard_1'],
	}

	-- 좌측 친위대 5명은 right, attack, prostrate 로 달려들어 가디언 위를 덮는다.(가디언 모습이 보이지 않게)
	local pos_list = { leader.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0.25), leader.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, 0.25)

		character_util.jump_move(guardian_mark_list[i], pos_list[i], 4, 0.75, false
		, dir_list[i])
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 친위대1 (down, attack, push), 친위대2 (right, attack, push)

		self.optimized_npc_list['top_royal_guard_3'], self.optimized_npc_list['down_royal_guard_3'],

		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, other_mark_list[1], {
			vector(sohee.Position.x, 0, other_mark_list[1].Position.z),
			sohee.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5) }, 4, false, nil, nil, 'down'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, other_mark_list[2], {
			vector(daughter.Position.x, 0, other_mark_list[2].Position.z),
			daughter.Position - vector(0, 0, 0.5) }, 4, false, nil, nil, 'down'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, other_mark_list[3], {
			vector(other_mark_list[3].Position.x, 0, sohee.Position.z),
			sohee.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0) }, 5, true, nil, nil, 'right'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, other_mark_list[4], {
			vector(other_mark_list[3].Position.x, 0, daughter.Position.z),
			daughter.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0) }, 5, true, nil, nil, 'right'),
	})
	dir_list = { 'down', 'up', 'right', 'right' }
	for i = 1, #other_mark_list do
		character_util.shake(other_mark_list[i], 0.03, 9999)
		character_util.set_direction(other_mark_list[i], dir_list[i])
		character_util.set_anim(other_mark_list[i], { name = 'push' })

	-- 1초 뒤 Qte 연타 출력.

	local tap_count = 0
	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)

	character_util.air_spin(other_mark_list[2])

	self.fx_sohee_laser_effect:Dispose()
	self.fx_sohee_laser_effect = nil

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_emotion(daughter)
	character_util.set_direction(daughter, 'up')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	-- 소히 (down, attack, release): 지금이야!! 빨리 뛰어!!!
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '34_5'
	, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })
	character_util.remove_anim(sohee)
	character_util.set_emotion(daughter, { name = 'attack' })

	-- 친위대들 right, attack, idle
	for i = 1, #down_leftover_guard_list do
		character_util.set_direction(down_leftover_guard_list[i], 'right')
	end

	for i = 1, #top_leftover_guard_list do
		character_util.set_direction(top_leftover_guard_list[i], 'right')
	end

	-- 가디언 left, attack, idle이었다가 소히, 프리실라 우측으로 3타일 뛰어 가까워지면 같이 우측으로 run (이때 가디언 포커싱하며 카메라 따라가지않고, 가디언 일행 화면 좌측으로 사라짐)
	-- 가디언 일행 우측으로 빠짐
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', parent = sohee })
	character_util.move_waypoint(sohee, sohee.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 10
	, 5, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)
	character_util.move_waypoint(daughter, daughter.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 10
	, 5, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 8
	, 5, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	for i = 1, #down_leftover_guard_list do
		character_util.remove_emotion(down_leftover_guard_list[i])
		character_util.set_direction(down_leftover_guard_list[i], 'up')
	end

	for i = 1, #top_leftover_guard_list do
		character_util.remove_emotion(down_leftover_guard_list[i])
		character_util.set_direction(top_leftover_guard_list[i], 'down')
	end

	-- 친위대장 get으로 일어난 뒤 right, attak, 짧은 진동, 이때 친위대들 시선 친위대장에게
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(captain_guard, 0.06, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(captain_guard, 0.06, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(captain_guard)
	character_util.set_emotion(captain_guard, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.mario_jump_async(captain_guard, 'left')

	character_util.set_direction(captain_guard, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	time_passed = 0
	duration = 0.5
	height = 1
	start_pos = captain_guard.Position
	local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(captain_guard.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 2.25, 0)
	character_util.set_anim(captain_guard, { name = 'get' })
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
		character_util.set_position(captain_guard, cur_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0), true)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	character_util.set_position(captain_guard, target_pos)
	character_util.remove_anim(captain_guard)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	-- 친위대장 right 마리오 점프로 뛰어내려 착지 후 하단 대사 출력하고 화면 우측으로 달려간다.
	-- 친위대장(right, attack, release) : 어서 쫓아라!! 절대 놓쳐선 안된다!!
	for i = 1, #down_leftover_guard_list do
		character_util.set_direction(down_leftover_guard_list[i], 'right')
	end

	for i = 1, #top_leftover_guard_list do
		character_util.set_direction(top_leftover_guard_list[i], 'right')
	end

	local left_count = 3
	for i = 1, left_count do
		character_util.set_direction(left_leftover_guard_list[i], 'right')
	end

	character_util.set_direction(captain_guard, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(captain_guard, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. '34_6'
	, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

	-- 발렌시아가 먼저 뛰어 간다.
	character_util.remove_anim(captain_guard)
	character_util.set_direction(captain_guard, 'right')
	character_util.move_waypoint(captain_guard, captain_guard.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 10
	, 5, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_09')
	-- 친위대들 우르르 우측으로 뛰면서 페이드 아웃.
	for i = 1, #down_leftover_guard_list do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(down_leftover_guard_list[i])
		character_util.set_emotion(down_leftover_guard_list[i], { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.move_waypoint(down_leftover_guard_list[i], {
			down_leftover_guard_list[i].Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 4,
			down_leftover_guard_list[i].Position + vector(4, 0, 1),
			down_leftover_guard_list[i].Position + vector(18, 0, 1),
		}, 5, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)
	end

	for i = 1, #top_leftover_guard_list do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(top_leftover_guard_list[i])
		character_util.set_emotion(top_leftover_guard_list[i], { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.move_waypoint(top_leftover_guard_list[i], {
			top_leftover_guard_list[i].Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 4,
			top_leftover_guard_list[i].Position + vector(4, 0, -1),
			top_leftover_guard_list[i].Position + vector(18, 0, -1),
		}, 5, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.28)
	character_util.move_waypoint(left_leftover_guard_list[1]
	, left_leftover_guard_list[1].Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 16
	, 5, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)

	character_util.move_waypoint(left_leftover_guard_list[3]
	, left_leftover_guard_list[3].Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 16
	, 5, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)

	-- 마지막으로 뛰어가는 로얄가드는 쓰러지도록
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(left_leftover_guard_list[2],
				{ left_leftover_guard_list[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 1.5
				, left_leftover_guard_list[2].Position + vector(3, 0, -1.5)
				}, 5, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(left_leftover_guard_list[2], { name = 'prostrate' }
		, { name = 'damaged' })

		character_util.jump_move(left_leftover_guard_list[2]
		, left_leftover_guard_list[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.right
		, 2.5, 0.5, true, 'right')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(left_leftover_guard_list[2].Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(left_leftover_guard_list[2].Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

		-- 0.5타일 슬라이딩 이동
		local cur_time_passed = 0
		local move_duration = 0.75
		local guard_start_pos = left_leftover_guard_list[2].Position
		local guard_end_pos = left_leftover_guard_list[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5
		while cur_time_passed < move_duration do
			cur_time_passed = cur_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local cur_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(cur_time_passed, guard_start_pos.x,
					guard_end_pos.x - guard_start_pos.x, move_duration)
			local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(cur_time_passed, guard_start_pos.z,
					guard_end_pos.z - guard_start_pos.z, move_duration)
			character_util.set_position(left_leftover_guard_list[2], vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z))
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end))
	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	-- 카고 엘레베이터 연출
	self:enter_cargo_elevator(leader, daughter, sohee, 3)
end

function local_class:optimized_royal_guard()
	-- 병사들 동적생성
	local npc_name = 'ds_vampire_guard'
	self.optimized_npc_list = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async({
		left_royal_guard_1 = npc_name, left_royal_guard_2 = npc_name,
		left_royal_guard_3 = npc_name, left_royal_guard_4 = npc_name,
		left_royal_guard_5 = npc_name, left_royal_guard_6 = npc_name,
		left_royal_guard_7 = npc_name, left_royal_guard_8 = npc_name,
		left_royal_guard_9 = npc_name,

		down_royal_guard_1 = npc_name, down_royal_guard_2 = npc_name,
		down_royal_guard_3 = npc_name, down_royal_guard_4 = npc_name,
		down_royal_guard_5 = npc_name, down_royal_guard_6 = npc_name,
		down_royal_guard_7 = npc_name, down_royal_guard_8 = npc_name,
		down_royal_guard_9 = npc_name,

		top_royal_guard_1 = npc_name, top_royal_guard_2 = npc_name,
		top_royal_guard_3 = npc_name, top_royal_guard_4 = npc_name,
		top_royal_guard_5 = npc_name, top_royal_guard_6 = npc_name,
		top_royal_guard_7 = npc_name, top_royal_guard_8 = npc_name,
		top_royal_guard_9 = npc_name,
	})

	-- 총 3줄
	local guard_count = 3
	local start_pos = vector(-121, 0, 8)
	for i = 1, guard_count do
		for j = 1, guard_count do
			local key = 'left_royal_guard_' .. (j + ((i - 1) * 3))
			local pos = start_pos - vector((i - 1), 0, (1.5 * (j - 1)))

			local guard = self.optimized_npc_list[key]
			character_util.set_direction(guard, 'right')
			character_util.set_position(guard, pos)
		end
	end

	start_pos = vector(-112, 0, 17)
	for i = 1, guard_count do
		for j = 1, guard_count do
			local key = 'top_royal_guard_' .. (j + ((i - 1) * 3))
			local pos = start_pos + vector((1.5 * (j - 1)), 0, (i - 1))

			local guard = self.optimized_npc_list[key]
			character_util.set_direction(guard, 'down')
			character_util.set_position(guard, pos)
		end
	end

	start_pos = vector(-112, 0, -4)
	for i = 1, guard_count do
		for j = 1, guard_count do
			local key = 'down_royal_guard_' .. (j + ((i - 1) * 3))
			local pos = start_pos + vector((1.5 * (j - 1)), 0, -(i - 1))

			local guard = self.optimized_npc_list[key]
			character_util.set_direction(guard, 'up')
			character_util.set_position(guard, pos)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:enter_cargo_elevator(leader, daughter, sohee, wait_start_time)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if wait_start_time ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_02')
		local before_captain_guard = self.get_captain_guard(1)

		wait_for_sec(wait_start_time)
		character_util.set_active_state(before_captain_guard, 'disabled')
		if self.optimized_npc_list ~= nil then
			load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npc_list)
			self.optimized_npc_list = nil
		end
	end

	-- 세이브 포인트
	local save_point_key = self.controller.save_point_key
	local cur_value = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, save_point_key)
	local save_point = 4
	if cur_value < save_point then
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, save_point_key, save_point)
	end

	local marker = field:GetMarker('s15_cargo_elevator_1')
	camera_util.move_async(marker.position, 0)

	-- 엘레베이터씬 전용 시어 값으로 변경
	local shear_controller = self.get_shear_controller()
	shear_controller:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = 0.05

	character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 0, 0)

	character_util.set_position(leader, marker.position + vector(0, 0, 0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')

	character_util.set_position(daughter, marker.position + vector(1, 0, -0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(daughter, 'left')

	character_util.set_position(sohee, marker.position + vector(-1, 0, -0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')

	character_util.remove_emotion(daughter)
	character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

	local captain_guard = self.get_captain_guard(2)

	local elevator_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_elevator_06', loop = true })
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 페이드 인. 엘리베이터 안
	-- 각자 노란색 방향으로 2타일 정도 damaged, walk4leg + 몸 shake걸어오는 모습 보여줌.
	-- Get자세로 일어난 후 아래의 정렬과 동일.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	elevator_loop_sfx.Volume = 0.5
	-- 소히(right, damaged, seat 짧은 진동) : 과학자는 뛰면 수명이 세 배나 줄어든다는 속설이 있다고…!
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'seat' })
	character_util.shake(sohee, 0.05, 0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'damaged' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 35, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	-- 프리실라(left, scared, cast) : 저, 저희 제대로 따돌린 것 맞겠죠…?
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(daughter, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'scared' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 36, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	-- 소히right, idle, seat, emoticon_bubble_annoyed
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(sohee, nil, 'annoyed')
	character_util.remove_emotion(daughter)

	-- 소히(right, attack, idle) : 저 힘만 센 고릴라가 바로 튀어나올 줄이야.
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.remove_anim(sohee)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 37, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	-- 소히(right, mad, jingak) : 중간 보스가 이래도 되는 거야?!
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, { name = 'jingak', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_jingak_01' },
			{ name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 38, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(sohee)

	-- 프리실라(left, tired, seat) : ……
	character_util.set_emotion(daughter, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 39, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	-- 프리실라(left, sleep_deep, idle) : 아까 전부터 신경 쓰였던 건데…
	character_util.set_emotion(daughter, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	character_util.remove_anim(daughter)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 40, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	-- 프리실라(left, idle, release) : 역시…여러분은 미래를 아는 건가요…?
	character_util.remove_emotion(daughter)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(daughter, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 41, skip = true })

	--선택지 출력.
	-- 1) (초록색) 가디언도 그저 휘말렸을 뿐. / 2) (노란색) 10년 후의 이야기라면… / 2) (붉은색) 눈치 빠른 꼬맹이는 싫어.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. 42, 'mercy' }
	, { self.string_key .. 43, 'intellect' }, { self.string_key .. '43_1', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		-- 가디언 right, smile, victory_get
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false }, { name = 'smile' })
		wait_for_sec(2)
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')

		-- 소히 (right, tired, bomb_idle) : 저 고릴라가 뭔가 알고 있을 거란 기대는 하지 말아 줘.
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, { name = 'bomb_idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 44, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(sohee)
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		-- 가디언 down, sleep_deep, idle 1초 대기 후
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
		wait_for_sec(1)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		--가디언 down, sleep_deep, nod 2회하고 눈뜸
		character_util.nod_twice(leader)
		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		--소히(right, tired, idle) : 너는 또 무슨 소릴 하는 거야…
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 45, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		--가디언 down, doyagao, bomb_idle
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'attack' })
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		--소히 (rignt, idle, idle) : …쟤는 정말로 믿을 것 같으니 그런 말 하지마.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '45_1', skip = true })
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 소히 (right,idle, cross_arm): 우리가 아는 건 진행됐던 시간선… 그러니까 과거로 돌아가기 전에 일어났던 일까지야.
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 46, skip = true })

	-- 소히 (right, idle, cross_arm): 그마저 사건이 다르게 진행되서 무의미한 데이터가 돼버렸지만…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 47, skip = true })

	-- 프리실라 (left, idle, idle): 다르게 진행됐다구요…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 48, skip = true })

	-- 소히 (right, attack, release) : 이전에 엘리베이터를 타고 가던 중에 나왔었던 적들이 이번엔 타기도 전에 튀어나왔다고.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 49, skip = true })

	-- 소히 (right, attack, idle) : 데이터를 재정립해야 할 필요가 있어 앞으로 무슨 일이 벌어질지는…
	character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 50, skip = true })

	-- 발렌시아(up) 쿵하고 떨어짐, 아래 표시한 자리에 착지
	character_util.set_active_state(captain_guard, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(captain_guard, 'up')

	-- 랜딩할 자리에 세팅
	local landing_pos = leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 2.5
	local jump_height = 10
	character_util.set_position(captain_guard, landing_pos + vector(0, jump_height, 0), true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(captain_guard)
	character_util.set_anim(captain_guard, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_duration = 0.5
	local start_pos = captain_guard.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, captain_guard.Position.y, 0)
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		if start_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
			character_util.set_position(captain_guard, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
		else
			character_util.set_position(captain_guard, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 떨어졌을 때 짧은 카메라 쉐이크 fx_lasthit, 가디언 일행 down, surprise, 점프 1회
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump(user_party[i], true)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
	self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(captain_guard.Position)

	character_util.remove_anim(captain_guard)
	character_util.set_position(captain_guard, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
	camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.35)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 이후 소히, 프리실라 뒷걸음으로 가디언 옆에 선다.
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'down')
		character_util.move_to(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + unity_class.vector3.forward
		, 1, nil, false, true)
	end

	camera_util.move_async(captain_guard.Position, 0.5)

	-- 발렌시아 (up) : 백작님의 명령을 완수하는 것이 제 사명…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. '50_1', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	-- 발렌시아 (up) : 절대 실패하지 않습니다…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. '50_2', skip = true })

	-- 소히 (down, attack, idle) : 몇 번이나 졌으면서 끈질기다고…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '50_3', skip = true })

	-- 가디언 앞으로 1걸음 전진
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5,
			1.5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')

	-- 선택지)
	-- 1) 결판을 짓죠. 중간 보스. (초록색) / 2) 허~접 허접허접~ (붉은색)허~접 허접허접~ (붉은색)
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. '50_4', 'mercy' }
	, { self.string_key .. '50_5', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 가디언 down, attack, attack 2회
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'attack', count = 2, sfx = '02_hero_sword_01' })

		-- 1초 대기 후 발렌시아 nod 2회
		wait_for_sec(1)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.nod_twice(captain_guard)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
		elevator_loop_sfx:Stop()
		elevator_loop_sfx = nil
		-- 발렌시아(up) : [shout] 덤벼라!!
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. '50_6'
		, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		-- 가디언 left, smile, dance 이후 right, smile, dance 이후 down, smile, idle
		character_util.show_emoticon(leader, nil, 'happy')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'dance' }, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		wait_for_sec(1)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		-- 발렌시아 shake 0.03으로 1.5초
		character_util.shake(captain_guard, 0.03, 1.5)
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
		elevator_loop_sfx:Stop()
		elevator_loop_sfx = nil
		-- 발렌시아(up) : [shout] 너는 내가 반드시 쓰러트린다!!
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. '50_7'
		, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
	end

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(captain_guard)

	screen_util.show_boss_title(self.string_key .. 31
	, self.string_key .. '50_7_1', 2, false)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 1)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(captain_guard, { name = 'katana_attack3', loop = false, scale = 0.5 }
	, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(2.2)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(captain_guard)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 발렌시아 2차전 시작
	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = false
	character_util.convert_to_monster(captain_guard, 's15_captain_guard_battle_2'
	, 's15_cargo_elevator_1')
	character_util.set_death_type(captain_guard, 'prostrate')
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(captain_guard, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	captain_guard.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.NoticeLinkName = 's15_captain_guard_battle_2'

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
end

function local_class:eliminated_captain_guard_elevator()

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. '50_8', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	-- 소히 (right, idle, idle) : 흥, 뭐가 한 번도 실패한 적이 없다란 거야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '50_9', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(captain_guard, 'left')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_equip_weapon_01')

		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'attack' })
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 발렌시아 (left, attack, idle) : 프리실라 님… 당신은 절대 이 위로…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. '50_11', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	-- 발렌시아 (left, attack, idle) : [shout] 올려보내지 않겠습니다!!
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. '50_12'
	, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_rise_01')
	--  발렌시아 twohand_attack4 (점프하여 공격 내리찍음)

	, 2.5, 2, false, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	elevator_loop_sfx.Volume = 0.5
	local mod_key = 'attack_captain'
	time_util.mod(mod_key, 0.1)
	wait_for_sec(0.15)
	elevator_loop_sfx.Volume = 1
	time_util.unmod(mod_key)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
	self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(marker.position + vector(-0.35, 0.2, 0))
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(marker.position + vector(-0.35, 0.2, 0))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--FIXME: 이때 1단계 부셔지는 연출 시작
	self.elevator_ani:Play('rift_floor_break1')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event' })
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'cliff' }, { name = 'surprise' })
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(captain_guard)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(captain_guard, { name = 'cliff' }, { name = 'surprise' })

	-- 화면 전체에 검은색 틴트 깜박 + 카메라 강하게 shake.

	local fall_pos_list = { vector(-4, 0, 2), vector(5, 0, -1), vector(-1, 0, -3) }
	for i = 1, fall_count do
		local cur_rock = self.get_fx_landslide_brown_small():Instantiate(
				stage_camera.LookAtPosition + fall_pos_list[i],
				unity_class.quaternion.identity,
				stage_camera.transform)
		cur_rock.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8
	end

	elevator_loop_sfx:Stop()

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 1.5)

	field:RemoveTint('elevator')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 51, skip = true })

	character_util.set_direction(captain_guard, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.75)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(captain_guard, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.75)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. '52_1', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	--화면 전체에 검은색 틴트 깜박 + 카메라 강하게 shake + 수용소 붕괴 때처럼 위에서 먼지,돌조각 떨어지는 연출.
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'cliff' }, { name = 'surprise' })

	for i = 1, fall_count do
		local cur_rock = self.get_fx_landslide_brown_small():Instantiate(

				unity_class.quaternion.identity,

		character_util.spine_scale(user_party[i], unity_class.vector3.one * 0.2, 1.7)

		character_util.spine_rotate(user_party[i], angle, 1.7)
		character_util.move_to(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + vector(0, 0, -0.2),
				0.2, nil, false, false, false)

	-- 발렌시아도 같이 떨어짐
	character_util.remove_emotion(captain_guard)
	character_util.set_emotion(captain_guard, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_active_shadow(captain_guard, false)
	character_util.spine_scale(captain_guard, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.2, 1.7)
	character_util.spine_rotate(captain_guard, 690, 1.7)
	character_util.move_to_async(captain_guard, captain_guard.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.2),
			0.2, nil, false, false, false)

	time_util.unmod(mod_key)

	-- 2초 후 슬로우 풀리면서 무너지는 바닥과 함께 가디언 일행 damaged, embarrassed로 빙글빙글 돌며 화면 아래로 낙하
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'embarrassed' })
		character_util.move_to(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + vector(0, 0, -0.4),
				1.5, nil, false, false, false)
	end
	character_util.set_anim(captain_guard, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.move_to(captain_guard, captain_guard.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.4),
			1.5, nil, false, false, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 인공태양 연구소 입구 연출
	self:research_institute_enter_event(leader, daughter, sohee, captain_guard)
end

function local_class:research_institute_enter_event(leader, daughter, sohee, captain_guard)
	-- 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_scale(user_party[i], unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
		character_util.spine_rotate(user_party[i], 0, 0)
		character_util.set_active_shadow(user_party[i], true)
	end

	-- 원래 시어 값으로 변경
	local shear_controller = self.get_shear_controller()
	shear_controller:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = 0.025

	-- 배경 강제로 제거
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SetBackgroundColorEvent.Create(CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 0, 0, 0), 0))

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	local marker = field:GetMarker('s15_research_institute_1')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_position(leader, marker.position - vector(0, 0, 0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_position(sohee, marker.position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(daughter)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(daughter, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_position(daughter, marker.position + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(daughter, 'left')

	character_util.spine_scale(captain_guard, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	character_util.spine_rotate(captain_guard, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(captain_guard, true)
	character_util.set_position(captain_guard, leader.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(captain_guard, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(captain_guard, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'confused' })
	captain_guard.Interactable.Talk = 'ds_main_s15_53_1'

	-- 근위대 1
	local guard_1 = get_character('pyramid_secret_floor_1')
	character_util.set_active_state(guard_1, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(guard_1, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -2))
	character_util.set_direction(guard_1, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(guard_1, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	captain_guard.Interactable.Talk = 'ds_main_s15_53_1'

	-- 근위대 2
	local guard_2 = get_character('pyramid_secret_floor_2')
	character_util.set_active_state(guard_2, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(guard_2, leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 2))
	character_util.set_direction(guard_2, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(guard_2, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	captain_guard.Interactable.Talk = 'ds_main_s15_53_1'

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 1 })
	-- 폐쇄 구역(구 인공태양 연구소) 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 일행 2번 짧게 shake 후 get 자세로 일어난다.
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(user_party[i], 0.02, 0.5)
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(user_party[i], 0.02, 0.5)
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_emotion(daughter)
	character_util.mario_jump_new(daughter, 'left')
	character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.mario_jump_new(sohee, 'right')
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(leader, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 소히(right, mad, 점프 1회) : 무식한 고릴라 같으니!!!
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.normal_jump(sohee, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 54, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })

	-- 프리실라(left, tired, cast) : 주… 죽는 줄 알았어요…
	character_util.set_direction(daughter, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(daughter, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 53, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(daughter)

	-- 소히 right, idle, 점프 1회 하며 emoticon_bubble_exclamation
	character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.normal_jump(sohee, true)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(sohee, nil, 'notice')

	-- 소히(right, idle, idle): 쫓아오던 녀석들은 저기 뻗어서 더 방해하진 못하겠네
	character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 55, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	-- 소히(right, attack, cross_arm) : 문제는 우리도 엘리베이터가 없으면 최상층으로 가는 방법이…
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '55_1', skip = true })

	-- 가디언 emoticon_bubble_silence
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'silence')

	-- 선택지
	-- 1) 길을 찾아본다. (초록색)/ 2) 한숨 자고 생각해 본다.(노란색)
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. 57, 'mercy' }
	, { self.string_key .. '57_1', 'intellect' } })

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 가디언 left, idle, release 2회
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })

		-- 프리실라 (down, tired, idle) : 다른 방법을 찾아보자는 말씀이신가요…?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 58, skip = true })

		-- 소히(down, idle, idle) : …뭐, 여기 계속 있을 것도 아니니까 그래야지.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
		character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'down')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 59, skip = true })

		-- 소히(left, tired, idle): 계단은 아니었으면 좋겠는데…
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 60, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)
		character_util.remove_emotion(daughter)
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
		local sleep_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_sleep_01', loop = true })
		-- 가디언 left, sleep, sleep 1.5초 대기 후
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'sleep' }, { name = 'sleep' })
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		-- 소히 down, attack, 짧은 진동
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
		character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.shake(sohee, 0.04, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
		-- 소히(down, mad, 점프 1회): [shout] 지금 그럴 때가 아니잖아!
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'mad' })
		character_util.normal_jump(sohee, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '60_1'
		, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

		sleep_sfx:Stop()
		sleep_sfx = nil
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bubble_pop_01')
		-- 가디언 (left, idle, sleep)
		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
		-- 이후 마리오 쩜으로 일어난 뒤 up, emoticon_bubble_sweat
		character_util.mario_jump_async(leader, 'left')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'sweat')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		-- 소히 (left, attack, idle) : 우선 길을 따라가보자, 분명히 최상층으로 가는 방법도 있을 거야.
		character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'left')
		character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '60_2', skip = true })
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	end

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	-- 컨트롤 풀림. 연구원에게 마커.
	-- 연구원 right, idle, eat + 검은 틴트 처리
	local researcher = self.get_researcher()
	character_util.set_active_state(researcher, 'enabled')
	character_util.add_listener(researcher, self.controller)

	self.typing_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_typing_01', loop = true, parent = researcher })
	character_util.set_anim(researcher, { name = 'eat' })
	researcher.SpineController:AddColor(researcher.Name, unity_color({ 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 1 }), 1, 0)

	self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.find_researcher
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, researcher, true)
end

function local_class:interact_researcher()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local daughter = self.controller.get_count_daughter()
	local sohee = self.controller.get_sohee()
	local researcher = self.get_researcher()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	-- 연구원 인터렉트 시 플레이어 좌측 정렬.0.5초 뒤 틴트 사라짐.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
	researcher.SpineController:RemoveColor(researcher.Name, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.typing_loop_sfx:Stop()
	self.typing_loop_sfx = nil

	-- 연구원 left, idle, idle

	character_util.set_direction(researcher, 'left')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')

	character_util.normal_jump(researcher, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher, { key = self.string_key .. 61, skip = true })

	-- 가디언 right, idle, release
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 3 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'tired' })
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 연구원 (left, idle, idle) : 최상층으로 가다가… 엘리베이터가 폭발했다고…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher, { key = self.string_key .. 62, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	-- 연구원 (left, idle, question)  emoticon_bubble_silence
	character_util.set_anim(researcher, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(researcher, nil, 'silence')
	character_util.remove_anim(researcher)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	-- 연구원 (right, attack, idle) : [small] 알고 여기 온 것 같진 않은데… 들킨 건 아니겠지…?
	character_util.set_direction(researcher, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(researcher, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher, { key = self.string_key .. 63, scale = 0.7
	, skip = true })

	-- 소히 (right, idle,idle) : 들키다니?
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 64, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)

	character_util.set_emotion(researcher, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(researcher, '01_player_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher, { key = self.string_key .. 65, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(researcher)

	-- 연구원(left, idle, release) : 우연이네…! 엘리베이터에서 떨어져 이런 곳에서 다 만나고…
	character_util.set_anim(researcher, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher, { key = self.string_key .. 66, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(researcher)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	-- 연구원(left, smile, idle) : 하하…
	character_util.set_emotion(researcher, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher, { key = self.string_key .. 67, skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })

		-- 연구원 (left, surprise, 점프 1회) emoticon_bubble_exclamation

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(researcher, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'damaged' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher, { key = self.string_key .. 71, skip = true })

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'shoot' }, { name = 'attack' })
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

		-- 연구원(left, damaged, embarrassed) : 아, 알았어!! 사실대로 말할 테니 용서해줘!!
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(researcher, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher, { key = self.string_key .. 72, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(researcher)

	-- 연구원 (left, tired, idle) : 여긴 폐쇄한 인공태양 연구동인데…
	character_util.set_emotion(researcher, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher, { key = self.string_key .. 73, skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(researcher, { name = 'damaged' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher, { key = self.string_key .. 75, skip = true })

	-- 프리실라 (right, tired, idle): 거짓말을 하는 거 같진 않아요…
	character_util.set_emotion(daughter, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 76, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(daughter)

	-- 소히 (right, idle, idle) : 인공태양 연구소의 자료? 여기가 연구 시설이란 말이야?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 77, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	-- 연구원 left, idle, nod 2회

function local_class:fail_escape_research_institute()
	self.is_resetting = true

	-- 2.5초 죽는 연출 후
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if user_party[i].Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up
				or user_party[i].Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
			character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'left')
		end

		if i == 0 then
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i]
			, { name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' }
			, { name = 'damaged' })
		else

					{ name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
		end

-- ExitInteractable의 Interactable를 원복하는 함수
function local_class:restore_exit_interact_fo()
	if self.exit_interact_fo == nil then
		return
	end

	-- ExitInteractable -> ExitInteractable로 원복
	for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
		local exit_fo = self.exit_interact_fo[i]
		exit_fo.Interactable = self.cached_exit[i]
	end

	self.exit_interact_fo = nil
	self.marker_fo_list = nil
	self.cached_exit = nil
end

-- ExitInteractable를 제어하기 위해 PublishInteractable로 변경하는 함수
function local_class:changed_exit_interact_fo(index)
	self.cached_exit = {}
	self.exit_interact_fo = {}

	local exit_names = {}
	if index == 1 then
		exit_names = { 'pyramid_inner_1', 'underpass_inner_1', 'underpass_outer_1'
		, 'underpass_inner_2', 'underpass_outer_2' }
		self.exit_teleport_names = { 'pyramid_inner_1', 'underpass_inner_1', 'underpass_outer_1'
		, 'underpass_inner_2', 'underpass_outer_2' }
	elseif index == 2 then
		exit_names = { 'underground_waterway_inner_1', 'underground_waterway_outer_1'
		, 'mansion_outer_1', 'mansion_inner_1' }
		self.exit_teleport_names = { 'underground_waterway_inner_1', 'underground_waterway_outer_1'
		, 'masion_inner_1_wp', 'masion_outer_1_wp' }
	end

	for i = 1, #exit_names do
		local exit_fo = get_field_object(exit_names[i])
		table.insert(self.cached_exit, exit_fo.Interactable)
		exit_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		table.insert(self.exit_interact_fo, exit_fo)
	end

	if index == 1 then
		self.marker_fo_list = {
			vector(-110.5, 0, 6.5),
			self.exit_interact_fo[3],
			self.exit_interact_fo[1],
			self.exit_interact_fo[3],
			self.exit_interact_fo[1]
		}
	elseif index == 2 then
		self.marker_fo_list = { get_field_object(self.exit_name), self.exit_interact_fo[1]
		, nil, self.exit_interact_fo[1] }
	end
end

-- ExitInteractable 대신 이동해주는 루틴
function local_class:teleport_party_for_marker_routine(index)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.teleport_party_for_marker
	, self, self.exit_teleport_names[index], self.marker_fo_list[index]))
end

-- ExitInteractable 대신 이동해주는 함수
function local_class:teleport_party_for_marker(marker_name, quest_marker_fo)
	-- 마커 재 조정
	local marker = field:GetMarker(marker_name)
	CS.Oak.TeleportPartyStageLogic.Execute(marker)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if quest_marker_fo == nil then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
		return
	end

	local quest_marker_name = self.controller.quest_marker_name
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, quest_marker_name, quest_marker_fo, true)
end

	end

	-- 파랑1 (right, attack, nod) : 주력 분대는 다음 지점으로 이동했다.

	self.blizzard_sfx = nil

	self.get_sun_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_theater_demonshire_sun_big') end

	-- 컨트롤 유닛
	self.get_control_unit = function() return get_field_object('control_unit_1') end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	if self.stage_name ~= stage.Name then
		return
	end

	self.get_sun_effect()

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if self.stage_name ~= stage.Name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	local control_unit = self.get_control_unit()
	control_unit.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	control_unit.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.3, 0, 0.5), vector(2, 1, 3))

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.stage_name ~= stage.Name then
		return
	end

	-- 마법진으로 마커
	local marker_pos = field:GetMarker('magic_circle_point_1').position
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, marker_pos, true)

	-- 태양 세팅
	self.sun_effect = self.get_sun_effect():Instantiate(vector(-140.5, 0, -16))
	self.sun_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.stage_name ~= stage.Name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	if self.blizzard_sfx ~= nil then
		self.blizzard_sfx:Stop()
		self.blizzard_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.sun_effect then
		self.sun_effect:Dispose()
		self.sun_effect = nil
	end

	if self.touch_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.touch_handler = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local control_unit = self.get_control_unit()

local local_class = newclass('DemonShireMainSection18')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DemonShireMain @
		Comment = DemonShireMain 퀘스트 섹션 18 @
		Index = 17 @
		NextSections = 18 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- npc
	self.get_sohee = function() return get_character('sohee') end
	self.get_count_daughter = function() return get_character('count_daughter') end
	self.get_vampire_captain = function() return get_character('vampire_captain') end

	-- 마커
	self.get_align_pos = function() return field:GetMarker('s18_align_pos').position end
	self.get_count_daughter_pos = function() return field:GetMarker('s18_count_daughter_pos').position end

	--  기믹
	self.get_exit = function() return get_field_object('exit_passage_14_3') end
	self.get_switch = function(index) return get_field_object('s18_switch_' .. index) end
	self.get_stair_lab_outer = function() return get_field_object('stair_lab_outer') end

	self.progress_enum = {
		none = 1,
		-- 프리실라를 본 상태
		show_count_daughter = 2
	}

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.none

	-- 퀘스트 마커 설정
	self.quest_marker_data = {
		prison = {
			zone_name = 'in_prison',
			get_target = self.get_stair_lab_outer
		},
		lab = {
			zone_name = 'in_lab',
			get_target = self.get_exit
		}
	}

	-- 연출 끝나고 나갈 때 사용할 exit fo 이름
	self.stage_exit_name = 'exit_passage_14_3'

	self.stage_name = 'demonshire_3_1'

	self.quest_marker_name = 'section18_quest_marker'

	-- 문 이름
	self.down_door_name = 's18_down_door_'
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	self.optimized_npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async({
		guard_1 = 'ds_vampire_guard_npc',
		guard_2 = 'ds_vampire_guard_npc',
		guard_3 = 'ds_vampire_guard_npc',
		guard_4 = 'ds_vampire_guard_npc',
		guard_5 = 'ds_vampire_guard_npc',
		guard_6 = 'ds_vampire_guard_npc'
	})
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	local exit = self.get_exit()
	exit.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	self:npc_setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.optimized_npcs then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
		self.optimized_npcs = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's18_show_count_daughter') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_count_daughter_event, self)

		return true
	end

	-- 퀘스트 마커 처리
	for _, marker_data in pairs(self.quest_marker_data) do
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.show_count_daughter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, marker_data.zone_name) then

			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, marker_data.get_target(), true)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.show_count_daughter and
		type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_exit()) then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.exit_stage_event, self))

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--- npc 세팅
function local_class:npc_setting()
	local count_daughter = self.get_count_daughter()
	local vampire_captain = self.get_vampire_captain()

	local count_daughter_pos = self.get_count_daughter_pos()
	character_util.set_active_state(count_daughter, 'enabled')
	count_daughter.Position = count_daughter_pos + vector(0, 1, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(count_daughter, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(count_daughter, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	character_util.set_anim(count_daughter, { name = 'sleep' })

	character_util.set_active_state(vampire_captain, 'enabled')
	vampire_captain.Position = count_daughter_pos + vector(0, 0, -1.5)
	character_util.set_direction(vampire_captain, 'down')

	for i = 1, 6 do
		local guard = self.optimized_npcs['guard_' .. i]
		character_util.set_direction(guard, 'down')
	end

	self.optimized_npcs.guard_1.Position = count_daughter_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 2.5)
	self.optimized_npcs.guard_2.Position = count_daughter_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 2.5)
	self.optimized_npcs.guard_3.Position = count_daughter_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 1.5)
	self.optimized_npcs.guard_4.Position = count_daughter_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 1.5)

	local guard_5 = self.optimized_npcs.guard_5
	guard_5.Position = count_daughter_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.25)
	character_util.set_anim(guard_5, { name = 'cast2', upper = true })

	local guard_6 = self.optimized_npcs.guard_6
	guard_6.Position = count_daughter_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.25)
	character_util.set_anim(guard_6, { name = 'cast2', upper = true })
end

--- 프리실라 지나가는 것을 보는 이벤트
function local_class:show_count_daughter_event()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local count_daughter = self.get_count_daughter()
	local vampire_captain = self.get_vampire_captain()

	sohee:HideWeapon(true)

	-- 트리거 존 진입시, 가디언 일행 초록점 위치까지 정렬
	local align_pos = self.get_align_pos()
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, leader, align_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 1),
			3, false, nil, nil, 'down'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, sohee, align_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 1),
			3, false, nil, nil, 'down')
	})

	camera_util.move_async(vampire_captain.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 동적 할당 npc라 스위치가 눌려있지 않아서 투명벽으로 누르고 있도록
	local wall_invisible = get_field_object('s18_wall_invisible')
	wall_invisible.Position = self.get_count_daughter_pos() + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
	wall_invisible.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(6, 0.5, 3))

	-- 카메라 패닝 후 1초 뒤, 노랑1~4가 파랑(버튼)1~4 각 위치로 이동하여 버튼 밟음
	local guard_origin_pos = {}
	local guard_move_end = {}

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local guard = self.optimized_npcs['guard_' .. i]
		local switch = self.get_switch(i)

		guard_origin_pos[guard] = guard.Position
		guard_move_end[guard] = false

		local waypoint = {}

		if i % 2 == 1 then
			table.insert(waypoint, guard.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0))
			table.insert(waypoint, vector(guard.Position.x - 1, 0, switch.Position.z))
		else
			table.insert(waypoint, guard.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))
			table.insert(waypoint, vector(guard.Position.x + 1, 0, switch.Position.z))
		end

		table.insert(waypoint, switch.Position)

		local cb = function(waypoint_index)
			if waypoint_index + 1 == #waypoint then
				guard_move_end[guard] = true

				message_system:SendSync(switch, CS.Oak.FloorSwitchStepOnEvent.Create(wall_invisible))
			end
		end

		character_util.move_waypoint(guard, waypoint, 4, false, nil, nil,
			'down', nil, nil, cb)
	end

	-- 테이블 안의 npc 이동이 전부 끝났는지 체크
	local check_move_end = function(check_table)
		local all_move_end = false

		-- 이동 끝날 때까지 대기
		while not all_move_end do
			all_move_end = true

			for _, value in pairs(check_table) do
				if not value then
					all_move_end = false
					break
				end
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	check_move_end(guard_move_end)

	-- 하단 도어 오픈하고, 0.5초 뒤
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.down_door_name .. 1, false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.down_door_name .. 2, false))
	wait_for_sec(1)

	wall_invisible.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	-- 발렌시아 병력 다시 정렬하여 화면 아래로 퇴장
	guard_move_end = {}

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local guard = self.optimized_npcs['guard_' .. i]

		guard_move_end[guard] = false

		local waypoint = {}

		if i % 2 == 1 then
			table.insert(waypoint, guard.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))
			table.insert(waypoint, vector(guard.Position.x + 1, 0, guard_origin_pos[guard].z))
		else
			table.insert(waypoint, guard.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0))
			table.insert(waypoint, vector(guard.Position.x - 1, 0, guard_origin_pos[guard].z))
		end

		table.insert(waypoint, guard_origin_pos[guard])

		local cb = function(waypoint_index)
			if waypoint_index + 1 == #waypoint then
				guard_move_end[guard] = true
			end
		end

		character_util.move_waypoint(guard, waypoint, 4, false, nil, nil,
			'down', nil, nil, cb)
	end

	check_move_end(guard_move_end)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_costume_equip_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 움직일 npc
	local move_npc_table = { vampire_captain }

	for i = 1, 6 do
		table.insert(move_npc_table, self.optimized_npcs['guard_' .. i])
	end

	-- 문 밑으로 내려가는 npc들
	for _, npc in pairs(move_npc_table) do

		local cb = function(waypoint_index)
			if waypoint_index + 1 == 1 then
				character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
			end
		end

		character_util.move_waypoint(npc, vector(npc.Position.x, 0, vampire_captain.Position.z - 6),
			4, false, nil, nil, nil, nil, cb)
	end

	character_util.move_to_async(count_daughter,
		vector(count_daughter.Position.x, 1, vampire_captain.Position.z - 6), nil, 4)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(count_daughter)
	character_util.set_active_state(count_daughter, 'disabled')

	-- 카메라 복귀, 가디언 소히(down, surprise, jumpx1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'surprise' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

	-- 이후 가디언, 소히 하단 지점까지 빠르게 달려서 이동
	local move_end_pos = self.get_switch(3).Position

	local speed = 7
	character_util.move_waypoint(sohee, vector(sohee.Position.x, 0, move_end_pos.z), speed, true)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, vector(leader.Position.x, 0, move_end_pos.z),
		speed, true, nil, nil, 'down', true)

	-- 상단 지점 도착하자마자 도어 닫힘, 가디언 (down, surprise, embarrassed), 소히(down, attack, jingak)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_up_02')
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.down_door_name .. 1))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.down_door_name .. 2))

	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'jingak', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim(sohee)

	-- 소히(down, attack, idle) : 수용소에 가두는 거로도 모자랐던 거야…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s18_5', skip = true })

	-- 소히(down, attack, idle) : 자기 딸을 대체 얼마나 더 괴롭히려고…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s18_6', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	-- 소히(left, sleep_deep, cross_arm) emoticon_bubble_silence
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(sohee, nil, 'silence')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	-- 소히(down, attack, idle) : …저 녀석도 데리고 가야겠지.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s18_9', skip = true })

	-- 소히(down, attack, idle) : 통치자를 설득할 수 있는 건 저 녀석 밖에 없을 테니까.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s18_10', skip = true })

	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	-- 소히(left, attack, release) : 빨리 쫓아가면 따라잡을 수 있을 거야!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s18_11', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	if self.optimized_npcs then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
		self.optimized_npcs = nil
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(count_daughter, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(vampire_captain, 'disabled')

	sohee:HideWeapon(false)

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_stair_lab_outer(), true)
end

--- exit 상호작용 했을 때 이벤트
function local_class:exit_stage_event()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)

	-- 스테이지 밖으로 내보낸다.
	CS.Oak.TeleportPartyStageLogic.Execute(self.stage_exit_name, 'passage_14_3', '', true)
end

return local_class

		NextSections = 19 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.target_stage = 'demonshire_3_5'

	self.talk_name = 'ds_main_s19_'

	-- 1, 2, 3
	self.event_states = {
		init = 1,
		to_lobby = 2,
		oh_no = 3,
		lobby_again = 4,
		get_key = 5,
		see_priscilla_setting = 6,
		see_priscilla = 7,
		lab_activities = 8,
		lab_all_clear = 9,
	}
	self.current_state = self.event_states.init

	self.sub_states = {
		pre = -1,
		on_going = 0,
		cleared = 1
	}
	self.lab_states = {
		self.sub_states.pre,
		self.sub_states.pre,
		self.sub_states.pre,
	}

	self.is_lab_started = function()
		for i = 1, 3 do

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage then return true end

	local lab_3_qp = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(300)
	if lab_3_qp ~= nil and lab_3_qp.IsComplete then
		return
	end

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_39_demonshire/worldmap/common', 'WorldMapLoopChange', function(prefab)
				self.loop_controller_prefab = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				self.loop_controller = self.loop_controller_prefab:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapLoopChange)).GetControllerLuaTable
			end)
	self.loop_controller:init_loop_effect()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'ui/prologue', 'typing_text', function(prefab)
				local typing_text_go = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				self.time_loop_text = typing_text_go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))
			end)
	self.time_loop_text.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 0, 100, 0, 0)
	self.time_loop_text.Label.fontSize = 64
	self.time_loop_text.Label.alignment = CS.NGUIText.Alignment.Center
	self.time_loop_text.Widget:UpdateAnchors()
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	self.time_loop_text.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.optimized_researchers = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async({
		researcher_1 = 'ds_researcher_male',
		researcher_2 = 'ds_vampire_researcher',
	})
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage then return true end

	-- PS-8964 FIX : 강제 종료 등의 이유로 Lab3가 클리어 되었음에도 불구하고 메인 섹션이 넘어가지 않은 상황을 대비
	local lab_3_qp = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(300)
	if lab_3_qp ~= nil and lab_3_qp.IsComplete then
		return false
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent), 'on_quest_cleared_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')

	self.lobby_info_clerk = get_character('lobby_info_clerk')

	-- 298, 299, 300
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local lab_qp = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(297 + i)
		if lab_qp == nil then
			self.lab_states[i] = self.sub_states.pre
		elseif lab_qp.IsComplete then
			self.lab_states[i] = self.sub_states.cleared
		else
			self.lab_states[i] = self.sub_states.on_going
		end
	end
	for i = 1, 3 do
		if self.lab_states[i] > self.sub_states.pre then
			local lab_door = self.get_lab_door(i)
			self:open_gate(lab_door, true)
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage then
		return
	end

	-- 프리실라 잡혀가는 것 까지 보고 스테이지 재입장 시 앞 연출 스킵
	local state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_key)
	if state == 1 then
		local lobby_door = self.get_lobby_door()
		self:open_gate(lobby_door, true)

		local lobby_card_reader = self.get_lobby_card_reader()
		lobby_card_reader.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		-- 여성 연구원 원라인 (down, idle, idle) : 이번 신입…  한 달은 버티겠지…?
		local information = self.get_information_npc()
		information.Interactable.Talk = self.talk_name .. 29

		if self.lab_states[1] > self.sub_states.pre then
			-- 1번 연구동 시작 이후 처리
			self.current_state = self.event_states.lab_activities
		else
			-- 1번 연구동 시작 이전 처리
			self.current_state = self.event_states.see_priscilla

			local lab_1_card_reader = self.get_lab_1_card_reader()
			lab_1_card_reader.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.first_entry_marker_name, self.get_lab_1_card_reader())
		end
	else
		local lobby_card_reader = self.get_lobby_card_reader()
		lobby_card_reader.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		local lobby_center_pos = vector(-199.5, 0, -117.5)
		character_util.set_active_state(self.optimized_researchers.researcher_1, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_active_state(self.optimized_researchers.researcher_2, 'enabled')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(self.optimized_researchers.researcher_1, 1, 0)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(self.optimized_researchers.researcher_2, 1, 0)
		character_util.set_position(self.optimized_researchers.researcher_1, lobby_center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(self.optimized_researchers.researcher_1, 'right')
		character_util.set_position(self.optimized_researchers.researcher_2, lobby_center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(self.optimized_researchers.researcher_2, 'left')
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage then return true end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))

	if self.optimized_researchers ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_researchers)
		self.optimized_researchers = nil
	end

	if self.time_loop_text ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.time_loop_text)
		self.time_loop_text = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
	if self.loop_controller_prefab then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.loop_controller_prefab)
		self.loop_controller_prefab = nil
	end

	self.loop_controller = nil
	-- 동적 로딩한 캐릭터들 전부 제거
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage then return true end
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage then return true end

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.lobby_info_clerk) then

		if self.current_state == self.event_states.to_lobby then
			self.current_state = self.event_states.oh_no
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interected_information, self)
			return true
		elseif self.current_state == self.event_states.lobby_again then
			self.current_state = self.event_states.get_key
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interected_information_after_reset, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_lobby_card_reader()) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_interacted_gate, self))
		return true
	end

	local lab_1_card_reader = self.get_lab_1_card_reader()
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, lab_1_card_reader) and
			self.current_state == self.event_states.see_priscilla then
		self.current_state = self.event_states.lab_activities
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lab_1_door_open_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if self.current_lab ~= 0 then
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	for i = 1, 3 do
		for n = 1, self.lab_section_count[i] do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_knight(), self.get_entrance_name(i, n)) then
				if n == 1 then
					self.current_lab = i
				end
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_knight(), 's19_lab_starting_zone') and
			self.current_state == self.event_states.init then
		self.current_state = self.event_states.to_lobby
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.entered_lab_lobby, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_knight(), 'battle_3') and
			self.current_state == self.event_states.get_key then
		self.current_state = self.event_states.see_priscilla_setting
		self:prepare_priscilla_taken()
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_knight(), 'lab_center_entrance') and
			self.current_state == self.event_states.see_priscilla_setting then
		self.current_state = self.event_states.see_priscilla
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.priscilla_taken, self)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_cleared_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.lab3_quest_id then
		start_coroutine(self.custom_progress_section, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:lab_1_door_open_event()
	local lab_1_card_reader = self.get_lab_1_card_reader()
	local lab_1_door = self.get_lab_door(1)
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.first_entry_marker_name)
	lab_1_card_reader.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	party_util.align_party(vector_util.get_x0z(lab_1_card_reader.Bounds.center), 'right', 0.5)
	character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, true)

	local typing_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_typing_01', loop = true})
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, {name = 'dualgun_attack_right', count = 4})
	--좌측 통로의 카드 리더기 인터렉트 시 정지 이벤트 실행.

	character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, false)

	typing_sfx:Stop()
	typing_sfx = nil
	--카드 리더기 : 평사원 보안 카드 확인.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_05')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lab_1_card_reader, { key = 'ds_main_s19_31', skip = true })

	--1초 뒤 게이트 문 열리고 플레이어 walk로 문 안쪽으로 들어가려는 순간 하단의 소히 대사 출력.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	self:open_gate(lab_1_door)

	local door_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(lab_1_door.Position)

	local knight_wp = {
		vector(knight.Position.x, 0, -49.5),
		vector(door_pos.x + 0.5, 0, -49.5)
	}

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(knight, knight_wp, 4, false)

	--소히 (left, attack, jump 1회) : [shout] 잠깐! 그렇게 당해놓고 또!
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(sohee)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s19_32', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	--상단 대사와 함께 플레이어 right 바라봄.
	--소히 (left, attack, release 2회) : 함부로 움직이지마! 예기치못한 변곡점이 생길 수 있다고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(sohee, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s19_33', skip = true })

	--소히 (left, attack, idle) : 모든 선택에는 신중을 가하자는 이야기야. 알겠지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s19_34', skip = true })

	--플레이어 right, idle, nod 2회 실행. 이후 컨트롤 복귀.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(knight, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(
			nil, { 'lab_1_1_start' }))
