function local_class:prepare_priscilla_taken()
	local card_reader = self.get_card_reader()
	local guard_pos = {
		card_reader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
		card_reader.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
		card_reader.Position + vector(-1, 0, -2),
		card_reader.Position + vector(-2, 0, -2)
	}

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local guard = self.get_lab_entry_guard_by_idx(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(guard, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_direction(guard, 'up')
		character_util.set_position(guard, guard_pos[i])
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard)
	end

	local priscilla = self.get_count_daughter()
	local priscilla_pos = card_reader.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, -1)
	character_util.set_active_state(priscilla, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(priscilla, 'up')
	character_util.set_position(priscilla, priscilla_pos)
end

function local_class:priscilla_taken()
	local card_reader = self.get_card_reader()
	local priscilla = self.get_count_daughter()
	local guards = {}
	local npcs = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local guard = self.get_lab_entry_guard_by_idx(i)
		table.insert(guards, guard)
		table.insert(npcs, guard)
	end
	table.insert(npcs, priscilla)

	--카메라 위로 패닝하여 프리실라 포커싱
	camera_util.move_async(priscilla.Position, 1, { end_target = priscilla })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--1번 카드키 리더 왼쪽 로얄가드가 (right, idle, attack 1회), 로얄가드가 어택 시 카드키 리더 0.5초 shake 0.03
	character_util.set_direction(guards[1], 'right')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(guards[1], { name = 'attack' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_equip_weapon_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--카드키 리더 : 1급 보안 카드 확인.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(card_reader, { key = 'ds_main_s19_42', skip = true })

	--obstacle 기믹 활성 (지나갈 수 있음)
	--TODO: 임시 연출
	local main_door = self.get_card_main_door(1)
	local door_anim = main_door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	main_door.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	door_anim:Play('on')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	character_util.set_direction(guards[1], 'up')

	--프리실라 아래, 오른쪽 로얄가드 대사 출력
	--로얄가드(up) : 이동하시죠. 프리실라 님.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guards[3], { key = 'ds_main_s19_43', skip = true })

	--이후 프리실라와 로얄가드 위로 up, walk
	for i = 1, #npcs do
		local npc = npcs[i]
		local target_pos = vector(npc.Position.x, 0, card_reader.Position.z + 2.5)
		character_util.move_to(npc, target_pos, nil, 2, true, true)
		character_util.move_waypoint(npc, target_pos, 2, false,
				nil, nil, 'up', false, 0, function()
					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 0.3)
				end)
	end

	party_util.align_party(main_door.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -6), 'down', 1, 'linear')

	--계단 아래 1~2 칸에서 알파 페이드로 사라짐. (알파 페이드 시작할 때 프리실라 따라가던 카메라는 정지.)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(priscilla.Position, 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, #npcs do
		local npc = npcs[i]
		character_util.set_position(npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, 0)
	end

	--obstacle 기믹 비활성 (지나갈 수 없음)
	main_door.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	door_anim:Play('off')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--1초 후 카메라 플레이어에게 돌아옴
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--가디언 up, 점프 1회하며 emoticon_bubble_exclamation
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()

	character_util.normal_jump(knight, true)
	character_util.normal_jump(sohee, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon(knight, nil, 'notice')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(sohee, nil, 'notice')

	-- 이후 run 으로 카드키 리더 앞에 정렬
	local card_reader_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(card_reader.Bounds.center)
	local knight_run_wp = {
		vector(knight.Position.x, 0, card_reader_pos.z - 0.5),
		vector(card_reader_pos.x + 0.5, 0, card_reader_pos.z - 0.5)
	}

	local sohee_run_wp = {
		vector(sohee.Position.x, 0, card_reader_pos.z - 0.5),
		vector(card_reader_pos.x - 0.5, 0, card_reader_pos.z - 0.5)
	}

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				knight, knight_run_wp, 7, true, nil, nil, 'up', true),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				sohee, sohee_run_wp, 7, true, nil, nil, 'up', true)
	})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--가디언 (up, release 2회)
	local typing_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_typing_01', loop = true})
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(knight, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	--1초 대기 후
	wait_for_sec(1)
	typing_sfx:Stop()
	typing_sfx = nil

	--카드키 리더: 접근 거부. 출입 권한이 부족합니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(card_reader, { key = 'ds_main_s19_44', skip = true })

	--기사 left, idle, idle  소히 right, idle, idle
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')

	--소히(right, idle, release): 아까 1급 보안 카드라고 했으니까, 그것만 찾으면 들어갈 수 있을 거야.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(sohee, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s19_45', skip = true })

	--기사 left, idle, victory_get 이후 컨트롤 풀림
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(2)
	character_util.remove_anim(knight)

	--이후 1번 연구동 테이블 위 아이템 merch_laura_diray 에 마커

	--연구동 초입 이벤트 한 뒤 데이터 저장(이후 19섹션 진행 도중 종료하고 재접속했을 때 초입 이벤트 진행하지 않도록)
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_key, 1)

	local lab_1_card_reader = self.get_lab_1_card_reader()
	lab_1_card_reader.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.first_entry_marker_name, lab_1_card_reader)
end

function local_class:screen_alarm_wave()
	while self.is_alarm_active do
		field:Tint(self.security_alarm_event, unity_class.color.red, 0.25, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		if not self.is_alarm_active then break end
		field:RemoveTint(self.security_alarm_event, 0.25)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end
	field:RemoveTint(self.security_alarm_event, 0)
end

function local_class:security_alarm()
	self.is_alarm_active = true

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.screen_alarm_wave, self))

	party_util.set_direction('right')

	party_util.set_anim({name = 'embarrassed'})
	party_util.set_emotion({name = 'surprise'})

	camera_util.shake(0.04, 0.2)

	character_util.normal_jump(self.get_knight(), true)
	character_util.normal_jump(self.get_sohee())
	character_util.normal_jump(self.get_count_daughter())

	--경보 스위치 밟을 경우 / 경비병들 존에 발각될 경우 아래 연출 (1,2,3연구동 전부 동일)
	--
	--적색 경보가 울리며 “경고!!! 침입자 발생!!!” 말풍선 출력
	--가디언 일행 surprise, embarrased 후 [리셋 위치]로 리셋됨.
	--
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.get_knight(), {key = self.talk_name .. 'security_alarm', skip = true,
																	screen_pos = vector(0, 200, 0),
																	bubble_type = 'shout', scale = 2})

	yield_return_func(self.where_are_we, self)
end

		self.optimized_researchers = nil

	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')

	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(sohee, {name = "nod", count = 2})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.talk_name .. 4, skip = true })

	--소히(right, smile, idle) : 여기가 어디인지 한눈에 알 거 같아.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.talk_name .. 5, skip = true })

	--기사 left, idle, question 자세, 이후 선택지 출력

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({

		{ self.talk_name .. 7, 'intellect' },
		{ self.talk_name .. 8, 'brutal' }
	})

	--선택지(초록색): 연구소
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--가디언 left, idle, release
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(knight, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		--소히 (right, idle, idle) : 맞아, 어떤 연구를 하는 곳인지는 모르겠지만.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.talk_name .. 9, skip = true })

		--선택지(노란색): 의문의 스튜디오
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		--가디언 left, idle, nod
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.nod_twice(knight)

		--소히 (right, tired, bomb_idle) : 스튜디오? 무슨 말이야, 그게…
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.talk_name .. 10, skip = true })

		--선택지(붉은색): 흔한 대학원
	elseif choose_result == 3 then
		--가디언 left, tired, cast
		character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'cast' })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

		--소히 (right, sleep_deep, idle) : 대학원생… 그들은 잘못된 선택을 했을 뿐이야.
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.talk_name .. 11, skip = true })
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

	--소히 (right, idle, question) emoticon_bubble_silence
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(sohee, nil, 'silence')

	--소히 (right, idle, idle) : 그것보다 프리실라를 찾아보자.
	character_util.remove_anim(sohee)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.talk_name .. 12, skip = true })

	--소히 (right, idle, release) : 오는 동안 길은 하나였으니, 분명 여기 어딘가에 있을 거야.
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.talk_name .. 13, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(sohee)

	--가디언 left, idle nod 2회 후 컨트롤 풀림. 다음 지역 인포메이션 npc에게 마커
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(knight)

	character_util.add_listener(self.get_information_npc(), self.controller)

	character_util.hide_weapon(knight, false)
	character_util.hide_weapon(sohee, false)

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.first_entry_marker_name, self.get_information_npc())
end

function local_class:interected_information()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.first_entry_marker_name)

	local information = self.get_information_npc()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local knight = self.get_knight()

	local information_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(information.Bounds.center)
	local leader_align_pos = information_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -2)
	local sohee_algin_pos = information_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -2)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				knight, leader_align_pos, 2.5, false, nil, nil, 'up'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				sohee, sohee_algin_pos, 2.5, false, nil, nil, 'up')
	})

	-- 여성 연구원 (down,  smile, idle) : 안녕하세요, 무엇을 도와드릴까요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(information, { key = self.talk_name .. 14, skip = true })

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ self.talk_name .. 15, 'normal' },
		{ self.talk_name .. 16, 'normal' },
	})

	-- 선택지(흰색): 프리실라를 찾고 있다.
	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 여성 연구원 (down,attack, idle) emoticon_bubble_exclamation
		character_util.set_emotion(information, { name = 'attack' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(information, nil, 'notice')

		-- 선택지(흰색): 연구소를 둘러보고 싶다.
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		-- 여성 연구원 (down, tired, idle) : 직원은 아닌 거 같은데… 둘러보고 싶다고요…?
		character_util.set_emotion(information, { name = 'tired' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(information, { key = self.talk_name .. 17, skip = true })
	end

	-- 여성 연구원 (down, attack, release) : [shout] 수상한 사람이다!!
	character_util.set_emotion(information, { name = 'attack' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_anim(information, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	local bubble_data = { key = self.talk_name .. 18, bubble_type ='shout', skip = true }
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(information, bubble_data)

	-- 화면 좌우에서 로얄가드가 달려와 붙잡는다
	local num_guards = 4
	local guards = {}
	local information_name = 'information'

	-- 가디언과 소히 right, damaged, embarrassed
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'cast' })

	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'cast' })

	local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_06', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	for i = 1, num_guards do
		local guard = self.get_lab_entry_guard_by_idx(i)
		local guard_marker = self.get_lab_entry_guard_pos(guard.Name, information_name)
		character_util.set_active_state(guard, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(guard, guard_marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(guard, guard_marker.direction)
		character_util.set_emotion(guard, { name = 'attack' })
		table.insert(guards, guard)
	end

	local guards_dis_wp = {
		{
			guards[1].Position + vector(7.5, 0, 0),
		},
		{
			guards[2].Position + vector(8, 0, 0),
			guards[2].Position + vector(8, 0, 0.5)
		},
		{
			guards[3].Position + vector(-7.5, 0, 0),
		},
		{
			guards[4].Position + vector(-8, 0, 0),
			guards[4].Position + vector(-8, 0, 0.5)
		}
	}

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local guard_1 = guards[1]

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard_1, guards_dis_wp[1],
					7, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)
			character_util.set_emotion(guard_1, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_anim(guard_1, { name = 'shoot', scale = 0.75 })
			character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'damaged' })
			character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'embarrassed' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
			run_sfx:Stop()
			run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', loop = true })
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local guard_2 = guards[2]

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard_2, guards_dis_wp[2],
					7, true, nil, nil, 'up', true)
			character_util.set_emotion(guard_2, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_anim(guard_2, { name = 'push', scale = 1.25 })
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local guard_3 = guards[3]

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard_3, guards_dis_wp[3],
					7, true, nil, nil, 'left', true)
			character_util.set_emotion(guard_3, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_anim(guard_3, { name = 'shoot', scale = 0.75 })

			character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = 'damaged' })
			character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local guard_4 = guards[4]

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard_4, guards_dis_wp[4],
					7, true, nil, nil, 'up', true)
			character_util.set_emotion(guard_4, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_anim(guard_4, { name = 'push', scale = 1.25 })
		end)
	})
	wait_for_sec(2)

	local fade_duration = 1
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	run_sfx:FadeOut(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(information)

	self:party_in_security_detention()
end

-- 시간 플 텍스트 페이드
function local_class:show_time_text(time_count)
	if self.time_loop_text == nil then
		return
	end

	self.time_loop_text.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	-- 태양제까지 n시간
	local text_fade_duration = 2
	local string_key = 'ds_main_explosion_1'
	self.time_loop_text.Label.pivot = CS.UIWidget.Pivot.Top
	self.time_loop_text.Label.width = 2000
	self.time_loop_text.Label.text = game_string:Format(string_key, time_count)
	self:fade_type_loop_text_in(self.time_loop_text, text_fade_duration)

end

function local_class:hide_time_text()
	self.time_loop_text.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:fade_type_loop_text_in(typing_text, duration)
	local cur_time = 0
	typing_text.Label.alpha = 0
	while cur_time < duration do
		cur_time = cur_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		typing_text.Label.alpha = cur_time / duration
		if typing_text.Label.alpha >= 1 then break end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	typing_text.Label.alpha = 1
end



function local_class:time_reset_event(reset_routine)
	self.loop_controller:on_loop_effect()
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	yield_return_func(reset_routine)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)
end

function local_class:lobby_after_reset(knight, sohee)

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false}, { name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.talk_name .. 19, skip = true })

	-- 소히 (right, idle, idle) : 다행히 이번엔 변곡점이 없어서 똑같은 방법으로 탈출해서 여기까지 왔지만…

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')

	end

	character_util.remove_anim(knight)
	typing_sfx:Stop()

	field_ui_manager:Show()

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's2_show_office_front_event') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_office_front_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.showing_office_front_event and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's2_get_bomb') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		if self.remaining_bomb then
			self.remaining_bomb.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
			self.remaining_bomb = nil
		end

		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.get_bomb and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's2_start_battle') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_battle, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.starting_battle and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's2_meet_secretary') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_secretary, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.meeting_with_secretary and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's2_meet_vampire_captain') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_vampire_captain, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.meeting_with_vampire_captain and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's2_second_meet_secretary') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.second_meet_secretary, self)

		return true
	end

	for _, marker_data in pairs(self.quest_marker_data) do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, marker_data.zone_name) then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, marker_data.get_target(), true)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 전투 시작함
function local_class:start_battle()
	local battle_guard_4 = self.get_battle_guard(4)
	local battle_guard_5 = self.get_battle_guard(5)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, vector(leader.Position.x, 0, battle_guard_4.Position.z), 4)

	-- 트리거 존 진입 시, 양쪽 경비병(초록원)가 가디언 바라봄
	character_util.set_direction(battle_guard_4, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(battle_guard_5, 'left')

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	-- 우측 경비병(left, idle, idle) : 정지!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(battle_guard_5, { key = 'ds_main_s2_112', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	-- 좌측 경비병(right, idle, idle)  : 검문을 실시하겠다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(battle_guard_4, { key = 'ds_main_s2_123', skip = true })

	-- 양쪽 경비병이 가디언 옆으로 다가오고, 가디언 down, idle, idle
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	local move_duration = 0.5
	character_util.move_to(battle_guard_4, leader.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
		move_duration, nil, false, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(battle_guard_5, leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
		move_duration, nil, false, true)

	wait_for_sec(0.02)

	-- 양쪽 경비병 push 애니메이션으로 몸수색 실시, 가디언 shake
	-- 가디언 down, confused
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_armor_01')
	character_util.set_anim(battle_guard_4, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_anim(battle_guard_5, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'confused' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(leader, 0.04, 2)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
	local battle_guard_2 = self.get_battle_guard(2)
	local bomb_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = leader.Position, target = battle_guard_2.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 1.5),
		  itemid = 20664, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.75 })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 폭탄 드랍되면 밑에 경비병들이 up
	character_util.set_direction(self.get_battle_guard(1), 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(battle_guard_2, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(self.get_battle_guard(7), 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(self.get_battle_guard(8), 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 가디언 down, confused에서 down, idle -> emoticon_bubble_question
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'question')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')

	for i = 3, 6 do
		local battle_guard = self.get_battle_guard(i)
		character_util.remove_anim(battle_guard)
		character_util.set_emotion(battle_guard, { name = 'surprise' })
	end

	-- 이후 경비병들 surprise
	-- 경비병1 : [shout] 포, 폭탄이다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(battle_guard_2,
		{ key = 'ds_main_s2_124', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', type_speed = 0, lower_priority = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
	-- 경비병2 : [shout] 당장 잡아!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(battle_guard_5,
		{ key = 'ds_main_s2_125', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', type_speed = 0, lower_priority = true })

	bomb_item:ConsumeComplete()

	for i = 1, 8 do
		local battle_guard = self.get_battle_guard(i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(battle_guard)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(battle_guard, 's2_battle', 's2_battle')
	end
end

--- 비서를 만남
function local_class:meet_secretary()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local secretary = self.get_secretary()
	local guard_1 = self.get_guard(1)
	local guard_2 = self.get_guard(2)

	local secretary_pos = self.get_secretary_outer_pos()
	secretary.Position = secretary_pos
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(secretary, 0, 0)

	party_util.align_party(secretary.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), 'down', 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 로얄가드 두 명이 양쪽에서 가디언을 가로 막는다.
	character_util.move_waypoint(guard_1, guard_1.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1.5,
		false, nil, nil, 'down')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard_2, guard_2.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1.5,
		false, nil, nil, 'down')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_armor_01')
	-- 로얄가드1(down, idle, idle) : 이곳은 백작님의 관저입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_1, { key = 'ds_main_s2_1', skip = true })

	-- 로얄가드2(down, idle, odle) : 용무가 있으신 분은 선약을 잡아주십시오.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_2, { key = 'ds_main_s2_2', skip = true })

	-- 가디언(right, attack, release2회)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

	-- 로얄가드2(down, idle, ) : …주지사님을 뵈러 왔다고요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_2, { key = 'ds_main_s2_3', skip = true })

	-- 로얄가드1(down, idle, ) : 주지사님이라면…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_1, { key = 'ds_main_s2_4', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	-- 비서 : 백작.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_5', skip = true })

	-- 대사 출력할 때 카메라 1칸 위로 이동
	-- 비서 ds_vampire_secretary (down, idle, idle) : 주지사와 같은 하잖은 직책으로 고결한 백작님을 모욕하면 곤란합니다.
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_6', skip = true }),
		util.cs_generator(camera_util.move_async, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 1)
	})

	-- 경비병들 up 점프 1회, 이후 경비가 옆으로 비키고, 카메라 다시 1칸 아래로 이동하며 보좌관이 등장

	character_util.set_direction(guard_2, 'up')

	character_util.normal_jump(guard_2, '01_player_jump_01')

		2, false, nil, nil, 'down')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard_2, guard_2.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
		2, false, nil, nil, 'down')

	-- 카메라 다시 1칸 아래로 이동하며 보좌관이 등장
	camera_util.move(leader.Position, 3, { end_target = leader })
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(secretary, 1, 1)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(secretary,
		secretary.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), 0.5)

	-- 비서(down, idle, dile) : …행색을 보아하니 외부인인가 보군요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_7', skip = true })

	-- 비서(down, idle, idle) : 클로드 백작님을 보좌하고 있는 멜리사입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_8', skip = true })

	-- 비서(down, idle, idle) : 축제 기간엔 백작님을 알현하는 것이 불가하니,
	-- 용건이 있다면 저에게 말씀해 주세요. 대신 전달드리겠습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_9', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(secretary, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	-- 비서(down, idle, cross_arm) : …백작님에게 필요한 이야기라면요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_10', skip = true })

	-- 선택지 출력
	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- [마나 축퇴로를 받으러 왔다.]
		{ 'ds_main_s2_11', 'Intellect' },
		-- [리리스의 칙서를 건넨다.]
		{ 'ds_main_s2_12', 'mercy' }
	})

	if player_choice == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		-- 비서(down, idle, cross_arm) : …마나축퇴로?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_13', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(secretary)
		-- 비서(down, idle, idle) : 당신이 그걸 왜 요구하는 건가요?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_14', skip = true })

		-- 비서(down, idle, idle) : 터무니없는 용건은 전달드릴 수 없습니다. 돌아가세요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_15', skip = true })

		-- 대사 종료 후 [리리스의 칙서를 건넨다] 선택지 출력(단일 선택지)
		choose_util.play_choose_event({
			-- [리리스의 칙서를 건넨다.]
			{ 'ds_main_s2_12', 'mercy' }
		})
	end

	-- [리리스의 칙서를 건넨다.] 선택 시, 가디언 up, attack 1회 모션 후  paper_piece 나와서 비서가 획득한다
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')

	local official_letter = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = leader.Position, target = secretary.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.3),
		  itemid = 20572, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.75 })

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(leader, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	official_letter.ConsumeTarget = secretary
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 비서가 칙서 획득하고 right, bow_idle 자세로 칙서 들고 읽는 것처럼
	official_letter = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = secretary.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0.2),
		  itemid = 20572, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.75, showoncharacter = true })

	character_util.set_direction(secretary, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(secretary, { name = 'bow_idle' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')
	-- 비서(right, idle, bow_idle) : 이 칙서를 소지한 $name의 신원을 마왕 리리스가 보증하며…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_17', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(secretary, { name = 'tired' })
	-- 비서(right, tired, bow_idle) : 향후 인베이더의 침공에 대비하기 위해, $name에게 마나축퇴로를 양도해 줄 것을 요청한다…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_18', skip = true })

	-- 비서(right, tired, bow_idle) : …인장이 있는 걸 보면 위조는 아닌 것 같군요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_19', skip = true })

	-- 들고 있던 칙서 사라지며 down
	character_util.remove_anim(secretary)
	official_letter:ConsumeComplete()
	character_util.set_direction(secretary, 'down')

	character_util.set_emotion(secretary, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(secretary, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	-- 비서(down, tired, bomb_idle) : 이런 헤실헤실한 사람이 마왕의 전령이라니…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_20', skip = true })

	-- 비서(down, idle, question) emoticon_bubble_silence
	character_util.set_anim(secretary, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(secretary, nil, 'silence')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(secretary)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	-- 비서(down, idle, idle) : 알겠습니다. 따라오시죠.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_21', skip = true })

	-- 대사 종료 후 비서가 건물로 들어가며 페이드
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(secretary, secretary.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5), 1)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(secretary, 0, 1)
	character_util.move_to_async(secretary, secretary.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
		1, nil, true, true)

	-- 마커 위치 갱신
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_exit_office_outer(), true)
	self.quest_marker_data['field'].get_target = self.get_exit_office_outer

	-- 비서 위치 이동

	secretary.Position = secretary_inner_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(secretary, 'left')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(secretary, 1, 0)

	local vampire_captain = self.get_vampire_captain()
	vampire_captain.Position = secretary.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(vampire_captain, 'right')
end

--- 비서 두 번째 만남
function local_class:second_meet_secretary()
	local secretary = self.get_secretary()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, secretary.Position + vector(1, 0, -1),2)

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

	-- 비서(down, idle, idle) : 이 위로 올라가면 백작님의 집무실입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_21_2', skip = true })

	local move_speed = 2
	local origin_hallway_pos = self.get_origin_hallway_pos() + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	character_util.move_waypoint(secretary, secretary.Position + vector(0, 0, 99), move_speed)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, origin_hallway_pos, move_speed)

	local get_dist = function()
		return leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 1)
	end

	character_util.stop(secretary)
	local start_loop_pos = self.get_start_loop_pos() + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	leader.Position = start_loop_pos
	secretary.Position = get_dist()
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	self.is_loop = true

	local end_loop_pos = self.get_end_loop_pos() + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		while self.is_loop do
			character_util.move_waypoint(secretary, secretary.Position + vector(0, 0, 99), move_speed)
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, end_loop_pos, move_speed)

			if not self.is_loop then
				return
			end

			leader.Position = start_loop_pos
			secretary.Position = get_dist()
		end
	end))

	-- 비서(up) : 백작님을 대면할 시간이 많진 않을 겁니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_22', skip = true })

	-- 비서(up) : 태양제 축제 준비로 매우 바쁘신 상황이라…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_23', skip = true })

	-- 가디언(up) emoticon_bubble_question
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'question')

	-- 비서(up) : 태양제 축제. 뱀파이어와 마족의 화합을 기념하는, 데몬샤이어의 가장 큰 행사입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_24', skip = true })

	-- 비서(up) : 마족들은 통일 전쟁 후 폐허가 된 지상을 버리고 뱀파이어가 살고 있는 지하도시로 이주해왔죠.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_25', skip = true })

	-- 비서(up) : 이후 두 종족이 힘을 합쳐 인공태양을 설치했고, 그날을 기념하여 이렇게 매년 축제를 벌이고 있습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_26', skip = true })

	self.is_loop = false

	character_util.stop(secretary)
	character_util.stop(leader)

	character_util.move_waypoint(secretary,
		secretary.Position + vector(0, 0, 99), move_speed)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, end_loop_pos, move_speed)

	character_util.stop(secretary)

	local origin_hallway_end_pos = self.get_origin_hallway_end_pos() + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	leader.Position = origin_hallway_end_pos
	secretary.Position = get_dist()
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	-- 가디언 멈춘 채, 비서 혼자 앞으로 1칸 이동하며 emoticon_bubble_silence
	character_util.move_waypoint(secretary, secretary.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(secretary, nil, 'silence')

	-- 1칸 이동 후 0.5초 뒤 하단 대사 출력

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	character_util.set_direction(secretary, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(secretary, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	-- 비서(down, sleep_deep, idle) : 다른 도시는 상상도 못할 겁니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_27', skip = true })

	-- 비서 : 깊은 역사를 가진 두 종족이 어울려 사는, 태양과 화합의 지하도시라니…
	-- 비서(right, sleep_deep, idle) 오른쪽으로 1칸 이동하며 대사 출력.
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_28', skip = true }),
		util.cs_generator(
			character_util.move_waypoint_async, secretary, secretary.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1)
	})

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(secretary)
	character_util.set_direction(secretary, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(secretary, { name = 'greed' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	-- 비서(down, greed, idle) : …정말 아름답지 않나요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary,
		{ key = 'ds_main_s2_29', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- 선택지 출력
	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- [태양! 화합! 지하도시!]
		{ 'ds_main_s2_30' },
		-- [잘 모르겠는데요.]
		{ 'ds_main_s2_31' },
	})

	if player_choice == 1 then
		-- 가디언 (left, smile, clap)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_02')
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'clap' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

		camera_util.move_async(secretary.Position, 1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		-- 비서(down, greed, idle) : 뭘 좀 아시는군요!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_31_1', skip = true })

	elseif player_choice == 2 then
		-- 가디언(left, tired, question)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'question', loop = false })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

		camera_util.move_async(secretary.Position, 1)

		character_util.set_emotion(secretary, { name = 'attack' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		-- 비서(down, attack, idle) : 이 철학을 모르시겠다고요?!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_31_2', skip = true })
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(secretary)

	-- 선택 시, 비서가 등을 돌려 왼쪽으로 1타일 이동하며 대사 출력(이동 멈춘 후에도 이어서 출력)
	local secretary_speech = function()
		character_util.set_emotion(secretary, { name = 'attack' })
		-- 비서(left, attack, idle) : 위기가 없는 건 아니었습니다. 두 종족이 하루아침에 친구가 될 수는 없었죠.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary,
			{ key = 'ds_main_s2_32', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'rb' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(secretary, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
		-- 비서(left, sleep_deep, idle) : 데몬샤이어를 위해 매일 같이 고민하시던 백작님은 어려운 결정을 내리셨습니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary,
			{ key = 'ds_main_s2_33', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'rb' })
	end

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(
			character_util.move_waypoint_async, secretary, secretary.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 0.5),
		util.cs_generator(secretary_speech)
	})

	-- 비서가 다시 가디언을 바라본다.
	character_util.remove_emotion(secretary)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(secretary, 'down')

	character_util.set_emotion(secretary, { name = 'attack' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	-- 비서(down, attack, idle) : 백작님 스스로 고위 마족과 혼인하기로!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_34', skip = true })

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(secretary, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	-- 비서(down attack, release 1회) : (shout) 원로의 반대를 무릅쓰고! 순혈 뱀파이어인 백작님이 직접!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_35', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(secretary, { name = 'greed' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	camera_util.move(secretary.Position, 0.5)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.5)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
	-- 비서(down, greed, release 2회) : (shout) 백작님은 도시를 위해 혈통이 아닌 화합을 선택하신 겁니다!
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, secretary, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async,
			secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_36', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' }),
		util.cs_generator(wait_for_sec, 0.5)
	})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(secretary)

	-- 카메라 복귀, 가디언(up, idle, idle) emoticon_bubble_sweat
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'sweat')

	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- [물어보진 않았지만 잘 들었습니다.]
		{ 'ds_main_s2_38' },
	})

	-- 가디언(right, smile, clap)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_01')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'clap' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

	-- 비서(down, idle, idle) : ……
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_40', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(secretary, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	-- 비서(down, sleep_deep, idle) : …제가 조금 흥분했군요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_41', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(secretary)
	-- 비서(down, idle, idle) : 몇 년 전 영부인께서 갑자기 돌아가신 후로는 잡음이 들리고 있지만....
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_42', skip = true })

	-- 비서(down, idle, idle) : 백작님께서 잘 해결해 주실 겁니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_43', skip = true })

	-- 비서가 등을 돌린 후 대사 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(secretary, 'up')

	-- 비서(up, idle, idle) : …늘 그랬듯이.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_44', skip = true })

	local office_center = self.get_office_center_pos()
	local guard_1 = self.get_guard(1)
	local guard_2 = self.get_guard(2)
	guard_1.Position = office_center + vector(-2.5, 0, 0)
	guard_2.Position = office_center + vector(2.5, 0, 0)

	local event_end_pos = office_center + vector(0, 0, -5)
	character_util.move_waypoint(secretary, vector(secretary.Position.x, 0, event_end_pos.z), move_speed)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, vector(leader.Position.x, 0, event_end_pos.z), move_speed)

	self:meet_count()
end

-- 백작을 만남
function local_class:meet_count()
	local count = self.get_count()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local secretary = self.get_secretary()
	local guard_1 = self.get_guard(1)
	local guard_2 = self.get_guard(2)
	local guard_7 = self.get_guard(7)

	character_util.move_waypoint(secretary, secretary.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 2)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 2)

	local office_center = self.get_office_center_pos()
	music_player_util.play_sfx(
		{ sfx_name = '01_fire_05', loop = true, fade_in_time = 3, play_pos = office_center, volume = 0.5 })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })

	-- 비서(up, idle, idle) : 백작님.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_45', skip = true })

	-- 비서(up, idle, idle) : 손님이 오셨습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_46', skip = true })

	camera_util.move_async(vector_util.get_x0z(count.Position), 4)

	-- 백작(down) : ……
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = 'ds_main_s2_47', skip = true })

	-- 백작(down) : …손님?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = 'ds_main_s2_48', skip = true })

	camera_util.move(vector_util.get_x0z(count.Position) + vector(0, 0, -2.5), 3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_walk_06')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(count, count.Position + vector(0, -0.5, -1), 1)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(count, count.Position + vector(0, -1.2, -1), 1)

	-- 백작(down) : 대체… 외부인이 여길 어떻게 들어왔지…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = 'ds_main_s2_49', skip = true })

	character_util.move_waypoint(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 3), 2)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(secretary, secretary.Position + vector(0, 0, 3), 2)

	-- 비서(up, idle, idle) : 죄송합니다. 제가 들여보냈습니다. 칙서를 가지고 있던 터라…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_50', skip = true })

	-- 백작(down, idle, idle) : 너에게 묻지 않았다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = 'ds_main_s2_51', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	-- 백작(down, idle, idle) : 외부인, 대답해 보거라.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = 'ds_main_s2_52', skip = true })

	-- 백작(down, idle, idle) : 이곳에 어떻게 들어온 것이냐.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = 'ds_main_s2_53', skip = true })

	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 그동안의 일을 설명한다.
		{ 'ds_main_s2_53_1' }
	})

	-- 가디언(right, smile, release2)
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

	-- 백작(down, idle, idle) emoticon_bubble_silence
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(count, nil, 'silence')

	character_util.set_emotion(count, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	-- 백작(down, sleep_deep, idle) : …전혀 대답이 되질 않는군.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = 'ds_main_s2_54', skip = true })

	-- 백작이 등을 돌려 다시 왕좌로 2타일 이동.
	character_util.remove_emotion(count)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(count, count.Position + vector(0, 1.7, 1), 1)

	-- 백작(up, sleep_deep, idle) : 대체 뭐가 어떻게 된 건지…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = 'ds_main_s2_55', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	-- 백작(up, idle, idle) : 한 번도 아니고, 두 번씩이나…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = 'ds_main_s2_56', skip = true })

	-- 비서(up, idle, idle) : …백작님. 말씀 중에 죄송합니다만, 마왕의 칙서를 가지고 있는 자입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_57', skip = true })

	-- 비서(up, idle, idle) : 이야기는 들어보는 게 어떠신지요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_58', skip = true })

	-- 백작이 다시 비서를 바라본다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(count, 'down')

	-- 백작(down, idle, idle) : 관심 없다. 그깟 애송이가 쓴 칙서가 무슨 의미가 있다고.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = 'ds_main_s2_59', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	-- 비서(up, idle, idle) : …예?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_60', skip = true })

	-- 비서(right, idle, idle) : 그럼 이 자는…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_61', skip = true })

	-- 백작이 왕좌에 앉는다. 이후 대사 출력
	character_util.set_anim(count, 'seat')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	-- 백작(down, idle, seat) : 수용소에 가둬라. 이 자가 누군지는 천천히 알아볼 테니.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = 'ds_main_s2_62', skip = true })

	-- 비서(up, idle, idle) : …알겠습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s2_63', skip = true })

	-- 이후 비서 뒷걸음질로 1칸 이동하는 동시에 집무실을 지키고 있던 로얄가드1, 2가 가디언 양쪽에서 다가와 가디언을 붙잡는다.
	-- 주지사 왕좌를 지키고 있던 로얄가드
	-- 상단 비서 대사 끝나면 가디언(up, jumpx1) -> (right, surprise, idle) -> (left, surprise, idle)
	character_util.move_waypoint(secretary, secretary.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_armor_01')
	character_util.move_waypoint(guard_1, guard_1.Position + vector(2.4, 0, 0), 1.2)
	character_util.move_waypoint(guard_2, guard_2.Position + vector(-1.4, 0, 0), 0.7)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event', mix = 3 })

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_player_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(guard_1, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_anim(guard_2, { name = 'push' })

	-- 가디언(right, surprised, embarrassed)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	guard_7.Position = office_center + vector(0, 0, -10)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	-- 로얄가드3(up, idle, idle) : 백작님!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_7,
		{ key = 'ds_main_s2_64', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', offset = vector(1.5, 0, 8.5) })

	-- 그때 로얄가드 3이 집무실로 뛰어 들어오며 비서 왼쪽에 정렬. 이후 백작에게 급히 보고한다.

	local guard_7_waypoint = {
		office_center + vector(0, 0, -2),
		office_center + vector(-1.5, 0, -2),
		office_center + vector(-1.5, 0, -1),
	}

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard_7, guard_7_waypoint, 5,
		true, nil, nil, nil, true)

	character_util.set_direction(secretary, 'left')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	-- 로얄가드3(up, idle, idle) : 경계구역에서 정체 모를 폭발이 발생했습니다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_7, { key = 'ds_main_s2_65', skip = true })

	-- 대사 끝나자마자 비서 (left, surprise, idle), 가디언을 붙잡고 있던 로얄가드1, 2 모두 모션 중지하고 (left, surprise, idle)
	local npc_list = { secretary, guard_1, guard_2, leader }

	for _, npc in pairs(npc_list) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'surprise' })

function local_class:enter()

		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	local priscilla = self.get_priscilla()
	local priscilla_pos = self.get_priscilla_found_pos()
	character_util.set_active_state(priscilla, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(priscilla, priscilla_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(priscilla, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(priscilla, { name = 'tired' })

	local iris = self.get_count_wife()
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(iris, { name = 'idle', loop = false }, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	character_util.set_position(iris, self.get_current_count_wife_pos())
	character_util.set_active_state(iris, 'enabled')

	return true

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return

	local card_key_reader = self.get_card_key_reader()
	card_key_reader.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, card_key_reader, true)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.door_name, true))

	local main_stair = self.get_a_room_down_stair()
	self.main_stair_interactable = main_stair.Interactable
	main_stair.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

		return
	end

	self:stop_npc_shake()

	if self.crowd_sfx ~= nil then
		self.crowd_sfx:Stop()
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	self.controller = nil

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_card_key_reader()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_card_key_reader, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_a_room_down_stair()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.hidden_lab_event_1, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.priscilla_found_zone) and
			self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.card_key_reader then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.priscilla_found, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.iris_capsule_found_zone) and
			self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.priscilla_rescue then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.iris_capsule_found, self))
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.hidden_lab_zone_2) and not self.researcher_ran_away then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hidden_lab_event_2, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		local grid_name = e.CameraGrid.name
		local fo_list = self.quest_marker_by_grid[grid_name]
		if fo_list ~= nil then
			local quest_marker_fo_name = fo_list[self.cur_marker_progress]
			if quest_marker_fo_name ~= nil then
				local quest_marker_fo = get_field_object(quest_marker_fo_name)
				if quest_marker_fo == nil then
					quest_marker_fo = get_character(quest_marker_fo_name)
				end

				if quest_marker_fo ~= nil then
					quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, quest_marker_fo, true)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'card_key_console_1' then
		if self.cur_marker_progress < self.marker_progress.priscilla then
			self.cur_marker_progress = self.marker_progress.priscilla

function local_class:pushed_routine(target, duration, distance, hit_sfx)
	local time_passed = 0
	local original_pos = target.Position

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(hit_sfx)

	character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_projectile_01')

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutExpo(unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration), 0, 1, 1)
		local cur_pos = original_pos + progress * distance

		character_util.set_position(target, cur_pos)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
end

local local_class = newclass('DemonShireMainSection22')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DemonShireMain @
		Comment = 백작과 조우 이후 바이크를 타고 인공태양 연구소를 탈출하기 까지 @
		Index = 21 @
		NextSections = 22 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- section state
	self.section_progress = {
		none = 1,
		count_interrupt = 2,
		run_count = 3,
		show_bike = 4,
		ending = 5,
	}
	self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.none

	-- character
	self.get_royal_guard = function(index) return get_character('s22_royal_guard_' .. index) end
	self.get_demon = function(index) return get_character('s22_demon_' .. index) end

	-- effect
	self.get_blink_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_vampirelord_clone_explosion') end
	self.get_blink_wave_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_vampirelord_knockwave') end

	self.get_fx_last_hit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit') end
	self.get_fx_hit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end

	-- field object
	self.get_bike = function() return get_field_object('s22_bike') end
	self.get_research_institute_inner = function() return get_field_object('research_institute_inner_1') end

	-- 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'demonshire_3_5'

	-- string first key
	self.string_key = 'ds_main_s22_'

	-- zone
	self.trigger_event_zone_name = 's22_trigger_1'

	-- 마족 군중 동적 생성한 리스트
	self.demon_list = nil
	self.demon_count = 17

	-- 친위대원 동적 생성
	self.guard_list = nil
	self.guard_count = 16

	-- 터치 이벤트 받을 때 스와이프 받을 방향
	self.swipe_direction = nil

	-- 연출 끝나고 나갈 때 사용할 exit fo 이름
	self.stage_exit_name = 'exit_demonshire_3_3'

	-- 이전 섹션에서 왔을 때의 블로킹 존
	self.blocking_zone_name = 'blocking_zone_'
	self.blocking_zone_count = 4

	-- 연구소 탈출 상호작용 문
	self.research_institute_outer_name = 'research_institute_outer_1'

	-- 이전 섹션에서 왔을 때 연구소 탈출 exit Interactable 캐싱
	self.cached_interactable = nil

	-- 자동 이벤트를 보았는지?
	self.is_show_auto_event = false

	-- exit가 호출되었는지?
	self.is_exit = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	if self.stage_name ~= stage.Name then
		return
	end

	self.get_blink_effect()
	self.get_fx_last_hit()
	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_blink_wave_effect()

	-- qte
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:enter()
	if self.stage_name ~= stage.Name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	-- 연구동 입구 앞에 군중 캐싱
	self.demon_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.demon_count do
		local demon = self.get_demon(i)
		table.insert(self.demon_list, demon)
	end

	-- 호버 바이크 쪽 npc 활성화
	for i = 5, 6 do
		local npc = get_character('s22_demon_1_' .. i)
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
	end

	-- 바이크 위치로
	local bike = self.get_bike()
	bike.Position = field:GetMarker('s22_bike_pos').position
	bike.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0)
	bike.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.75, 0, 0.75), vector(2, 1, 2))

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.stage_name ~= stage.Name then
		return
	end

	-- 연출로 클리어 해야하니 나가는 exit 비활성화

	exit_fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	-- 연구소 입구 막음
	local research_institute_inner = self.get_research_institute_inner()
	research_institute_inner.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	-- 시작 프로그래스 체크
	local is_prev_section = self.controller.starting_inner_progress <= 20
	if is_prev_section then
		-- 이전 섹션에서 온 것 이라면 연구소 출구를 PublishInteractable로 바꾸고 마커 세팅
		exit_fo = get_field_object(self.research_institute_outer_name)
		self.cached_interactable = exit_fo.Interactable
		exit_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, exit_fo, true)
	else
		-- 존 트리거 이벤트 할 캐릭터는 talk nil 처리
		local npc_count = 2
		for i = 1, npc_count do
			local npc = get_character('s22_npc_' .. i)
			npc.Interactable.Talk = nil
		end

		-- 이 섹션에서 시작한 경우 그냥 연출 바로 시작
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.intro_start, self))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.stage_name ~= stage.Name then
		return
	end

	self.is_exit = true

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	-- 쉐이크 중인 npc들 disabled
	if self.guard_list ~= nil then
		local cur_guard_count = 4
		local guard_number = { 6, 4, 12, 11 }
		for i = 1, cur_guard_count do
			local guard = self.guard_list[guard_number[i]]
			character_util.stop_shake(guard)
		end
	end

	local npc_count = 4
	for i = 1, npc_count do
		local npc = get_character('s22_demon_1_' .. i)
		character_util.stop_shake(npc)
	end

	-- 캐싱한 npc table nil
	self.guard_list = nil
	self.demon_list = nil

	-- 터치 이벤트 구독 중이면 구독 해지
	if self.touch_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.touch_handler = nil
	end

	local exit_fo = get_field_object(self.research_institute_outer_name)
	exit_fo.Interactable = self.cached_interactable
	self.cached_interactable = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local exit_fo = get_field_object(self.research_institute_outer_name)
	local bike = self.get_bike()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, exit_fo)
			and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_research_institute_outer, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bike)
			and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.show_bike then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_bike, self, bike))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.trigger_event_zone_name)
			and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.run_count then
		self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.show_bike
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_bike, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's22_auto_event_1')
			and not self.is_show_auto_event then
		self.is_show_auto_event = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.auto_event, self))
		return true
	end

	for i = 1, self.blocking_zone_count do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.blocking_zone_name .. i)
				and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.none then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_blocking_zone, self, i)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

-- 이전 섹션에서 진행했으면서 연구소 출구에 상호작용 했을 때
function local_class:interact_research_institute_outer()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular(0.6, 'ease_in_out_sine')
	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	self:count_interrupt_event()
end

function local_class:enter_blocking_zone(index)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local sohee = self.controller.get_sohee()

	-- 소히(side, idle, question) : 이 쪽이 아닌 것 같은데…
	local dir = index % 2 == 0 and 'right' or 'left'
	character_util.set_direction(leader, dir)
	character_util.look_at(sohee, leader)
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 0, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(sohee)

	local add_pos = index % 2 == 0 and unity_class.vector3.left or unity_class.vector3.right
	character_util.move_to_async(leader, leader.Position + add_pos,
			nil, 2, true, true)
end

function local_class:intro_start()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self:count_interrupt_event()
end

-- 22섹션 인트로 이벤트
function local_class:count_interrupt_event()
	self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.count_interrupt

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local daughter = self.controller.get_count_daughter()
	local count = self.controller.get_count()
	local sohee = self.controller.get_sohee()

	-- 터치 이벤트
	local swipe_direction = nil
	local qte_complete = false
	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if swipe_direction == nil then
				return false
			end

			if e.TouchEventType == swipe_direction then
				qte_complete = true
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	-- 셋 모두 down, attack, run
	local marker = field:GetMarker('research_institute_outer_1')
	local pos_list = { marker.position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 2, marker.position + vector(0.75, 0, 2.5)
	, marker.position + vector(-0.75, 0, 2.5) }

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'down')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'run' }, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 0, 0)
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], pos_list[i + 1])
		-- 포지션 배치
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local city_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_city_03', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1 })
	local crowd_buzz_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', player_priority = 'npc'
	, loop = true, fade_in_time = 1 })

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 프리실라, 가디언, 소히 알파 0->100으로 생성되며 [초록색 존]까지 달리는 모습 보여준다.
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 1, 1)
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
		-- “뭐야…?” 대사 후 up, idle, idle. 0.5초 후 jump1회
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.demon_list[11], { key = self.string_key .. 2 })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		character_util.set_direction(self.demon_list[11], 'up')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--  up, idle, idle. 0.5초 후  jump1회 + shake 1번
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.demon_list[11])
		character_util.normal_jump(self.demon_list[11], true)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(self.demon_list[11], 0.05, 0.5)
	end))

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_to_async, leader, leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 6.5,
				3, nil, false, false, true),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_to_async, sohee, sohee.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 6.5,
				3, nil, false, false, true),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_to_async, daughter, daughter.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 6.5,
				3, nil, false, false, true),
	})

	-- 이후 화면 상단에 말풍선 출력.
	-- 백작이 가디언 일행을 불러세운다.
	-- 백작 말풍선과 동시에 일행 표정 down, tired, idle
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'tired' })
	end

	-- “멈춰라.”
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = self.string_key .. 1
	, skip = true, screen_pos = vector(-125, 400), bubble_direction = 'ct' })

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'up')
	end

	-- 카메라 패닝 후 백작이 위에서 걸어나오는 모습을 보여주고 가디언 일행과 대치한다. (가디언 일행, 백작 멈춰섬과 동시에 up방향)
	character_util.set_active_state(count, 'enabled')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(count)
	character_util.set_direction(count, 'down')
	character_util.set_position(count, marker.position + unity_class.vector3.forward)

	local active_demon_count = 12
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
		crowd_buzz_sfx:Stop()
		for i = 1, active_demon_count do
			local demon = self.demon_list[i]
			local dir = i <= 6 and 'right' or 'left'
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(demon)
			character_util.set_direction(demon, dir)
			character_util.set_emotion(demon, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.normal_jump(demon, true)
			character_util.show_emoticon(demon, nil, 'notice')
		end
	end))

	local camera_pos = marker.position + unity_class.vector3.back * 2.5
	camera_util.move(camera_pos, 1)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(count, count.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 2
	, 1.5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		name = 'ondemand/v2_39_demonshire/audio:bgm_demonshire_claude', state = 'event', mix = 2 })
	city_sfx:FadeOut(2)

	-- 프리실라 (up, idle, idle) : 아버지…!
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.demon_list[11])
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 3, skip = true })

	-- 백작 (down, idle, idle) : 누가 멋대로 빠져나가도 좋다 했지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = self.string_key .. 4, skip = true })

	-- 백작 (down, idle, idle) : …두 번 말하지 않을 테니 이쪽으로 오거라.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = self.string_key .. 5, skip = true })

	-- 백작 반 타일 앞으로 내려간다.
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(count, count.Position + unity_class.vector3.back,
			1.5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')

	-- 백작 (down, attack, idle) : 당장! (카메라 shake)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(count, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = self.string_key .. 6, bubble_type = 'shout'
	, skip = true })

	-- 선택지
	-- 1) [초록색] 당신 딸은 꼭두각시가 아니야! / 2) [빨간색] 딸은 당신의 소유물이 아닙니다.
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. 7, 'mercy' }
	, { self.string_key .. 8, 'brutal' } })

	-- 가디언 up, idle, release
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

	-- 프리실라 (up, idle, idle) : 시, 싫어요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 9, skip = true })

	-- 프리실라 (right, tired, release) : 다들 도망쳐요…!
	character_util.set_direction(daughter, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(daughter, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }
	, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 10, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(daughter)

	-- 가디언, 소히, 프리실라 down방향으로 전환 후 아래로 1타일 가는 순간 백작 텔레포트 (FX_Blink)
	camera_pos = leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 2
	camera_util.move(leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 1.5, 0.5)
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, leader, leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 1.5, 3
		, true, nil, nil, 'down', true),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, sohee, sohee.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 1.5, 3
		, true, nil, nil, 'down', true),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, daughter, daughter.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 1.5
		, 3, true, nil, nil, 'down', true),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.15)
			-- 가디언 일행, 아래로 도망칠 때 마족들 모두 down, surprised, idle로 가디언 일행 바라봄.
			for i = 1, active_demon_count do
				local demon = self.demon_list[i]
				character_util.set_direction(demon, 'down')
			end
		end),
	})

	-- 백작 텔레포트 후 가디언 일행 down, surprise, jump1회 후, surprise표정으로 반 타일 뒷걸음. (확인 필요)
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump(user_party[i], '01_jump_01')
	end

	self.get_blink_effect():Instantiate(count.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(count, 'up')
	local count_pos = count.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 5.5
	character_util.set_position(count, count_pos)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_dark_02')
	self.get_blink_effect():Instantiate(count_pos)
	self.get_blink_wave_effect():Instantiate(count_pos)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.5,
				0.5, nil, false, true)
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'attack' })
	end

	-- 소히 (down, attack, cross_arm) : 가는 곳 마다 나타나고… 정말 대단하네 당신!
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 11, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(sohee)

	-- 소히 (down, attack, release) : 한 나라의 통치자라더니 그냥 스토커 아냐?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 12, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(sohee)

	-- 백작 (up, idle, idle) : 불현듯 나타나 훼방을 놓던 것도 모자라 건방지기 짝이 없는 태도라…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = self.string_key .. 13, skip = true })

	-- 백백작 (up, idle, idle) : 아이리스의 데이터를 건드린 것도 네놈들이겠군.
	character_util.set_emotion(daughter, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = self.string_key .. 14, skip = true })

	-- 선택지 발생
	--1) 죽은 아내가 불쌍하지도 않나요. / 2) 따님의 미모는 어머니를 닮았더군요. / 3) 백작의 은밀한 취미란 클리셰인가요?
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. 15, 'mercy' }
	, { self.string_key .. 16, 'intellect' }, { self.string_key .. 17, 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 가디언 down, attack, release
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'blush' })
		wait_for_sec(2)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	else
		-- down, sleep_deep, nodx2
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
		character_util.nod_twice(leader)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	end

	-- 백작 (up, idle, idle) : …몇 번이나 말하지 않았느냐.
	character_util.remove_emotion(count)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = self.string_key .. 18, skip = true })

	-- 백작 (up, idle, idle) : 굴레의 저편으로 도달할 때까지…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = self.string_key .. 19, skip = true })

	-- 백작 (up, idle, idle) : 나는 포기하지 않을 것이라고.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = self.string_key .. 20, skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })

	-- 친위대 등장
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_10')
	self:set_vampire_guard()

	-- 백작 뒤쪽으로 발렌시아를 포함한 친위대들이 등장한다.
	camera_pos = camera_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5
	camera_util.move(camera_pos, 1)
	self:appear_royal_guards()

	-- 발렌시아 : [shout] 백작님! 제 1군 도착했습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.guard_list[10], 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.guard_list[10], { name = 'salute', sfx_name = '01_swing_01', loop = false }
	, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.guard_list[10], { key = self.string_key .. 21
	, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.guard_list[10])
	character_util.set_direction(self.guard_list[10], 'up')

	for i = 1, active_demon_count do

		local duration = 3
		local move_speed = 8.5
		while not self.is_exit or time_passed <= duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

local local_class = newclass('DemonShireMainSection23')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DemonShireMain @
		Comment = 템플런 미니게임 @
		Index = 22 @
		NextSections = 23 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.minigame_name = 'BikeTempleRun'
	self.minigame = nil

	self.minigame_loaded = false

	self.stage_name = 'demonshire_3_3'
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')

	self.minigame = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.minigame_name)
	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.minigame_name, stage.Name, function()
		self.minigame_loaded = true
	end)
end

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

end

		return
	end

		mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.minigame_name)
	end
	self.minigame = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	return false
end

	if e.Name == self.minigame_name then
		if e.Success then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.progressing_routine, self))

			return true
		else
			CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToLobby()
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

	while not self.minigame_loaded do

	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.minigame_name)
end

function local_class:progressing_routine()
	-- 너무 빨리 페이드인 되는 듯 해서 딜레이 추가
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
end

	end

	local backup_background_pos = background.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.1

	local function background_move(duration, end_pos)
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos = background.Position

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			if background ~= nil then
				background.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	local center_pos = field:GetMarker('s24_center_point').position
	local camera_pos = center_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * 4.5

	-- 백작 세팅
	local target_pos = center_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * 3
	character_util.set_active_state(count, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(count, 'up')
	character_util.set_position(count, target_pos)

	-- 카메라는 인공 태양을 바라보도록하고 배경도 미리 땡겨둠
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * 6.5, 0)
	background.Position = backup_background_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5

	-- 위처럼 태양 보여주는 상태로 페이드 인

	local sun_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_sun_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 3 })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 카메라 / 전경 이동 시간
	local duration = 3

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. 10, 'mercy' }

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')

	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({

	end

	-- 백작 몬스터로
	character_util.convert_to_monster(count, self.battle_group_name, 's24_count_battle_zone')
	character_util.set_death_type(count, 'none')
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(count, leader, 'battle')
	count.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.NoticeLinkName = self.battle_group_name
end

function local_class:end_count_battle()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	local count = self.get_count()
	character_util.set_active_state(count, 'disabled')

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

return local_class

	self.get_fx_explosion()
	self.get_fx_vampirelord_buff()
	self.get_fx_spark_effect()
	self.get_fx_knockwave_effect()

	end

	if self.effect_pool_list ~= nil then
		for i, effect in ipairs(self.effect_pool_list) do
			effect:Dispose()
		end
		self.effect_pool_list = nil
	end

	if self.black_hat_item ~= nil then
		self.black_hat_item:ConsumeComplete()
	end

	if self.paper_item_list ~= nil then
		for i, item in ipairs(self.paper_item_list) do
			item:ConsumeComplete()
		end
		self.paper_item_list = nil
	end

	if self.royal_guard_list ~= nil then
		for i, guard in ipairs(self.royal_guard_list) do
			guard.Interactable.Talk = nil
			character_util.set_position(guard, vector(999, 0, 999))
		end
		self.royal_guard_list = nil
	end

	if self.twinkle_effect ~= nil then
		self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
		self.twinkle_effect = nil
	end

	-- 광장 npc 표정리셋 후 제외
	local center_civilian_count = 18
	for i = 1, center_civilian_count do
		character_util.remove_emotion(get_character('center_civilian_' .. i))
		character_util.set_active_state(get_character('center_civilian_' .. i), 'disabled')
	end

	self.stair_exit_interactable = nil
	self.wave_monster_list = nil
end

	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end
