function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_paper(1)) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress.paper_zone then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.office_paper
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_office_paper, self)
			return true
		end
	end
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_paper(2)) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_paper(3)) then
		local index = 1
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_paper(3)) then
			index = 2
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')
		end
		if self.current_progress == self.progress.stair_open then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.shelter_paper_1
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_shelter_paper_1, self, e.Target, index)
			return true
		elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.shelter_paper_1 then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.shelter_paper_2
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_shelter_paper_2, self, e.Target, index)
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_paper(4)) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress.shelter_paper_2 then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.shelter_paper_3
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_shelter_paper_3, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_office_cabinet()) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress.office_paper then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.stair_open
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.shelter_stair_open, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('narration_letter')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_main_s26_narration_1' })
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_main_s26_narration_2' })
			if self.twinkle_effect ~= nil then
				self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
				self.twinkle_effect = nil
			end
		end)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'plaza_zone') then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.show_guard
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.plaza_guard_zone_event, self))
			return true
		end

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'office_zone_1') then
		if self.current_progress <= self.progress.show_guard then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.paper_zone
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.paper_zone_event, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's26_event_out_zone_right') then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.event_out_zone, self, vector(2, 0, 0))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's26_event_out_zone_left') then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.event_out_zone, self, vector(-2, 0, 0))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's26_event_out_zone_up') then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.event_out_zone, self, vector(0, 0, 2))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's26_event_out_zone_down') then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.event_out_zone, self, vector(0, 0, -2))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.swipe_type = 'left'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.swipe_type = 'right'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
		self.swipe_type = 'up'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'down'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'tap'
		self.turbo_tap_count = self.turbo_tap_count + 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	for i, enemy in ipairs(self.wave_monster_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, enemy) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.next_monster_appear, self, enemy))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'battle1' and self.battle_clear_check then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.wave_battle_end, self))
		return true
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'main_grid') then
		self:marker_change_event('main_grid')
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'office_grid') then
		self:marker_change_event('office_grid')
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'shelter_grid') then
		self:marker_change_event('shelter_grid')
		return true
	end
	return false
end

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(sohee, sohee_pos, 1.5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')

function local_class:next_monster_appear(enemy)
	self.monster_index = self.monster_index + 1
	if self.monster_index > #self.wave_monster_list then
		self.battle_clear_check = true
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_dark_03')
		character_util.reset_all_state(self.wave_monster_list[self.monster_index])
		self:shadow_appear(self.wave_monster_list[self.monster_index],
				self.wave_monster_list[self.monster_index].Position, self.wave_monster_list[self.monster_index].Direction)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(self.wave_monster_list[self.monster_index], 'battle1', 'BATTLE_1')
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(self.wave_monster_list[self.monster_index], user_party.Leader, 'battle')
		character_util.set_death_type(self.wave_monster_list[self.monster_index], 'none')
	end

	character_util.set_side_direction(enemy)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(enemy, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.set_anim(enemy, { name = 'unique/melt_dead', loop = false })
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(enemy, 0, 2)
	wait_for_sec(2)
	character_util.set_active_state(enemy, 'disabled')
end

function local_class:wave_battle_end()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local count = self.get_count()

	local leader_pos = field:GetMarker('shelter_knight_pos_3').position - vector(0, 0, 3)
	local sohee_pos = field:GetMarker('shelter_sohee_pos_3').position - vector(0, 0, 3)
	local count_pos = field:GetMarker('count_appear_pos').position

	local battle_gate_num = 2
	for i = 1, battle_gate_num do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('s26_battle_gate_' .. i, false))
	end

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async(
			{ state = 'field', 'ondemand/v2_39_demonshire/audio:bgm_demonshire_main' })
	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async(
			{ state = 'combat', name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_battle_normal_02' })
	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = true

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.set_position(leader, leader_pos)
	character_util.set_position(sohee, sohee_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'down')

	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })

	camera_util.move_async(leader_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -1.5), 1)

	local enemy_list = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		for j, enemy in ipairs(self.wave_monster_list) do
			character_util.convert_to_npc(enemy)
			character_util.set_position(enemy, vector(999, 0, 999))
			character_util.reset_all_state(enemy, 'up')

			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.sender = nil
			heal_info.target = enemy
			heal_info.heal = enemy.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			heal_info.isRevive = true

			if #enemy_list < 10 then

	end

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	for i, enemy in ipairs(enemy_list) do

--- 시작 씬 연출
function local_class:start_scene()
	local count_daughter = self.get_count_daughter()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--region 벨리알 연출
	local intro_pos = field:GetMarker('s26_intro').position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 4

	character_util.set_position(count_daughter, intro_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(count_daughter, 'up')

	local backup_background_pos = get_field_object('background').Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.1
	function background_move(duration, end_pos)
		local time_passed = 0
		local background = get_field_object('background')
		local start_pos = background.Position

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			if background ~= nil then
				background.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		background.Position = end_pos
	end

	camera_util.move_async(intro_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * 6, 0)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(background_move, 0,
			backup_background_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5))

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_39_demonshire/audio:bgm_demonshire_priscilla'
	, state = 'event' })

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(2)

	local sound_loop = true

		while sound_loop do

			if sound_count < sound_max_count then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wing_03')

--- QTE 함수
--- @param type nil key: qte 타입
--- @param duration number key: qte 제한시간
--- @return boolean key: duration 이후 qte 성공 시 true 실패 시 false
function local_class:qte_swipe(data)
	local type = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'type', 'tap')
	local duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'duration', 9999)

	if type == 'tap' then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTap()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	else
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')
	end

	self.swipe_type = ''
	self.is_qte_start = true
	local time_passed = 0

	while self.is_qte_start and self.swipe_type ~= type and time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.is_qte_start = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	-- 실패시
	if self.swipe_type ~= type then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

		for i = 1, #self.battle_enemy_list do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.battle_enemy_list[i]) then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

				--- 유저의 영웅의 패시브 능력등을 추가로 발동시키지 않기 위해 패시브 플래그를 달아줌

				damage_info.target = self.battle_enemy_list[i]
				damage_info.damage = self.battle_enemy_list[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
				damage_info.direction = (self.battle_enemy_list[i].Position - user_party.Leader.Position).normalized

function local_class:shadow_appear(npc, position, direction, move)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_dark_03')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 0)
	npc.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)

	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(npc, position)
	character_util.set_direction(npc, direction)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, 1)
	self.get_shadow_appear_effect():Instantiate(position)

	if lua_helper.get_or_default(move, false) then
		local dir = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(npc.Direction)
		character_util.move_waypoint(npc, npc.Position + dir, 1,
				false, 'stop', 'floor')
	end
end

--- 미리 세팅하는 NPC들
function local_class:setting_push_npc(marker_index, active_check)
	local guard = self.royal_guard_list[marker_index]
	local shadow = self.push_shadow_list[marker_index]
	local guard_pos = field:GetMarker('s27_push_pos_' .. marker_index .. '_1').position
	local shadow_pos = field:GetMarker('s27_push_pos_' .. marker_index .. '_2').position

	character_util.set_position(guard, guard_pos)
	character_util.set_emotion(guard, { name = 'attack' })

	if active_check then
		character_util.set_position(shadow, shadow_pos)
		character_util.look_at(guard, shadow)
		character_util.look_at(shadow, guard)
		local guard_move = direction_util.to_vector3(guard.Direction) * 0.25
		local shadow_move = direction_util.to_vector3(shadow.Direction) * 0.25
		character_util.set_position(guard, guard_pos + guard_move)
		character_util.set_position(shadow, shadow_pos + shadow_move)
		character_util.set_group_anim_and_emotion({ guard, shadow },
				{ name = 'push' }, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.shake(guard, 0.03, 9999)
		character_util.shake(shadow, 0.03, 9999)
	end
end

--- 그림자 발견하고 push 하는 연출
function local_class:active_push_npc(marker_index)
	local guard = self.royal_guard_list[marker_index]
	local shadow = self.push_shadow_list[marker_index]
	local shadow_pos = field:GetMarker('s27_push_pos_' .. marker_index .. '_2').position
	local guard_move_pos = field:GetMarker('s27_push_pos_' .. marker_index .. '_3').position

	self:shadow_appear(shadow, shadow_pos, 'down')
	character_util.look_at(guard, shadow)
	character_util.set_emotion(guard, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.normal_jump_async(guard)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard, guard_move_pos, 4)
	character_util.look_at(guard, shadow)
	character_util.look_at(shadow, guard)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	local guard_move = direction_util.to_vector3(guard.Direction) * 0.25
	local shadow_move = direction_util.to_vector3(shadow.Direction) * 0.25
	character_util.move_waypoint(guard, guard_move_pos + guard_move, 3)
	character_util.move_waypoint(shadow, shadow_pos + shadow_move, 3)
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate((shadow.Position + guard.Position) / 2 + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
	character_util.set_group_anim_and_emotion({ guard, shadow },
			{ name = 'push' }, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.shake(guard, 0.03, 9999)
	character_util.shake(shadow, 0.03, 9999)
end

-- 1대1 전투 연출 (단순하게 합 주고 받음)
function local_class:battle_template_attack_repeat(key, char_1, char_2)
	self:play_battle(key)

	while CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) do
		coroutine.yield(self:attack_normal(key, char_1, char_2))

		coroutine.yield(self:attack_normal(key, char_2, char_1))
	end
end

-- 1대1 전투 연출 (서로 힘겨루기하며 밀고 당김)
function local_class:battle_template_power_struggle(key, char_1, char_2, dist, duration)
	self:play_battle(key)

	local cur_dist = lua_helper.get_or_default(dist, 0.5)
	local cur_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 2)

	local dir_1 = (char_2.Position - char_1.Position).normalized
	local dir_2 = (char_1.Position - char_2.Position).normalized

	character_util.shake(char_1, 0.04, 9999)
	character_util.set_anim(char_1, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_1, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.shake(char_2, 0.04, 9999)
	character_util.set_anim(char_2, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_2, { name = 'damaged' })

	character_util.move_to_async(char_1, char_1.Position + dir_1 * cur_dist,
			0.1, nil, false, false)

	while CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) do
		character_util.move_to(char_1, char_1.Position + dir_1 * cur_dist / 2,
				1, nil, false, false)

		character_util.move_to(char_2, char_2.Position + dir_1 * cur_dist / 2,
				1, nil, false, false)

		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < cur_duration do
			if not CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) then
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.move_to(char_1, char_1.Position + dir_2 * cur_dist / 2,
				1, nil, false, false)

		character_util.move_to(char_2, char_2.Position + dir_2 * cur_dist / 2,
				1, nil, false, false)

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < cur_duration do
			if not CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) then
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:battle_template_push_scared(key, char_1, char_2)
	self:play_battle(key)

	character_util.shake(char_1, 0.03, 9999)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(char_1, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(char_2, { name = 'push' }, { name = 'attack' })
	while CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 해당하는 키의 전투 연출 시작
function local_class:play_battle(key)
	if not self.is_battle_dict:ContainsKey(key) then
		self.is_battle_dict:Add(key, true)
	else
		-- 중복 키 오류 검출
		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Battle Dictionary already has same key')
		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError(key)
	end
end

-- 해당하는 키의 전투 연출 중단
function local_class:stop_battle(key)
	if self.is_battle_dict:ContainsKey(key) then
		self.is_battle_dict:Remove(key)
		self.is_battle_dict:Add(key, false)
	end
end

-- 공격 연출 (A가 B를 때리고 B는 데미지 입고 원위치로)
function local_class:attack_normal(key, char_1, char_2, no_anim)
	local no_anim_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(no_anim, false)

	local dir = (char_2.Position - char_1.Position).normalized

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(char_1, dir * 0.7, 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.set_anim(char_1, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local duration = 0.3

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		if not CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', max_distance = 6
	, parent = char_2, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(char_2.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(char_2.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	character_util.spine_pulse_color(char_2, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(char_2, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(char_2, dir * 0.5, 0.3, 0.2)

	if not no_anim_val then
		character_util.set_anim(char_2, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.set_emotion(char_2, { name = 'damaged' })
	end

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	duration = 0.2

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		if not CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(char_1)

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	duration = 0.3

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		if not CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(self.is_battle_dict, key) then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not no_anim_val then
		character_util.remove_anim(char_2)
		character_util.set_emotion(char_2, { name = 'attack' })
	end
end

-- 전투 연출 중인 적을 쓰러트렸을 경우 감사 표시
function local_class:battle_finished_event(index)
	local cur_shadow = self.battle_enemy_list[index]

	-- 연출은 컨트롤러에서 하고 있는 관계로 컨트롤러에 연출 중지 요청
	self:stop_battle(cur_shadow.Name)

	-- index 기반으로 전투 중인 레지스탕스 찾아냄
	if self.team_dict:ContainsKey(cur_shadow.Name) then
		self:team_thank_to_player(
				CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(self.team_dict, cur_shadow.Name), false)
	end
end

-- 플레이어에게 감사를 표시
function local_class:team_thank_to_player(team_name)
	local team_npc = get_character(team_name)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(team_npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	team_npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.stop_shake(team_npc)
	character_util.set_side_direction(team_npc)
	character_util.set_anim(team_npc, { name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' })
	character_util.set_emotion(team_npc, { name = 'smile' })

	local rand = random_util.get_random_int(0, 2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	if rand == 1 then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(team_npc, { key = 'ds_main_s27_0_1' })
	elseif rand == 2 then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(team_npc, { key = 'ds_main_s27_0_2' })
	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(team_npc, { key = 'ds_main_s27_0_3' })
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(team_npc, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.remove_anim(team_npc)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(team_npc, 0, 0.5)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(team_npc, team_npc.Position +
			direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(team_npc.Direction).normalized * 2, 4, true)
	character_util.set_active_state(team_npc, 'disabled')
end

--- exit 상호작용 했을 때 이벤트
function local_class:exit_stage_event(stage_name)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	for i = 1, #self.battle_enemy_list do
		-- 연출 중지 요청

end

-- 친위대 싸우는 연출
function local_class:guard_fight(guard, num, wait_time, speed)
	local pos = field:GetMarker('s29_shadow_pos_' .. num).position
	local shadow = self.optimized_npcs['shadow_' .. num]
	local move_z = 5
	if num%2 == 0 then
		move_z = 6
	end

	while not self.finish_defense do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(shadow, 0, 0)
		character_util.set_direction(shadow, 'up')
		shadow.Position = pos
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(shadow, 1, 1)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(shadow, { shadow.Position + vector(0, 0, move_z) }, speed,
				true, nil, nil, 'up')
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_sword_02', parent = guard })
		character_util.set_anim(guard, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'sword_idle' } )
		wait_for_sec(0.23)
		shadow.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
		shadow.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(shadow, 0, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(wait_time)
	end
end

function local_class:arrangement_npc()
	-- 시민 npc 배치
	for i = 1, self.civil_num do
		local x = math.floor((i-1)/2)
		local z = i%2
		local npc = get_character(self.civil_key_name .. i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'up')
		npc.Position = field:GetMarker('s29_civil_pos_1').position + vector(x, 0, -z)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)
	end

	-- 부족한 시민 npc는 동적으로 채움
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local npc = self.optimized_npcs['civil_' .. i]
		local x = math.floor((i-1)/2)
		local z = i%2
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'up')
		npc.Position = field:GetMarker('s29_civil_pos_2').position + vector(x, 0, -z)
	end

	-- 감옥 npc 배치
	for i = 1, self.prison_num do
		local x = i < 5 and 0 or 1
		local z = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt((i-1)%4)
		local npc = get_character(self.prison_key_name .. i)
		character_util.remove_anim(npc)
		character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'right')
		npc.Position = field:GetMarker('s29_prison_pos').position + vector(x, 0, -z)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)
	end

	-- 연구소 npc 배치
	for i = 1, self.researcher_num do
		local x = i%2
		local z = math.floor((i-1)/2)
		local npc = get_character(self.researcher_key_name .. i)
		character_util.remove_anim(npc)
		character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'left')
		npc.Position = field:GetMarker('s29_researcher_pos').position + vector(x, 0, -z)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)
	end

	-- 뱀파이어 타운 npc 배치
	for i = 1, self.vampire_town_num do
		local x = (i-1)%4
		local z = i < 5 and 0 or -1
		local npc = get_character(self.vampire_town_key_name .. i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'up')
		npc.Position = field:GetMarker('s29_vampire_town_pos').position + vector(x, 0, z)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)
	end

	-- 왼쪽 막고있는 가드
	local left_guard_num = 10
	local right_guard_num = 10
	for i = 1, left_guard_num do
		local npc = get_character(self.guard_key_name .. i)
		character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
		character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'sword_idle' })
		if i ~= 10 then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, 'left')
			npc.Position = field:GetMarker('s29_guard_pos_1').position + vector(0, 0, -i+1)
		else
			character_util.set_direction(npc, 'up')
			npc.Position = field:GetMarker('s29_guard_pos_1').position + vector(1, 0, 0)
		end
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)
	end

	-- 오른쪽 막고있는 가드
	local right_guard_start = left_guard_num+1
	local right_guard_end = left_guard_num+right_guard_num
	for i = right_guard_start, right_guard_end do
		local npc = get_character(self.guard_key_name .. i)
		character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
		character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'sword_idle' })
		if i ~= right_guard_end then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, 'right')
			npc.Position = field:GetMarker('s29_guard_pos_2').position + vector(0, 0, -i+right_guard_start)
		else
			character_util.set_direction(npc, 'up')
			npc.Position = field:GetMarker('s29_guard_pos_2').position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
		end
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)
	end

	-- 아래 막고 있는 가드
	local down_guard_start = left_guard_num+right_guard_num+1
	for i = down_guard_start, self.guard_num do
		local npc = get_character(self.guard_key_name .. i)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'down')
		character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
		character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'sword_idle' })
		npc.Position = field:GetMarker('s29_guard_pos_3').position + vector(i-down_guard_start, 0, 0)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)
	end

	-- 부족한 가드npc는 동적으로 채움
	local optimized_guard_num = 4
	for i = 1, optimized_guard_num do
		local npc = self.optimized_npcs['guard_' .. i]
		character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
		character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'sword_idle' })
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'down')
		npc.Position = field:GetMarker('s29_guard_pos_3').position + vector(3+i, 0, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 공통으로 쓰이는 이벤트 구독
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')

	if stage.Name == self.plaza_stage_name then
		-- 1스테이지(광장)
		self.current_state = self.event_state.init

		-- 원라인 NPC 설정
		local demon_pos = field:GetMarker('demon_oneline_civilian_pos').position
		table.insert(self.demon_oneline_npcs, get_character('demon_kid_1'))
		table.insert(self.demon_oneline_npcs, get_character('demon_civilian_1'))

		character_util.set_position(self.demon_oneline_npcs[1], demon_pos)
		character_util.set_position(self.demon_oneline_npcs[2], demon_pos + vector(1, 0, 0))

		character_util.set_direction(self.demon_oneline_npcs[1], 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(self.demon_oneline_npcs[2], 'left')

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.demon_oneline_npcs[1], {name = 'release'}, {name = 'awesome'})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.demon_oneline_npcs[2], {name = 'tired'})

		character_util.add_listener(self.demon_oneline_npcs[1], self.controller)
		character_util.add_listener(self.demon_oneline_npcs[2], self.controller)

		local vampire_pos = field:GetMarker('vampire_oneline_civilian_pos').position
		table.insert(self.vampire_oneline_npcs, get_character('vampire_civilian_1'))
		table.insert(self.vampire_oneline_npcs, get_character('vampire_civilian_2'))

		character_util.set_position(self.vampire_oneline_npcs[1], vampire_pos)
		character_util.set_position(self.vampire_oneline_npcs[2], vampire_pos + vector(1, 0, 0))

		character_util.set_direction(self.vampire_oneline_npcs[1], 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(self.vampire_oneline_npcs[2], 'left')

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.vampire_oneline_npcs[1], {name = 'question', loop = false}, {name = 'tired'})
		character_util.set_anim(self.vampire_oneline_npcs[2], {name = 'bomb_idle'})

		character_util.add_listener(self.vampire_oneline_npcs[1], self.controller)
		character_util.add_listener(self.vampire_oneline_npcs[2], self.controller)

		self.plaza_to_prison = get_field_object('exit_demonshire_1_2').Position

		if user_progress:IsStageCleared(self.plaza_stage_name) and not self.is_replaying then
			-- 스테이지 클리어시 별도 처리
			for i = 1, 6 do
				local guard = get_character('plaza_east_guard_' .. i)
				character_util.set_position(guard, vector(999, 0, 999))
				character_util.set_active_state(guard, 'disabled')
			end

			local npcs = {
				--1
				get_character('office_guard_5'),
				--2
				get_character('office_guard_6'),
				--3
				get_character('office_guard_8'),
				--4
				get_character('office_guard_9')
			}
			for _, npc in ipairs(npcs) do
				character_util.set_position(npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
				character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
			end
		else
			--연출용 로얄가드 설정
			for i = 1, 8 do
				table.insert(self.royale_guards, get_character(self.guards_name .. i))
			end

			self.oneline_state = 0
			self:office_oneline_event(0)
		end

	elseif stage.Name == self.prison_stage_name then
		-- 2스테이지(수용소)
		self.current_state = self.event_state.prison_entrance

		--
		--수용소 가는 길목
		--
		--수용소로 가는 길목에는 로얄가드들이 위, 아래에 일렬로 3명씩 배치되어 있음. (빨간색 네모 라인)
		--길목에 원라인 NPC 배치 예정
		--
		--1스테이지(0회차)때는 수용소로 가는 길 외에는 도어(아래쪽)나 로얄가드(우측 끝 ‘1회차 NPC 길막’ 부분)로 막혀 있음.
		--추후 다음 스테이지에서 조건 변경될 예정. (정해지는대로 기재)
		--원라인 NPC 추가 배치 예정
		--
		for i = 1, 16 do
			table.insert(self.prison_guards, get_character(self.prison_guard_name .. i))
		end
		for i = 1, 11 do
			table.insert(self.blocker_guards, get_character(self.prison_guard_right_name .. i))
		end

		--우측 하얀색 라인은 로얄가드들이 left, idle, idle로 막고 있다.
		--인터랙트시 아래 원라인 출력.
		--로얄가드 (left, idle, idle) : 테러범 도주 경로로 확인되어 조사 전까지 통행이 불가능합니다. self.talk_name .. 'oneline_5'

		for i = 1, 4 do
			local reporter = get_character(self.reporter_name .. i)
			table.insert(self.reporters, reporter)

		end
		for i = 1, 7 do
			local demon = get_character(self.demon_civilian_name .. i)
			table.insert(self.demon_civilians, demon)
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:opening_scene()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, field:GetMarker('s3_start_pos').position)


	yield_return_func(self.reporters_assault, self)


	-- 리더를 시작 좌표로 이동
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	character_util.set_position(leader, field:GetMarker('s3_start_pos').position)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	self.reporters_sfx:FadeOut(1)
	self.reporters_sfx = nil
	camera_util.move(user_party.Leader.Position, 1.5, {end_target = user_party.Leader})

	wait_for_sec(1.7)

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1.5)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false}, {name = 'smile'})

	wait_for_sec(1.7)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, get_field_object('prison_inner_1'), true)

	self.reporters_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01', loop = true, parent = self.reporters[2],
													  type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.prison_stage_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.opening_scene, self))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	-- 공통으로 쓰이는 이벤트 구독 해제
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))

	self.guard_loop_condition = false

	if self.reporters_sfx ~= nil then
		self.reporters_sfx:Stop()
		self.reporters_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.on_guards_running then
		self.on_guards_running = false
		self:dispose_running_guards()
	end

	if self.typing_text then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.typing_text)
		self.typing_text = nil
	end

	if self.resource_holder then
		self.resource_holder:Dispose()
		self.resource_holder = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.vampire_oneline_npcs[1]) or type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.vampire_oneline_npcs[2]) then
		if self.on_left_oneline then return false end
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.left_oneline_npcs, self))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.demon_oneline_npcs[1]) or type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.demon_oneline_npcs[2]) then
		if self.on_right_oneline then return false end
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.right_oneline_npcs, self))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose_running_guards()
	if self.optimized_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
		self.optimized_npcs = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name == self.plaza_stage_name then
		-- 1스테이지(광장)
		--self.is_replaying
		if not user_progress:IsStageCleared(self.plaza_stage_name) or self.is_replaying then
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.plaza_zone_name) then
				if self.current_state == self.event_state.init then
					self.current_state = self.event_state.plaza_entrance
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.running_guards, self)
					return true
				end
			elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.exit_zone_name) then
				if self.current_state == self.event_state.plaza_entrance then
					self.current_state = self.event_state.prison_entrance
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.check_for_identify, self)
				end
				return true
			elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's2_second_meet_secretary') then
				if self.oneline_state == 0 then
					self.oneline_state = 1
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.office_oneline_event, self, 1))
				end
				return true
			elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's3_office_oneline_zone_1') then
				if self.oneline_state == 1 then
					self.oneline_state = 2
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.office_oneline_event, self, 2))
				end
				return true
			elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's3_office_oneline_zone_2') then
				if self.oneline_state == 2 then
					self.oneline_state = 3
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.office_oneline_event, self, 3))
				end
				return true
			elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's3_office_oneline_zone_3') then
				if self.oneline_state == 3 then
					self.oneline_state = 4
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.office_oneline_event, self, 4))
				end
				return true
			elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's2_meet_vampire_captain') then
				if self.oneline_state == 4 then
					self.oneline_state = 5
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.office_oneline_event, self, 5))
				end
				return true
			end
		end
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'in_field') then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.plaza_to_prison, true)
			return true
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'in_office') then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, get_field_object('exit_office_inner'), true)
			return true
		end

	elseif stage.Name == self.prison_stage_name then
		-- 2스테이지(수용소)
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.prison_zone_name .. 1) then
			if self.current_state == self.event_state.prison_entrance then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.reporters1
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.worring_oneline, self))
			end
			return true
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.prison_zone_name .. 2) then
			if self.current_state == self.event_state.reporters1 then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.reporters2
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.people_asks, self))
			end
			return true
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.prison_zone_name .. 3) then
			if self.current_state == self.event_state.reporters2 then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.into_prison
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.main_s3_ending, self)
			end
			return true
		end

	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name == self.prison_stage_name then
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.prison_basement_grid) then
			if self.current_state == self.event_state.into_prison then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.progress_section, self))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:progress_section()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:running_guards()
	local pos = field:GetMarker('running_guards_pos').position
	local player = user_party.Leader
	--플레이어 초록색 이벤트 존에 진입하면 강제 이벤트 시작.
	--NPC 스파인
	--위쪽 로얄가드 4명 : ds_vampire_royalguard
	--아래쪽 로얄가드 4명 : ds_demon_royalguard
	--연출 진행 내용
	--(0) 초록색 존 진입 시 가디언 가운데 위치로 정렬. right, idle, idle
	party_util.align_party(pos, 'left', 1, 'linear')
	--(1) 화면 좌측에 shout 말풍선만 출력. “다들 서둘러!!! 백작님의 지원 요청이다!!!”
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_09')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.royale_guards[1], {key = self.talk_name .. 'oneline_0', skip = true,
		bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(-350, 300), scale = 1.15})
	--(2) 가디언 left, idle, idle + bubble_emoticon_question
	character_util.set_direction(player, 'left')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(player, nil, 'question')
	--(3) 가디언 left, suspried, jump1회
	character_util.set_emotion(player, {name = 'surprise'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(player)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)



	--플레이어 초록색 이벤트 존에 진입하면 우측 방향 수용소 쪽으로 빠르게 달려가는 로얄가드(attack 표정으로 8명 정도 배치)들의 모습을 보여줌.
	--(달리는 속도 플레이어와 동일, 우측 수용소 엑시트쪽에서 알파값 0되며 사라짐)
	local routine = {}
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local guard = self.royale_guards[i]
		character_util.set_position(guard, pos + vector(-21 -((i - 1) % 4),0 ,math.floor((i-1)/4) - 0.5))
		character_util.set_emotion(guard, {name = 'attack'})
		guard.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		table.insert(routine, util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard, vector(self.plaza_to_prison.x - 4.5, 0, guard.Position.z),
					9, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(guard, 0, 0.3)
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard, guard.Position + vector(3.5, 0, 0),
					9, true, nil, nil, 'right')
			character_util.set_position(guard, vector(999, 0, 999))
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(guard, 1, 0)
			guard.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
		end))
	end
	table.insert(routine, util.cs_generator(function()
		camera_util.move_async(pos + vector(-7 ,0 ,0), 1)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
		wait_for_sec(4/9)
		character_util.set_direction(player, 'down')
		character_util.move_distance(player, vector(0, 0, 1.5), 5/9, nil, false, true)
		wait_for_sec(3/9)
		camera_util.move_async(pos + vector(6, 0, 0), 13/9)
		character_util.set_direction(player, 'right')
	end))
	wait_all(routine)

	--(3-1) 3번 연출과 동시에 로얄가드들 달려오는 모습 보여주기 시작
	--우측 방향 수용소 쪽으로 빠르게 달려가는 로얄가드(attack 표정으로 8명 정도 배치)들의 모습을 보여줌.
	--가디언은 위로 1타일 0.5배속으로 뒷걸음질. (로얄가드를 피한다는 느낌으로)
	--(4) 로얄가드 엑시트 쪽에서 알파값 0되며 사라짐
	--(5) 컨트롤 풀림.

	character_util.remove_emotion(player)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

function local_class:check_for_identify()

	end

	character_util.move_distance(player, vector(1,0 ,0), 1, nil, true, true)

	character_util.set_emotion(guards[3], {name = 'attack'})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(guards[3], nil, 'notice')
	--
	guards[3]:HideWeapon(true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_armor_01')
	character_util.move_distance_async(guards[3], vector(0, 0, -1.5), 0.5, nil, true, true)
	--1번 로얄가드, 보라색 네모 위치로 이동 후 left, attack, idle

	for i = 1, 2 do
		character_util.set_direction(guards[i], 'down')
	end
	character_util.set_direction(guards[3], 'left')
	for i = 4, 6 do
		character_util.set_direction(guards[i], 'up')
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_jump_01')
	--위 연출과 동시에 위쪽 빨간 네모 라인 로얄가드들 down, idle, idle
	--동시에 아래쪽 빨간 네모 라인 로얄가드들도  up, idle, idle
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	--1번 로얄가드 (left, attack, release) : …잠시 검문이 있겠습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	character_util.set_anim(guards[3], {name = 'dualgun_attack_right'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guards[3], {key = self.talk_name .. 'check_1', skip = true})
	--1번 로얄가드 (left, attack, idle) : 차림새를 보아하니 로얄가드는 아닌 듯한데…
	character_util.set_anim(guards[3], {name = 'cross_arm'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guards[3], {key = self.talk_name .. 'check_2', skip = true})
	--1번 로얄가드 (left, attack, idle) : 현재 수용소로 통하는 길은 출입을 통제하고 있습니다.
	character_util.remove_anim(guards[3])
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guards[3], {key = self.talk_name .. 'check_3', skip = true})

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{self.talk_name .. 'check_4', 'mercy'},
		{self.talk_name .. 'check_5', 'brutal'},
	})


	if result == 2 then
		--[붉은색] 백작 데려와 백작!
		--가디언 right, attack, jingak + 카메라 살짝 shake
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(player, {name = 'attack'})
		character_util.set_anim(player, {name = 'jingak', loop = false})
		wait_for_sec(0.7)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_02')
		camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.2)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		--로얄가드1 (left, attack, cross_arm) : …아무리 축제날이라고 하지만 대낮부터 웬 술주정뱅이가…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(guards[3], {name = 'cross_arm', loop = false}, {name = 'attack'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guards[3], {key = self.talk_name .. 'check_6', skip = true})
		--로얄가드1 (left, mad, release) : 백작님이 아무나 만날 수 있는 분인 줄 알아?!
		camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.2)
		character_util.normal_jump(player, true)
		character_util.remove_anim(player)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(player, {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'damaged'})
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(guards[3], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'mad'})
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guards[3], {key = self.talk_name .. 'check_7', skip = true})

		--이후 선택지 [초록색] 다시 리리스의 칙서를 건넨다 만 남음. 이후 연출 동일.
		character_util.set_emotion(player, {name = 'tired'})
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guards[3])

		choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{self.talk_name .. 'check_4', 'mercy'},
		})
	end

	--선택지 출력
	--[초록색] 다시 리리스의 칙서를 건넨다

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(player, {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(player, nil, 'silence')

	player.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	--
	--로얄가드1 쪽으로 반 타일 다가가서 건네는 연출.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(player, {name = 'bow_walk'}, {name = 'tired'})

	character_util.move_distance_async(guards[3], vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.5, nil, true, false)
	--paper piece 로얄가드1에게 건네짐.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(player, {name = 'dualgun_attack_right', count = 1})
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(guards[3], {name = 'dualgun_attack_right', count = 1})
	guards[3].SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	player.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'paper_piece')
	character_util.set_anim(player, {name = 'bow_idle'})
	character_util.move_distance_async(guards[3], vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.5, nil, false, false)
	character_util.remove_anim(guards[3])

	character_util.set_anim(player, {name = 'cast'})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	player.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	character_util.remove_anim(player)


	--위 대사와 동시에 가디언 right, smile, idle
	--로얄가드1 (left, idle, release): 수용소는 비상 사태이니 절대로 따라오시면 안 됩니다!
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(guards[3], {name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guards[3], {key = self.talk_name .. 'check_13', skip = true})
	--로얄가드1 (down, attack, release) : 다들 무장하고  따라와!
	character_util.set_direction(guards[3], 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(player, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_anim(guards[3], {name = 'cast2'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guards[3], {key = self.talk_name .. 'check_14', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guards[3])
	--로얄가드 줄맞춰서 우측 엑시트로 알파값 0되며 퇴장.

	guards[3]:RefreshWeaponAttachments()

	local routine = {}
	table.insert(routine, util.cs_generator(function()
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(guards[3],
			pos + vector(3, 0, 0), 5, true, nil, nil, 'right' )
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(guards[3], 0, 0.5)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(guards[3],
				pos + vector(5, 0, 0), 5, true, nil, nil, 'right' )
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guards[3])
		character_util.set_position(guards[3], vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.set_active_state(guards[3], 'disabled')
	end))
	for i = 1, 2 do
		table.insert(routine, util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(guards[i], {
				pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5), pos + vector(3, 0, 0.5) },
			5, true, nil, nil, 'right' )
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(guards[i], 0, 0.5)
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(guards[i],
			pos + vector(5, 0, 0.5), 5, true, nil, nil, 'right' )
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guards[i])
			character_util.set_position(guards[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
			character_util.set_active_state(guards[i], 'disabled')
		end))
	end
	for i = 4, 6 do
		table.insert(routine, util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(guards[i], {
				pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5), pos + vector(3, 0, -0.5) },
			5, true, nil, nil, 'right' )
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(guards[i], 0, 0.5)
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(guards[i],
			pos + vector(5, 0, -0.5), 5, true, nil, nil, 'right' )
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guards[i])
			character_util.set_position(guards[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
			character_util.set_active_state(guards[i], 'disabled')
		end))
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	wait_all(routine)

	--컨트롤 풀림.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	player:HideWeapon(false)
	player:RefreshWeaponAttachments()
end

function local_class:reporters_assault()
	--수용소 마을
	--‘초록색 네모 라인 트리거존’에 진입하면 강제 이벤트 발생.
	--(현재 위치보다 트리거존 위치 1타일 왼쪽으로 변경.)
	--카메라 패닝하여 수용소 쪽을 비춰주며, 화면 하단에 말풍선(아래의 대사) 출력
	local block_pos = field:GetMarker('s3_guards_block_pos_1').position
	camera_util.move_async(block_pos + vector(0, 0, 5), 0.3)

	local sergant = self.prison_guards[6]
	local count = get_character('count')

	character_util.set_position(sergant, sergant.Position + vector(0, 0, 2))
	character_util.set_position(count, sergant.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))

	character_util.set_direction(sergant, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(count, 'down')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.reporters_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1,
													  type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1.2, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--[shout] : 수용소 안에 정말로 백작님의 따님이 갇혀 있는 건가요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.reporters[1], {key = self.talk_name .. 1,
															  bubble_type = 'shout',
															  screen_pos = vector(-200, -150),
															  scale = 1.5, skip = true})

	--수용소 앞, 로얄가드와 마족이 대치 상태로 소란스러운 상황.
	--수용소 문 입구는 로얄가드(경비병)들이 막고 있어 진입 불가능.

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--이후 카메라 아래로 패닝하여 로얄가드와 기자들 쪽 비춰줌.
	camera_util.move_async(block_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 1)


	--기자들이 카메라를 들고 수용소 안을 취재하려 애쓰고 있는 상황.
	--NPC 배치 설정
	--왼쪽 초록색 라인 4명. 로얄가드로 left, idle, idle (원라인 대사 없음.)
	--오른쪽 초록색 라인 4명. 로얄가드로 right, idle, idle (원라인 대사 없음.)
	--아래쪽 하늘색 라인 4명. 로얄가드로 down, idle, idle
	--+ 하늘색 라인 바로 윗줄에 동일하게 4명 로얄가드 배치 down, idle, idle
	--붉은색 숫자는 마족 기자 번호
	--숫자 기재한 마족들쪽 윗줄 4명, 아랫줄 6명으로 두줄배치. up, idle, cast2
	--
	--‘초록색 네모 라인 트리거존’에 진입하면 비강제 이벤트 발생.
	--기자 각자 대사 후 shoot자세 풀어주고 cast2자세로 변경.
	--마족 기자1 = 6(up, idle, shoot) : 수용소 폭발 사건에 대한 자세한 상황 설명 부탁드립니다!
	character_util.set_anim(self.reporters[1], {name = 'shoot'})
	character_util.normal_jump(self.reporters[1], true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.reporters[1], {key = self.talk_name .. 2, skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(self.reporters[1])
	character_util.set_anim(self.reporters[1], {name = 'cast2'})

	--마족 기자2 = 9(up, idle, shoot) : 현재 범인은 잡힌 상태인가요?
	character_util.set_anim(self.reporters[4], {name = 'shoot'})
	character_util.normal_jump(self.reporters[4])
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.reporters[4], {key = self.talk_name .. 3, skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(self.reporters[4])
	character_util.set_anim(self.reporters[4], {name = 'cast2'})
	--마족 기자3 = 2(up, idle, shoot) : 백작님은 지금 수용소 안에 계신 겁니까?
	character_util.set_anim(self.reporters[2], {name = 'shoot'})
	character_util.normal_jump(self.reporters[2], true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.reporters[2], {key = self.talk_name .. 4, skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(self.reporters[2])
	character_util.set_anim(self.reporters[2], {name = 'cast2'})
	--마족 기자4 = 4(up, idle, shoot) : 백작님에 대한 불신으로 민심이 기울고 있습니다! 이에 대한 대책은 있나요?
	character_util.set_anim(self.reporters[3], {name = 'shoot'})
	character_util.normal_jump(self.reporters[3])
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.reporters[3], {key = self.talk_name .. 5, skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(self.reporters[3])
	character_util.set_anim(self.reporters[3], {name = 'cast2'})

	--백작 down, sleep_deep, idle + bubble_emoticon_silience
	camera_util.move_async(block_pos + vector(0, 0, 3), 0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(count, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(count, nil, 'silence')
	character_util.remove_emotion(count)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_direction(count, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(sergant, 'right')
	--벡작 (left, left, idle) : 한 놈도 들여보내지 마라.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, {key = self.talk_name .. '5_0', skip = true})
	--백작 왼쪽 로얄가드 (right, attack, salute) : [shout] 예!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sergant, {name = 'salute', loop = false}, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sergant, {key = self.talk_name .. '5_1', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})

	character_util.move_distance_async(count, vector(0, 0, 1), 1, nil, true, true)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(count, 0, 0.5)
	character_util.move_distance_async(count, vector(0, 0, 0.5), 0.5, nil, true, true)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(count, active_state_type.disabled)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sergant)
	camera_util.move(block_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.5)

	--앞줄에 있는 로얄가드 1명 (down, idle, idle) : 안전을 위해 모두 물러나 주십시오.
	character_util.move_distance_async(sergant, vector(0, 0, -2), 1, nil, true, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.set_anim(sergant, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sergant, {key = self.talk_name .. 6, skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sergant)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sergant, {key = self.talk_name .. '6_0', skip = true})
	--
	self.reporters[1].Interactable.Talk = self.talk_name .. 2
	self.reporters[4].Interactable.Talk = self.talk_name .. 3
	--self.reporters[2].Interactable.Talk = self.talk_name .. 4
	--self.reporters[3].Interactable.Talk = self.talk_name .. 5

end


function local_class:worring_oneline()
	--1번,2번,3번 npc up, idle, idle 자세였다가 초록색 트리거존 밟으면 아래의 연출 발생
	--1번 npc (right, tired, question) : 분명 그이가 수용소 출근 전까지는 연락이 됐는데 말예요…
	character_util.set_direction(self.demon_civilians[5], 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(self.demon_civilians[6], 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(self.demon_civilians[7], 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.demon_civilians[5], {name = 'question', loop = false}, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.demon_civilians[6], {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.demon_civilians[7], {name = 'tired'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.demon_civilians[5], {key = self.talk_name .. '6_1'})
	--위 npc 대사와 동시에 2번,3번 npc left, idle, idle
	--2번 npc (left, mad, release) : 이 썩을 놈들이 마족들은 사람 취급도 안해주는겨?!
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.demon_civilians[6],
			{name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'mad'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.demon_civilians[6], {key = self.talk_name .. '6_2'})
	character_util.remove_anim(self.demon_civilians[6])
	--3번 npc (left, cry, cast) : 죽었는지 살았는지… 제발 무사해다오 아들아!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.demon_civilians[7], {name = 'cast', loop = true}, {name = 'cry'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.demon_civilians[7], {key = self.talk_name .. '6_3'})
	--이후 원라인 인터랙트 가능.
	self.demon_civilians[5].Interactable.Talk = self.talk_name .. '6_1'
	self.demon_civilians[6].Interactable.Talk = self.talk_name .. '6_2'
	self.demon_civilians[7].Interactable.Talk = self.talk_name .. '6_3'
end

function local_class:people_asks()
	local civ2_pos = field:GetMarker('s3_guards_block_pos_2').position + vector(2, 0, -2)

	-- 빠르게 진행해서 연출 도중 섹션이 끝나버리면 미리 종결 상태로 세팅하고 루틴을 마친다.
	local set_end_state = function()
		if self.current_state == self.event_state.into_prison then
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.demon_civilians[1], {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'damaged'})
			character_util.set_position(self.demon_civilians[1], civ2_pos + vector(1, 0, 0))
			character_util.set_position(self.demon_civilians[2], civ2_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
			for i = 2, 4 do
				character_util.set_emotion(self.demon_civilians[i], {name = 'surprise'})
			end
			return true
		end
		return false
	end
	--	if set_end_state() then	return end
	--남색 네모라인에 마족들 5명x2 두 줄 정렬 right, tired, idle 배치
	--남색 3번 로얄가드로 left, idle, idle
	--(밑에 로얄가드 한명 더 배치)
	--
	--
	--초록색 이벤트존 진입시 비강제 이벤트 발생.
	--마족1(right, tired, release) : 제 동료가 수용소 안에 갇혀있습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_anim(self.demon_civilians[1], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.demon_civilians[1], {key = self.talk_name .. 7, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	if set_end_state() then	return end
	--마족1(right, tired, cast) : 무사한지 확인만이라도 할 수 있게 해주세요!
	--character_util.set_anim(self.demon_civilians[1], {name = 'cast'})
	--speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.demon_civilians[1], {key = self.talk_name .. 8})
	--if set_end_state() then	return end
	--로얄가드1(left, idle, idle) : 수용소는 정식으로 권한을 가진 분들만 출입이 가능합니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.blocker_guards[9], {key = self.talk_name .. 9})
	if set_end_state() then	return end
	--마족1(right, tired, bomb_idle) : 그, 그런 권한은 귀족 뱀파이어들만 가지고 있지 않습니까?!
	--character_util.set_anim(self.demon_civilians[1], {name = 'bomb_idle'})
	--speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.demon_civilians[1], {key = self.talk_name .. 10})
	--if set_end_state() then	return end
	----로얄가드1(left, idle, idle) : 권한이 없다면 출입은 불가능합니다.
	--speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.blocker_guards[9], {key = self.talk_name .. 11})
	--if set_end_state() then	return end
	--마족2, 마족1에게 반타일 다가가서 격려하듯 위로를 건넨다.
	character_util.shake(self.demon_civilians[1], 0.02, 0.3)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.demon_civilians[1])
	character_util.move_to_async(self.demon_civilians[2],
			self.demon_civilians[1].Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			1, nil, true, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	if set_end_state() then	return end
	--마족2 (right, tired, push) : 저자들이 들여보내 주지 않을 거라 예상했네. 물러가세나.
	character_util.set_anim(self.demon_civilians[2], {name = 'push'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', loop = false, parent = self.demon_civilians[2],
								 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.demon_civilians[2], {key = self.talk_name .. 12})
	if set_end_state() then	return end
	--마족1, right, tired, idle로 한 번 shake. 이후1.5초간 대기 후 아래의 대사.
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', loop = false, parent = self.demon_civilians[1],
								 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
	character_util.shake(self.demon_civilians[1], 0.05, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(1.2)
	if set_end_state() then	return end
	--마족1 (right, tired, idle) : …저는 이런 불합리한 처우 더 이상은 못 견디겠습니다.
	character_util.remove_anim(self.demon_civilians[2])
	character_util.set_emotion(self.demon_civilians[1], {name = 'attack'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_ready_01', loop = false, parent = self.demon_civilians[1],
								 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.demon_civilians[1], {key = self.talk_name .. 13})
	if set_end_state() then	return end
	--
	--마족1, 한타일 앞으로 다가가 항의한다.
	character_util.move_to_async(self.demon_civilians[1],
			self.demon_civilians[1].Position + vector(1, 0, 0),

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.battle_start_zone_1  and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.enter_battle_zone_1
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_battle_zone_1, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.battle_start_zone_2 and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.enter_battle_zone_1 then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.enter_battle_zone_2
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_battle_zone_2, self))
	elseif zone_name == 's30_battle_2_end' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.enter_battle_zone_2 then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.enter_pyramid
		for i = 5, 8 do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battlegate_2_key .. i))
		end
	elseif (zone_name == self.battle_start_zone_3_1 or zone_name == self.battle_start_zone_3_2 or
			zone_name == self.battle_start_zone_3_3) and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.enter_pyramid then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.enter_battle_zone_3
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_battle_zone_3, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.leave_sohee_zone and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.enter_elevator then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.leave_sohee
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.leave_sohee, self))
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('pyramid_elevator_1')) then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.enter_elevator
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_elevator, self))
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_pyramid_inner()) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_pyramid, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_zone_1 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clear_battle_zone_1, self))
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_zone_2 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clear_battle_zone_2, self))
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_zone_3 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clear_battle_zone_3, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.daughter_p1 and e.FieldObject == self.get_boss_daughter_p1() then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clear_daughter_p1, self))
	end
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.daughter_p2 and e.FieldObject == self.get_boss_daughter_p2() then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clear_daughter_p2, self))
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	self.boss_phase_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.boss_phase_custom_key)

	if self.boss_phase_state == self.phase_info.phase_1_start then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rooftop_belial_event, self, true))
	elseif self.boss_phase_state == self.phase_info.phase_2_start then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clear_daughter_p1, self, true))
	else
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pre_setting, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and
			self.lock_side_cam_movement_on and self.cam_vfo ~= nil then
		stage_camera:SetTarget(self.cam_vfo)
	end
end

-- 피라미드 진입
function local_class:enter_pyramid()
	local count = self.get_count()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	self.get_pyramid_inner().Interactable = self.pyramid_interactable
	self.pyramid_interactable = nil

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party.Leader.Position = field:GetMarker('pyramid_inner_1').position
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'up')
	sohee.Position = field:GetMarker('pyramid_inner_1').position + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'up')
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(vector(-110.5, 0, 8.5), 2)

	for i = 1, 12 do
		local shadow = self.get_shadow_spirit(i)
		local dir = 'right'
		if i > 7 then
			dir =  'left'
		elseif i > 3  then
			dir = 'down'
		end
		character_util.set_active_state(shadow, 'enabled')
		character_util.remove_anim(shadow)
		character_util.set_direction(shadow, dir)
		self:shadow_appear(shadow, field:GetMarker('s30_battle_3_shadow_' .. i).position, dir)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_dark_03')
		wait_for_sec(0.1)
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(2)

	for i = 1, self.group_member_num do
		character_util.move_waypoint(self.group_b[i], self.group_b[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 8),
				6, true, nil, nil, 'up', true)
	end
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(count, count.Position + vector(0, 0, 8),
			6, true, nil, nil, 'up', true)

	count.Position = field:GetMarker('s30_battle_3_count_pos_2').position
	character_util.set_direction(count, 'left')

	local dir = { 'right', 'left', 'up', 'up' }
	for i = 1, self.group_member_num do
		self.group_b[i].Position = field:GetMarker('s30_battle_3_group_b_pos_2_' .. i).position
		character_util.set_direction(self.group_b[i], dir[i])
	end

	CS.Oak.StageUtil.NpcToAllyInBattle(count)
	for i = 1, 4 do
		CS.Oak.StageUtil.NpcToAllyInBattle(self.group_b[i])
	end

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.s30_marker_key, get_field_object('pyramid_elevator_1'), true)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:enter_elevator()
	local count = self.get_count()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local elevator_door = get_field_object('pyramid_elevator_1')
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.s30_marker_key)

	party_util.align_party(elevator_door.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 'down', 0.5, 'arc')

	-- 엘레베이터가 열리는 연출
	local animator = elevator_door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')
	animator:Play('open')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 파티원 위로 이동
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 1.5
		, nil, 1.5, true, true, false)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 0, 1)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 엘레베이터가 닫히는 연출
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')
	animator:Play('close')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_02')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 1, 0)
	end

	local elevator_pos = field:GetMarker('s30_elevator_pos').position
	camera_util.move(elevator_pos, 0)

	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, elevator_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(sohee, elevator_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(count, elevator_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(count, 'right')

	-- 엘레베이터씬 전용 시어 값으로 변경
	local shear = self.get_shear_controller()
	shear:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = 0.05

	local elevator_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_elevator_06', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1 })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- …이제 곧 옥상이야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s30_10', skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false })
	-- 우리들이 벨리알을 쓰러트리면 프리실라는 어떻게 되는…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s30_11', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(sohee)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	-- 벨리알의 부활을 막는 방법은 하나 뿐이다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = 'ds_main_s30_12', skip = true })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(count, nil, 'silence')

	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)
	-- 염치 없지만 한가지 부탁을 해도 되겠나?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count, { key = 'ds_main_s30_15', skip = true })

	local wait = true
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local result = 1

	-- 보상은 넉넉히 주시는거죠?
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('ds_main_s30_16'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end })

	-- 말씀만 하십시오. 장인어른!
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('ds_main_s30_17'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			result = 2
			wait = false
		end })

	-- 아니요.
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('ds_main_s30_18'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			result = 3
			wait = false
		end })

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if result == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'bomb_idle' }, { name = 'doyagao'})
	elseif result == 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'smile' })
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false },
				{ name = 'sleep_deep' })
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

-- 옥상 벨리알 이벤트
function local_class:rooftop_belial_event(on_start)
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local belial = self.get_boss_daughter()
	local belial_boss = self.get_boss_daughter_p1()
	local count = self.get_count()
	local center_pos = field:GetMarker('s30_rooftop').position
	local camera_pos = center_pos

	local background = get_field_object('background')

	local backup_background_pos = background.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.1

	local function background_move(duration, end_pos)
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos = background.Position

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			if background ~= nil then
				background.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	-- 카메라는 인공 태양을 바라보도록하고 배경도 미리 땡겨둠
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos + vector(0, 0, 11), 0)
	background.Position = backup_background_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5

	belial.Position = center_pos + vector(0, 0, 2)
	leader.Position = center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -6)
	count.Position = center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -6)

	belial.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

	self.boss_phase_state = self.phase_info.phase_1_start
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.boss_phase_custom_key, self.boss_phase_state)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	if on_start == true then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		local sohee = self.get_sohee()
		character_util.convert_to_npc(sohee)
		sohee.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		character_util.convert_to_party_member(count, user_party, true)

		if self.sun_effect == nil then
			self.sun_effect = self.get_sun_effect():Instantiate(self.sun_default_pos)
			self.sun_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
		screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
	end

	local sun_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_sun_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = 'event' })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
			background_move, 3, backup_background_pos))

		center_pos + (pos_diff * (1 / 3)),
		center_pos + (pos_diff * (2 / 3)),
		belial_evo.Position
	}

		cam_size - (size_diff * (1 / 3)),

	camera_util.move(cam_zoom_pos[2], 0.15)
	camera_util.resize_to(cam_zoom_size[2], 0.15)

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.25)
	camera_util.move(cam_zoom_pos[3], 0.15)

	character_util.set_anim(belial_evo, { name = 'phase_1_off', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(2.467)
	character_util.set_anim(belial_evo, { name = 'phase_2_on', loop = false })
	self.get_fx_boss_priscilla_transform_phase2():Instantiate(belial_evo.Position)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.075, 9999)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_se_ds_02')
	wait_for_sec(3)

	-- 오른쪽 날개 나오는 타이밍
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.2)
	camera_util.move(center_pos + vector(1.75, 0, 1.5), 0.15)
	wait_for_sec(3.45)

	-- 왼쪽 날개 나오는 타이밍

	self.feather_effect = self.get_fx_black_feather():Instantiate(stage_camera.Transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(45, 0, 0), stage_camera.Transform)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

	belial_boss_p2.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	knight_bow.Position = knight.Position

	local shield = knight.Weapon2.WeaponSpec.SpriteName
	local bow = knight_bow.Weapon1.WeaponSpec.SpriteName

	knight_bow.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', shield)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	local feather_effect_long = self.get_fx_black_feather_long():Instantiate(stage_camera.Transform.position,
			unity_class.quaternion.Euler(45, 0, 0), stage_camera.Transform)

	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(1.1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_se_ds_03')
	wait_for_sec(0.9)

	local function feather_move(duration, end_pos)
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos = feather_effect_long.transform.position

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			if feather_effect_long ~= nil then
				feather_effect_long.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	-- 카메라 위로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 12), 3.5)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 카메라 아래로 이동
	camera_util.move(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 2), 4.5)

	local feather_bot_end_pos = feather_effect_long.transform.position + vector(0, 0, 8)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(feather_move, 4.5, feather_bot_end_pos))

	local time = 4.5
	local dis = 15
	local speed = dis / time
	local boss_pyramid_anim = boss_pyramid:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	character_util.move_to(belial_boss_p2, belial_boss_p2.Position + vector(0, -dis, 0),
			nil, speed, false, false)

	boss_pyramid_anim:Play('chain_R')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.35, 0.2)
	wait_for_sec(0.7)
	boss_pyramid_anim:Play('chain_M')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.35, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_39_demonshire/audio:bgm_demonshire_boss_02', state = 'combat' })
	screen_util.show_boss_title('ds_main_s30_p2_boss_title', 'ds_main_s30_p2_boss_subtitle', 2)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	camera_util.move_async(knight_bow.Position, 0.5)

	self.get_fx_change():Instantiate(knight_bow.Position)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_cast_light_02')
	character_util.set_direction(knight_bow, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(knight_bow, { name = 'cwp/knight', loop = false })
	character_util.shake(knight_bow, 0.01, 0.8)
	wait_for_sec(0.15)
	camera_util.resize_to(2.25, 0.075)
	wait_for_sec(0.65)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_cast_light_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
	self.get_fx_cast():Instantiate(knight_bow.Position)
	camera_util.resize_to(5, 1.2)

	-- 카메라 위 아래로만 움직이도록 설정
	self.lock_side_cam_movement_on = true
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent), 'on_field_object_revived_event')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		self.cam_vfo = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		self.cam_vfo.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
		self.cam_vfo.Position = center_pos

		while self.lock_side_cam_movement_on do
			self.cam_vfo.Position = vector(center_pos.x, 0, knight_bow.Position.z)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end))
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	camera_util.move(self.cam_vfo.Position, 1.2, { end_target = self.cam_vfo })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	knight_bow.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', bow)
	knight_bow.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')
	character_util.set_anim(knight_bow, { name = 'dualgun_victory', scale = 0.75 })
	wait_for_sec(0.75)
	character_util.remove_anim(knight_bow)

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(count, user_party, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.45)

	belial_boss_p2.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.set_death_type(belial_boss_p2, 'none')
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(belial_boss_p2, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	stage.FieldUIManager:SetUI(belial_boss_p2, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
