function local_class:clear_daughter_p2()
	local count = self.get_count()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local belial_boss_p2 = self.get_boss_daughter_p2()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local knight_bow = self.get_knight_bow()

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.ending

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	while user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = knight
	heal_info.target = knight
	heal_info.heal = knight.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.skipEffect = true
	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

	self.lock_side_cam_movement_on = false
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent))
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	count.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(count)
	sohee.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	belial_boss_p2.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	get_field_object('control_system').ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	character_util.convert_to_npc(count)

	-- 리베라 TypeB 기사 세팅
	local leader = knight
	character_util.set_active_state(leader, 'enabled')
	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(leader, param, true)

	local character_spec_id = 1
	if user_util.has_knight_male() then
		character_spec_id = 2
	end
	get_party_leader().CharacterInfo = CS.Oak.CharacterInfo.CreateDummyCharacterInfo(
			user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.User, character_spec_id)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	knight.Position = knight_bow.Position

	if self.sun_effect ~= nil then
		self.sun_effect:Dispose()
		self.sun_effect = nil
	end

	if self.sun_phase_2_effect ~= nil then
		self.sun_phase_2_effect:Dispose()
		self.sun_phase_2_effect = nil
	end

	if self.feather_effect ~= nil then
		self.feather_effect:Dispose()
		self.feather_effect = nil
	end

	for i = 1, self.group_member_num do
		if self.group_b[i] ~= nil then
			self.group_b[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.group_b[i])
		end

		if self.group_c[i] ~= nil then
			self.group_c[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.group_c[i])
		end

		if self.group_d[i] ~= nil then
			self.group_d[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.group_d[i])

	local belial_shake = function(magnitude, duration)
		local origin_position = belial_effect.transform.position

		shake_calculator:Shake(shake_info)

		while shake_calculator.IsActive do
			belial_effect.transform.position = belial_effect.transform.position + shake_calculator.ShakeOffset

			coroutine.yield()

			shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		end

		end

-- 배경(전경) 이동 함수
function local_class:background_move_async(background, end_position, duration)
	local start_position = background.Position

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local position = vector_util.lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)

		background.Position = position

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	background.Position = end_position
end

function local_class:background_move(background, end_position, duration)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.background_move_async, self,
		background, end_position, duration))
end

	character_util.move_waypoint(kid_boy, kid_boy.Position + kid_move_dist, kid_speed)

		drop_item_util.move_to_async(kid_boy_balloon,kid_boy_balloon.Position + kid_move_dist, nil,
			kid_speed)

		-- 풍선 아이템 해제

		end
	end))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_phone_receive_01')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 가디언 (idle)상태로 전화 받음

	local phone_speech_offset = vector(2.2, 0, 1.2)

	-- 공주: 아! 드디어 받았다!

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(knight, { key = 'ds_main_s32_1_1', skip = true,
														  offset = phone_speech_offset })

	-- 공주: 며칠 동안 연락이 안 되어 걱정했다구!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(knight, { key = 'ds_main_s32_1_2', skip = true,
														  offset = phone_speech_offset })

	-- 선택지

	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'ds_main_s32_1_2_1', 'normal' } })

	knight.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	-- 가디언(right,mad,cast2)(jump2회)
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'cast2' })
	character_util.normal_double_jump(knight, '01_player_jump_01')

	-- 가디언(left,attack,dualgun_attak) 1초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'dualgun_attack' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 가디언(right,damaged,dead모션 1회)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(knight, { name = 'dead', sfx = '01_trip_01' })

	-- 가디언 (idle)상태로 전화 받음
	knight.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'mall_phone')
	character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
	character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'twohand_idle' })

	-- 공주 : 무슨 소린지 잘 모르겠지만…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(knight, { key = 'ds_main_s32_1_3', skip = true,
														  offset = phone_speech_offset })

	-- 공주 : 모두 잘 해결되었다는 거지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(knight, { key = 'ds_main_s32_1_4', skip = true,
														  offset = phone_speech_offset })

	-- 가디언(right,smile,nod2회)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(knight, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	-- 가디언 (idle)상태로 전화 받음
	character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'twohand_idle' })

	-- 공주 : 정말 다행이야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(knight, { key = 'ds_main_s32_1_5', skip = true,
														  offset = phone_speech_offset })

	-- 공주 : 조심히 돌아와야 해!

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(knight, { key = 'ds_main_s32_1_6', skip = true,
														  offset = phone_speech_offset })

	-- 가디언 전화 내리고
	knight.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	knight:HideWeapon(false)

	character_util.remove_anim(knight)

	-- 이후 가디언 (right,smile,victory_get) 하고 컨트롤 복귀
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(knight, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	sohee:HideWeapon(false)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:enter_office()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local count_daughter = self.get_count_daughter()
	local secretary = self.get_secretary()
	local vampire_captain = self.get_vampire_captain()

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'ease_in_out_sine')

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	local exit_office_outer = self.get_exit_office_outer()
	quest_marker_util.remove(exit_office_outer.Name)

	-- 파티 위치 이동
	local office_inner_marker = self.get_office_inner_marker()

	party_util.position_party(office_inner_marker.position, office_inner_marker.direction, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	sohee:HideWeapon(true)
	count_daughter:HideWeapon(true)

	local fire_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fire_05', loop = true,
													   type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default',
													   fade_in_time = 4, volume = 0.5 })

	-- 주지사 저택 입장 시, 곧바로 주지사 집무실이 나오며 이벤트 발생 (컨트롤 빼앗는 이벤트)
	-- 가디언과 소히 집무실 중앙으로 걸어나가는 상태에서 페이드인 되며, 위 화살표 상단의 위치에 정렬
	-- 왕좌에 프리실라 앉아 있고, 좌측에 비서, 우측에 발렌시아 서 있음,
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.6, 'ease_in_out_sine')

	local align_marker = self.get_office_align_marker()

	character_util.move_waypoint(knight, {
		align_marker.position, align_marker.position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	}, 4, false, nil, nil, 'up')
	character_util.move_waypoint(sohee, {
		align_marker.position, align_marker.position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	}, 4, false, nil, nil, 'up')
	camera_util.move_async(align_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 2.5), 2.625)

	-- 프리실라가 가디언 보고 내려옴.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_walk_06')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(count_daughter, {
		count_daughter.Position + vector(0, -0.5, -1),
		count_daughter.Position + vector(0, -1.7, -2)
	}, 1, false)

	-- 프리실라가 비서와 발렌시아 사이 지나치는 시점에, 비서와 발렌시아는 반 타일씩 안쪽으로 이동한 후 다시 down.
	character_util.move_waypoint(vampire_captain, vampire_captain.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
		1, false, nil, nil, 'down')
	character_util.move_waypoint(secretary, secretary.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1,
		false, nil, nil, 'down')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(count_daughter,
		count_daughter.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5), 1, false)

	-- 프리실라 (down, idle, idle) : 오셨군요, 가디언.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_39_demonshire/audio:bgm_demonshire_main', state = 'event', mix = 3 })
	fire_loop_sfx:FadeOut(3)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s32_1', skip = true })

	-- 프리실라 (down, idle, idle) : 이야기는 다 들었어요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s32_2', skip = true })

	-- 프리실라 (down, sleep_deep, idle) : 벨리알에 관한 것도…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(count_daughter, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s32_2_1', skip = true })

	-- 0.3초 후
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 프리실라 (left, tired, idle) : …아버지에 관한 것도.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(count_daughter, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(count_daughter, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s32_3', skip = true })

	-- 프리실라 … 이모티콘
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(count_daughter, nil, 'silence')

	-- 프리실라 (down, idle, idle) : 하지만 반드시 돌아온다고 하셨어요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(count_daughter, 'down')
	character_util.remove_emotion(count_daughter)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s32_4', skip = true })

	-- 프리실라 (down, idle, idle) : 아버지를 다시 만나는 그날 부끄럽지 않기 위해…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s32_4_1', skip = true })

	-- 0.3초 후
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 프리실라 (down, idle, nod) : 열심히 하겠어요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.set_anim(count_daughter, { name = 'nod' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s32_4_2', skip = true })

	-- 비서 (right, sleep_deep, salute_china) : 백작님의 명을 받들어, 프리실라 님을 충실히 보조하겠습니다.
	-- 이때 프리실라 왼쪽을 봄
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_jump_01')
	character_util.look_at(count_daughter, secretary)
	character_util.look_at(secretary, count_daughter)
	character_util.remove_anim(count_daughter)
	character_util.set_emotion(secretary, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	character_util.set_anim(secretary, { name = 'salute_china', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s32_5', skip = true })

	-- 발렌시아 (left, sleep_deep, salute) : 프리실라 님을 어떤 위협으로부터도 완벽히 지키겠습니다.
	-- 이때 프리실라 오른쪽을 봄.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	character_util.look_at(count_daughter, vampire_captain)
	character_util.look_at(vampire_captain, count_daughter)
	character_util.set_emotion(vampire_captain, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	character_util.set_anim(vampire_captain, { name = 'salute', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_captain, { key = 'ds_main_s32_6', skip = true })

	-- 오른쪽을 향한 상태로 아래의 대사
	-- 프리실라 (right, idle, idle) : 두 분 다 정말 고마워요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s32_7', skip = true })

	-- 비서와 발렌시아 down, idle 로 방향과 표정 리셋
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_direction(secretary, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(vampire_captain, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(secretary)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(vampire_captain)

	-- 1초 후 프리실라도 down, idle 로 변환
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 프리실라 (down, idle, idle) : 기사님이 이곳에 처음 도착했을 때, 무언가 요구하셨다고 들었는데요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(count_daughter, 'down')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s32_8', skip = true })

	-- 선택지
	-- 마나 축퇴로를 받으러 왔습니다.
	-- 마나 축퇴로를 받으러 왔습니다. / 순순히 마나 축퇴로를 넘기지 않으면 유혈사태는 일어나지 않을 것이다.
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'ds_main_s32_8_1', 'mercy' }, { 'ds_main_s32_8_2', 'brutal' }
	})

	-- 프리실라 …이모티콘 추가
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(count_daughter, nil, 'silence')

	-- 프리실라 (down, idle, idle) : 리리스 님의 칙서는 보았습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s32_9', skip = true })

	-- 프리실라 (left, tired, idle) : 곧 인베이더 세력과의 전쟁이 벌어질 거라니…
	character_util.set_direction(count_daughter, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(count_daughter, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s32_9_1', skip = true })

	-- 0.7초 후
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	-- 프리실라 (down, idle, idle) : 저와 데몬샤이어 시민들은 가디언 당신에게 은혜를 입은 몸.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(count_daughter, 'down')
	character_util.remove_emotion(count_daughter)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s32_10', skip = true })

	-- 프리실라 (down, smile, idle) : 당신이 저희들을 원하신다면 얼마든지 기쁜 마음으로 돕겠습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(count_daughter, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s32_11', skip = true })

	-- 프리실라 (right, idle, nod x 1)
	-- 이때 가디언 일행도 오른쪽을 바라본다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(count_daughter, 'right')
	character_util.remove_emotion(count_daughter)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(count_daughter, { name = 'nod' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 0.5초 후 우측으로 카메라 이동.
	local mana_singularity_drive = self.get_mana_singularity_drive()

	camera_util.move_async(mana_singularity_drive.Position, 1, { end_target = mana_singularity_drive })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 0.5초 후 우측 로얄가드들이 마나 축퇴로 들고 온다.(카메라 마나 축퇴로 이동 따라서 다시 돌아와 원위치)
	-- 좌측 로얄가드 ds_demon_royalguard
	-- Down, idle, idle 상태에서 마나축퇴로 들 때 right, idle, push
	-- 우측 로얄가드 ds_vampire_royalguard

	local royal_guard_2 = self.get_royal_guard(2)

	character_util.move_waypoint(royal_guard_1, royal_guard_1.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0),
		2, false)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(royal_guard_2,
		royal_guard_2.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, 0), 2, false)

	character_util.set_locked_dir(royal_guard_1, 'right')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(royal_guard_2, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(royal_guard_1, { name = 'push', upper = true })
	character_util.set_anim(royal_guard_2, { name = 'push', upper = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_battery_02')
	character_util.move_waypoint(royal_guard_1, {
		royal_guard_1.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), royal_guard_1.Position + vector(-4.25, 0, -1)
	}, 2, false, nil, nil, 'right')
	character_util.move_waypoint(royal_guard_2, {
		royal_guard_2.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), royal_guard_2.Position + vector(-3.75, 0, -1)
	}, 2, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	character_util.move_to_async(mana_singularity_drive,
		mana_singularity_drive.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), nil, 2)
	character_util.move_to_async(mana_singularity_drive,
		mana_singularity_drive.Position + vector(-4, 0, 0), nil, 2)

	-- 위 이미지에 축퇴로 놓은 후,(이때 가디언과 소히 up으로 전환) 로얄가드들 오른쪽으로 퇴장.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'up')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(royal_guard_1, 'none')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(royal_guard_2, 'none')
	character_util.remove_anim(royal_guard_1, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(royal_guard_2, true)
	character_util.move_waypoint(royal_guard_2, royal_guard_2.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
		4, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(royal_guard_1, {
		royal_guard_1.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), royal_guard_1.Position + vector(3.75, 0, -2),
		royal_guard_1.Position + vector(3.75, 0, -1)
	}, 4, false, nil, nil, 'left')

	-- 프리실라 (down, idle, idle) : 그럼…이걸 받아 주세요.
	character_util.set_direction(count_daughter, 'down')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s32_12', skip = true })

	-- 프리실라 (down, idle, idle) : 당신의 남은 여정에 빛이 있기를…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s32_13', skip = true })

	-- 가가디언 right, smile, get_victory 애니메이션
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(knight, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 소히 (right, attack, release) : 그렇게 헤벌레해서 좋아하고 있을 시간 없어!

	end

		return field:GetMarker('s4_battle_up_pos_' .. idx).position
	end

		return field:GetMarker('s4_battle_leader_align_pos').position
	end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')

	local oneline_eat_npc_14 = get_character('oneline_npc_14')
	self.npc_eat_sound_3d = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', parent = oneline_eat_npc_14,
		loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc',
		max_distance = 3
	})
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	-- 기본 퀘스트 마커 설정
	local quest_marker_fo_name = self.quest_marker_by_grid.main_floor
	local quest_marker_fo = get_field_object(quest_marker_fo_name)
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, quest_marker_fo, true)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local battle_npc = self.get_battle_npc(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(battle_npc, 'enabled')
		character_util.convert_to_npc(battle_npc)
		character_util.set_emotion(battle_npc, { name = 'attack' })
	end

	local prisoner_1 = get_character('oneline_event_11_npc_1')
	local prisoner_2 = get_character('oneline_event_11_npc_2')

	local prisoner_1_pos = field:GetMarker('s4_oneline_11_npc_1_pos_1').position
	character_util.set_position(prisoner_1, prisoner_1_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(prisoner_1, 'down')
	prisoner_1.Interactable.Talk = nil
	prisoner_1.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local prisoner_2_pos = field:GetMarker('s4_oneline_11_npc_2_pos_1').position
	character_util.set_position(prisoner_2, prisoner_2_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(prisoner_2, 'down')
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	local paper_guard_1 = self.get_paper_guard(1)
	if paper_guard_1 ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(paper_guard_1, self.controller)
	end

	local paper_guard_2 = self.get_paper_guard(2)
	if paper_guard_2 ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(paper_guard_2, self.controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	if self.npc_eat_sound_3d ~= nil then
		self.npc_eat_sound_3d:Stop()
		self.npc_eat_sound_3d = nil
	end
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target

	if (lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_paper_guard(1)) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_paper_guard(2))) and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.prisoner_flee_event then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.paper_guard_interact, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.prisoner_flee_event_zone) and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.prisoner_flee_event, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.guard_order_event_zone) and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.prisoner_run_down then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.guard_order_event, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.battle_event_zone) and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.paper_guard_interact then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.battle_event, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.npc_run_down_zone) and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.battle_event then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.npc_run_down_event, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		local grid_name = e.CameraGrid.name
		local quest_marker_fo_name = self.quest_marker_by_grid[grid_name]
		if quest_marker_fo_name ~= nil then
			local quest_marker_fo = get_field_object(quest_marker_fo_name)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, quest_marker_fo, true)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:battle_event()
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.battle_event

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local up_npc_1 = self.get_battle_npc(2)
	local up_npc_2 = self.get_battle_npc(1)
	local down_npc_1 = self.get_battle_npc(3)
	local down_npc_2 = self.get_battle_npc(4)
	local npcs = { up_npc_1, up_npc_2, down_npc_1, down_npc_2 }

	local leader_move_to = self.get_battle_leader_align_pos()
	character_util.move_to_async(leader, leader_move_to, nil, 4, true, true)

	--전투방 초록색 트리거존 진입시 화면 좌측 중앙에 shout 말풍선 출력
	--“저깄다!!!”
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_small_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, {
		key = 'ds_main_s4_20', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout',
		scale = 1.15, screen_pos = vector(-400, 100)
	})

	--간수 (ds_vampire_prisonfficer)들 run으로 달려와서 1,2,3,4번 위치에 정렬
	local up_npc_1_wp = {
		self.get_battle_up_pos(1),
	}

	local up_npc_2_wp = {
		self.get_battle_up_pos(1),
		self.get_battle_up_pos(2)
	}

	local down_npc_1_wp = {
		self.get_battle_down_pos(1)
	}

	local down_npc_2_wp = {
		self.get_battle_down_pos(1),
		self.get_battle_down_pos(2)
	}

	local speed = 5

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				up_npc_1, up_npc_1_wp, speed, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				up_npc_2, up_npc_2_wp, speed, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				down_npc_1, down_npc_1_wp, speed, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				down_npc_2, down_npc_2_wp, speed, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)
	})

	--2번 간수 (right, attack, release) : 이게 감히 우리를 속여?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_emotion(up_npc_1, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(up_npc_1, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(up_npc_1, { key = 'ds_main_s4_21', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(up_npc_1)

	--가디언 left, idle, idle  + bubble_emoticon_question
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'question')

	--3번 간수 (right, attack, jingak) : [shout] 백작 님께서 가짜 칙서를 언급하며 접근하는 놈은 잡아들이라 하셨다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	character_util.set_anim(down_npc_1, { name = 'jingak', loop = false,
										  remove_after = 1, sfx_name = '03_mech_stomp_02' })
	wait_for_sec(0.7)
	stage_camera:Shake(0.2, 0.3) -- 0.7초에
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(down_npc_1, { key = 'ds_main_s4_22', skip = true })

	--2번 간수 (right, mad, cast2) : 감히 리리스님의 인장을 도용하다니 용서못해…!
	character_util.set_emotion(up_npc_1, { name = 'mad' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_anim(up_npc_1, { name = 'cast2' })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(up_npc_1, { key = 'ds_main_s4_23', skip = true })

	--선택지 출력
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--[초록색] 이건 진짜 칙서라고!
		{ 'ds_main_s4_24', 'mercy' },
		--[붉은색] 제 마음만은 진심입니다
		{ 'ds_main_s4_25', 'brutal' }
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--가디언 left, attack, release
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01'})
	else
		--가디언 left, tired, bomb_idle
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'sing' })
		wait_for_sec(2)
	end

	--2번 간수 (right, attack, release) : 시끄러워! 당장 백작님께 끌고가주마!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(up_npc_1, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(up_npc_1, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(up_npc_1, { key = 'ds_main_s4_26', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(up_npc_1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	--이후 일반 전투 진행.
	for i = 1, #npcs do
		character_util.remove_emotion(npcs[i])
		character_util.convert_to_monster(npcs[i], 'battle1')
	end
end

function local_class:guard_order_event()
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.guard_order_event

	local guard_leader = self.get_guard_leader()
	local guards = {}
	local guard_num = 5
	for i = 1, guard_num do
		local guard = self.get_ordered_guard(i)
		table.insert(guards, guard)
	end

	local guard_leader_move_to_1 = self.get_guard_leader_wp_1()
	camera_util.move_async(guard_leader_move_to_1, 1)

	character_util.remove_anim(guard_leader)
	character_util.move_to_async(guard_leader, guard_leader_move_to_1, nil, 1.5, true, true)

	-- 간수1 (right, attack, idle) : 다들 무전으로 들었겠지만 현재 흉악한 범죄자들이 대거 탈옥한 상황이다.
	character_util.set_emotion(guard_leader, { name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_leader, { key = 'ds_main_s4_2', skip = true })

	-- 간수1 (right, attack, idle+shake) : 게다가 감히 백작님을 속이려한 발칙한 놈까지…!
	character_util.shake(guard_leader, 0.03, 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_leader, { key = 'ds_main_s4_2_1', skip = true })

	-- 간수1(right, attack, release) : 데몬샤이어의 치안을 위해서라도 절대 그런 일은 발생하게 둬선 안돼!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_anim(guard_leader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_leader, { key = 'ds_main_s4_3', skip = true })

	-- 간수1(right, attack, jingak) : [SHOUT] 건물이 다 무너지는 한이 있더라도 한 명도 놓치지 말고 전부 잡아들여!!!
	character_util.set_anim(guard_leader,
			{ name = 'jingak', loop = false, remove_after = 1, sfx_name = '03_mech_stomp_02' })
	wait_for_sec(0.7)
	stage_camera:Shake(0.2, 0.3) -- 0.7초에
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_leader,
			{ key = 'ds_main_s4_4', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })
	character_util.remove_anim(guard_leader)

	-- 간수들(2~7 up, idle, basket_attack) : [shout] 네!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	character_util.set_group_anim(guards, { name = 'salute', loop = false })
	local answer_fo = self.get_ordered_guard(1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_09')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(answer_fo, { key = 'ds_main_s4_5', skip = true,
															 bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = answer_fo.Position })
	character_util.remove_group_anim(guards)
	local run_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_dash_06', parent = guards[1],
		loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc',
		max_distance = 7
	})
	local guard_1 = guards[1]
	local guard_1_move_to = guard_1.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.25)
	character_util.move_waypoint(guard_1, guard_1_move_to, 2, true,
			'stop', 'floor', 'down', true)

	local guard_5 = guards[5]
	local guard_5_move_to = guard_5.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.25)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard_5, guard_5_move_to, 2, true,
			'stop', 'floor', 'up', true)

	for i = 1, guard_num do
		local guard = guards[i]
		local move_to = guard.Position + vector(20, 0, 0)
		character_util.move_waypoint(guard, move_to, 7, true,
				'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)
	end

	run_sound:Stop()

	local last_guard = guards[guard_num]
	while true do
		if not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(last_guard.Position, { bonus_distance = 1 }) then
			for i = 1, guard_num do
				local guard = self.get_ordered_guard(i)
				character_util.stop(guard)
				character_util.set_active_state(guard, 'disabled')
			end
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(guard_leader)

	local guard_exit_pos_1 = self.get_guard_exit_pos(1)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard_leader, guard_exit_pos_1, 4, false,
			'stop', 'floor', 'left')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('guard_exit_door', false))
	wait_for_sec(2)

	local guard_leader_move_to_2 = guard_leader.Position + vector(-20, 0, 0)
	character_util.move_waypoint(guard_leader, guard_leader_move_to_2, 4, false,
			'stop', 'floor', 'left')

	while true do
		if not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(guard_leader.Position, { bonus_distance = 1 }) then
			character_util.stop(guard_leader)
			character_util.set_active_state(guard_leader, 'disabled')
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('guard_exit_door', false))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.last_hit_effect_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fx_dead)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.twinkle_preset)

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	return true
end

			itemid = cur_data.id,
			notforinven = true,

		item.ShadowTransform.position = item.ShadowTransform.position + cur_data.shadow_offset
		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = cur_data.rot
		item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = cur_data.rot

		table.insert(self.sleep_items, {
			drop_item = item,
			sfx = cur_data['sfx']
		})
	end

	--TODO: 타일맵에서 마커 추가해서 수정 필요
	local temp_vec = {
		vector(80.75, 0, -177.5),
		vector(81.5, 0, -177.6),
		vector(82.25, 0, -177.4)
	}

	for i = 1, #temp_vec do
		local item_pos = temp_vec[i]
		local cur_data = item_data[item_list[i]]

		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = item_pos + cur_data.offset,
			itemid = cur_data.id,
			notforinven = true,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			skip_text = true
		})

		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = cur_data.rot
		item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = cur_data.rot

			drop_item = item,

		table.insert(self.tutorial_sleep_items, data)
	end

	local lever = self.get_dark_room_lever()
	self.lever_twinkle_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.twinkle_preset):Instantiate(lever.Bounds.center)

	local sohee_weapon_box = self.get_sohee_weapon_box()
	self.sohee_weapon_box_twinkle_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.twinkle_preset):Instantiate(sohee_weapon_box.Bounds.center)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	local sleeping_guard = self.get_sleeping_guard()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(sleeping_guard, self.controller)

	for i = 1, #self.sleep_items do
		if self.sleep_items[i].drop_item ~= nil then
			self.sleep_items[i].drop_item:ConsumeComplete()
		end
	end

	if self.prison_key_item ~= nil then
		self.prison_key_item:ConsumeComplete()
	end

	if self.lever_twinkle_fx ~= nil then
		self.lever_twinkle_fx:Dispose()
	end

	if self.sohee_weapon_box_twinkle_fx ~= nil then
		self.sohee_weapon_box_twinkle_fx:Dispose()
	end

	if self.sohee_equipping_sfx ~= nil then
		self.sohee_equipping_sfx:Stop()
	end

	if self.snoring_sfx ~= nil then
		self.snoring_sfx:Stop()
	end

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_sohee_prison_door()) then
		if self.cur_progress == self.progress.sohee_found_in_prison then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.interact_sohee_prison_door, self))
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_dark_room_lever()) and
			not self.is_lever_pulled then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.pull_lever, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_sleeping_guard_key()) and
			not self.is_key_found then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.get_key_from_sleeping_guard, self))
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_escape_room_door()) and
			self.is_key_found then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_escape_room_door, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_sleeping_guard()) and
			not self.is_sleeping_guard_awake then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.sleeping_guard_interact_detect, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_irongate(1)) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.open_prison_door_with_event, self, self.get_irongate(1))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.sohee_found_zone) and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.sohee_found_in_prison, self)
	elseif (type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.dark_room_event_zone) or
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_mouse_bomb(), self.dark_room_event_zone)) and
			self.is_lever_pulled then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.toggle_dark_room_tint, self, true, true))
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.rescue_sohee_first_notice_zone) and
			self.is_key_found and self.cur_progress < self.progress.sohee_join_party then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.rescue_sohee_first_notice, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.prisoner_talk_zone) and
			not self.is_prisoner_talked then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.prisoner_talk, self))
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.key_sneaking_zone) then
		if not self.is_sneaking then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sneaking_mode_on, self))
		end
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.step_item, self))
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.sleep_talk_zone) and
			not self.is_sleep_talked then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sleep_talk, self))
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.sleep_intro_zone) and
			not self.is_sleep_intro_played then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.sleep_intro_event, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.sohee_sfx_play_zone) and
			not self.is_sohee_equipping_sfx_played then
		self.is_sohee_equipping_sfx_played = true
		self.sohee_equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, parent = self.get_sohee()
		})
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if (type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, leader, self.dark_room_event_zone) or
			type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, self.get_mouse_bomb(), self.dark_room_event_zone)) and
			self.is_lever_pulled then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.toggle_dark_room_tint, self, false, true))
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, leader, self.key_sneaking_zone) and self.is_sneaking then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.sneaking_mode_off, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		local grid_name = e.CameraGrid.name
		local quest_marker_fo_name = self.quest_marker_by_grid[grid_name]
		if quest_marker_fo_name ~= nil then
			if type_util.is_table(quest_marker_fo_name) then
				local quest_marker_fo = get_field_object(quest_marker_fo_name[self.cur_quest_marker_progress])
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, quest_marker_fo, true)
			else
				local quest_marker_fo = get_field_object(quest_marker_fo_name)
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, quest_marker_fo, true)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'interacting' then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, self.get_sohee_weapon_box()) and
				self.cur_progress == self.progress.sohee_join_party then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ghostbuster_found, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_step(item_pos, radius)
	local leader_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party.Leader.Bounds.center)
	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(item_pos - leader_pos).magnitude
	if diff < radius then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

--- 아이템 밟아서 간수 깸
function local_class:step_item()
	local stepped_item = nil
	while true do
		if not self.is_sneaking then
			return
		end

		if not self.is_sleeping_guard_awake then
			for i = 1, #self.sleep_items do
				local cur_item = self.sleep_items[i].drop_item
				local pos = cur_item.SpriteTransform.position
				local check = self:check_step(pos, 0.4)
				if check and not self.is_getting_key then
					local step_sfx = self.sleep_items[i].sfx
					if step_sfx ~= nil then
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(step_sfx)
					end

					stepped_item = cur_item
					break
				end
			end
		end

		if stepped_item ~= nil then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	if self.is_step_item_tutorial_played then
		self:item_shake(stepped_item, 0.03, 0.5)
		self:sleep_detect_reaction()
	else
		self:tutorial_sleep_detect_reaction(stepped_item)
	end

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	if not self.is_step_item_tutorial_played then
		self.is_step_item_tutorial_played = true
		self:enable_walk_interact_only()
		self:step_item()
	end
end

function local_class:tutorial_sleep_detect_reaction(item)
	local guard = self.get_sleeping_guard()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	self:item_shake(item, 0.03, 0.5)

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local cur_item = self.tutorial_sleep_items[i].drop_item
		cur_item.SpriteTransform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		cur_item.ShadowTransform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

	item.SpriteTransform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	item.ShadowTransform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	local cmap_to = vector_util.get_x0z(guard.Position)
	camera_util.move_async(cmap_to, 1)

	if guard.Position.x > leader.Position.x then
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	else

	end
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })

	if self.snoring_sfx ~= nil then
		self.snoring_sfx:Stop()
		self.snoring_sfx = nil
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(guard, 0.03, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.set_direction(guard, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.75)
	character_util.set_direction(guard, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.75)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(guard, nil, 'silence')

	character_util.set_direction(guard, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(guard, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(guard, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard, { key = 'ds_main_s5_49', skip = true })

	--(4) 간수 다시 잠자기 시작.
	character_util.set_anim(guard, { name = 'sleep' })
	character_util.set_emotion(guard, { name = 'sleep' })

	self.snoring_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_sleep_01', loop = true, parent = guard
	})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

function local_class:sleep_detect_reaction()
	local guard = self.get_sleeping_guard()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	self.is_sleeping_guard_awake = true
	self.is_sleep_talked = false

	if not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(vector_util.get_x0z(guard.Bounds.center), { bonus_distance = -1 }) then
		local cmap_to = vector_util.get_x0z((leader.Position + guard.Position) / 2)
		camera_util.move_async(cmap_to, 1)
	end

	character_util.look_at(leader, guard)
	if leader.Direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		if guard.Position.x > leader.Position.x then
			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		end
	end
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })

	if self.snoring_sfx ~= nil then
		self.snoring_sfx:Stop()
		self.snoring_sfx = nil
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(guard, 0.03, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard)
	character_util.look_at(guard, leader)

	character_util.show_emoticon(leader, nil, 'silence')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(guard, nil, 'silence')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(guard, { name = 'mad' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard, { key = 'ds_main_s5_48', skip = true,
														 bubble_type = 'shout', scale = 1.15 })

	-- 플레이어 일행 surprise, embarrassed
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(leader, true)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	local guard_orgin_pos = guard.Position

	if guard.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		character_util.set_anim(guard, { name = 'get' })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(guard, { name = 'prostrate' })
	end

	local move_speed = 4
	time_util.mod('attack', 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')

	local jump_to = leader.Bounds.center + vector(0, 1, 0)
	character_util.jump_move(guard, jump_to, move_speed, 2, false)

	local time = vector_util.get_x0z(guard.Position - leader.Position).magnitude / move_speed
	local speed_mult = 2
	local time_passed = 0

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if time_passed >= time * 0.25 then
			break
		end
		time_util.unmod('attack')
		time_util.mod('attack', (time_passed * speed_mult) + 0.3)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_01')

	time_util.unmod('attack')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard)

	character_util.stop(guard)
	character_util.cancel_jump(guard)
	character_util.set_position(guard, guard_orgin_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(guard, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(guard, { name = 'sleep' })
	character_util.set_emotion(guard, { name = 'sleep' })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	local reset_pos = self.get_sleeping_guard_reset_pos() + vector(1, 0, 0)
	party_util.align_party(reset_pos, 'left', 0)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.snoring_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_sleep_01', loop = true, parent = guard
	})

	self.is_sleeping_guard_awake = false
end

function local_class:enable_walk_interact_only()

	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash
			| CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton

function local_class:prisoner_talk()
	self.is_prisoner_talked = true
	local prisoner = self.get_prisoners(2)

--- 소히가 갇힌 감옥 문 상호작용 연출 함수
function local_class:interact_sohee_prison_door()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()

	if self.is_key_found then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		self.cur_progress = self.progress.sohee_join_party

		local prison_door = self.get_sohee_prison_door()

		self:open_prison_door_with_event(prison_door)

		-- 소히 (right, attack, nodx2) : 좋아. 고릴라 치곤 빠르게 찾아왔어!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(sohee, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s5_23', skip = true })

		-- 소히 (right, idle, release) : 가는 길에 내 마기톤도 찾아야하니까 서둘러 나가자고!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)
		character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s5_23_1', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(sohee)

		character_util.convert_to_party_member(sohee, user_party, true)

		--나레이션 메시지 출력.
		--소히가 파티에 합류하였습니다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_main_s5_23_2' })

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'destroy_shortcut_wreck_available' }))

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	else
		-- 감옥 열쇠를 가지고 와야 해! 간수들이 가지고 있을 거야.
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(sohee)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s5_24' })
	end
end

--- 캐릭터 빙글빙글 돌면서 날라가다 떨어지는 연출 함수
function local_class:character_spin_fall(character, duration, end_pos, height, rotate_count)
	local fx_pos = character.Bounds.center
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(character.Bounds.center)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.last_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(character.Bounds.center)

	local airspin_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_air_spin_01', loop = true, parent = character
	})

	character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_emotion(character, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_direction(character, 'right')
	character_util.hide_weapon(character, true)
	local is_final_anim_emo_applied = false

	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = character.Position
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
		character_util.set_position(character, cur_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0), true)

		local cur_rot = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 360 * rotate_count, progress)
		character_util.spine_rotate(character, cur_rot, 0)

		if not is_final_anim_emo_applied and progress > 0.8 then
			is_final_anim_emo_applied = true
			character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'prostrate' })
			character_util.set_emotion(character, { name = 'confused' })
			airspin_sfx:FadeOut(0.2)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

	fx_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(character.Bounds.center)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(fx_pos)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.last_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(fx_pos)

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(character)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(character, 0.7, 1.3, 1, 0.5)

	character_util.hide_weapon(character, false)
	character_util.spine_rotate(character, 0, 0)
end

function local_class:make_key()
	if self.prison_key_item ~= nil then
		self.prison_key_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.prison_key_item = nil
	end

	local prison_key_pos = self.get_key_pos()

		showoncharacter = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		sprscale = 0.5
	})
end

function local_class:item_shake(item, amplitude, duration)
	local pos_1 = item.SpriteTransform.position
	local pos_2 = item.ShadowTransform.position
	local time = 0
	while time < duration do
		local rand_1 = unity_class.random.Range(-amplitude, amplitude)
		local rand_2 = unity_class.random.Range(-amplitude, amplitude)

		item.SpriteTransform.position = pos_1 + vector(rand_1, 0, rand_2)
		item.ShadowTransform.position = pos_2 + vector(rand_1, 0, rand_2)

		time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	item.SpriteTransform.position = pos_1
	item.ShadowTransform.position = pos_2
end

return local_class

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_hold_up_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.KeyUsedEvent), 'on_key_used_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	-- 기본 퀘스트 마커 설정
	local quest_marker_fo_name = self.quest_marker_by_grid.room_3
	local quest_marker_fo = get_field_object(quest_marker_fo_name)
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, quest_marker_fo, true)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.KeyUsedEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	-- 동적할당 npc 제거
	if self.top_optimized_npcs_key_table ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.top_optimized_npcs_key_table)
		self.top_optimized_npcs_key_table = nil
	end

	if self.bot_optimized_npcs_key_table ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.bot_optimized_npcs_key_table)
		self.bot_optimized_npcs_key_table = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	if e.BattleGroupName == 'battle2' and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
		sp_util.play_battle_end_screenplay(self.event_battle_scene, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		local grid_name = e.CameraGrid.name
		local quest_marker_fo_name = self.quest_marker_by_grid[grid_name]
		if quest_marker_fo_name ~= nil then
			if type_util.is_table(quest_marker_fo_name) then
				local quest_marker_fo = get_field_object(quest_marker_fo_name[self.cur_quest_marker_progress])
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, quest_marker_fo, true)
			else
				local quest_marker_fo = get_field_object(quest_marker_fo_name)
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, quest_marker_fo, true)
			end
		elseif grid_name == self.room_4_name then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
			end))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Holder, user_party.Leader) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_key_door_key()) then
		self.cur_quest_marker_progress = self.quest_marker_progress.exit_4_stair_up
		local quest_marker_fo_name = self.quest_marker_by_grid.main_floor[self.cur_quest_marker_progress]
		local quest_marker_fo = get_field_object(quest_marker_fo_name)
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, quest_marker_fo, true)
	end
end

function local_class:on_key_used_event(e)
	if e.KeyName == 'fourth_floor_gate_key' then
		get_field_object('holdable_key_reset_switch').FieldObjectBehaviour.CanResetGimmick = false
	end
end

--- 동적할당 npc 생성과 초기 설정
function local_class:set_optimized_npc()
	-- 적은 위에 10, 아래에 10 들어온다.
	-- 적 생성 및 세팅
	local top_npcs_table = {}
	local bot_npcs_table = {}
	local enemy_name_key = 's6_battle_event_npcs_'
	for i = 1, self.enemy_num / 2 do
		local enemy_name = enemy_name_key .. i
		top_npcs_table[enemy_name] = 'ds_vampire_prisonofficer'
		bot_npcs_table[enemy_name] = 'ds_vampire_prisonofficer'
	end

	self.top_optimized_npcs_key_table = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async(top_npcs_table)
	self.bot_optimized_npcs_key_table = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async(bot_npcs_table)

	-- 관리하기 편하게 idx 테이블에 옮기기
	local cnt = 0
	for _, optimized_npc in pairs(self.top_optimized_npcs_key_table) do
		character_util.set_emotion(optimized_npc, 'attack')
		character_util.set_direction(optimized_npc, 'down')
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(optimized_npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		optimized_npc.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'monster_baton_sword')

		if cnt < self.enemy_num / 4 then
			table.insert(self.top_left_npcs, optimized_npc)
		else
			table.insert(self.top_right_npcs, optimized_npc)
		end
		table.insert(self.all_npcs, optimized_npc)
		cnt = cnt + 1
	end
	cnt = 0
	for _, optimized_npc in pairs(self.bot_optimized_npcs_key_table) do
		character_util.set_emotion(optimized_npc, 'attack')
		character_util.set_direction(optimized_npc, 'up')
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(optimized_npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		optimized_npc.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'monster_baton_sword')

		if cnt < self.enemy_num / 4 then
			table.insert(self.bot_left_npcs, optimized_npc)
		else
			table.insert(self.bot_right_npcs, optimized_npc)
		end
		table.insert(self.all_npcs, optimized_npc)
		cnt = cnt + 1
	end

	-- 초기 위치 설정
	-- 4분선을 기준으로
	-- top 1,2,3,4,5 는 -x,+y축
	-- top 6,7,8,9,19 은 +x,+y축
	-- bot 1,2,3,4,5 는 -x,-y축
	-- bot 6,7,8,9,10 은 -x,-y축
	local top_pivot = self.get_top_enter_end_pos()
	local bot_pivot = self.get_bot_enter_end_pos()
	local first_z_dist = 4
	local iter_num = self.enemy_num / 4
	local rad = math.rad(9)
	local x_gap = math.asin(rad * self.radius[1])

	local total_z_gap = (iter_num - 1) * 0.5
	for i = 1, iter_num do
		local z_gap = (i - 1) * 0.5

		local top_left_pos = top_pivot + vector(-x_gap, 0, total_z_gap + first_z_dist - z_gap)
		local top_left_npc = self.top_left_npcs[i]
		character_util.set_position(top_left_npc, top_left_pos)

		local top_right_pos = top_pivot + vector(x_gap, 0, total_z_gap + first_z_dist - z_gap)
		local top_right_npc = self.top_right_npcs[i]
		character_util.set_position(top_right_npc, top_right_pos)

		local bot_left_pos = bot_pivot + vector(-x_gap, 0, z_gap - first_z_dist)
		local bot_left_npc = self.bot_left_npcs[i]
		character_util.set_position(bot_left_npc, bot_left_pos)

		local bot_right_pos = bot_pivot + vector(x_gap, 0, z_gap - first_z_dist)
		local bot_right_npc = self.bot_right_npcs[i]
		character_util.set_position(bot_right_npc, bot_right_pos)
	end
end

-- 원의 둘래를 좌표로 등록
function local_class:set_wp()
	local radius = self.radius
	local angle_between = (360 / self.enemy_num)
	local center_point = self.get_event_battle_center_pos()
	local iter_num = self.enemy_num / 4
	local start_angle_gap = angle_between / 2

	local top_left = {
		start_angle = 90 + start_angle_gap,
		end_angle = 180,
		angle_between = angle_between
	}
	local top_right = {
		start_angle = 90 - start_angle_gap,
		end_angle = 0,
		angle_between = -angle_between
	}
	local bot_left = {
		start_angle= 270 - start_angle_gap,
		end_angle = 180,
		angle_between = -angle_between
	}
	local bot_right = {
		start_angle = 270 + start_angle_gap,
		end_angle = 360,
		angle_between = angle_between
	}

	for i = 1, iter_num do
		-- 원의 둘래로 경로 지정
		local top_left_angle = top_left.start_angle + (top_left.angle_between * (i - 1))
		local top_right_angle = top_right.start_angle + (top_right.angle_between * (i - 1))
		local bot_left_angle = bot_left.start_angle + (bot_left.angle_between * (i - 1))
		local bot_right_angle = bot_right.start_angle + (bot_right.angle_between * (i - 1))

		-- 원의 반지름으로 포위망 좁히는 경로 지정
		local tl_wp = {}
		local tr_wp = {}
		local bl_wp = {}
		local br_wp = {}
		for j = 1, #radius do
			local top_left_approach_pos = self:get_coordinates(center_point, top_left_angle, radius[j])
			table.insert(tl_wp, top_left_approach_pos)

			local top_right_approach_pos = self:get_coordinates(center_point, top_right_angle, radius[j])
			table.insert(tr_wp, top_right_approach_pos)

			local bot_left_approach_pos = self:get_coordinates(center_point, bot_left_angle, radius[j])
			table.insert(bl_wp, bot_left_approach_pos)

			local bot_right_approach_pos = self:get_coordinates(center_point, bot_right_angle, radius[j])
			table.insert(br_wp, bot_right_approach_pos)
		end
		table.insert(self.top_left_approach_wp, tl_wp)
		table.insert(self.top_right_approach_wp, tr_wp)
		table.insert(self.bot_left_approach_wp, bl_wp)
		table.insert(self.bot_right_approach_wp, br_wp)
	end
end

function local_class:approach_to_center(speed, move_to_idx, anim, next_anim)
	local distance = self.radius[move_to_idx - 1] - self.radius[move_to_idx]
	local duration = distance / speed

	local iter_num = self.enemy_num / 4
	for i = 1, iter_num do
		character_util.set_anim(self.top_left_npcs[i], { name = anim })
		character_util.set_anim(self.top_right_npcs[i], { name = anim })
		character_util.set_anim(self.bot_left_npcs[i], { name = anim })
		character_util.set_anim(self.bot_right_npcs[i], { name = anim })

		character_util.move_to(self.top_left_npcs[i], self.top_left_approach_wp[i][move_to_idx],
				duration, nil, true, false)
		character_util.move_to(self.top_right_npcs[i], self.top_right_approach_wp[i][move_to_idx],
				duration, nil, true, false)
		character_util.move_to(self.bot_left_npcs[i], self.bot_left_approach_wp[i][move_to_idx],
				duration, nil, true, false)
		character_util.move_to(self.bot_right_npcs[i], self.bot_right_approach_wp[i][move_to_idx],
				duration, nil, true, false)
	end
	wait_for_sec(duration)

	for i = 1, #self.all_npcs do
		local npc = self.all_npcs[i]
		if next_anim ~= nil then
			if type_util.is_table(next_anim) then
				character_util.set_anim(npc, next_anim)
			else
				character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = next_anim })
			end
		else
			character_util.remove_anim(npc)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		self.get_fx_landslide_brown_small()
		self.get_fx_ghost_buster_magiton()
		self.get_fx_smokescreen()
		self.get_fx_dead()
		self.get_fx_hit()
		self.get_fx_last_hit()
		self.get_fx_jump_smoke()
		self.get_fx_obj_smoke()

		yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	-- 백작의 딸 위치로 보내고 알파값 어둡게
	local daughter = self.controller.get_count_daughter()
	character_util.set_active_state(daughter, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(daughter, field:GetMarker('s7_daughter_pos').position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 2)
	character_util.set_direction(daughter, 'down')
	daughter.SpineController:AddColor(daughter.Name, unity_color({ 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 1 }), 1, 0)
	character_util.shake(daughter, 0.02, 9999)

	-- 이벤트 진행을 위해 ExitInteractable -> PublishInteractable
	self:changed_exit_interact_fo()

	for i = 1, self.rock_fo_count do
		local rock_fo = get_field_object('s7_directing_rock_' .. i)
		rock_fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		rock_fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	-- 수용소 탈출 중에 떨어질 3포인트 위치 캐싱
	self.directing_fall_rock_point_list = {}
	local fall_rock_point = 3
	for i = 1, fall_rock_point do
		local pos = field:GetMarker('s7_directing_fall_rock_' .. i).position
		table.insert(self.directing_fall_rock_point_list, pos)
	end

	-- 상호작용 가능하도록
	local door_lock = self.get_door_lock()
	door_lock.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	-- 최초 마커 세팅
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, daughter, true)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	if self.damage_event_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.damage_event_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
		self.damage_event_handler = nil
	end

	-- 사이렌 연출 비활성화
	self.is_siren_directing = false

	-- 소히가 문 공격중이면 루틴 빠져나오도록 true로
	self.is_destroy_door_lock = true

	self.directing_fall_rock_point_list = nil

	self:dispose_ghost_buster_laser()

	self:dispose_optimized_npc_list()

	self:dispose_bomb_range()

	self:dispose_amb_sfx(0)
	self:dispose_siren_sfx(0)

	self.is_play_escape_camp = false
	self:restore_exit_interact_fo()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.top_floor_camp_zone)
			and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		-- 프리실라 조우 이벤트
		self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.show_daughter
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.top_floor_camp_event, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.top_floor_leave_zone)
			and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.show_daughter then
		-- 소히가 문 부시고 있을 때 떠나려고 하면
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.leave_top_floor, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's7_directing_fall_rock_zone')
			and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.escape_camp
			and not self.is_show_directing_fall_rock then
		-- 탈출 도중에 돌 떨어지는 연출
		self.is_show_directing_fall_rock = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fall_rock_event
		, self))
	end

	if self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.escape_camp then
		for i = 1, self.blocking_rock_count do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.fall_down_zone_name .. i)
					and self.is_escape_camp_fall_down_event[i] == false then
				-- 돌 낙하
				self.is_escape_camp_fall_down_event[i] = true
				local rock_fo = get_field_object('s7_rock_' .. i)
				local pos = field:GetMarker('s7_fall_down_' .. i).position
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.directing_fall_rock
				, self, rock_fo, pos))

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local door_lock = self.get_door_lock()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, door_lock)
			and self.cur_progress <= self.section_progress.show_daughter then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_prison_door_event, self, door_lock)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.get_count_daughter())
			and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.open_prison_door then
		-- 최상층 감옥 문 열고 딸과 상호작용
		self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.escape_camp
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_daughter, self)
		return true
	end

	-- exit 상호작용
	for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.exit_interact_fo[i]) then
			if self.exit_interact_fo[i] == self.get_exit_interact_fo()
					and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.escape_camp then
				self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.ending
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.section_ending, self))
			else
				self:teleport_party_for_marker_routine(i)
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.cur_progress ~= self.section_progress.show_daughter then
		return false
	end

	-- 이미 데미지 이벤트를 보았다면 확인 할 필요 없음
	if self.is_takes_damage then
		return false
	end

	local top_floor_door = self.get_door_lock()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, top_floor_door) then
		self.is_takes_damage = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

-- 소히 연출 루프
function local_class:directing_sohee_buster()
	local sohee = self.controller.get_sohee()
	local door_lock = self.get_door_lock()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local top_floor_door = self.get_top_floor_door()

	-- 소히 말하면서 버스터 연출 시작
	local delay = 6
	local is_first_speech = false
	local is_show_takes_damage_event = false
	self.cur_sohee_directing_time = delay - 2

	-- 버스터 연출
	local is_buster = false
	local buster_time = 0
	local buster_disabled_time = 3

	-- 하단 대사 3초 딜레이로 번갈아가며 출력
	while not self.is_destroy_door_lock do
		-- 키패드 비활성화 됐을 때 루틴 종료
		if door_lock.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
			self.is_destroy_door_lock = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.destroy_door_lock, self)
			break
		end

		if self.is_takes_damage and not is_show_takes_damage_event then
			is_show_takes_damage_event = true

			-- 강제 이벤트 재생
			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(sohee)
			wait_for_sec(0.25)

			-- 마기톤 버스터 초기화
			top_floor_door:CancelShake()
			self:dispose_ghost_buster_laser()
			is_buster = false
			buster_time = 0

			-- 이벤트 끝나고 2초뒤에 자동 이벤트 재생하도록
			self.cur_sohee_directing_time = delay - 2

			-- 소히와 기사 마주보며 카메라가 이동
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			character_util.look_at(leader, sohee)
			character_util.look_at(sohee, leader)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
			character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'mad' })
			camera_util.move_async(sohee.Position, 1)

			-- 소히 (mad, release) : 지금 뭐하는 거야!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 24, skip = true })
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
			character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'up')

			camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

			party_util.reset_controllers()
			field_ui_manager:Show()
		end

		-- pause 상태가 아닐 때
		if not self.is_pause_sohee_directing then
			-- 버스터 활성화 되어있으면 buster_disabled_time초 뒤에 비활성화
			if is_buster then
				buster_time = buster_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				if buster_time > buster_disabled_time then
					self:dispose_ghost_buster_laser()
					character_util.remove_anim(sohee)
				end
			end

			-- 텍스트 출력 딜레이
			if self.cur_sohee_directing_time > delay then
				self.cur_sohee_directing_time = 0
				-- 소히: 물리학적으로 이런 문쯤은…! /  소히: 3초 안에 원자 단위로…!
				-- 연출 중일 때는 대사는 출력되지 않는다.
				local index = is_first_speech and 20 or 21
				if not lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
						CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) then
					local sfx_name = is_first_speech and '03_dialogue_tipsy_01' or '03_dialogue_emphasize_01'
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = sfx_name, loop = false, play_pos = sohee.Position })
					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. index })
					wait_for_sec(0.05)
				end
				is_first_speech = is_first_speech == false

				-- 버스터 연출 시작
				is_buster = true
				buster_time = 0
				top_floor_door:Shake(0.02, 3)
				character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'rifle_shoot2' })

				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hyper_laser_01', loop = false, parent = sohee })
				self:dispose_ghost_buster_laser()
				self.ghost_buster_laser = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.Instantiate(self.get_fx_ghost_buster_magiton(),
						sohee.Bounds.center, direction_util.to_vector3(sohee.Direction))
			end
			self.cur_sohee_directing_time = self.cur_sohee_directing_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 소히가 감옥문을 부수려고 시도할 때 떠날려고 하면
function local_class:leave_top_floor()
	self.is_pause_sohee_directing = true
	--  소히 : [shout] 얘를 구해야지 어딜 가는 거야!
	local sohee = self.controller.get_sohee()
	if self.ghost_buster_laser == nil then
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'mad' })
		character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'down')
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 22, bubble_type = 'shout'
	, skip = true })

	-- 위로 돌아감
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	character_util.move_to_async(leader, leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward,
			nil, 2, true, true)

	if self.ghost_buster_laser == nil then
		character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)
		character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'up')
		self.cur_sohee_directing_time = 3
	end

	self.is_pause_sohee_directing = false
end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(sohee)

	-- 소히에게 카메라 패닝
	camera_util.move_async(sohee.Position, 1)

	-- 소히 버스터 쏘고 있을 수도 있으니 지워줌
	self:dispose_ghost_buster_laser()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

	--기사가 소히 왼쪽에 있는지?
	local is_left = leader.Position.x < sohee.Position.x

	-- 소히 right, attack, 점프 1회 : 뭐 하는 거야! 그걸 부순다고 이 문이 열릴 리가…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, is_left and 'left' or 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.normal_jump(sohee, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 25, skip = true })

	-- 카메라 쉐이크 강도(0.2) 시간(1) 쉐이크 끝나고 감옥문이 열리기 시작할 때 소히 바로 up
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 도어 열림
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')
	top_floor_door.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	local animator = top_floor_door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Play('on', -1)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 감옥문이 열리기 시작할 때 소히 바로 up

	-- 소히 (up) emoticon_bubble_silence
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(sohee)
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(sohee, nil, 'silence')

	-- 가디언 소히 아래로 정렬하여 up
	local target_add_pos = is_left and unity_class.vector3.left or unity_class.vector3.right
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, sohee.Position + target_add_pos
	, 2.5, false, nil, nil, is_left and 'right' or 'left', false)
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, is_left and 'left' or 'right')

	-- 선택지
	-- 1) 기다리기 지루해서 직접 해결했다. (초록색) / 2) 이제 누가 고릴라지? (붉은색)
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. 27, 'mercy' }
	, { self.string_key .. 28, 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 가디언 left, idle, release 2회
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		-- 소히 (down ,attack, 점프 1회) : 곧 부서질 문이었어!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.normal_jump(sohee, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '28_1', skip = true })
	else

		leader:HideWeapon(true)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'bomb_idle', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
		message_system:SendSync(leader.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		-- 소히 (side, mad, 점프 1회) : [shout] 뭐어?!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'mad' })
		character_util.normal_jump(sohee, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '28_2'
		, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
	end

	-- 소히 (side, attack, release) : 정확히 2.78초만 더 있었으면 내가 문을 열었을 거라고!!
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' },
			{ name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '28_3', skip = true })

	-- 소히 (up) : …애초에 네가 이 문을 연 게 아니라…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'up')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '28_4', skip = true })

	-- 소히 (side, idle, cross_arm) : 내가 가한 에너지 덕분에 분자 진동의 파장이 중첩되면서…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, is_left and 'left' or 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '28_5', skip = true })

	-- 소히 (sidle, idle, release): 문이 열리기 쉬운 상태로 상변환을…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '28_6', skip = true })

	-- 가디언 side, tired, idle emoticon_bubble_silence
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })

	-- 소히 (up) : 아, 아무튼 쓸데없는 말은 그만하고 들어가자!
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'up')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '28_7', skip = true })
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

	-- 소히 파티 합류
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(sohee, user_party, true)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	-- 카메라 기사에게
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- 백작의 딸에게 상호작용 가능하도록
	self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.open_prison_door
	character_util.add_listener(daughter, self.controller)
end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '59_3', skip = true })

	-- 소히(right, attack, idle) : 여기서 천천히 얘기를 나눌 때가 아닌 거 같네.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 60, skip = true })

	-- 소히 (down, attack, idle) : 여기가 완전히 무너지기 전에 어서 빠져나가자고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.exit_interact_fo[1])

	-- 리더 무적으로
	character_util.set_immortal(leader, true)

	-- 주변에 갈곳은 다 막아둔다.
	local wall_invisible_count = 4
	for i = 1, wall_invisible_count do

		local pos = field:GetMarker('s7_wall_point_' .. i).position
		wall.Position = pos

	for i = 1, guard_count do
		local guard = get_character('blocking_guard_' .. i)
		character_util.set_active_state(guard, 'disabled')

	-- 원라인 npc들 비활성화
	local npc_first_name = 'oneline_event_7_npc_'

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')

	npc_first_name = 'oneline_npc_'

	local prisoner_count = 3
	for i = 1, prisoner_count do
