		character_util.add_color(prisoner, 'dark_tint', unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
		prisoner.Interactable.Talk = nil
	end

	-- 수용소 루틴 시작
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.camp_escape_routine, self))

	, 1, false, nil, nil, 'left')

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(daughter, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'smile' })

	-- 1초 후 백작 right 보면 꼬마실라 smile 점프 2회

	character_util.normal_jump(daughter, true)

	-- 버블 끝나고 아래에서 뱀파이어 로얄가드가 달려와 표시한 곳에 정렬

	character_util.remove_emotion(daughter)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

	-- 아이리스 left, smile, sing 1초 후

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 꼬마실라 right, smile, 점프 2회 후 아이리스 좌측으로 1칸 run

		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(daughter, daughter.Position + unity_class.vector3.right
	, 2.5, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)

	-- 꼬마실라 정렬 후 꼬마실라는 우측으로 약간 이동하여 right, smile, push
	character_util.remove_anim(daughter)
	character_util.move_waypoint(daughter, daughter.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.2
	, 1, false, nil, nil, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim(iris)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(iris, iris.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.2
	, 1, false, nil, nil, 'left')

	-- 아이리스는 좌측으로 약간 이동하여 left, smile, push
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.set_anim(daughter, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_anim(iris, { name = 'push' })

	-- 프리실라 : 항상 따뜻했고… 자상했고…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. '45_2'
	, skip = true, screen_pos = bubble_pos, bubble_direction = 'ct' })

	-- 프리실라 : 그리고 누구에게나 친절했기에 데몬샤이어의 주민들은 어머니를 무척 좋아했어요…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. '45_3'
	, skip = true, screen_pos = bubble_pos, bubble_direction = 'ct' })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 화면 페이드 하지 않고 한번에 암전(1프레임 전환)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 틴트 제거
	self.controller:remove_reminiscent_tint({ daughter, iris, count, royal_guard })

	-- 검은 화면 중앙에 아래 말풍선 출력
	camera_util.move_async(vector(3000, 0, 0), 0.1)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 프리실라 : 그게 독이 됐죠.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. '45_4'
	, skip = true, screen_pos = bubble_pos, bubble_direction = 'ct' })

	-- 동적 할당 제거
	self:dispose_optimized_npc_list()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

-- 동적 생성한 과거 회상용 npc 제거
function local_class:dispose_optimized_npc_list()
	if self.optimized_npc_list then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npc_list)
		self.optimized_npc_list = nil
	end
end

-- 수용소 탈출 타임어택 루틴
function local_class:camp_escape_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local daughter = self.controller.get_count_daughter()
	local sohee = self.controller.get_sohee()

	-- 해당 시간 마다 화면이 흔들리며 필요하면 돌 떨어지는 연출도 추가
	-- 최초에 바로 쉐이킹 될 수 있도록 같은 값으로 세팅
	local shake_time = 5
	local cur_shake_time = 0

	-- 어택레인지 세팅
	self.bomb_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector(999, 0, 999) + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.05, self.bomb_radius)
	self.bomb_range:Show(0)

	-- 타이머 시작
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	timer_util.start_timer(
			{ duration = self.escape_camp_time_limit, handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished' })

	-- 일정 시간 마다 화면 흔들어주는 함수
	local shake_screen = function(delta_time)
		cur_shake_time = cur_shake_time + delta_time
		if cur_shake_time >= shake_time then
			cur_shake_time = 0
			-- 낙석 이팩트 출력
			camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.75)
			self:random_earthquake()
		end
	end

	--region
	-- 돌에 눌렸는지?
	local is_pressed_on_stone = false

	-- 현재 낙석 체크 시간
	local cur_rock_fall_time = 0

	-- 낙석이 떨어지는 시간
	local rock_fall_time = 2

	-- 낙석 데미지 체킹 범위
	local rock_damage_range = 1.75

	-- 낙석 상태
	local rock_fall_state = { none = 1, targeting = 2, fall = 3, waiting = 4, }
	local cur_rock_fall_state = rock_fall_state.none

	-- 낙석이 떨어질 위치
	local rock_fall_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local rock_start_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local rock_end_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local rock_fo = nil
	local damage_rate = 0.26
	local fall_duration = 0.3
	--endregion

	-- 어택레인지가 출력되고 특정 시간 뒤에 해당 부분으로 돌이 떨어진다.
	local rockfall_routine = function(delta_time)
		if cur_rock_fall_state == rock_fall_state.none then
			-- 리더 주변 4x4 사이에 낙석 떨어지는 어택 레인지 표시
			local pos = user_party.Leader.Position
					+ vector(unity_class.random.Range(-2, 2), 0.01, unity_class.random.Range(-2, 2))

			-- 떨어질 수 없는 곳이라면 기사 아래로 바로 직행
			local invalid_land = not field:IsThereFloorAt(pos)
			if invalid_land then
				-- floor가 아니면 리더 자리에
				pos = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0.01, 0)
			end

			-- 어택 레인지 활성화
			--TODO: 떨어지는 돌에 맞춰 보정수치 바꿔야할지도?
			rock_fall_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(pos)
			self.bomb_range.transform.position = pos
			self.bomb_range.gameObject:SetActive(true)

			cur_rock_fall_state = rock_fall_state.targeting
		elseif cur_rock_fall_state == rock_fall_state.targeting then
			cur_rock_fall_time = cur_rock_fall_time + delta_time
			-- rock_fall_time 초 뒤에 해당 위치에 낙석
			if cur_rock_fall_time > rock_fall_time then
				cur_rock_fall_time = 0
				cur_rock_fall_state = rock_fall_state.fall
				self.bomb_range.gameObject:SetActive(false)

				rock_fo = self:get_de_active_rock_fo()
				rock_start_pos = rock_fall_pos + vector(-0.5, 10, -0.5)
				rock_end_pos = rock_fall_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5)

				rock_fo.Position = rock_start_pos
				rock_fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			end
		elseif cur_rock_fall_state == rock_fall_state.fall then
			cur_rock_fall_time = cur_rock_fall_time + delta_time
			-- rock_fall_time 초 뒤에 해당 위치에 낙석
			if cur_rock_fall_time > fall_duration then
				-- 떨어진 곳에 연기 이팩트 추가
				cur_rock_fall_time = 0
				cur_rock_fall_state = rock_fall_state.waiting
				rock_fo.Position = rock_end_pos
				self.get_fx_smokescreen():Instantiate(rock_fall_pos)
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_rock_break_02', loop = false, play_pos = rock_end_pos })
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_lina_lb_explosion_01', loop = false, play_pos = rock_end_pos })

				-- 리더가 CharacterControllerScreenplayState가 아니면서 일정 거리 안에 있으면 데미지를 준다.
				local dis = (leader.Position - rock_fall_pos).magnitude
				if dis <= rock_damage_range
						and not lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
						CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) then
					-- 데미지를 주고 일정 DamageEvent에서 체크
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
					damage_info.sender = rock_fo
					damage_info.target = leader
					damage_info.damage = math.floor(leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * damage_rate)
					damage_info.notMortal = true
					damage_info.noCritical = true

					command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
				end
			else
				-- 돌 떨어진다.
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(10, 0, cur_rock_fall_time / fall_duration)
				rock_fo.Position = vector(rock_start_pos.x, progress, rock_start_pos.z)
			end
		else
			cur_rock_fall_time = cur_rock_fall_time + delta_time
			if cur_rock_fall_time > 0.15 then
				cur_rock_fall_time = 0
				cur_rock_fall_state = rock_fall_state.none

				rock_fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				rock_fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			end
		end
	end

	-- 탈출 실패 함수
	local fail_escape_camp = function()
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

		-- 타이머 종료
		self:timer_finished()

		-- 사이렌 틴트 딜레이 2초로 변경
		self.siren_tint_delay = 2

		-- 떨어지고 있는게 있을 수도 있으니 먼저 disabled
		if rock_fo ~= nil then
			rock_fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			rock_fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end

		if is_pressed_on_stone then
			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				if user_party[i].Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up
						or user_party[i].Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
					character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'left')
				end
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i],
						{ name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' }
				, { name = 'damaged' })
			end
			wait_for_sec(2)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
		else
			camera_util.shake(0.3, 3)

			-- 낙석 이팩트 추가
			self:random_earthquake()

			-- 파티원들 놀라며
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'embarrassed' }
				, { name = 'scared' })
			end
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
		self:dispose_siren_sfx(0)

		-- fade out
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 어택 레인지 비활성화
		self.bomb_range.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		-- 돌 상태 초기화
		cur_rock_fall_time = 0
		cur_rock_fall_state = rock_fall_state.none

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = leader
		heal_info.target = leader
		heal_info.heal = leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

		is_pressed_on_stone = false

		-- 돌 초기화
		self.is_escape_camp_fall_down_event = { false, false }
		local rock_count = 2
		for i = 1, rock_count do
			local blocking_rock = get_field_object('s7_rock_' .. i)
			blocking_rock.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end

		for i = 1, self.rock_fo_count do
			local rock_object = get_field_object('s7_directing_rock_' .. i)
			rock_object.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			rock_object.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
		-- 기사, 소히, 백작의 딸 원래 자리로 이동
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.set_position(leader, vector(31, 0, -214.5))
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
		character_util.set_position(sohee, vector(31, 0, -215.5))
		character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(daughter)
		character_util.set_emotion(daughter, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.set_position(daughter, vector(31.5, 0, -215))
		character_util.set_direction(daughter, 'right')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		self.siren_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_siren_oneshot_02'
		, loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })

		-- 소히 (down, attack, idle) : 여기가 완전히 무너지기 전에 어서 빠져나가자고!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '60_1', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(daughter)

		-- 마커 최상층 탈출구로
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.exit_interact_fo[1])

		-- 타이머 다시 세팅
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
		timer_util.start_timer(
				{ duration = self.escape_camp_time_limit, handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished' })

		self.is_show_directing_fall_rock = false

		-- 사이렌 딜레이 다시 1초로
		self.siren_tint_delay = 1

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end

	self.damage_event_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, leader)
					and e.HpBefore - e.Info:GetTotalDamage() <= 1 then
				is_pressed_on_stone = true
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}
	message_system:Subscribe(self.damage_event_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'callback')

	local time_passed = 0
	self.is_play_escape_camp = true
	while self.is_play_escape_camp do
		local delta_time = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 화면 흔들림 연출
		shake_screen(delta_time)

		-- 낙석 연출
		rockfall_routine(delta_time)

		-- 시간이 다 지났을 경우
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if time_passed > self.escape_camp_time_limit
				or is_pressed_on_stone then
			cur_shake_time = 0
			time_passed = 0

			-- 게임오버 연출 및 캐릭터들을 특정 좌표로 이동
			fail_escape_camp()
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.damage_event_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	self:dispose_bomb_range()

	-- 타이머 종료
	self:timer_finished()
end

-- 탈출 도중에 돌이 떨어지는 연출
function local_class:fall_rock_event()
	-- 초록 트리거 존 진입 시 붉은 1,2,3 번 자리에 순서대로 잔해가 떨어짐.
	-- 1번 0.3초 후 2번 0.5초 후 3번
	local wait_time = { 0.3, 0.5, 0 }
	for i = 1, #self.directing_fall_rock_point_list do
		local fall_rock = self:get_de_active_rock_fo()
		self:directing_fall_rock(fall_rock, self.directing_fall_rock_point_list[i])
		wait_for_sec(wait_time[i])
	end
end

-- 사이렌 틴트
function local_class:directing_siren_tint()
	local fade_out = 0.5
	local fade_in = 0.5

	self.is_siren_directing = true
	while self.is_siren_directing do
		field:Tint('siren', unity_color({ 0.6, 0, 0, 1 }), fade_out)
		wait_for_sec(fade_out)

		field:RemoveTint('siren', fade_in)
		wait_for_sec(fade_in)

		wait_for_sec(self.siren_tint_delay)
	end
end

-- 낙석 이팩트 랜덤하게 5개 뿌려주는 함수
function local_class:random_earthquake()
	-- 낙석 sfx
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_02', type_priority = 'event'
	, player_priority = 'object', loop = false })

	-- 낙석 이팩트 4개 출력
	local earthquake_count = 4
	for _ = 1, earthquake_count do
		local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(-5, 5)
		local rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(-3, 3)
		local cur_rock = self.get_fx_landslide_brown_small():Instantiate(
				stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z),
				unity_class.quaternion.identity,
				stage_camera.transform)
		cur_rock.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8
	end
end

-- 돌이 떨어지는 연출
function local_class:directing_fall_rock(rock_fo, target_pos)
	-- 돌이 아래로 떨어지고 모래 연기 연출
	local fall_duration = 0.2

	local height = 10
	local start_pos = target_pos + vector(0, height, 0)
	local end_pos = target_pos
	local time_passed = 0

	if rock_fo == nil then
		rock_fo = self:get_de_active_rock_fo()
	end

	rock_fo.Position = start_pos
	rock_fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	while time_passed <= fall_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(height, 0, time_passed / fall_duration)
		rock_fo.Position = vector(start_pos.x, progress, start_pos.z)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 떨어진 곳에 연기 이팩트 추가
	rock_fo.Position = end_pos
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.5)
	self.get_fx_smokescreen():Instantiate(target_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5))

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_rock_break_02', loop = false, play_pos = end_pos })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_lina_lb_explosion_01', loop = false, play_pos = end_pos })

	-- 낙석 disable
	wait_for_sec(0.15)
	rock_fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:get_de_active_rock_fo()
	for i = 1, self.rock_fo_count do
		local rock_fo = get_field_object('s7_directing_rock_' .. i)
		if rock_fo.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
			return rock_fo
		end
	end

	return get_field_object('s7_directing_rock_' .. 1)
end

-- 수용소 탈출 연출
function local_class:section_ending()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 타이머를 멈추기 위해 false
	self.is_play_escape_camp = false

	-- 사이렌 틴트 연출 멈춤
	self.is_siren_directing = false
	self:dispose_siren_sfx(0)

	-- 연출용 npc 캐싱
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local daughter = self.controller.get_count_daughter()
	local sohee = self.controller.get_sohee()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out_circular(0.6, 'ease_in_out_sine')
	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 리더 체력 풀피로
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = leader
	heal_info.target = leader
	heal_info.heal = leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.skipEffect = true
	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

	-- 리더 무적 해제
	character_util.set_immortal(leader, false)

	-- 파티원 세팅
	local marker = field:GetMarker('camp_outer')
	local emotion_list = { 'surprise', 'attack', 'scared' }
	local pos_list = { marker.position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 1.5, marker.position + vector(0.5, 0, 2)
	, marker.position + vector(-0.5, 0, 2) }
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'down')
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], pos_list[i + 1])
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'run', scale = 1.25 }
		, { name = emotion_list[i + 1] })
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(user_party[i], 0, 0)
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

-- ExitInteractable의 Interactable를 원복하는 함수
function local_class:restore_exit_interact_fo()
	if self.exit_interact_fo == nil then
		return
	end

	-- ExitInteractable -> ExitInteractable로 원복
	for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
		local exit_fo = self.exit_interact_fo[i]
		exit_fo.Interactable = self.cached_exit[i]
	end

	self.exit_interact_fo = nil
	self.marker_fo_list = nil
	self.cached_exit = nil
end

-- ExitInteractable를 제어하기 위해 PublishInteractable로 변경하는 함수
function local_class:changed_exit_interact_fo()
	self.cached_exit = {}
	self.exit_interact_fo = {}

	local exit_names = { 'exit_4_stair_down', 'exit_4_stair_up', 'camp_inner'
	, 'camp_outer', 'underpass_inner_1', 'underpass_outer_1', 'exit_3_stair_down'
	, 'exit_3_stair_up' }

	, 'camp_outer', 'underpass_inner_1', 'underpass_outer_1', 'stair_down_exit_3_outer'
	, 'stair_up_exit_3_outer' }

	for i = 1, #exit_names do
		local exit_fo = get_field_object(exit_names[i])
		table.insert(self.cached_exit, exit_fo.Interactable)
		exit_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		table.insert(self.exit_interact_fo, exit_fo)

	self.pyramid_outer_zone_name = 's8_pyramid_outer_zone'
	self.courier_event_zone_name = 's8_courier_event_'
	self.cargo_elevator_zone = 's8_enter_cargo_elevator_zone'
	self.elevator_zone = 's8_enter_elevator_zone'
	self.leaving_cargo_elevator_zone = 's8_leaving_cargo_elevator_zone'

	self.sun_effect = nil

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		self.fx_last_hit()
		self.get_fx_hit()
		self.get_fx_ghost_buster_magiton()
		self.get_fx_ch14_count_barrier()
		self.get_sun_effect()

		screen_util.preload_boss_title()

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

		yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

		-- 이벤트 진행을 위해 ExitInteractable -> PublishInteractable
		self:changed_exit_interact_fo()

		-- 지하도 출구에 있는npc들 Talk nil처리
		local npc_count = 2
		for i = 1, npc_count do
			local npc = get_character('pyramid_1_' .. i)
			npc.Interactable.Talk = nil
		end

		-- 피라미드 입구 히트박스 늘려줌
		local exit_fo = get_field_object('pyramid_inner_1')
		exit_fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(4, 1, 1))
	elseif stage.Name == self.before_stage_name then
		-- 이전 스테이지일 경우
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

		-- 스테이지 출구를 알려주기 위해  ExitInteractable -> PublishInteractable
		self:changed_exit_interact_fo()

		-- 8섹션일 때에는 수용소에 진입 못하도록
		local inner_camp_fo = get_field_object('camp_inner')
		inner_camp_fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

		-- 수용소 입구 건물 무너져있도록
		local city_guardpost = self.get_city_guardpost()
		local on_object = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(city_guardpost.Transform, 'on')
		on_object.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		local off_object = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(city_guardpost.Transform, 'off')
		off_object.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		-- 최초 마커 세팅
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.exit_interact_fo[1], true)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		-- 섹션8일 때 1_3 스테이지 입장
		for i = 1, self.courier_count do
			local courier = self.get_courier(i)
			character_util.set_active_state(courier, 'enabled')
		end

		-- 택배 상자 세팅
		-- 우측 세팅
		local box_count = 3
		local box_pos = field:GetMarker('courier_box_pos_1').position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 2
		for i = 1, box_count do
			local courier_box = self.get_courier_box(i)
			courier_box.Position = box_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * i
		end

		-- 좌측
		box_count = 6
		box_pos = field:GetMarker('courier_box_pos_2').position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 2
		for i = 4, box_count do
			local courier_box = self.get_courier_box(i)
			courier_box.Position = box_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * (i - 3)
		end

		-- 8섹션 중에는 엘레베이터 타고 옥상에서 내려올 수 없도록
		local elevator_exit = get_field_object('elevator_inner_1')
		local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()
		narration_interactable.StringKeys = { 'ds_main_s8_interact_2' }
		elevator_exit.Interactable = narration_interactable

		local oneline_npc_count = 2
		for i = 1, oneline_npc_count do
			local npc = self.get_oneline_npc(i)
			character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
		end

		-- 엘레베이터 애니메이션 캐싱
		self.elevator_animator_list = {}
		local elevator_anim_count = 10
		for i = 1, elevator_anim_count do
			local cargo_elevator = get_field_object('cargo_elevator_obj_' .. i)
			local animator = cargo_elevator:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
			table.insert(self.elevator_animator_list, animator)
		end

		self.sun_default_pos = vector(-140.5, 0, -16)

		local cur_save_point = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.controller.save_point_key)
		if cur_save_point == 1 then
			-- 로얄가드들만 잡았을 경우 세이브 지점1
			self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.battle_guard
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.eliminated_guard, self)
		elseif cur_save_point == 2 then
			-- 발렌시아까지 잡았을 경우 세이브 지점2
			self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.battle_guard
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.eliminated_captain, self)
		else
			-- 최초 마커 세팅
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.exit_interact_fo[1], true)
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.before_stage_name then
		-- 섹션8일 때 1_2 스테이지 입장
		-- 스테이지 컨트롤러에서 수용소 exit들을 InField 처리를 해주고 있어서 start에서 다시 disabled 처리
		local inner_camp_fo = get_field_object('camp_inner')
		inner_camp_fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

		self.is_siren_directing = true

		if self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.battle_guard then
			message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
		end

		-- 터치 이벤트 구독중이면 해지
		if self.touch_handler then
			message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
			self.touch_handler = nil
		end

		-- 인공 태양 dispose
		self.sun_default_pos = nil
		self:dispose_sun_effect()

		-- 동적 생성한 npc 남아있으면 dispose
		self:dispose_optimized_npc()

		-- 소히 마기톤 버스터 이팩트가 있다면 dispose
		if self.fx_sohee_laser_effect then
			self.fx_sohee_laser_effect:Dispose()
			self.fx_sohee_laser_effect = nil
		end

		self:dispose_environment_sfx(0)

		-- 엘레베이터 애니메이션 nil
		self.elevator_animator_list = nil

		self.activate_guard_list = nil

		self.is_active_pulse = false
	elseif stage.Name == self.before_stage_name then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	end

	-- ExitInteractable 원복
	self:restore_exit_interact_fo()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 택배기사들에게 상호작용 했을 때
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		for i = 1, self.courier_count do
			local courier = self.get_courier(i)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, courier)
					and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.enter_pyramid then
				-- 1번 택배기사와 상호작용할 때
				if i == 1 then
					if self.cur_first_courier_event_state == self.courier_event_state.end_event
							and self.cur_second_courier_event_state == self.courier_event_state.end_event then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_courier
						, self, courier))
					else
						speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 17 })
					end
				elseif i == 2 then
					-- 2번 택배기사와 상호작용 했을 때
					if self.cur_first_courier_event_state <= self.courier_event_state.running_event then
						sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.first_courier_event, self, courier)
					end
				elseif i == 3 then
					-- 3번 택배기사와 상호작용 했을 때
					if self.cur_second_courier_event_state <= self.courier_event_state.running_event then
						sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.second_courier_event, self, courier)
					else
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
						speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 50 })
					end
				end
				return true
			end
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_control_unit())
				and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.go_to_the_roof then
			-- 옥상에서 컨트롤 유닛에 상호작용 했을 때
			self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.ending
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_control_unit, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	-- exit 상호작용
	for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.exit_interact_fo[i]) then
			self:teleport_party_for_marker_routine(i)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.pyramid_enter_zone_name)
			and self.cur_progress <= self.section_progress.show_pyramid_entrance_event then
		self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.enter_pyramid
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.pyramid_trigger_event, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.pyramid_outer_zone_name)
			and self.cur_progress >= self.section_progress.enter_pyramid then
		-- 피라미드를 나가려고할 때
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.go_out_pyramid, self))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.courier_event_zone_name .. 1)
			and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.enter_pyramid
			and self.cur_first_courier_event_state == self.courier_event_state.zone_enter then
		-- 최초 택배 이벤트1 존에 진입했을 때
		self.cur_first_courier_event_state = self.courier_event_state.interact
		local courier = self.get_courier(2)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 18 })
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.courier_event_zone_name .. 2)
			and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.enter_pyramid
			and self.cur_second_courier_event_state == self.courier_event_state.zone_enter then
		-- 최초 택배 이벤트2 존에 진입했을 때
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		self.cur_second_courier_event_state = self.courier_event_state.interact
		local courier = self.get_courier(3)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 43 })
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.cargo_elevator_zone)
			and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.get_delivery_box then
		-- 택배기사를 기절 시킨 후 화물 엘레베이터로 이동하려고 할 때
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_cargo_elevator_zone, self))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.elevator_zone)
			and self.cur_progress >= self.section_progress.get_delivery_box then
		-- 엘레베이터 존으로 이동하려고 할 때
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_elevator_zone, self))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.pyramid_outer_zone_name)
			and self.cur_progress >= self.section_progress.get_delivery_box then
		-- 택배 상자를 들고 나가려고할 때
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.go_out_pyramid, self))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.leaving_cargo_elevator_zone) then
		if self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.battle_end_for_guard then
			self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.go_to_the_roof
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.leaving_elevator_event, self)
			return true
		elseif self.cur_progress >= self.section_progress.go_to_the_roof then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.go_back_cargo_elevator, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's8_auto_event_1')
			and not self.is_show_auto_event then
		self.is_show_auto_event = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.directing_auto_event, self))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's8_auto_event_2')
			and not self.is_show_underpass_exit_event then
		self.is_show_underpass_exit_event = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject
		, util.cs_generator(self.directing_underpass_exit_auto_event, self))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's8_auto_event_3')
			and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.show_pyramid_entrance_event
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.direcing_pyramid_entrance_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 's8_guard_battle' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.eliminated_guard, self)
		return true
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == 's8_captain_guard_battle' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.eliminated_captain, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if self.is_detected then
		return false
	end

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'detected_guard_1' or e:GetParamAt(0) == 'detected_guard_2' then
		if self.cur_progress < self.section_progress.get_delivery_box then
			-- 경비를 기절시키지 않았다면 리셋 포지션으로 보내도록
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.detected_event, self, e.Sender, e:GetParamAt(0))
			return true
		end
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'warp_magic_circle'
			and self.cur_progress == self.section_progress.go_to_the_roof then
		-- 제어기에 마커
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.get_control_unit(), true)

		-- 배경 원복
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SetBackgroundColorEvent.Create(CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 255, 255, 255), 0))

		-- 태양 이팩트 생성
		self.sun_effect = self.get_sun_effect():Instantiate(self.sun_default_pos)
		self.sun_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

		-- 환경음 재생
		self:dispose_environment_sfx(0)
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		self.environment_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', play_pos = vector(-140.5, 0, -47)
		, loop = true })
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	-- 로얄가드들과 전투중이 아닌 경우에는 retur false
	if self.cur_progress ~= self.section_progress.battle_guard
			or self.activate_guard_list == nil then
		return false
	end

	for i = 1, #self.activate_guard_list do
		local guard = self.activate_guard_list[i]
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, guard) then
			if e.HpBefore - e.Info:GetTotalDamage() < 1 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.first_eliminated_guard, self))
			end
		end
	end

end

function local_class:detected_event(sender, event_name)
	self.is_detected = true
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sender, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }
	, { name = 'attack' })

	-- 파티원들 놀라며
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'embarrassed' }
		, { name = 'scared' })
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(sender, { key = self.string_key .. 125, bubble_type = 'shout' })
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- fade out
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local reset_pos = field:GetMarker('s8_detected_reset_1').position
	party_util.align_party(reset_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward, 'down', 0, 'linear')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sender)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'reset', event_name }))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	self.is_detected = false
end

-- 피라미드 앞 자동 이벤트
function local_class:directing_auto_event()
	local mother = self.get_oneline_npc(2)
	local kid = self.get_oneline_npc(1)

	local string_key = 'ds_main_s8_oneline_'

	-- 초록1(right, tired, idle) : 엄마, 오늘 태양제인데 왜 피라미드에 못 들어가는 거야…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_sadness_01', parent = kid, loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(kid, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, { key = string_key .. 1 })

	-- 초록2(left, tired, idle) : 가드 아저씨들이 일이 있어서 오늘은 못 들어간대.
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01', parent = mother, loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = string_key .. 2 })

	-- 이후 원라인 대사
	kid.Interactable.Talk = string_key .. 1
	mother.Interactable.Talk = string_key .. 2
end

-- 피라미드 앞 자동 이벤트
function local_class:directing_underpass_exit_auto_event()
	local left_man = get_character('pyramid_1_1')
	local right_man = get_character('pyramid_1_2')

	local string_key = 'ds_pyramid_1_oneline_'

	-- 마족 남성(right, scared, idle) : 소문이 사실이면, 우리 모두 큰일인 거잖아!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(left_man, { key = string_key .. 1 })

	-- 마족 남성(left, tired, cross_arm) : 백작이 설마 그럴 리가…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(right_man, { key = string_key .. 2 })

	-- 이후 원라인 대사
	left_man.Interactable.Talk = string_key .. 1
	right_man.Interactable.Talk = string_key .. 2
end

-- 피라미드 앞 컨트롤 뺏는 이벤트
function local_class:direcing_pyramid_entrance_event()
	local vampire_male = self.get_oneline_npc(3)
	local vampire_female = self.get_oneline_npc(4)
	local first_string_key = 'ds_s8_oneline_'

	camera_util.move_async(vampire_male.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5, 1)

	-- ds_vampire_male (right, tired, idle) : 태양제인데 피라미드에 관람객을 받지 않는다니…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(vampire_male, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_male, { key = first_string_key .. 6, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(vampire_male)

	-- ds_vampire_female (left, tired, cross_arm) : 평소랑 다르게 로얄가드들도 많이 있었고…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(vampire_female, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_female, { key = first_string_key .. 7, skip = true })

	-- ds_vampire_female (left, tired, bomb_idle) : 무슨 일이라도 있는 걸까…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_anim(vampire_female, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_female, { key = first_string_key .. 8, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(vampire_female)

	-- ds_vampire_male (right, idle, question) 1초 후 하단 대사
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(vampire_male, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- ds_vampire_male (right, idle, release) : 혹시 모르니까 그냥 다른 데나 구경하러 가자.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(vampire_male, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_male, { key = first_string_key .. 9, skip = true })

	-- ds_vampire_female nod 2회
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(vampire_female)

	-- 이후 2명 화면 아래로 퇴장, 카메라 플레이어에게 돌아옴.
	character_util.move_waypoint(vampire_male, vampire_male.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 7
	, 3, false, nil, nil, 'down')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(vampire_female, vampire_female.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 7
	, 3, false, nil, nil, 'down')

	character_util.set_active_state(vampire_male, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(vampire_female, 'disabled')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

-- 피라미드 입장 후 이벤트
function local_class:pyramid_trigger_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local daughter = self.controller.get_count_daughter()
	local sohee = self.controller.get_sohee()

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, leader, vector(-110.5, 0, 1.5), 2
		, false, nil, nil, 'down'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, sohee, vector(-111, 0, 1), 2
		, false, nil, nil, 'right'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, daughter, vector(-110, 0, 1), 2
		, false, nil, nil, 'left'),
	})
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')

	-- 소히(right, idle, idle): 여기 꼭대기로 가야 한다고?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 1, skip = true })

	-- 딸(left, idle, idle) : 네, 맞아요. 최상층에 인공 태양 제어기가 있기 때문에…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 2, skip = true })

	-- 소히 (right, tired, bomb_idle) : 설마 계단으로 올라가야하는 건 아니지?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, { name = 'bomb_idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 3, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

	-- 소히 (down, idle, idle) : 그런 거면 돌아갈래.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'down')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 4, skip = true })

	-- 딸 (left, surprise, release) : 자, 잠시만요! 엘리베이터를 타고 가면 돼요…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(daughter, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01', loop = true },
			{ name = 'surprise' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 5, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(daughter)

	-- 소히 (right, idle, idle), 딸 (left, idle, idle)
	character_util.set_direction(daughter, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')

	-- 딸(left, idle, idle): 그러면 최상층까지 금방 갈 수 있어요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 6, skip = true })

	-- 딸(up): 엘리베이터는 바로 저기에…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(daughter, 'up')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 7, skip = true })

	-- 일행 시선 up
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'up')

	camera_util.move(vector(-110.5, 0, 21.5), 2)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 's8_moving_guard' }))

	-- 딸 : 있는데…
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 8
	, skip = true, screen_pos = vector(-125, -200), bubble_direction = 'ct' })
	camera_util.return_to_leader(2)

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(daughter, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')

	-- 소히(right, idle, cross_arm): 저기 인감도장이라도 숨겨놨어? 대체 몇 명이 지키고 있는 거야?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. 9, skip = true })

	-- 딸(left, tired, idle): 제가 막으러 올 걸 예상하고 아버지가 로얄가드를 대기시켜놨나 봐요.
	character_util.set_emotion(daughter, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 10, skip = true })

	-- 딸(left, tired, cross_arm): …엘리베이터 없이 최상층까지 가기엔…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(daughter, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 11, skip = true })

	-- 가디언 (down, idle ,question) 1.5초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 화면 좌상단에 말풍선 출력 인부1: 글쎄, 여긴 건물 설계가 잘못됐다니까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 12
	, skip = true, screen_pos = vector(-450, 400), bubble_direction = 'ct' })

	-- 가디언 (down, idle, idle) emoticon_bubble_question
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'question')

	-- 가디언 일행 up 바라보면 카메라 좌상단으로 패닝하여 인부1,2 사이에 포커싱
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'up')
	end

	-- 인부 캐싱
	local worker_list = {}
	local worker_count = 2
	local start_pos = vector(-125.5, 0, 6.5)
	for i = 1, worker_count do
		local worker = get_character('s8_worker_' .. i)
		character_util.set_active_state(worker, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_direction(worker, 'right')
		character_util.set_position(worker, start_pos - vector(i, 0, 0))

		local box_fo = get_field_object('directing_courier_box_' .. i)
		command_util.execute_holdup(worker, box_fo, worker.Position, 0, false)

		table.insert(worker_list, worker)
	end

	-- 화물 엘레베이터 용 로얄가드 캐싱
	local guard_count = 2
	local guard_list = {}
	for i = 1, guard_count do
		local guard = self.get_fixed_guard((i + 2))
		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.CharacterIdleState.Create(guard))
		message_system:SendSync(guard.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)
		table.insert(guard_list, guard)
	end

	local camera_pos = vector(-114, 0, 6.5)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(2.5)

		-- 인부1 : 화물 창고랑 화물 엘리베이터랑 거리가 이렇게 먼 게 말이 되냐고.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker_list[1], { key = self.string_key .. 13
		, skip = true })
		wait_for_sec(0.25)


		-- 인부2 : 어이, 김 씨. 그만 투덜대고 빨리 옮기기나 해.
		if not music_player_util.is_voice_available() then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
		end
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker_list[2], { key = self.string_key .. 14
		, skip = true })

	end))

	local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_04'
	, parent = worker_list[1], loop = true })

	local duration_mult = 1
	if music_player_util.is_voice_available() then
		duration_mult = 1.4
	end

	character_util.move_to(worker_list[1], camera_pos, 3.83 * duration_mult, nil, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(worker_list[2], camera_pos + unity_class.vector3.left
	, 3.83 * duration_mult, nil, true, true)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0, { end_target = worker_list[1] })

	character_util.move_to(worker_list[1], worker_list[1].Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 11
	, 3.6 * duration_mult, nil, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(worker_list[2], worker_list[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 11
	, 3.6 * duration_mult, nil, true, true)

	camera_util.move_async(worker_list[1].Position, 0)

	character_util.move_to(worker_list[1], worker_list[1].Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 4
	, 1.4 * duration_mult, nil, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(worker_list[2], worker_list[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 4
	, 1.4 * duration_mult, nil, true, true)
	dash_sfx:Stop()
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 로얄가드: 또 화물인가? 오늘따라 들어오는 게 많네.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_list[1], { key = self.string_key .. '14_1'
	, skip = true })

	-- 가드들이 비켜준다.
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, guard_list[1]
		, guard_list[1].Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.75, 1, false, nil, nil, 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, guard_list[2]
		, guard_list[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.75, 1, false, nil, nil, 'left'),
	})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_armor_01')

	-- 인부가 안으로 들어감
	dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_04'
	, parent = worker_list[1], loop = true })
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, worker_list[1]
		, worker_list[1].Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 12, 3.5, false, nil, nil, 'right'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, worker_list[2]
		, worker_list[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 12, 3.5, false, nil, nil, 'right'),
	})
	dash_sfx:Stop()

	-- 워커 숨겨줌.
	for i = 1, #worker_list do
		character_util.set_position(worker_list[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
		local current_state = worker_list[i].FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
		if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
			local target = current_state.HoldTarget
			command_util.execute_throw(worker_list[i], target, direction_util.to_vector3(worker_list[i].Direction)
			, worker_list[i].Position, 4, false)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			target.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end
		character_util.set_active_state(worker_list[i], 'disabled')
	end

	-- 가드들 원래 자리로
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, guard_list[1]
		, guard_list[1].Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.75, 1, false, nil, nil, 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, guard_list[2]
		, guard_list[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.75, 1, false, nil, nil, 'left'),
	})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_armor_01')

	-- 원래 FieldObjectController로 변경
	for i = 1, #guard_list do
		guard_list[i]:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 카메라 돌아오는 중에 일행 시선 right, 카메라 복귀 끝나면 가디언(down) 소히(right) 프리실라(left)
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'right')
	end
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(daughter, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')

	-- 딸(left, smile, idle): 바로 저거예요! 화물용 엘리베이터!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(daughter, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 15, skip = true })

	-- 딸(left, smile, release): 우리도 물건을 옮기는 척하면 지나갈 수 있을 거예요!
	character_util.set_anim(daughter, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 16, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(daughter)

	-- 가디언과 소히 smile, nod 2회
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(sohee, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	character_util.nod_twice(leader)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'up')
	end

	-- 상호작용 가능하도록
	for i = 1, self.courier_count do
		local courier = self.get_courier(i)
		character_util.add_listener(courier, self.controller)
	end

	local top_courier = self.get_courier(2)
	self.environment_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', parent = top_courier, loop = true })

	-- 컨트롤 풀림. 택배원1, 2에게 마커
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'courier_event_1', top_courier, true)
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'courier_event_2', self.get_courier(3), true)
end

-- 택배원 1이벤트
function local_class:first_courier_event(courier)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	party_util.align_party(courier.Position, 'right', 0.5, 'arc')

	self:dispose_environment_sfx(0)
	if self.cur_first_courier_event_state < self.courier_event_state.running_event then
		-- 택배원 (right, tired, idle) : …당신은 누구요?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)
		character_util.set_emotion(courier)
		character_util.set_direction(courier, 'right')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 19, skip = true })

		-- 택배원 (right, tired, bomb_idle) : 여기서 못 보던 얼굴인데…
		character_util.set_anim(courier, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 20, skip = true })

		-- 가디언 left, smile, release
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		-- 택배원 (right, tired, question) : 택배 알바생?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim(courier, { name = 'question', loop = false })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 21, skip = true })

		-- 택배원 emoticon_bubble_silence
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(courier, nil, 'silence')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)

		-- 택배원 (right, attack, idle) : …월급도 밀리면서 알바생은 추가로 고용해?
		character_util.set_emotion(courier, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 22, skip = true })

		-- 택배원 (left, mad, cast2) : 이놈의 회사를 진짜… 때려치우던지 해야지…!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(courier, { name = 'cast2' }, { name = 'mad' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 23, skip = true })

		-- 택배원, 왼쪽에 있는 택배 오브젝트를  left, mad, attack으로 피격
		-- 피격 효과
		character_util.set_direction(courier, 'left')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(courier, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_dummy_02')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(courier.Position + vector(-0.4, 0.1, 0))
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		character_util.remove_anim(courier)

		-- 선택지 출력
		-- 1) 진정하고 가족을 생각해요. (초록색) / 2) 그래요! 때려 치워요!
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. '23_1', 'mercy' }
		, { self.string_key .. 24, 'brutal' } })

		if choose_result == 1 then
			-- 가디언 left, smile, sing
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'smile' })
			wait_for_sec(1.5)
			character_util.remove_anim(leader)

			-- 택배원 right, tired, idle + emoticon_bubble_silence
			character_util.remove_emotion(courier)
			character_util.set_emotion(courier, { name = 'tired' })
			character_util.set_direction(courier, 'right')
			character_util.show_emoticon_async(courier, nil, 'silence')

			-- 택배원 (right, tired, release) : 하지만 지금 버는 돈으론 처자식을 먹여살리기도 급급하고…
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(courier, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }
			, { name = 'tired' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. '23_2', skip = true })
			character_util.remove_anim(courier)

			-- 택배원 (right, tried, cross_arm) : 더 벌어둬야 아내와 노후도 준비할 수 있는데.
			character_util.set_anim(courier, { name = 'cross_arm' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. '23_3', skip = true })
		else
			-- 가디언 left, attack, attack 2회
			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'attack', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
			character_util.remove_anim(leader)

			-- 택배원 right, tired, idle + emoticon_bubble_silence
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)
			character_util.set_emotion(courier, { name = 'tired' })
			character_util.set_direction(courier, 'right')
			character_util.show_emoticon_async(courier, nil, 'silence')

			-- 택배원 (right, tired, release) : …홑몸이라면 그러겠지만 먹여 살릴 처자식도 있고…
			character_util.set_anim(courier, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01', loop = true })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 28, skip = true })
			character_util.remove_anim(courier)

			-- 택배원 (right, tried, cross_arm) : 밥벌이로는 이 일만 해와서 다른 걸 할 수 있을지…
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			character_util.set_anim(courier, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 29, skip = true })
		end
		self.cur_first_courier_event_state = self.courier_event_state.running_event
	end

	-- 택배원 (right, idle, idle) : 혹시 돈벌이에 좋은 거라도 알고 있나?
	character_util.set_direction(courier, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 30, skip = true })

	-- 선택지 출력
	-- 1) 안정적인 직장이 좋죠. / 2) 인생은 한 방! 마트코인!
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. 25, 'mercy' }
	, { self.string_key .. 26, 'intellect' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		-- 택배원 (right, tired, nodx2) : …역시 그렇지?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(courier, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.nod_twice(courier)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 31, skip = true })

		-- 택배원 (right, tired, cross_arm) : 헛생각 하지 말고  일이나 해야겠네.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim(courier, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 32, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(courier)

		-- 택배원 (right, tired, idle) : 이번 달 월급은 밀리지 않아야 할텐데…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 33, skip = true })
		self.environment_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', parent = courier, loop = true })
		character_util.set_direction(courier, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(courier, { name = 'eat' })
	else
		-- 가디언 left, smile, victory_get
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false }
		, { name = 'smile' })
		wait_for_sec(2)
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

		-- 택배원 right, surprise, jump1회
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(courier, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump(courier)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 택배원 (right, surprise, cast) : 마, 마, 마 마트코인?!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		character_util.set_anim(courier, { name = 'cast', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 34, skip = true })

		-- 택배원 (right, surprise, release) : 마계에서 유명한 그 코인 말인가…?
		character_util.set_anim(courier, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 35, skip = true })

		-- 가디언 left, smile, nodx2
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.nod_twice(leader)

		-- 택배원 (right, tired, cast)  : …그건 너무 위험하지 않은가…? 잘못하면 나락으로…
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(courier, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 36, skip = true })

		-- 선택지
		-- 1) 도전은 언제나 아름답죠. / 2) 그럼 평생 월세로 사세요. / 3) 쫄?
		choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. '26_1', 'mercy' }
		, { self.string_key .. '26_2', 'intellect' }, { self.string_key .. 27, 'brutal' } })

		if choose_result == 1 then
			-- 가디언 left, smile, sing
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'smile' })
			wait_for_sec(1.5)
		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			-- 가디언 left, sleep_deep, nod 2회
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
			character_util.nod_twice(leader)
		else
			-- 가디언 left, doyagao, bomb_idle
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
			leader:HideWeapon(true)
			character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
			wait_for_sec(1.5)
			leader:HideWeapon(false)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			message_system:SendSync(leader.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		end
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		-- 택배원 right, attack, idle + emoticon_bubble_exclamation
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)
		character_util.set_emotion(courier, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(courier, nil, 'notice')

		-- 택배원 right, attack, idle + 한 번 shake
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(courier, 0.06, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		-- 택배원 (right, attack, nodx2) : 그래… 자네 말이 맞아.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.nod_twice(courier)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 37, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(courier)

		-- 택배원 (right, attack, cast2) : 어차피 인생은 한 방인데 겁먹을 필요는 없지!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_anim(courier, { name = 'cast2' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 38, skip = true })

		-- 택배원 (right, attack, release) : 고맙네! 자네 덕에 새로운 인생을 시작할 수 있겠어!
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(courier, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01', loop = true },
				{ name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 39, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)

		-- 택배원, 보라색 네모 라인까지 달려가다가 멈추고 대사.
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(courier, {
			courier.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 2,
			courier.Position + vector(3, 0, -2),
		}, 5, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)

		-- 택배원1 (right, idle, idle) : 이건 이제 필요 없겠군.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 40, skip = true })

		-- 택배원1 (left, attack, attack) : 지긋지긋하던 운송 일도 이젠 안녕이다!
		character_util.set_direction(courier, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(courier, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(courier, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
		local transport_permit = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = courier.Position
		, target = vector(-138, 0, 14), itemid = 20573, notforinven = true, sprscale = 0.7
		, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 41, skip = true })

		-- 택배원1 상단대사하며 attack 모션할때, dropitem으로 [운송 허가증] 던져버리고 우측을 바라보며 right, attack, cast2자세로 아래의 대사

		-- 택배원 : [shout] 마트코인 풀매수하고 천계 가즈아아!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_direction(courier, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(courier, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false }
		, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 42
		, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(courier)

		-- 택배원 퇴장
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(courier, courier.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 14
		, 5, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)
		character_util.set_active_state(courier, 'disabled')

		-- 택배원1 화면 밖으로 달려나가면 이벤트 종료, 컨트롤 풀림.
		transport_permit.ConsumeTarget = leader

		self.cur_first_courier_event_state = self.courier_event_state.end_event
		quest_marker_util.remove('courier_event_1')
		if self.cur_second_courier_event_state == self.courier_event_state.end_event then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.get_courier(1), true)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:second_courier_event(courier)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(courier)
	party_util.align_party(courier.Position, 'right', 0.5, 'arc')

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 택배원2(right, attack, idle) : …뭡니까? 바빠 죽겠는데.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)
	character_util.set_direction(courier, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(courier, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 44, skip = true })

	if self.cur_second_courier_event_state < self.courier_event_state.running_event then
		-- 선택지(초록색) : 죄송합니다.
		choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. '44_1', 'mercy' } })

		-- 택배원2(right, attack, release) : 볼일 없으면 귀찮게 하지 마쇼!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(courier,
				{ name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }
		, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 45, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)

		self.cur_second_courier_event_state = self.courier_event_state.running_event
	else
		-- 선택지(붉은색) 한가해 보이는데?
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. '44_1', 'mercy' }
		, { self.string_key .. '45_1', 'brutal' } })

		if choose_result == 1 then
			-- 택배원2(right, attack, release) : 볼일 없으면 귀찮게 하지 마쇼!
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(courier,
					{ name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }
			, { name = 'attack' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 45, skip = true })
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)

			self.cur_second_courier_event_state = self.courier_event_state.running_event
		else
			-- 택배원2(right, attack, idle 짧은 진동) : 지금 시비거는 거요?
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)
			character_util.set_direction(courier, 'right')
			character_util.set_emotion(courier, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.shake(courier, 0.03, 0.5)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 46, skip = true })

			-- 택배원2(right, mad, cast2) : 안 그래도 <b>전력 관리동</b>에 물건 보낼 담당자가 늦어서 미칠 것 같구만!!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(courier, { name = 'cast2' }, { name = 'mad' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 47, skip = true })

			-- 택배원2(right, damaged, embarrassed) : 그놈들은 물건이 조금만 늦어도 하루 종일 클레임 건다고!!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(courier, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 48, skip = true })

			-- 택배원2(right, attack, release) : 짜증 나니까 볼일 없으면 저리 가쇼!
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(courier, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }
			, { name = 'attack' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 49, skip = true })
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)

			-- 컨트롤 풀림. 택배원2 상호작용 시 원라인 출력.
			self.cur_second_courier_event_state = self.courier_event_state.end_event
			quest_marker_util.remove('courier_event_2')
			if self.cur_first_courier_event_state == self.courier_event_state.end_event then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.get_courier(1), true)
			end
		end
	end

	character_util.set_direction(courier, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(courier, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'attack' })
end

-- 택배기사와 상호작용
function local_class:interact_courier(courier)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local daughter = self.controller.get_count_daughter()
	local sohee = self.controller.get_sohee()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(courier)
	party_util.align_party(courier.Position, 'right', 0.5, 'arc')

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	-- 택배 관리인(right, tired, cross_arm): 배송 담당이 아니면 돌아가서 일이나 해.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 17, skip = true })

	-- 선택지 : 운송 허가증을 보여준다.
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. 51, 'mercy' } })

	-- 가디언 attack 1회하면 획득했던 운송 허가증 드랍.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(leader, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })
	local transport_permit = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = leader.Position
	, target = courier.Position, itemid = 20573, notforinven = true, sprscale = 0.7
	, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
	transport_permit.ConsumeTarget = courier
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 택배 관리인이 아이템 습득한 후 right, idle, nod 2회
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)
	character_util.nod_twice(courier)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 택배 관리인(right, idle, nod): 배송지는?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 52, skip = true })

	-- 이후 선택지 : 전력 관리동
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. 53, 'intellect' } })

	-- 택배 관리인(right, idle, release): 왜 이렇게 늦게 온 거야? 물건은 뒤에 있으니까 빨리 가져가라고.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(courier, { name = 'release', count = 2, keep_anim = false
	, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(courier, { key = self.string_key .. 54, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(courier)

	-- 가디언, 소히, 프리실라 우측에 있는 택배 상자를 한 개씩 든다.(던질 수 없음)

	-- 택배 박스 앞으로 정렬
	local target_pos = vector(-126, 0, 11)
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, sohee, target_pos, 3
		, false, nil, nil, 'right'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, leader, target_pos + unity_class.vector3.back, 3
		, false, nil, nil, 'right'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, daughter, target_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 2, 3
		, false, nil, nil, 'right'),
	})

	-- 택배 박스를 eat
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true
	, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'player' })

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'eat' })
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)
	eat_sfx:Stop()

	-- 택배박스 셋이서 든다.
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local box_fo = self.get_courier_box(i + 1)
		box_fo.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		command_util.execute_holdup(user_party[i], box_fo, user_party[i].Position)
	end

	-- 움직이지 않는 가드들은 더이상 감시하지 않는다.
	local fixed_guard_count = 8
	for i = 1, fixed_guard_count do
		local guard = self.get_fixed_guard(i)
		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.CharacterIdleState.Create(guard))
		message_system:SendSync(guard.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)
	end

	-- 택배원들 상호작용 불가능하도록
	for i = 1, self.courier_count do
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_courier(i), self.controller)
	end

	self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.get_delivery_box

	-- 퀘스트 마커는 화물 엘레베이터 부분으로
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, vector(-92.5, 0, 6.5), true)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 걷기, 상호작용만 가능하게 한다
	self:disable_controls(leader)
end

-- 엘레베이터에 상호작용 할 때
function local_class:interact_cargo_elevator()
	-- 연출용 npc 캐싱
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local daughter = self.controller.get_count_daughter()
	local sohee = self.controller.get_sohee()

	party_util.align_party(vector(-91.5, 0, 6.5), 'left', 2.5, 'linear')
	local target_pos_x = leader.Position.x

	-- 기사 먼저 올라가기 시작
	character_util.move_waypoint(leader, leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 3
	, 3, false, nil, nil, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.11)

	-- 소히
	character_util.move_waypoint(sohee, {
		vector(target_pos_x, 0, sohee.Position.z),
		vector(target_pos_x, 0, sohee.Position.z + 2),
	}, 3, false, nil, nil, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.11)

	-- 프리실라
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(daughter, {
		vector(target_pos_x, 0, daughter.Position.z),
		vector(target_pos_x, 0, daughter.Position.z + 1),
	}, 3, false, nil, nil, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 엘레베이터가 열리는 연출
	local elevator_door = get_field_object('elevator_inner_2')
	local animator = elevator_door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')
	animator:Play('open')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 박스 페이드 함수
	local fade_box = function(box)
		local renderer = box:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
		local material = renderer.material

		-- 박스 페이드
		local start_alpha = 1
		local end_alpha = 0

		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 0.65
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local color = material.color
			color.a = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_alpha, end_alpha, progress)
			material.color = color
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	-- 파티원 위로 이동
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * (i + 1) * 1.5
		, nil, 1.5, true, true, false)
	end

	-- 박스 페이드 시작
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(user_party[i], 0, 0.65)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(fade_box, self.get_courier_box(i + 1)))
		wait_for_sec(0.4)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 엘레베이터가 닫히는 연출
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')
	animator:Play('close')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_02')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		local current_state = party_member.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState

		-- 들고 있는 박스들 내려 놓도록
		if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
			local target = current_state.HoldTarget
			command_util.execute_throw(party_member, target, direction_util.to_vector3(user_party[i].Direction)
			, party_member.Position, 4, false)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			target.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end

		-- 알파값 원래대로
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(user_party[i], 1, 0)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		message_system:SendSync(user_party[i].CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	-- 파티원들을 엘레베이터에 세팅
	local marker = field:GetMarker('s8_cargo_elevator_1')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_position(leader, marker.position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.set_position(sohee, marker.position + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(daughter)
	character_util.set_position(daughter, marker.position + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(daughter, 'left')

	-- 엘레베이터씬 전용 시어 값으로 변경
	local shear_controller = self.get_shear_controller()
	shear_controller:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = 0.05

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	self:dispose_environment_sfx(0)
	self.environment_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_elevator_06', loop = true })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 페이드 인 되고 1초 후 소히 left, right 봄
	wait_for_sec(1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 소히(right, tired, idle) : 뭐야, 이 구식 모델은…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '57_1', skip = true })

	--소히(right, idle, idle) : 이걸로 옥상까지 가려면 한참 걸리겠어.
	character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '57_2', skip = true })

	-- 딸 (left, idle, cross_arm) : 조금만 더 가면 최상층…
	character_util.set_anim(daughter, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 58, skip = true })

	-- 딸 (left, sleep_deep, cross_arm): 마침내 여기까지…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(daughter, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 59, skip = true })

	-- 소히(right, idle, idle) : 이제 슬슬 말 좀 해주지 그래?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '59_1', skip = true })

	-- 소히(right, attack, release): 수용소에서 말했던 이상한 소문은 뭐고, 넌 인공태양 제어기로 뭘 하려는 건데.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }
	, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '59_2', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

	-- 프리실라(left, idle, idle)  emoticon_bubble_silence
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(daughter)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(daughter, nil, 'silence')

	-- 프리실라(right, idle, idle) : 데몬샤이어에 퍼진 이상한 소문은…
	self.environment_sfx.Volume = 0.5
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. '59_3', skip = true })

	-- 프리실라(right, tired, cast) : 아버지가 귀족 뱀파이어와 손을 잡고…  마족인 어머니를 숙청했다는 소문이에요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(daughter, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. '59_4', skip = true })

	-- 소히 right, surprise, 점프 1회하며 emoticon_bubble_exclamation
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(sohee, true)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(sohee, nil, 'notice')

	-- 소히(right, attack, release) : 그, 그게 사실이야?!
	character_util.remove_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }
	, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '59_5', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(sohee)

	-- 프리실라(left, tired, idle) : …모르겠어요. 하지만 어머니의 피가 흐르는 반마족인 절 가두고 모든 마족을 숙청하시려는 걸 보면…
	character_util.remove_anim(daughter)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. '59_6', skip = true })

	-- 가디언 (down, idle, question) emoticon_bubble_silence
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'silence')

	-- 선택지
	-- 1) 당신의 아버지를 막아야 해요!. (초록색) / 2) 친딸이 아니란 걸 눈치챘나? (빨간색)
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. '59_7', 'mercy' }
	, { self.string_key .. '59_8', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 가디언 down, attack, release 2회
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		-- 소히 (right, attack, nod) : 맞는 말이야…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(sohee, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = self.string_key .. '59_9', skip = true })
	else
		-- 가디언 (down, idle, bomb_idle)
		leader:HideWeapon(true)
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
		leader:HideWeapon(false)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		message_system:SendSync(leader.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		-- 소히 (up, 점프 1회) : 너는 이 상황에서…!!
