function local_class:first_eliminated_guard()
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	if self.guard_count >= 10 then
		return
	end
	self.guard_count = self.guard_count + 1

	local guard = self.get_battle_guard(self.guard_count)
	character_util.convert_to_monster(guard, 's8_guard_battle', 'cargo_elevator_battle_zone')
	guard.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.NoticeLinkName = 's8_guard_battle'

	local jump_height = 10

	local marker = field:GetMarker('s8_cargo_elevator_1')
	local landing_pos_list = { marker.position + vector(0, jump_height, 3)
	, marker.position + vector(4, jump_height, 1.5)
	, marker.position + vector(-4, jump_height, 1.5)
	, marker.position + vector(3, jump_height, -2)
	, marker.position + vector(-3, jump_height, -2) }

	local landing_pos = landing_pos_list[self.guard_count - 5]
	local dir = { 'down', 'left', 'right', 'left', 'right' }

	character_util.set_active_state(guard, 'enabled')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard)
	character_util.set_anim(guard, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false })
	character_util.set_direction(guard, dir[self.guard_count - 5])
	character_util.set_position(guard, landing_pos, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_duration = 0.6
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, guard.Position.y, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()
		if landing_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
			character_util.set_position(guard, landing_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
		else
			character_util.set_position(guard, vector(landing_pos.x, 0, landing_pos.z))
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.fx_last_hit():Instantiate(guard.Position)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard)
	character_util.set_position(guard, vector(landing_pos.x, 0, landing_pos.z))
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	command_util.execute_monster_notice(guard, user_party.Leader, 'battle')

	table.insert(self.activate_guard_list, guard)
end

-- 가드들을 쓰러뜨린 후
function local_class:eliminated_guard()
	-- muted
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	-- 세이브 포인트
	local save_point_key = self.controller.save_point_key
	local cur_value = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, save_point_key)
	local save_point = 1
	if cur_value < save_point then
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, save_point_key, save_point)
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	self:dispose_environment_sfx(0)
	self.environment_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_elevator_06', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })
	self.is_siren_directing = false
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	-- 엘레베이터씬 전용 시어 값으로 변경
	local shear_controller = self.get_shear_controller()
	shear_controller:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = 0.05

	-- 연출용 npc 캐싱
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local daughter = self.controller.get_count_daughter()
	local sohee = self.controller.get_sohee()
	local captain_guard = self.get_captain_guard()

	-- 파티원들 세팅
	local marker = field:GetMarker('s8_cargo_elevator_1')
	camera_util.move_async(marker.position, 0)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_position(leader, marker.position + unity_class.vector3.left)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.set_position(sohee, marker.position + vector(-2, 0, 0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(daughter)
	character_util.set_position(daughter, marker.position + vector(-2, 0, -0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(daughter, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 친위대장 : [shout] 거기까지입니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. 77
	, skip = true, screen_pos = vector(50, 250), bubble_type = 'shout', bubble_direction = 'ct' })

	-- 근위대장 히어로 랜딩
	character_util.set_active_state(captain_guard, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(captain_guard, 'left')

	-- 랜딩할 자리에 세팅
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	local landing_pos = marker.position + unity_class.vector3.right * 2
	local jump_height = 10
	character_util.set_position(captain_guard, landing_pos + vector(0, jump_height, 0), true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(captain_guard)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(captain_guard, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_duration = 0.6
	local start_pos = captain_guard.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, captain_guard.Position.y, 0)
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		if start_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
			character_util.set_position(captain_guard, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
		else
			character_util.set_position(captain_guard, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump(user_party[i], false)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	self.fx_last_hit():Instantiate(captain_guard.Position)

	character_util.set_position(captain_guard, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
	camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.35)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	-- 친위대장 : 프리실라 님. 당신을 잡아들이라는 백작님의 명입니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(captain_guard)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. 78, skip = true })

	-- 딸: 발렌시아…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(daughter, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 79, skip = true })

	-- 선택지 출력
	-- 1) 당신은 누구죠? / 2) 저리 비켜. 애송이.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. 80, 'mercy' }
	, { self.string_key .. 81, 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 기사 (right, idle, release 2회)
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		-- 딸: ……
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 82, skip = true })
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		leader:HideWeapon(true)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'bomb_idle' }, { name = 'doyagao' })
		wait_for_sec(1)
		leader:HideWeapon(false)
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		-- 딸: 애송이가 아니에요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

	-- 딸(right, attack, idle): 저 사람은 오직 아버지의 명령을 수행하기 위해 존재하는 친위대의 대장…!

	character_util.set_emotion(daughter, { name = 'tired' })

	-- 딸 (right, tired, cast) : 친위대장인 발렌시아의 강함은 특히…
	character_util.set_anim(daughter, { name = 'cast' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 86, skip = true })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 친친위대장(left, idle, sword_idle): 다치게 할 생각은 없으니, 얌전히 따라와주시죠.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. '86_1', skip = true })

	-- 친위대장(left, sleep_deep, idle): 제가 맡은 임무는 실패한 적이 단 한 번도 없다는 것을…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(captain_guard, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. '86_2', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(captain_guard)

	-- 친위대장(left, idle, sword_idle): 당신도 잘 알고 계실 겁니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. 87, skip = true })

	-- 프리실라 emoticon_bubble_silence
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(daughter, nil, 'silence')

	-- 딸: 하지만… 나는 반드시 아버지를 막아야…
	character_util.set_emotion(daughter, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 88, skip = true })

	-- 1초 대기 후
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 근위대장: …알겠습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(captain_guard, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. 89, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(captain_guard)

	-- 친위대장(left, idle, sword_idle) : 그것이 당신의 뜻이라면…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	camera_util.move_async(captain_guard.Position, 1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. 90, skip = true })

	-- 친위대장(attack): [shout] 강제로 데려가는 수밖에 없겠군요!

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')

	character_util.set_emotion(captain_guard, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. 91
	, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(captain_guard)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(daughter)

	-- 보스 타이틀 “친위대장 발렌시아” 서브 타이틀 “임무를 실패한 적이 없습니다.”

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(captain_guard, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false }
	, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.set_death_type(captain_guard, 'prostrate')
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(captain_guard, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	captain_guard.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.NoticeLinkName = 's8_captain_guard_battle'

-- 근위대장을 쓰러뜨린 이후
function local_class:eliminated_captain()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	-- 세이브 포인트
	local save_point_key = self.controller.save_point_key
	local cur_value = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, save_point_key)
	local save_point = 2
	if cur_value < save_point then
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, save_point_key, save_point)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:dispose_environment_sfx(0)
	self.environment_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_elevator_06', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 엘레베이터씬 전용 시어 값으로 변경
	local shear_controller = self.get_shear_controller()
	shear_controller:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = 0.05

	-- 연출용 npc 캐싱
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local daughter = self.controller.get_count_daughter()
	local sohee = self.controller.get_sohee()
	local captain_guard = self.get_captain_guard()

	-- 파티원 회복
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = party_member
		heal_info.target = party_member
		heal_info.heal = party_member.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
	end

	-- 자리 배치
	local marker = field:GetMarker('s8_cargo_elevator_1')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_position(leader, marker.position + unity_class.vector3.left)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.set_position(sohee, marker.position + vector(-2, 0, 0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(daughter)
	character_util.set_position(daughter, marker.position + vector(-2, 0, -0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(daughter, 'right')

	-- 근위 대장은 쓰러져있게
	character_util.set_active_state(captain_guard, 'enabled')
	character_util.convert_to_npc(captain_guard)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(captain_guard)
	character_util.set_position(captain_guard, marker.position + unity_class.vector3.right)
	character_util.set_direction(captain_guard, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(captain_guard, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false }
	, { name = 'doyagao' })
	wait_for_sec(2)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 딸(right, surprise, 점프 1회): 발렌시아를 쓰러트리다니…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_emotion(daughter, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(daughter, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 94, skip = true })

	-- 딸(right, idle, idle): 당신… 보기보다 강했군요…
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.remove_emotion(daughter)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 95, skip = true })

	-- 움직이던 배경 감속하다가 카메라 쉐이크 강도 0.1 시간1초 후 정지.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_teatan_head_break_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	self:dispose_environment_sfx(0)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_02')

	-- 엘레베이터 멈춤 연출
	local time_passed = 0
	local stop_time = 2
	while time_passed < stop_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / stop_time
		local speed = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(1, 0, progress)
		for i = 1, #self.elevator_animator_list do
			self.elevator_animator_list[i].speed = speed
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.elevator_animator_list do
		self.elevator_animator_list[i].speed = 0
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_02')
	wait_for_sec(1.25)

	-- 가디언, 소히 프리실라 시선 down
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'down')
	end

	-- 프리실라 (down, idle, idle) : 엘리베이터로 올 수 있는 곳은 여기까지…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. '95_1', skip = true })

	-- 프리실라 (right, idle, idle) : 이제 한 층만 더 올라가면 최상층이에요…!
	character_util.set_direction(daughter, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. '95_2', skip = true })

	-- 가디언 left, idle nod 2회
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(leader)

	character_util.move_waypoint(leader, leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 3.5
	, 1.35, false, nil, nil, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	character_util.move_waypoint(daughter, {
		daughter.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 1.5,
		daughter.Position + vector(1.5, 0, -2.5)
	}, 1.5, false, nil, nil, 'down')
	character_util.move_waypoint(sohee, {
		sohee.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5,
		sohee.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -3.5)
	}, 1.5, false, nil, nil, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- fade out
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	-- 캐릭터들을 옥상 복도로 이동 알파 값은 다뺌
	local pos = field:GetMarker('elevator_inner_2').position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 2
	party_util.align_party(pos, 'up', 0, 'arc')
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(user_party[i], 0, 0)
	end

	-- 원래 시어 값으로 변경
	shear_controller = self.get_shear_controller()
	shear_controller:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = 0.025

	-- 엘레베이터 열어둔다.
	local cargo_elevator = get_field_object('elevator_inner_1')
	local animator = cargo_elevator:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Play('open')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 배경 강제로 제거
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SetBackgroundColorEvent.Create(CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 0, 0, 0), 0))

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 기사 일행 아래로 내려옴
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(user_party[i], 1, 2.5)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		message_system:SendSync(user_party[i].CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.move_to(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 3
		, 2.5, nil, true, true, false)
	end
	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	-- 엘레베이터 닫힘
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')
	animator:Play('close')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

	-- 옥상 마법진쪽으로 마커
	self.cur_progress = self.section_progress.battle_end_for_guard
	local marker_pos = field:GetMarker('magic_circle_point_1').position
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, marker_pos, true)
end

-- 엘레베이터 밖 존에 트리거했을 때
function local_class:leaving_elevator_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local daughter = self.controller.get_count_daughter()
	local sohee = self.controller.get_sohee()
	local captain_guard = self.get_captain_guard()

	-- 근위대장 로얄가드들 배치
	local captain_pos = vector(-98.5, 0, -48)
	character_util.set_position(captain_guard, captain_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(captain_guard, 'up')
	character_util.set_anim(captain_guard, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_active_state(captain_guard, 'enabled')

	local guard_count = 4
	local guard_list = {}
	local guard_pos_list = { captain_pos + vector(0.65, 0, -1), captain_pos - vector(0.65, 0, 1)
	, captain_pos + vector(0.65, 0, -2), captain_pos - vector(0.65, 0, 2) }
	for i = 1, guard_count do
		local guard = self.get_subordinate_guard(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(guard, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_direction(guard, 'up')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard)
		character_util.set_position(guard, guard_pos_list[i])
		table.insert(guard_list, guard)
	end

	-- 트리거 존 진입 시 정렬.
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, leader, vector(-98.5, 0, -40), 2
		, false, nil, nil, 'down'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, sohee, vector(-99, 0, -40.5), 2
		, false, nil, nil, 'right'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, daughter, vector(-98, 0, -40.5), 2
		, false, nil, nil, 'left'),
	})

	-- 프리실라 (left, idle, idle) : 조금만 더 가면 최상층이에요! 거기 있는 제어기로…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(daughter, { key = self.string_key .. 96, skip = true })

	-- 화면 하단에 말풍선 출력. 하단 말풍선 출력 시 짧은 카메라 쉐이크, 일행들 surprise, 점프 1회
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump(user_party[i])
	end

	-- 근위대장: [shout] 프리실라 님!!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. 97
	, skip = true, screen_pos = vector(-100, -250), bubble_type = 'shout', bubble_direction = 'ct' })

	-- 가디언 일행 시선 down/ 카메라 아래로내려감
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'down')
	end
	camera_util.move(vector(-98.5, 0, -43.5), 1.7)

	-- 엘리베이터 문에서 근위대장과 병사들이 내려와 정지.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	for i = 1, #guard_list do
		character_util.move_to(guard_list[i], guard_list[i].Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 3
		, 1.5, nil, true, true, false)
	end
	character_util.move_to_async(captain_guard, captain_guard.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 3
	, 1.5, nil, true, true, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 친위대장: 백작님이 내리신 명은… 반드시 완수하는 것이 제 사명!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. '97_1', skip = true })

	-- 근위대장: 절대 놓치지 않겠습니다…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(captain_guard, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain_guard, { key = self.string_key .. 98, skip = true })

	-- 소히가 앞으로 나서 마기톤 버스터를 쏜다.
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(sohee, vector(-98.5, 0, -43)
	, 5, true, nil, nil, 'down', true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hyper_laser_01')
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'rifle_shoot2' })
	wait_for_sec(0.05)
	self.fx_sohee_laser_effect = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.Instantiate(self.get_fx_ghost_buster_magiton(),
			sohee.Bounds.center, direction_util.to_vector3(sohee.Direction))
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	-- 로얄 가드1,2 근위대장 밀린다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_small_01')
	for i = 1, #guard_list do
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(guard_list[i], 1.2, 0.8, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(guard_list[i], CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(guard_list[i], { name = 'damaged2', loop = false }
		, { name = 'damaged' })
		if i <= 2 then
			self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(guard_list[i].Position)
			character_util.move_to(guard_list[i], guard_list[i].Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.3
			, 0.1, nil, false, false)
			character_util.shake(guard_list[i], 0.02, 0.3)
		end
	end

	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(captain_guard.Position)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(captain_guard, 1.2, 0.8, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(captain_guard, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(captain_guard, { name = 'damaged2', loop = false }
	, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.shake(captain_guard, 0.02, 0.3)
	character_util.move_to(captain_guard, captain_guard.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.7
	, 0.1, nil, false, false)

	wait_for_sec(0.6)
	for i = 1, #guard_list do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard_list[i])
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(captain_guard)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	self.fx_sohee_laser_effect:Dispose()
	self.fx_sohee_laser_effect = nil

	wait_for_sec(0.05)
	character_util.remove_anim(sohee)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(sohee, sohee.Position + unity_class.vector3.back
	, 4, false, nil, nil, 'down')

	-- 소히가 한칸 더 내려가서 다시 레이저 발사

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	local backup_background_pos = get_field_object('background').Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.1

	function background_move(duration, end_pos)
		local time_passed = 0
		local background = get_field_object('background')
		local start_pos = background.Position

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			if background ~= nil then
				background.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
		character_util.set_position(leader, cur_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0), true)
		local cur_rot = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 360 * 4, progress)
		character_util.spine_rotate(leader, cur_rot, 0)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 빙글빙글 돌며 위 지점에 떨어짐. 가디언(right, confused, prostrate)

-- 걷기 상호작용만 가능하도록 하는 함수
function local_class:disable_controls(leader)
	-- 걷기, 상호작용만 가능하게 한다
	local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(leader, false)
	local enabling_control = CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Move | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact
	local disabled_control = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
			~ CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(enabling_control)

	player_state:DisableControls(disabled_control)
	message_system:SendSync(leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state))
end

-- 사이렌 연출
function local_class:directing_siren()
	local fade_out = 0.6
	local fade_in = 0.6

	self.is_siren_directing = true
	while self.is_siren_directing do
		field:Tint('siren', unity_color({ 0.6, 0, 0, 1 }), fade_out)
		wait_for_sec(fade_out)

		field:RemoveTint('siren', fade_in)
		wait_for_sec(fade_in)
	end
end

-- ExitInteractable의 Interactable를 원복하는 함수
function local_class:restore_exit_interact_fo()
	if self.exit_interact_fo == nil then
		return
	end

	-- ExitInteractable -> ExitInteractable로 원복
	for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
		local exit_fo = self.exit_interact_fo[i]
		exit_fo.Interactable = self.cached_exit[i]
	end

	self.exit_interact_fo = nil
	self.marker_fo_list = nil
	self.cached_exit = nil
end

-- ExitInteractable를 제어하기 위해 PublishInteractable로 변경하는 함수
function local_class:changed_exit_interact_fo()
	self.cached_exit = {}
	self.exit_interact_fo = {}

	local exit_names = nil

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		exit_names = { 'underpass_outer_1', 'underpass_inner_1', 'pyramid_inner_1'
		, 'pyramid_outer_1' }

		self.exit_teleport_names = { 'underpass_outer_1', 'underpass_inner_1', 'pyramid_inner_1'
		, 'pyramid_outer_1' }
	elseif stage.Name == self.before_stage_name then
		--TODO: 다른 곳 더 이동 가능하다면 추가해줘야함.
		exit_names = { 'underpass_inner_1', 'underpass_outer_1' }

		self.exit_teleport_names = { 'underpass_inner_1', 'underpass_outer_1', }
	end

	for i = 1, #exit_names do
		local exit_fo = get_field_object(exit_names[i])
		table.insert(self.cached_exit, exit_fo.Interactable)
		exit_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		table.insert(self.exit_interact_fo, exit_fo)
	end

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		self.marker_fo_list = { self.exit_interact_fo[3], self.exit_interact_fo[1], nil
		, self.exit_interact_fo[3] }
	elseif stage.Name == self.before_stage_name then
		local exit_fo = get_field_object('exit_passage_14_1')
		self.marker_fo_list = { exit_fo, self.exit_interact_fo[1] }
	end
end

	, self, self.exit_teleport_names[index], self.marker_fo_list[index]))

	-- 마커 재 조정
	local marker = field:GetMarker(marker_name)
	CS.Oak.TeleportPartyStageLogic.Execute(marker)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	end

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, quest_marker_name, quest_marker_fo, true)
end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	local exit_demonshire_2_4 = self.get_exit_demonshire_2_4()
	exit_demonshire_2_4.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	return true
end

		return
	end

	self:npc_setting()
	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.opening, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	time_util.unmod('qte')

	self.is_detected = true

	if self.runaway_loop_sfx then
		self.runaway_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.runaway_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.touch_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.touch_handler = nil
	end

	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end

	for i = 1, self.max_detecting_in_guard do
		local guard = self.get_in_guard(i)
		if self.stop_detecting[guard] then
			self.stop_detecting[guard] = true
		end
	end

	for i = 1, self.max_detecting_out_guard do
		local guard = self.get_out_guard(i)
		if self.stop_detecting[guard] then
			self.stop_detecting[guard] = true
		end
	end
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's9_meet_secretary') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_secretary, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.meeting_with_secretary and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's9_meet_vampire_captain') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_vampire_captain, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.meeting_with_vampire_captain and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's9_second_meet_secretary') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.second_meet_secretary, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.second_meeting_with_secretary and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's9_meet_count') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.meet_count, self))

		return true
	end

	if not self.is_add_moving_guard.first and self.current_progress >= self.progress_enum.meeting_with_count and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's9_move_detecting_guard_1') then

		self.is_add_moving_guard.first = true

		self:setting_add_guard_waypoint(1)

		return true
	end

	if not self.is_add_moving_guard.second and self.current_progress >= self.progress_enum.meeting_with_count and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's9_move_detecting_guard_2') then

		self.is_add_moving_guard.second = true

		self:setting_add_guard_waypoint(2)

		return true
	end

	if not self.is_add_moving_guard.third and self.current_progress >= self.progress_enum.meeting_with_count and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's9_move_detecting_guard_3') then

		self.is_add_moving_guard.third = true

		self:setting_add_guard_waypoint(3)

		return true
	end

	if not self.is_add_moving_guard.jump and self.current_progress >= self.progress_enum.meeting_with_count and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's9_move_detecting_guard_jump') then

		self.is_add_moving_guard.jump = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.setting_add_jump_guard_waypoint, self, self.get_out_guard(22)))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.setting_add_jump_guard_waypoint, self, self.get_out_guard(23)))

		return true
	end

	-- 퀘스트 마커 처리
	for _, marker_data in pairs(self.quest_marker_data) do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, marker_data.zone_name) then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, marker_data.get_target(), true)
			return true
		end
	end

	if self.zone_event_current_progress == self.zone_event_progress_enum.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's9_zone_event_1') then

		self.zone_event_current_progress = self.zone_event_current_progress + 1

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_guard_1, self))

		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's9_zone_event_4') and
		self.zone_event_current_progress == self.zone_event_progress_enum.talking_guard_1 then

		self.zone_event_current_progress = self.zone_event_current_progress + 1

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_guard_2, self))

		return true
	end

	if self.zone_event_current_progress == self.zone_event_progress_enum.talking_guard_2 and
			self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.meeting_with_count and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's9_zone_event_3') then

		self.zone_event_current_progress = self.zone_event_current_progress + 1

		self:reaction_zone_2()

		return true
	end

	if self.zone_event_current_progress == self.zone_event_progress_enum.reaction_zone_2 and
			self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.meeting_with_count and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's9_zone_event_2') then

		self.zone_event_current_progress = self.zone_event_current_progress + 1

		self:reaction_zone_3()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.is_detected then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.meeting_with_count and
		type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_exit_office_inner()) then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.exit_office_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.first_runaway and
		type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_exit_demonshire_2_4()) then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.exit_stage_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'can_cook_chasing_start' then

--- 비서를 만남
function local_class:meet_secretary()

		false, nil, nil, 'down')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard_2, guard_2.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1.5,

	-- 로얄가드2(down, idle, odle) : 용무가 있으신 분은 선약을 잡아주십시오.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_2, { key = 'ds_main_s9_2', skip = true })

	-- 가디언(up, attack, release2회)
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 로얄가드2(down, idle, ) : …백작님을 뵈러 왔다고요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_2, { key = 'ds_main_s9_3', skip = true })

	-- 로얄가드1(down, idle, ) : 백작님은 지금…

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	-- 대사 출력할 때 카메라 1칸 위로 이동
	-- 비서(down, idle, idle)  : 백작님은 바쁘시니 용건이 있다면 제게 말씀해 주세요.

		util.cs_generator(

		util.cs_generator(camera_util.move_async, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 1)
	})

	character_util.set_direction(guard_2, 'up')

	character_util.normal_jump(guard_2, '01_player_jump_01')

		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'victory_extra' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'happy')

		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

		character_util.set_emotion(secretary, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.normal_jump(secretary, '01_small_jump_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		-- 비서(down, smile, 점프 1회) : 뭘 좀 아시는 분이군요!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s9_10', skip = true })

		character_util.set_anim(secretary, { name = 'sing' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		-- 비서(down, smile, sing) :당연할 수밖에 없는 게, 데몬샤이어를 통치하시는 백작님은 마계에서 가장 멋지고 훌륭한…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s9_10_1', skip = true })

		character_util.set_anim(secretary, { name = 'sing', scale = 0 })
		-- 비서 sing 애니메이션 루프꺼주고 emoticon_bubble_silence
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(secretary, nil, 'silence')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(secretary)
		-- 비서(down, idle, idle) : 그런다고 외부인을 막 들여보내 줄 리는 없으니 용건이 없으면 돌아가세요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s9_11', skip = true })

		-- 대사 종료 후, 비서가 관저 입구를 막은 채 컨트롤 복귀
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(secretary)

		choose_util.play_choose_event({
			-- [리리스의 칙서를 건넨다.]
			{ 'ds_main_s9_9', 'mercy' }
		})
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')

	-- [리리스의 칙서를 건넨다.] 선택 시, 가디언 up, attack 1회 모션 후  paper_piece 나와서 비서가 획득한다

		{ pos = leader.Position, target = secretary.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.3),
		  itemid = 20572, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.75 })

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(leader, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(secretary)

	official_letter.ConsumeTarget = secretary
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 비서가 칙서 획득하고 right, bow_idle 자세로 칙서 들고 읽는 것처럼
	official_letter = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = secretary.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0.2),
		  itemid = 20572, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.75, showoncharacter = true })

	character_util.set_direction(secretary, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(secretary, { name = 'bow_idle' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')
	-- 비서(right, idle, bow_idle) : 이 칙서를 소지한 $name의 신원을 마왕 리리스가 보증하며…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s9_13', skip = true })

	-- 비서(right, tired, bow_idle) : 향후 인베이더의 침공에 대비하기 위해, $name에게 마나축퇴로를 양도해 줄 것을 요청한다…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s9_14', skip = true })

	official_letter:ConsumeComplete()
	character_util.set_direction(secretary, 'down')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(secretary, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(secretary, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	-- 비서(down, tired, bomb_idle) : 이런 헤실헤실한 사람이 마왕의 전령이라니…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s9_15', skip = true })

	-- 비서(down, idle, question) emoticon_bubble_silence
	character_util.set_anim(secretary, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(secretary, nil, 'silence')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(secretary)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	-- 비서(down, idle, idle) : 알겠습니다. 따라오시죠.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s9_16', skip = true })

	-- 대사 종료 후 비서가 건물로 들어가며 페이드

function local_class:meet_vampire_captain()

	character_util.normal_jump(vampire_captain, '01_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	-- 발렌시아 (right, attack, 점프 1회) : 그런데 관저에 들이는 것도 모자라 백작님께 알현시킨다고?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_captain, { key = 'ds_main_s9_16_2', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(secretary, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	-- 비서 (left, idle, release) : 마왕의 칙서를 가지고 온 전령이기에 백작님께 보고가 필요한 사항이에요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s9_16_3', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(secretary)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(secretary, { name = 'nod' })
	-- 비서 (left, idle, nod) : 이에 관한 건 제 업무이니 신경 끄시길.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s9_16_4', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_anim(secretary, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	-- 비서 (left, idle, bomb_idle) : 당신은 평소처럼 힘자랑이나 하면서 순찰 돌러 가시죠.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'ds_main_s9_16_5', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(secretary)

	-- 상단 대사 후 비서 왼쪽으로 걸어서 화면 밖으로 나감
	local secretary_waypoint = {
		secretary.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
		secretary.Position + vector(-7, 0, 1)
	}

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(secretary, secretary_waypoint, 3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(vampire_captain, 0.04, 0.3)
	-- 발렌시아 (left, attack, 짧은 쉐이크) : 전령 따위가 무슨 대수라고…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_captain, { key = 'ds_main_s9_16_6', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(vampire_captain)

	-- 리더 1칸 앞까지 이동
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(vampire_captain,
		vampire_captain.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0), 4)

	local vampire_captain_move_end_pos = leader.Position + vector(2, 0, 0)

	local qte_complete = false
	local time_over = false

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(vampire_captain,
			vampire_captain.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1)

		if not qte_complete then
			time_over = true
		end
	end))

	time_util.mod('qte' , 0.3)

	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
				qte_complete = true
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	-- 게임패드 사용중이면 이벤트 핸들러 세팅
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self.game_pad_handler = {
			callback = function(_, e)
				if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
					e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
					e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
					e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))
					return true
				end
				return false
			end
		}
	end

	-- 게임패드 핸들러가 세팅되있다면 게임패드 이벤트 구독
	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Subscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'callback')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('up')

	while not qte_complete and not time_over do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if qte_complete then
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 0)
	else
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	self.touch_handler = nil

	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end

	character_util.stop(vampire_captain)

	time_util.unmod('qte')

	if not qte_complete then
		-- 시간 안에 qte 성공 못 했을 때

		-- 가디언 위쪽으로 1타일 밀려나며 (left, confused, prostration)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_monster_01')
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0, 0.3, -0.3))
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'confused' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'prostrate' })
		character_util.move_to(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.2)

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(vampire_captain, vampire_captain_move_end_pos, 4)

		-- 발렌시아 left, idle, idle 보고 1초 대기
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(vampire_captain, 'left')

		character_util.set_emotion(vampire_captain, { name = 'attack' })
		-- 발렌시아(right, attack, idle) : 흥, 시시하군.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_captain, { key = 'ds_main_s9_16_10', skip = true })

	else
		-- 시간 안에 qte 성공 했을 때

		character_util.move_to(vampire_captain, leader.Position, 1.5, nil, true, true)

		-- 입력 시 가디언 (left, attack, get) 마리오 점프로 높게 뛴다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'get' })

		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 0.5
		local height = 2
		local start_height = 0

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_height, height, progress)
			leader.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, cur_y, 0)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		-- 가디언 공중에서 left, damaged, damaged 회전 (화려한 에어스핀)
		local air_spin_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_air_spin_01', loop = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 360 * 3, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		air_spin_sfx:Stop()

		-- 발렌시아가 아래를 지나가는 타이밍에  jingak 자세로 머리를 밟음
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_jump_01')
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'jingak', loop = false, scale = 1.5 })

		time_passed = 0
		duration = 0.5
		height = 1
		start_height = 2

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_height, height, progress)
			leader.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, cur_y, 0)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		-- 이때 발렌시아 (right, damaged, damaged2) + 레드펄스 + Squish
		character_util.set_emotion(vampire_captain, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.set_anim(vampire_captain, { name = 'damaged2' })
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(vampire_captain)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(vampire_captain)

		-- 발렌시아 머리에 fx_hit,  Fx_lasthit, 카메라 shake (강도 0.1) (시간 0.4)
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.4)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(vampire_captain.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0.3))
		self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(vampire_captain.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0.3))

		-- 머리를 밟고 가디언은 get 자세로 살짝 떠서 좌측에 착지.
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'get' })
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		-- 발렌시아는 밟히고 right, damaged, prostrate로 넘어짐
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
		character_util.set_anim(vampire_captain, { name = 'prostrate' })

		-- 각자 좌로 착지, 우로 넘어져서 둘 사이에 1타일 거리 존재
		character_util.move_to(vampire_captain,
			vampire_captain.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 0.3)
		character_util.move_to(leader, leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 0.3)

		time_passed = 0
		duration = 0.5
		height = 0
		start_height = 1

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local lerp_height = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_height, height, progress)
			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * 0.5 + lerp_height
			leader.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, cur_y, 0)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

		-- 0.5초 후 가디언 right ,doyagao, idle 이후 선택지 출력
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'doyagao' })

		local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			-- 선택지: 같은 걸 두 번 당하진 않아요. (초록색)
			{ 'ds_main_s9_16_7', 'mercy' },
			-- 선택지: 다시는 전령을 무시하지 마라.(보라색)
			{ 'ds_main_s9_16_8', 'forced' },
			-- 선택지: 느리구나, 쓰러지는 것조차.(붉은색)
			{ 'ds_main_s9_16_9', 'brutal' }
		})

		if player_choice == 1 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
			-- Right, smile, nod
			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'nod' })

		elseif player_choice == 2 then
			-- Right, attack, victory_get
			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
			character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
			wait_for_sec(1.5)

		elseif player_choice == 3 then
			-- Right, sleep_Deep, cross_arm
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
			character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'cross_arm' })
			wait_for_sec(1)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		-- 발렌시아 right, damaged, prostrate 짧은 shake 2회 후
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(vampire_captain, 0.04, 0.7)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(vampire_captain, 0.04, 0.7)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 마리오 점프로 일어난 뒤 (left, attack, 부들부들) emoticon_bubble_angry
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(vampire_captain)
		character_util.set_direction(vampire_captain, 'left')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
		character_util.mario_jump_async(vampire_captain, 'left')

		character_util.set_emotion(vampire_captain, { name = 'attack' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(vampire_captain, 0.04, 2.5)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(vampire_captain, nil, 'angry')

		-- 발렌시아 (left, attack, idle): 백작님이 내리신 명으로 가봐야 할 일만 없었다면…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_captain, { key = 'ds_main_s9_16_11', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_emotion(vampire_captain)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(vampire_captain, 'right')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
		-- 발렌시아 (right, idle, idle) : 네놈은 여기서 절명했을 것이다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_captain, { key = 'ds_main_s9_16_12', skip = true })

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(vampire_captain, vampire_captain_move_end_pos, 4)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(vampire_captain)

	-- 발렌시아 대사 종료 후 다시 화면 오른쪽으로 이동하여 퇴장.
	local vampire_captain_waypoint = {
		vampire_captain.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
		vampire_captain.Position + vector(3, 0, -5)
	}

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(vampire_captain, vampire_captain_waypoint, 4)

	local secretary_hallway_pos = self.get_secretary_hallway_pos()
	secretary.Position = secretary_hallway_pos
	character_util.set_direction(secretary, 'down')

	character_util.set_active_state(vampire_captain, 'disabled')

	-- 카메라 돌아옴, 컨트롤 풀림. 비서 위치 붉은점(마커)
	if not qte_complete then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local secretary = self.get_secretary()

	local count_daughter = self.get_count_daughter()

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

	character_util.move_waypoint(secretary, secretary.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 2)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 2)

		{ sfx_name = '01_fire_05', loop = true, fade_in_time = 3, play_pos = office_center, volume = 0.5 })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })

	-- 비서(up, idle, idle) : 백작님.

	-- 비서(up, idle, idle) : 손님이 오셨습니다.

		guard_3.Position + vector(2.4, 0, 0),

		true, nil, nil, 'down', true)

		4, true, nil, nil, 'right')

	character_util.set_emotion(secretary, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(secretary, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.move_to_async(secretary,
		secretary.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), nil, 1.5)

	character_util.set_emotion(secretary, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_walk_06')

	character_util.set_direction(secretary, 'up')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })

-- 가드들의 감시에 걸렸을 때
function local_class:on_detected(guard)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	self.attack_range_renderer[guard]:Update(guard)

	party_util.look_at(guard)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'surprise' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'embarrassed' })
	party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)

	character_util.set_anim(guard, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

	for _, detecting_guard in pairs(self.current_detecting_guards) do
		character_util.stop(detecting_guard)
		character_util.set_emotion(detecting_guard, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim(detecting_guard, { name = 'release' })
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	-- 로얄가드(attack, release): [shout] 잡아라!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard, { key = 'ds_main_s9_47', bubble_type = 'shout' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	for _, detecting_guard in pairs(self.current_detecting_guards) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(detecting_guard)
	end

	self:setting_detecting_guard()

	local reset_pos
	local reset_dir

	-- 분기별 세팅
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.meeting_with_count then
		reset_pos = self.get_reset_party_pos(1)
		reset_dir = 'up'

		self.zone_event_current_progress = self.zone_event_progress_enum.talking_guard_2

		self:zone_event_npc_setting()
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.first_runaway then
		reset_pos = self.get_reset_party_pos(2)
		reset_dir = 'up'

		self.stop_detecting[self.get_out_guard(22)] = true
		self.stop_detecting[self.get_out_guard(23)] = true

		table.remove(self.current_detecting_guards)
		table.remove(self.current_detecting_guards)
	end

	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.position_party(reset_pos, reset_dir, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	self.is_detected = false

	self:setting_guard_waypoint()

	self.is_add_moving_guard.first = false
	self.is_add_moving_guard.second = false
	self.is_add_moving_guard.third = false
	self.is_add_moving_guard.jump = false
end

--- 감시 체크 업데이트
function local_class:detect_update(fo)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	local sight_distance = self.detecting_data[fo].sight_distance
	local sight_angle = self.detecting_data[fo].sight_angle

	local attack_range_renderer = CS.Oak.GhostGuardAttackRangeRenderer(fo, sight_distance, sight_angle)
	self.attack_range_renderer[fo] = attack_range_renderer
	attack_range_renderer.AttackRange:Show(0)

	while not self.stop_detecting[fo] do
		if not self.is_detected and self:is_in_sight(fo, leader) then
			self.is_detected = true

			self:on_detected(fo)
		end

		attack_range_renderer:Update(fo)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	attack_range_renderer:Dispose()
	self.attack_range_renderer[fo] = nil
end

--- 플레이어가 감시에 보이는지 체크
function local_class:is_in_sight(fo, target)
	local diff = target.Position - fo.Position

	local sight_distance = self.detecting_data[fo].sight_distance
	local sight_angle = self.detecting_data[fo].sight_angle

	if diff.magnitude > sight_distance then
		return false
	end

	diff.y = 0

	if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized, direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)) > sight_angle / 2 then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

--- 가드들 감시 세팅
function local_class:setting_detecting_guard()
	-- 몇 번째 도망 이벤트인지
	local part_num

	-- 세팅할 npc 시작 번호
	local start_index

	-- 세팅할 npc 끝 번호
	local end_index

	-- 분기별 세팅
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.meeting_with_count then
		part_num = 1
		start_index = 3
		end_index = self.max_detecting_in_guard
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.first_runaway then
		part_num = 2
		start_index = 1
		end_index = self.max_detecting_out_guard
	end

	for i = start_index, end_index do
		local guard
		if part_num == 1 then
			guard = self.get_in_guard(i)
		elseif part_num == 2 then
			guard = self.get_out_guard(i)
		end

		local detect_pos = self.get_detecting_guard_pos(part_num, i)
		local detect_dir = self.get_detecting_guard_dir(part_num, i)

		guard.Position = detect_pos
		character_util.set_direction(guard, detect_dir)
		if self.attack_range_renderer[guard] then
			self.attack_range_renderer[guard]:Update(guard)
		end

		-- 점프 가드들 예외 처리
		if part_num == 2 and (i == 22 or i == 23) then
			self.stop_detecting[guard] = true
		end
	end
end

--- 가드들 이동 세팅
function local_class:setting_guard_waypoint()
	-- 몇 번째 도망 이벤트인지
	local part_num

	-- 세팅할 npc 번호
	local guard_index = {}

	local waypoint_index = 2

	local speed

	-- 분기별 세팅
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.meeting_with_count then
		part_num = 1
		guard_index = { 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 }
		speed = 5.5
		waypoint_index = 3

		-- 0.5초 뒤에 출발
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		if self.is_detected then
			return
		end

	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.first_runaway then
		part_num = 2
		guard_index = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 }
		speed = 4.5
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')

	for _, i in pairs(guard_index) do
		local guard
		if part_num == 1 then
			guard = self.get_in_guard(i)
		elseif part_num == 2 then
			guard = self.get_out_guard(i)
		end

		local waypoints = {}
		for index = 1, waypoint_index do
			local waypoint = self.get_detecting_guard_waypoint(part_num, i, index)
			table.insert(waypoints, waypoint)
		end

		character_util.move_waypoint(guard, waypoints, speed, true)
	end
end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.meeting_with_count then

			speed = 4

			speed = 4
			waypoint_count = 1

		elseif index == 3 then
			start_index = 11
			end_index = 15
			speed = 5.5
			waypoint_count = 4
		end

	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.first_runaway then
		part_num = 2
		if index == 1 then
			start_index = 7
			end_index = 15
			speed = 4

		elseif index == 2 then
			start_index = 16
			end_index = 19
			speed = 2

		elseif index == 3 then
			start_index = 19
			end_index = 21
			speed = 2
		end

	for i = start_index, end_index do

			speed = 0.6
		elseif part_num == 2 and i > 6 and i < 11 then
			speed = 5.5
		end

		local guard
		if part_num == 1 then
			guard = self.get_in_guard(i)
		elseif part_num == 2 then

	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'get' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(target, 0.7, duration)
	character_util.move_to_async(target,
		target.Position + vector(2 * move_dir_vector.x, -1, 0), duration)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_direction(target, 'down')

	self.stop_detecting[target] = false
	self.detecting_data[target] = {
		sight_distance = self.sight_distance,
		sight_angle = self.sight_angle
	}

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.detect_update, self, target))

end

function local_class:exit_office_event()
	self.is_detected = true

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_zone_event_npc(1), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_zone_event_npc(2), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_exit_guard(1), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_exit_guard(2), 'disabled')

	-- 안의 감시병 전부 감시 종료
	for i = 3, self.max_detecting_in_guard do
		local in_guard = self.get_in_guard(i)
		character_util.stop(in_guard)
		self.stop_detecting[in_guard] = false
	end

	self.current_detecting_guard = {}

	-- 밖의 감시병들 활성화
	for i = 1, self.max_detecting_out_guard do
		if i ~= 22 and i ~= 23 then
			local  out_guard = self.get_out_guard(i)

			local sight_distance = self.sight_distance
			local sight_angle = self.sight_angle

			if i > 6 and i < 11 then
				sight_distance = sight_distance + 1.5
				sight_angle = sight_angle + 20
			end

			self.stop_detecting[out_guard] = false
			self.detecting_data[out_guard] = {
				sight_distance = sight_distance,
				sight_angle = sight_angle
			}

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.detect_update, self, out_guard))
			table.insert(self.current_detecting_guards, out_guard)
		end
	end

	self:setting_detecting_guard()

	-- 밖의 npc나 상호작용 막기
	self.get_exit_office_outer().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'main_s9_start_chase' }))

	local reset_party_pos = self.get_reset_party_pos(2)
	party_util.align_party(reset_party_pos, 'up', 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	-- 친위대: 잡아라!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
		{ key = 'ds_main_s9_47', bubble_type = 'shout', type_speed = 0,
		  world_pos = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 1.5), life_time = 1 })

	self:setting_guard_waypoint()

	self.is_detected = false
	self.is_add_moving_guard.first = false
	self.is_add_moving_guard.second = false
	self.is_add_moving_guard.third = false

	self.runaway_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_npc_runaway_02', loop = true })
end

	}

	-- 트레이닝 체크용

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_botanist()) then
		if self.current_progress <= self.progress.talk_botanist then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.botanist_first_talk, self)
			return true
		elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.training_out then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.training_restart, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_mandrake_trainer(1)) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.battle_training, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_mandrake_trainer(2)) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.water_training, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_mandrake_trainer(3)) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.part_time_training, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.talk_zone_name) and
			self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mandrake_attack_routine, self))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.training_out_zone_name) and
			self.current_progress == self.progress.start_training then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.training_center_out, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.talk_zone_name) and
			self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
		self.req_cnt = self.req_cnt + 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.swipe_type = 'left'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.swipe_type = 'right'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
		self.swipe_type = 'up'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'down'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'tap'
		self.turbo_tap_count = self.turbo_tap_count + 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 입장 시 보여주는 맨드레이크 공격 루틴
function local_class:mandrake_attack_routine()
	self.req_cnt = self.req_cnt + 1
	local req_cnt = self.req_cnt
	local botanist = self.get_botanist()
	local mandrake = self.get_mandrake_member()

	while req_cnt == self.req_cnt do
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(mandrake, { name = 'attack' })
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_comic_01',
									 parent = botanist, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(botanist, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(botanist, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
		if not music_player_util.is_voice_available() then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_creature_05',
										 parent = mandrake, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		end
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mandrake, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_2' })
	end
end
