--- 배틀 트레이닝
function local_class:battle_training()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local trainer = self.get_mandrake_trainer(1)
	local mandrake = self.get_mandrake_member()
	local center_pos = self.get_training_pos(1)
	local invader_1 = self.get_invader_npc(1)
	local invader_2 = self.get_invader_npc(2)
	local invader_3 = self.get_invader_npc(3)
	local trainer_pos = trainer.Position

	party_util.align_party(trainer, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.look_at(trainer, leader)

	if not self.training_talk_check.battle then
		self.training_talk_check.battle = true

		--전사(right,idle,idle):맨드레이크들은 엄청난 에너지를 품고있지.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(trainer, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_30', skip = true })

		--전사(right,idle,cross arm):철저한 단련으로 배출 시켜주지 않으면 뿌리가 썩어버릴거야.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim(trainer, { name = 'cross_arm' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(trainer, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_31', skip = true })
	end

	--전사(right,idle,release):어떤가, 한번 검투사들과 맞서 보겠나? (다시 말걸면)
	character_util.play_speech_action(trainer, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' },
			{ name = 'idle' }, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_32', skip = true })

	-- 선택지 예 아니오
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { 'ds_mandrake_maker_13', 'intellect' }, { 'ds_mandrake_maker_14', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 2 then
		--아니요
		--전사(right,idle,idle):그렇군.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(trainer, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_34', skip = true })
		character_util.set_direction(trainer, 'down')
		return
	end

	--예
	--전사(right,idle,idle):그럼 바로 시작하도록 하지.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(trainer, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_33', skip = true })

	--가디언이 안으로 들어간다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(mandrake, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(invader_1, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(invader_2, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(invader_3, 'down')

	if not self.training_restart_check.battle then
		self.training_restart_check.battle = true

		--전사(right,idle,idle): 이 장비가 필요할 걸세…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(trainer, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_35', skip = true })

		--전사 NPC가 VR기기를 던져준다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		character_util.set_direction(mandrake, 'left')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(trainer, { name = 'throw' })

		local vr_item_id = 20574
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
		drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = trainer.Position, target = leader.Position,
									 itemid = vr_item_id, notforinven = true, skip_text = false })
		local mandrake_vr = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = trainer.Position, target = mandrake.Position,
														 itemid = vr_item_id, notforinven = true, skip_text = false })
		mandrake_vr.ConsumeTarget = mandrake

		wait_for_sec(2)

		--맨드레이크와 가디언이 맨드레이크 (left,smile,idle) 가디언 (right,smile,idle)로 바뀌고 왼쪽 오른쪽 한번 돌아보고 VR기기를 장착한다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(mandrake, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'smile' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		local equip_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true
		, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'player' })
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'eat' })
		character_util.set_anim(mandrake, { name = 'eat' })
		wait_for_sec(1)
		equip_sfx:Stop()
		equip_sfx = nil

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'vr' })
		character_util.set_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'vr' })
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		character_util.remove_anim(mandrake)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		-- 위치 세팅
		character_util.set_position(leader, center_pos - vector(0, 0, 6.5))
		character_util.set_position(mandrake, center_pos - vector(0, 0, 7.2))
		character_util.set_position(invader_1, center_pos + vector(5.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_position(invader_2, center_pos - vector(5.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_position(invader_3, center_pos + vector(0, 0, 5))
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mandrake)
		character_util.hide_weapon(leader, true)

		-- 손님 세팅
		character_util.add_color(invader_1, 'dark_tint', unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
		character_util.add_color(invader_2, 'dark_tint', unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
		character_util.add_color(invader_3, 'dark_tint', unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(invader_1, 0, 0)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(invader_2, 0, 0)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(invader_3, 0, 0)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_2)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_3)

		-- 카메라 정렬
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4.5, 0)
		camera_util.move_async(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.2)

		-- field tint
		field:Tint('dark_tint', unity_color({ 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1 }), 0)

		local cave_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_cave_01', type_priority = 'event', loop = true })
		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		-- 가디언과 맨드레이크가 각각 오른쪽 왼쪽에 선다
		local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc', })
		character_util.move_waypoint(leader, { center_pos, center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0) },
				4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(mandrake, { center_pos, center_pos - vector(0.5, 0, 0) },
				4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
		dash_sfx:Stop()

		wait_for_sec(1)

		--왼쪽 오른쪽 위쪽 (위에 숫자순)으로 불이 켜지면서 검게칠해진 캐릭터들이 보인다.
		--각각 불이 켜질때마다 맨드레이크와 가디언은 켜진쪽을 바라본다.
		command_util.execute_burn(nil, self.get_mandrake_brazier(1), false)
		command_util.execute_burn(nil, self.get_mandrake_brazier(2), false)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(invader_2, 1, 0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
		character_util.look_at(leader, invader_2)
		character_util.look_at(mandrake, invader_2)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		command_util.execute_burn(nil, self.get_mandrake_brazier(3), false)
		command_util.execute_burn(nil, self.get_mandrake_brazier(4), false)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(invader_3, 1, 0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
		character_util.look_at(leader, invader_3)
		character_util.look_at(mandrake, invader_3)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		command_util.execute_burn(nil, self.get_mandrake_brazier(5), false)
		command_util.execute_burn(nil, self.get_mandrake_brazier(6), false)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(invader_1, 1, 0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
		character_util.look_at(leader, invader_1)
		character_util.look_at(mandrake, invader_1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--가디언(right,attack,rifle_idle) 맨드레이크 (left,attack,idle)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(mandrake, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'rifle_idle' }, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'attack' })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--각각 세방향의 그림자가 그려진 방향대로 동시에 맨드레이크가 가디언쪽으로 다가온다
		--화면이 클로즈업 된다.
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 1.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_slowmotion_01' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_walk_03' })
		character_util.move_waypoint(invader_1, invader_1.Position - vector(1.5, 0, 0),
				1, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
		character_util.move_waypoint(invader_2, invader_2.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0),
				1, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(invader_3, invader_3.Position - vector(0, 0, 1.5),
				1, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')

		camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
		field:RemoveTint('dark_tint', 0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_light_turn_off_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
		cave_sfx:FadeOut()
		character_util.remove_color(invader_1, 'dark_tint', 1)
		character_util.remove_color(invader_2, 'dark_tint', 1)
		character_util.remove_color(invader_3, 'dark_tint', 1)
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		-- 위치 세팅
		character_util.set_position(leader, center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_position(mandrake, center_pos - vector(0.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(mandrake, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'rifle_idle' }, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.hide_weapon(leader, true)

		-- 인베이더 NPC 배치
		character_util.set_position(invader_1, center_pos + vector(4, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_position(invader_2, center_pos - vector(4, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_position(invader_3, center_pos + vector(0, 0, 3.5))
		character_util.reset_all_state(invader_1, 'left')
		character_util.reset_all_state(invader_2, 'right')
		character_util.reset_all_state(invader_3, 'down')

		camera_util.move_async(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.3)

		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_battle_event', state = 'event' })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--(1) 위,(2) 오른쪽,(3) 왼쪽 연속 출력
	--인베이더(left,(1) gauntlet_handskill2 -> left, (2)gauntlet_combo_attack->left,(3) gauntlet_kick)
	--가디언(right,(1) gauntlet_handskill, (2)attack ,(3) gauntlet_kick2)
	camera_util.move(center_pos + vector(1, 0, 1), 1)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 1)

	character_util.remove_anim(invader_1)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(invader_1, leader.Position + vector(0.7, 0, 0),
			3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local training_success = true
	local success_count = 0
	local end_attack_check = false
	if self:qte_action(leader, invader_1, { type = 'up', duration = 2.5 }, 'gauntlet_handskill',
			'gauntlet_handskill2', 0.2, 0.2, false,
			'02_twohand_stomp_jump_01', '02_normal_slash_01') then
		success_count = success_count + 1
	end

	if self:qte_action(leader, invader_1, { type = 'right', duration = 2.5 }, 'attack',
			'gauntlet_combo_attack', 0.1, 0.2, false,
			{ '01_swing_01', '01_hit_comic_01' }, '02_energy_fist_03') then
		success_count = success_count + 1
	end

	if success_count >= 1 then
		end_attack_check = true
	end

	if self:qte_action(leader, invader_1, { type = 'left', duration = 2.5 }, 'gauntlet_kick2',
			'gauntlet_kick', 0.2, 0.2, end_attack_check,
			'02_energy_fist_03', { '01_villain_scream_03', '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01' }) then
		success_count = success_count + 2
	end

	--커맨드 3번 중 2번 이상 성공하면 성공 처리
	if success_count >= 3 then
		--인베이더 dead1 모션 유지
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_demon_01')
		character_util.air_spin(invader_1)

		camera_util.move(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.5)
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)

		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	else
		camera_util.move(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.5)
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)


		--가디언(right,tired,rifle_idle)
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim(invader_1)
		character_util.move_to_async(invader_1, invader_1.Position + vector(4.3, 0, 0),
				nil, 3, false, true)
		training_success = false
	end

	if training_success then
		--function local_class:qte_action(party, enemy, qte_info, user_anim, enemy_anim, user_delay, enemy_delay)
		--(1) 위, (2)아래, (3)아래 연속 출력
		--인베이더 (right, (1)gauntlet_kick2 -> right,(2) gauntlet_kick -> right, (3)gauntlet_handskill)
		--맨드레이크 (left, gauntlet_handskill,dualgun_attack, gauntlet_kick)
		camera_util.move(center_pos + vector(-1, 0, 1), 1)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 1)

		character_util.remove_anim(invader_2)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(invader_2, mandrake.Position - vector(0.7, 0, 0),
				3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		success_count = 0
		end_attack_check = false
		if self:qte_action(mandrake, invader_2, { type = 'up', duration = 2.5 }, 'gauntlet_handskill',
				'gauntlet_kick2', 0.2, 0.2, false,
				'02_twohand_stomp_jump_01', '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01') then
			success_count = success_count + 1
		end

		if self:qte_action(mandrake, invader_2, { type = 'down', duration = 2.5 }, 'boong_attack',
				'gauntlet_kick', 0.1, 0.2, false,
				'02_normal_slash_01', '02_fire_harpy_jump_01') then
			success_count = success_count + 1
		end

		if success_count >= 1 then
			end_attack_check = true
		end

		if self:qte_action(mandrake, invader_2, { type = 'down', duration = 2.5 }, 'gauntlet_kick',
				'gauntlet_handskill', 0.3, 0.3, end_attack_check,
				'02_fire_harpy_jump_01', { '01_villain_scream_04', '02_energy_fist_01' }) then
			success_count = success_count + 2
		end


		--커맨드 3번 중 2번 이상 성공하면 성공 처리
		if success_count >= 3 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_villain_01')
			character_util.air_spin(invader_2, { offset = unity_class.vector3.left * 3 })

			camera_util.move(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.5)
			camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)

			wait_for_sec(1.5)
		else
			camera_util.move(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.5)
			camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)

			--가디언(right,tired,rifle_idle)
			character_util.set_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'tired' })
			wait_for_sec(1)

			character_util.remove_anim(invader_2)
			character_util.move_to_async(invader_2, invader_2.Position - vector(4.3, 0, 0),
					nil, 3, false, true)
			training_success = false
		end
	end

	if training_success then
		--위쪽 인베이더 바로 앞까지 나오고 QTE발생
		--빠르지 않게 -(1) 위,(2) 아래,(3) 연타 연속 출력
		--인베이더 (down,(1) bomb_attack ->down, (2)throw->down, (3)attack)
		--가디언과 맨드레이크 up 상태로 모션 (up,((1)bomb_attack,(2)throw,(3)attack) )
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 1)

		character_util.remove_anim(invader_3)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(invader_3, center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1),
				3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
		character_util.set_direction(mandrake, 'up')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		success_count = 0
		end_attack_check = false
		if self:qte_action({ leader, mandrake }, invader_3, { type = 'up', duration = 2.5 },
				'bomb_attack', 'bomb_attack', 0.2, 0.2, false,
				'02_normal_slash_01', '02_normal_slash_01') then
			success_count = success_count + 1
		end

		if self:qte_action({ leader, mandrake }, invader_3, { type = 'down', duration = 2.5 },
				'throw', 'throw', 0.1, 0.2, false,
				'02_normal_slash_01', '02_energy_fist_01') then
			success_count = success_count + 1
		end

		if success_count >= 1 then
			end_attack_check = true
		end

		if self:qte_action({ leader, mandrake }, invader_3, { type = 'tap', duration = 2.5 },
				'attack', 'attack', 0.2, 0.2, end_attack_check,
				'02_twohand_stomp_jump_01', { '02_die_fat_ogre_01', '02_normal_slash_01' }) then
			success_count = success_count + 2
		end

		--커맨드 3번 중 2번 이상 성공하면 성공 처리
		if success_count >= 3 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_03')
			character_util.air_spin(invader_3)

			camera_util.move(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.5)
			camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)

			wait_for_sec(1.5)
		else
			camera_util.move(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.5)
			camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)

			character_util.remove_anim(invader_3)
			character_util.move_to_async(invader_3, invader_3.Position + vector(0, 0, 3.5),
					nil, 3, false, true)
			training_success = false
		end
	end

	--QTE 이벤트 종료.
	--성공 시 (3명 중 2명 이김)
	--가디언과 맨드레이크 마주 보며 victory_get
	if training_success then
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		character_util.look_at(leader, mandrake)
		character_util.look_at(mandrake, leader)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false }, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false }, { name = 'smile' })
		wait_for_sec(2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	else
		--맨드레이크(left,scared,idle)가디언(right,scared,idle)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(mandrake, 'left')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'scared' })
		wait_for_sec(2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	end

	--이후 페이드아웃.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 위치 정렬
	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	character_util.set_position(trainer, trainer_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(trainer, 'right')
	party_util.align_party(trainer, 'right', 0, 'linear')

	if training_success then
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
		character_util.set_direction(mandrake, 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
	else
		--퇴장 위치에서 가디언(right,scared,idle) 맨드레이크(left,scared,idle)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(mandrake, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.set_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'scared' })
	end

	character_util.hide_weapon(leader, false)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if training_success then
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--성공 시
		--나레이션 박스 : 맨드레이크이(가) 힘이 8올랐다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_level_up_lobby_01')
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_36' })

		--나레이션 박스 꺼진 후에 가디언(down,idle,idle)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')

		--맨드레이크(down,idle,idle): 진짜 인베이더를 무찌른 것 같았어.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mandrake, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_37', skip = true })

		--맨드레이크(down,smile,unique/walk):아까 그 인간보다 때리는맛이 있었어!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_05')
		character_util.play_speech_action(mandrake, { name = 'unique/walk', sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' },
				{ name = 'smile' }, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_38', skip = true })

		--원라인 대사 전사(down,idle,idle) 이 자료면 다음에 넣을 맨드레이크 괴물의 생동감이 살겠군!
		character_util.set_direction(trainer, 'down')
		character_util.remove_relate_event(trainer, self.controller)
		trainer.Interactable.Talk = 'ds_mandrake_maker_39'
		trainer.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01'

		self.current_training = self.current_training | self.training_option.training_battle

		if self.current_training == self.training_option.training_all then
			self:training_end()
		end
	else
		--실패 시
		--나레이션 박스 : 형편없이 져버렸다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_38_1' })

		--맨드레이크(left,scared,idle)(jump1회): 지…진짜 죽는 줄 알았어…
		character_util.normal_jump(mandrake, true)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.play_speech_action(mandrake, { name = 'idle' },
				{ name = 'scared' }, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_38_2', skip = true })

		--가디언(left,idle,idle),맨드레이크(left,idle,idle)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

		--전사(right,mad,release) : 그런식이면 아무런 의미가 없네! 다시 해보게나.
		character_util.play_speech_action(trainer, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' },
				{ name = 'mad' }, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_38_3', skip = true })

		character_util.set_direction(trainer, 'down')
	end
end

function local_class:qte_action(party, enemy, qte_info, user_anim, enemy_anim,
								user_delay, enemy_delay, end_attack, user_sfx, enemy_sfx)
	if self:qte_swipe(qte_info) then
		if type_util.is_array(party) then
			for key, value in pairs(party) do
				character_util.set_animation_n_times(value, { name = user_anim })
			end
		else
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(party, { name = user_anim })
		end

		if type_util.is_array(user_sfx) then
			for key, value in pairs(user_sfx) do
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(value)
			end
		else
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(user_sfx)
		end

		wait_for_sec(user_delay)
		self:tint_damaged_target(enemy, end_attack)
		return true
	else
		if type_util.is_array(enemy_sfx) then
			for key, value in pairs(enemy_sfx) do
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(value)
			end
		else
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(enemy_sfx)
		end

		character_util.set_animation_n_times(enemy, { name = enemy_anim })
		wait_for_sec(enemy_delay)

		if type_util.is_array(party) then
			for key, value in pairs(party) do
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.tint_damaged_target, self, value, false))
			end
			wait_for_sec(0.4)
		else
			self:tint_damaged_target(party, false)
		end
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:tint_damaged_target(target, end_attack)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_monster_01')
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(target.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(target.Direction) * 0.3 + vector(0, 0.4, 0))
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.2)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)

	if not end_attack then
		character_util.remove_anim(target)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(target, { name = 'damaged' }, { name = 'damaged' })
		wait_for_sec(0.4)

		character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'attack' })
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, get_party_leader()) then
			character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
		else
			character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'idle' })
		end
	end
end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_in'):Instantiate(sauna_leader.Position)
	character_util.move_to_async(sauna_leader, sauna_leader.Position - down_pos, 0.3)
	--이후 QTE 시작 - 버튼 연타.

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mandrake, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_45', skip = true })

		character_util.play_speech_action(mandrake, { name = 'idle' },
				{ name = 'smile' }, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_46', skip = true })

		--뱀파이어남성(down,doyagao,idle)키히히… 다음엔 여길 맨드레이크 욕탕이라고 소개하고…
		character_util.set_direction(trainer, 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(trainer, { name = 'doyagao' })
		character_util.remove_relate_event(trainer, self.controller)
		trainer.Interactable.Talk = 'ds_mandrake_maker_47'
		trainer.Interactable.TalkSfx = '01_male_laugh_at_01'

		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

		self.current_training = self.current_training | self.training_option.training_water

		if self.current_training == self.training_option.training_all then
			self:training_end()
		end
	else
		--나레이션 박스 : 충분히 쉬지 못한 느낌이다…
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_43_4' })

		--가디언(left,scared,idle),맨드레이크(left,doyagao,idle)

		--맨드레이크(left,doyagao,idle): 너랑은 시시해서 오래 탕에 못있겠어!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mandrake, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_43_5', skip = true })

		--가디언(left,idle,idle),맨드레이크(left,idle,idle)
		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
		character_util.remove_emotion(mandrake)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		character_util.set_direction(mandrake, 'left')

		--온천 앞 NPC(right,attack,release) : 저런, 다시 몸을 충분히 담그고 오는게 좋겠네!
		character_util.play_speech_action(trainer, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' },
				{ name = 'attack' }, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_43_6', skip = true })

		character_util.set_direction(trainer, 'down')
	end
end

		character_util.set_emotion(civilian_1, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civilian_1, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_53_17', skip = true })
	end

	local training_clear = true

	if choose_result == 1 then

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_07')
		self.fx_twinkle = self.get_fx_twinkle():Instantiate(mandrake.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, mandrake.Transform)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'dance' }, { name = 'smile' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--손님(right,tired,seat) : 잠깐만 이건…주변 공기가!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(civilian_1, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civilian_1, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_53_3', skip = true })

		wait_for_sec(1)

		--손님(right,blush,seat) : 아…상쾌해, 마치 하늘을 나는 기분?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(civilian_1, { name = 'blush' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civilian_1, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_53_4', skip = true })

		self.fx_twinkle:Dispose()
		self.fx_twinkle = nil
	else
		--맨드레이크(left,doyagao,sing)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'doyagao' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--손님(right,tired,seat) : 빈말은 더 이상 듣고 싶지 않아.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_sigh_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(civilian_1, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civilian_1, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_53_6', skip = true })

		--맨드레이크(left,tired,idle) 1초
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_emotion(mandrake)

		training_clear = false
	end

	--노래 하기 (맞는 선택지) 애교 부리기(틀린 선택지)
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'ds_mandrake_maker_53_7', 'intellect' },
													{ 'ds_mandrake_maker_53_10', 'mercy' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'sing' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--손님(right,tired,seat) : 자…잠깐 맨드레이크는 끔찍한 소리를…

		character_util.set_emotion(civilian_1, { name = 'surprise' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civilian_1, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_53_8', skip = true })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--손님(right,blush,seat) : 아…이 산뜻함, 드림 테라피보다 좋을지도?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(civilian_1, { name = 'blush' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civilian_1, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_53_9', skip = true })
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'victory_extra' }, { name = 'smile' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--손님(right,tired,seat) : 그래…노력은 가상하네.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_sigh_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(civilian_1, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civilian_1, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_53_11', skip = true })

		--맨드레이크(left,tired,idle) 1초
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		training_clear = false
	end

	if not training_clear then
		--손님(right,tired,seat) : 뭔가 기대했던 것보다는 별로인데…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(civilian_1, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civilian_1, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_53_12', skip = true })

		--손님(right,tired,seat) : 이래서 신생 사업은 믿는 게 아닌데.
		character_util.set_emotion(civilian_1, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civilian_1, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_53_13', skip = true })

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	else
		--손님(right,doyagao,seat) : 굉장해! 몸도 마음도 상쾌해지다니!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(civilian_1, { name = 'doyagao' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civilian_1, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_53_14', skip = true })

		--손님(right,smile.seat) : 좋았어! 결심했어!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(civilian_1, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civilian_1, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_53_15', skip = true })

		--손님(right,smile.seat) : 집으로 돌아가면 맨드레이크 하나 주문해야겠어!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civilian_1, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_53_16', skip = true })

		character_util.set_direction(mandrake, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mandrake,
				{ name = 'unique/walk', sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' }, { name = 'smile' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(mandrake, nil, 'heart')
	end

	--페이드 아웃 되면서 서큐버스 인력 사무소 앞으로
	loop_sfx:FadeOut()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- npc 세팅
	character_util.set_position(leader, trainer.Position - vector(0, 0, 1))
	character_util.set_position(mandrake, trainer.Position + vector(1, 0, 1))
	character_util.set_direction(mandrake, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(trainer, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim(mandrake)

	if training_clear then
		character_util.set_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'doyagao' })
	else
		character_util.set_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'tired' })
	end

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(mandrake, 0, 0)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.1)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--가디언(left,idle,idle)은 밖에서 대기하고 있고 맨드레이크(down,doyagao,idle)가 사무소에서 나온다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_door_push_01')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(mandrake, 1, 1)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(mandrake, leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1,
			false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')

	if training_clear then
		--가디언(down,idle.idle)->(right,smile,idle)
		character_util.look_at(leader, mandrake)
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })

		--서큐버스(down,smile.hold_loop) : 오오! 열심히 일했구나. 보수를 50%추가해 줄게.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.play_speech_action(trainer, { name = 'hold_loop' }, { name = 'smile' },
				{ key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_54', skip = true })

		--나레이션 박스: 자존감이 8올랐다! 정기를 1260 받았다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_level_up_lobby_01')
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_55' })

		--가디언의 성공포즈 (right,smile,victory) 나레이션 박스 꺼진 후 (down,idle,idle)
		--나레이션 박스 : 맨드레이크이(가) 불량해진 거 같다!
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_56' })

		--맨드레이크(down,tired,idle): 후후 역시 나 맨드레이크님은 만능이라니까.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		character_util.play_speech_action(mandrake, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' },
				{ key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_57', skip = true })

		--맨드레이크(down,smile,idle) 점프1회 :모두 나를 찬향하라고!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_05')
		character_util.normal_jump(mandrake, true)
		character_util.play_speech_action(mandrake, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'smile' },
				{ key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_58', skip = true })

		--맨드레이크(left,doyagao,unique/walk): 다 같이 외쳐! 맨드레이크님 최고!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		character_util.play_speech_action(mandrake,
				{ name = 'unique/walk', sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' }, { name = 'doyagao' },
				{ key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_59', skip = true })

		party_util.remove_animation()
		party_util.remove_emotion()

		--다시말을걸면 하단 원라인 출력
		--서큐버스(down,smile,idle):가게 안이 훨씬 맑고 깨끗해졌어! 다음에도 부탁해!
		character_util.set_direction(trainer, 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(trainer, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.remove_relate_event(trainer, self.controller)
		trainer.Interactable.Talk = 'ds_mandrake_maker_60'
		trainer.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_positive_01'

		self.current_training = self.current_training | self.training_option.training_part_time

		if self.current_training == self.training_option.training_all then
			self:training_end()
		end
	else
		character_util.look_at(leader, mandrake)
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })

		--서큐버스(down,tired,idle) : 저런…다음에는 정화능력과 산뜻한 목소리를 활용해 보렴
		character_util.play_speech_action(trainer, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' },
				{ key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_60_1', skip = true })

		--나레이션 박스 : 제대로 일하지 못한 것 같다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_60_2' })

		--맨드레이크(down,tired,idle): 다시…다시 한번 잘해보자!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.play_speech_action(mandrake, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' },
				{ key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_60_3', skip = true })

		party_util.remove_animation()
		party_util.remove_emotion()
	end
end

--- 트레이닝 구역에서 나가려고 할 경우
function local_class:training_center_out()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local botanist = self.get_botanist()
	local mandrake = self.get_mandrake_member()
	local botanist_pos = self.get_botanist_pos()

	-- 재배를 포기하시겠습니까?
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_27' })

	-- 선택지 예 아니오
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { 'ds_mandrake_maker_13', 'intellect' }, { 'ds_mandrake_maker_14', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 2 then
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5), 4
		, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_03')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		character_util.convert_to_npc(mandrake)

		character_util.set_position(botanist, botanist_pos)
		character_util.set_position(mandrake, botanist_pos + vector(1, 0, 0))

		character_util.set_direction(botanist, 'left')
		character_util.set_direction(mandrake, 'left')

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(botanist, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mandrake, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'smile' })

		party_util.align_party(botanist, 'left', 0, 'linear')
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 식물학자(left,tired,idle):그래… 다음에 시간나면 언제든 와도 좋아.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(botanist, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_28', skip = true })

		self.current_progress = self.progress.training_out
	end
end

-- 트레이닝을 재시작 하는 경우
function local_class:training_restart()
	local botanist = self.get_botanist()
	local mandrake = self.get_mandrake_member()

	party_util.align_to_target(botanist, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	--식물학자(left,smile,sing): 어때 해보겠어?
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(botanist, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(botanist, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_12', skip = true })

	-- 선택지 예 아니오
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { 'ds_mandrake_maker_13', 'intellect' }, { 'ds_mandrake_maker_14', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		local training_center_pos = self.get_training_center_pos()

		--예
		--식물학자(left,smile,idle): 좋았어! 따라와.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(botanist, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(botanist, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_16', skip = true })

		--플레이어 중심으로 서큘러 페이드 아웃
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_03')
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		-- 맨드레이크 파티 합류
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mandrake)
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(mandrake, user_party, true, CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone)

		-- 위치 세팅
		party_util.align_party(training_center_pos, 'right', 0, 'linear')

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.2)

		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		self.current_progress = self.progress.start_training
	else
		--아니요
		--식물학자(left,scared,idle): 그럼… 어쩔 수 없지.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(botanist, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'scared' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(botanist, { key = 'ds_mandrake_maker_15', skip = true })
	end
end

-- 3개의 트레이닝을 모두 완료했을 시
function local_class:training_end()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local mandrake = self.get_mandrake_member()
	local botanist = self.get_botanist()
	local center_pos = self.get_training_center_pos()
	local leader_table_pos = self.get_botanist_pos() + vector(2, 0, -3.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.set_position(leader, center_pos - vector(1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(mandrake, center_pos + vector(1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(botanist, center_pos - vector(0, 0, 6))
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(botanist, 0, 0)
	character_util.remove_emotion(botanist)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(mandrake)

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(mandrake, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(botanist, 'up')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.3)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--…… 오잉?! 맨드레이크의 상태가……!

--- QTE 함수
--- @param type nil key: qte 타입
--- @param duration number key: qte 제한시간
--- @return boolean key: duration 이후 qte 성공 시 true 실패 시 false
function local_class:qte_swipe(data)
	local type = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'type', 'tap')
	local duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'duration', 9999)

	if type == 'tap' then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTap()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	else
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')
	end

	self.swipe_type = ''
	self.is_qte_start = true
	local time_passed = 0

	while self.is_qte_start and self.swipe_type ~= type and time_passed < duration do
		coroutine.yield()

		-- 다른 입력을 할 경우
		if self.swipe_type ~= '' and self.swipe_type ~= 'tap' and self.swipe_type ~= type then
			break
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.is_qte_start = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	-- 실패시
	if self.swipe_type ~= type then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

--- 터치를 멈추지 않고 계속해야 되는 함수
function local_class:turbo_tap_loop(duration)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_trickery_theme', state = 'event' })
	local bubble_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_bubble_01',
													loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local time_passed = 0
	local loop_passed = 1
	local leader = self.get_sauna_leader()
	local leader_pos = leader.Position

	self.is_qte_start = true
	self.turbo_tap_count = 0

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)
	while self.is_qte_start and time_passed < duration and loop_passed > 0 do

		if self.turbo_tap_count >= 1 then
			self.turbo_tap_count = 0
			loop_passed = math.min(loop_passed + 0.25, 1)
		end

		loop_passed = loop_passed - unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		leader.Position = leader_pos + vector(0, 0.6 - loop_passed * 0.5, 0)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.is_qte_start = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	bubble_sfx:Stop()

	-- 실패시
	if loop_passed <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

			table.insert(self.can_soup_item_list, item)
		end
	end

	-- 2섹션을 끝내기 이전이면, 이벤트 아이템 배치

			local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(self.item_spec_name_list[i]).Id
			local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = item_fo.Position, itemid = item_id,
													  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
													  sprscale = 0.8 })

			table.insert(self.item_list, item)
		end

end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then

local local_class = newclass('DemonShireManTimeForgotSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DemonShireManTimeForgot @
		Comment = 패잔병을 만나기 까지 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.bubble_event_zone_name = 'man_time_forgot_bubble_'
	self.loser_event_zone_name = 'man_time_forgot_bomb'

	-- 배틀 그룹 이름
	self.battle_group_name = 'man_time_forgot_loser'

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_bubble_marker = function(num) return field:GetMarker('man_time_forgot_bubble_' .. num) end
	self.get_battle_end_marker = function(num) return field:GetMarker('man_time_forgot_battle_end_' .. num) end
	self.get_knight_armor_down_marker = controller.get_knight_armor_down_marker

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_loser = controller.get_loser
	self.get_knight_armor = controller.get_knight_armor

	-- 오브젝트 풀을 가져오는 함수
	self.get_smoke_effect_pool = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_SmokeScreen') end
	self.get_hit_effect_pool = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end
	self.get_dead_effect_pool = controller.get_dead_effect_pool

	-- coroutine req id list
	self.req_id_list = {}

	-- 배틀 게이트 이름
	self.battle_gate_name = 'man_time_forgot_battle_gate_'

	-- 배틀 게이트 갯수
	self.battle_gate_num = 4

	-- 균열 바위가 부서졌는가
	self.is_rock_destroyed = false

	-- 기사 갑옷 원본 Hitbox size
	self.knight_armor_origin_hitbox_size = nil

	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		show_bubble_1 = 1,
		knight_armor_hit = 2,
		fight = 3
	}

	self.current_progress = self.progress.none

	self.custom_state_key = controller.custom_state_key
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_smoke_effect_pool()
	self.get_hit_effect_pool()
	self.get_dead_effect_pool()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	local knight_armor = self.get_knight_armor()

	-- 내레이션 박스 : 강력해보이는 기사가 길을 막고 있다.
	local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()

	narration_interactable.StringKeys = { 'ds_man_time_forgot_2_5' }
	knight_armor.Interactable = narration_interactable

	self.knight_armor_origin_hitbox_size = knight_armor.Hitbox.size
	knight_armor.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(2, 1, 1))

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	local knight_armor = self.get_knight_armor()
	local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()

	narration_interactable.StringKeys = { 'ds_man_time_forgot_4_2' }
	knight_armor.Interactable = narration_interactable

	if self.knight_armor_origin_hitbox_size then
		knight_armor.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), self.knight_armor_origin_hitbox_size)
		self.knight_armor_origin_hitbox_size = nil
	end

	self:dispose_req_id()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.bubble_event_zone_name .. 1 and self.current_progress < self.progress.show_bubble_1 then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_bubble_1, self)
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.loser_event_zone_name and self.current_progress < self.progress.fight then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_loser_event_zone, self, e.FieldObject)
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.battle_end, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local knight_armor = self.get_knight_armor()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, knight_armor) and
		self.current_progress < self.progress.knight_armor_hit then
		local direction = vector_util.to_direction(e.Info.target.Position - e.Info.sender.Position)

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.knight_armor_hit, self, direction)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

-- A존 엔터하면 최초 이벤트 발생.(컨트롤 빼앗음)
function local_class:show_bubble_1()
	local loser = self.get_loser()
	local bubble_position = self.get_bubble_marker(1).position

	self.current_progress = self.progress.show_bubble_1

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(loser)

	-- 샤우트 말풍선 : 쿨럭! 쿠우울럭!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(loser, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_1', skip = true,
														 bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = bubble_position })

	-- 샤우트 말풍선2 : …흡!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_china_master_shout_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(loser, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_2', skip = true,
														 bubble_type = 'shout',
														 world_pos = bubble_position + vector(1, 0, 1) })

	-- 가디언은 존 엔터 위치에 멈춘 상태로 left, idle, 퀘스천 버블 출력.(파티 정렬 하지 않음)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party.Leader, nil, 'question')

	-- 이후 선택지 출력.
	-- 거기 누구 있나요?
	-- 말로 할 때 나와라.
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'ds_man_time_forgot_2_1', 'mercy' },
									{ 'ds_man_time_forgot_2_2', 'brutal' } })

	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'release', count = 2,
																	sfx = '01_swing_01' })

	-- 어떤 선택지 선택해도 아무 반응 없음. 가디언 left, idle 상태로 1초 있다가 말줄임표 버블 띄운 후 꺼지면, 컨트롤 풀림.
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party.Leader, nil, 'silence')

	-- A존 다시 엔터해도 말풍선 출력되지 않음.
	-- 스테이지 재입장 시 A존 엔터하면 말풍선 출력.
end

-- 이동 화로를 던져서 기사를 맞추면 이벤트 발생.(컨트롤 정지, 파티 정렬 안 함)
function local_class:knight_armor_hit(direction)
	local knight_armor = self.get_knight_armor()

	self.current_progress = self.progress.knight_armor_hit

	-- 화로를 히트박스의 left 와 down 면에 맞췄다면 clover_knight 몸통에 FX_dead 이펙트 출력 후 left, dead3 모션으로 2번 위치에 쓰러짐.
	-- 화로를 히트박스의 right 면에 맞췄다면 clover_knight 몸통에 FX_dead 이펙트 출력 후 right, dead3 모션으로 1번 위치에 쓰러짐.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	self.get_dead_effect_pool():Instantiate(knight_armor.Position)

	local move_marker = nil
	local custom_state_value = 0

	if direction ~= character_util.get_direction('right') then
		move_marker = self.get_knight_armor_down_marker(1)
		custom_state_value = 0
	else
		move_marker = self.get_knight_armor_down_marker(2)
		custom_state_value = 1
	end

	-- 가디언은 clover_knight 의 dead3 모션 시작되면 클로버 나이트 향하는 방향으로 surprised 표정이다가, clover_knight 가 1 또는 2 위치에 쓰러진 후 컨트롤 풀림.
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, move_marker.direction)
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_direction(knight_armor, move_marker.direction)
	character_util.set_anim(knight_armor, { name = 'damaged2', loop = false })
	character_util.move_to_async(knight_armor, move_marker.position, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	-- 이후 쓰러진 기사에게 인터랙트 하면 내레이션 박스 출력.
	-- 내레이션 박스 : 갑옷 곳곳에 오래된 전투의 흔적이 새겨져 있다.
	local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()

	narration_interactable.StringKeys = { 'ds_man_time_forgot_4_2' }
	knight_armor.Interactable = narration_interactable

	knight_armor.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), self.knight_armor_origin_hitbox_size)
	self.knight_armor_origin_hitbox_size = nil

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_state_key, 1)
end

-- 폭탄이 균열 앞쪽에 던져졌을 때
function local_class:enter_loser_event_zone()
	local align_position = self.get_bubble_marker(2).position + vector(0, 0, 1)
	local loser = self.get_loser()

	self.current_progress = self.progress.fight

	-- 이후 유저가 A존 구역의 화약통을 B존의 균열 앞 판정 범위(위 이미지 빨간 사각형) 내에 떨어뜨리면(화약통이 바닥에 닿으면) 이벤트 발생.(컨트롤 빼앗음)
	-- 일반적인 화약통 폭발 연출 후, 균열 있던 지점에 FX_Common_SmokeScreen 생성. 가디언은 이 시점 파란색 포인트 위치에 up 방향 정렬.
	party_util.align_party(align_position, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	-- 잔잔한 카메라 쉐이크 시작(지진 전조 증상처럼), 가디언은 up, 퀘스천 버블
	local earthquake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', type_priority = 'event',
												 player_priority = 'default' })
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 9999)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party.Leader, nil, 'question')

	-- FX_Common_SmokeScreen 희미해지면, 패잔병(요청 예정)이 통로에서 down, attakc, gauntlet_boong_attack_ready 모션으로 빠르게 날아와 down, attack, gauntlet_boong_attack 으로 가디언 공격.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(loser, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(loser, { name = 'gauntlet_boong_attack_ready', loop = false })
	character_util.jump(loser, 1, 0.533)
	character_util.move_to(loser, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.533)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 패잔병 샤우트 말풍선 : 후랴아아압!!!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	character_util.set_anim(loser, { name = 'gauntlet_boong_attack', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(loser, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_2_6', bubble_type = 'shout',
												   type_speed = 0 })
	wait_for_sec(0.333)

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	self.get_hit_effect_pool():Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position)

	-- 가디언은 붉은 틴트, surprised, damaged 로 피격된  후 공간 중앙까지 나동그라짐.
	earthquake_sfx:Stop()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.spine_rotate(user_party.Leader, 360 * 3, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -3),
		0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'prostrate' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.shake_and_wakeup(user_party.Leader, 'right', 1, nil, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_jump_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(loser)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(loser, 'left')
	character_util.jump(loser, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(loser, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(4, 0, 0),
		0.5)

	character_util.set_locked_dir(loser, 'none')
	character_util.set_direction(loser, 'left')

	-- 패잔병 left, attack, attack x 2 : 임시 대사
	character_util.set_emotion(loser, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, loser, { name = 'attack', count = 2,
																			   sfx = '01_swing_01' }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, loser, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_2_7',
																				skip = true })
	})

	-- 카메라가 공간 중앙의 가디언에게로 이동하면, 컨트롤 풀리며 전투 시작.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(loser)
	character_util.convert_to_monster(loser, self.battle_group_name)
	character_util.set_death_type(loser, 'prostrate')
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(loser, user_party.Leader, 'battle')

	-- 배틀게이트 올리기
	for i = 1, self.battle_gate_num do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. i, false))
	end
end

-- 전투가 끝난 후
function local_class:battle_end()
	local loser = self.get_loser()
	local battle_end_position_1 = self.get_battle_end_marker(1)
	local battle_end_position_2 = self.get_battle_end_marker(2)

	-- 배틀게이트 내리기
	for i = 1, self.battle_gate_num do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. i, false))
	end

	-- 전투 후, 페이드아웃/인 되면 위와 같이 정렬(파랑 가디언/ 빨강 패잔병) 후 이벤트 진행. (컨트롤 빼앗음)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	party_util.position_party(battle_end_position_1.position, battle_end_position_1.direction, 'linear')

	character_util.convert_to_npc(loser)
	character_util.set_direction(loser, battle_end_position_2.direction)
	character_util.set_emotion(loser, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.remove_anim(loser)
	character_util.set_position(loser, battle_end_position_2.position)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 패잔병 (right, attack, attack X 2) : 적이지만 대단한 실력이군…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(loser, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, loser, { name = 'attack', count = 2,
																			   sfx = '01_swing_01' }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, loser, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_5', skip = true })
	})

	-- 패잔병 (right, tired, idle) : 치밀한 위장과 함정, 살 떨리는 교란술까지 뚫고 내 비밀 기지에 도달하다니…
	character_util.set_emotion(loser, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.remove_anim(loser)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(loser, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_6', skip = true })

	-- 패잔병 (right, sleep_deep, idle) : 결국, 통일 전쟁 승리를 위한 내 비밀 임무도 여기까지인가…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	character_util.set_emotion(loser, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(loser, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_7', skip = true })

	-- 패잔병 (right, attack, attack x 2) : 포로가 될 생각은 없다. 어서 죽여라!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(loser, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.set_animation_n_times, loser, { name = 'attack', count = 2,
																		 sfx = '01_swing_01' }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, loser, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_8',

local local_class = newclass('DemonShireManTimeForgotSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DemonShireManTimeForgot @
		Comment = 패잔병에게 아이템을 가져다 주기 까지 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.homeless_event_zone_name = 'man_time_forgot_homeless_'

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_item_marker = controller.get_item_marker
	self.get_loser_position_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('man_time_forgot_bubble_2') end
	self.get_bed_side_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('man_time_forgot_bed_side') end

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_loser = controller.get_loser
	self.get_homeless = function(num) return get_character('man_time_forgot_homeless_' .. num) end

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_item = controller.get_item

	-- 이벤트를 봤는가 여부
	self.saw_event = 0

	-- 이벤트 enum
	self.event_enum = {
		none = 0,
		homeless_1 = 1 << 0,
		homeless_2 = 1 << 1,
	}

	-- 아이템을 습득했는가 여부
	self.item_get = 0

	-- 아이템 갯수
	self.item_num = controller.item_num

	-- 습득한 아이템 갯수
	self.item_get_num = 0

	-- 건네준 아이템 갯수
	self.item_send_num = 0

	-- 아이템 enum
	self.item_enum = {
		1 << 0, -- ds_canned_soup
		1 << 1, -- ds_demonworld_dollar
		1 << 2, -- ds_receipt
		1 << 3 -- ds_newspaper
	}

	-- coroutine req id list
	self.req_id_list = {}
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	local loser = self.get_loser()
	local loser_position_marker = self.get_loser_position_marker()

	loser.Position = loser_position_marker.position
	character_util.set_direction(loser, loser_position_marker.direction)
	character_util.set_emotion(loser, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(loser, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	character_util.add_listener(loser, self.controller)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 컨트롤 풀리면 위 이미지에 초록색으로 표시한 4군데에 스프라이트와 마커.
	for i = 1, self.item_num do
		local item_fo = self.get_item(i)

		item_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, item_fo.Name, item_fo)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	for i = 1, self.item_num do
		local item_fo = self.get_item(i)

		quest_marker_util.remove(item_fo.Name)
		item_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		item_fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	self.controller:dispose_all_item()

	local loser = self.get_loser()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(loser, self.controller)
	quest_marker_util.remove(loser.Name)

	self:dispose_req_id()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.homeless_event_zone_name .. 1 and self.saw_event & self.event_enum.homeless_1 == 0 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.homeless_event_1, self))
			return true
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.homeless_event_zone_name .. 2 and self.saw_event & self.event_enum.homeless_2 == 0 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.homeless_event_2, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local loser = self.get_loser()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, loser) then
		if self.item_get ~= 0 then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_loser, self)
			return true
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_loser_have_no_item,
				self))
			return true
		end
	end

	for i = 1, self.item_num do
		local item = self.get_item(i)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, item) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_item, self, i)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

-- homeless 이벤트 1
function local_class:homeless_event_1()
	local homeless_1 = self.get_homeless(1)

	self.saw_event = self.saw_event | self.event_enum.homeless_1

	-- 1번 NPC (left, tired, question) : 고물상 가는 길이 무너지다니… 이러면 고물을 팔 수가 없는데…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(homeless_1, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_20' })

	homeless_1.Interactable.Talk = 'ds_man_time_forgot_20'

-- 떨어져 있는 아이템에 상호작용 했을 때
function local_class:interact_item(item_num)
	-- 플로팅 네임 : 토마토 스프 통조림.
	-- 내레이션 박스 : 유통기한이 한 달 지난 통조림.
	-- 플로팅 네임 : 구겨진 마계 달러
	-- 내레이션 박스 : 리리스 중앙 정부에서 발행한 지폐.
	-- 플로팅 네임 : 도매 거래 영수증
	-- 내레이션 박스 : 남부 양복점과 북부 백화점 간 거래 영수증.
	-- 플로팅 네임 : 낡아 빠진 신문
	-- 내레이션 박스 : <1면 특종> 데몬샤이어의 뱀파이어들, 마족 전쟁 난민 수용하기로 결정!

	local item_fo = self.get_item(item_num)

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_item_' .. item_num })

	-- 내레이션 박스 꺼지면 eat 모션 후, 플로팅 네임과 함께 습득 처리.
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true,
												 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	character_util.set_side_direction(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.controller.item_list[item_num].ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
	self.controller.item_list[item_num] = nil
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	-- 아이템 1개 이상 습득 시, 패잔병 위치에 마커.
	local loser = self.get_loser()

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, loser.Name, loser)

	quest_marker_util.remove(item_fo.Name)
	item_fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	self.item_get = self.item_get | self.item_enum[item_num]
	self.item_get_num = self.item_get_num + 1

	if self.item_get_num >= 3 then
		for i = 1, self.item_num do
			local item_fo = self.get_item(i)

			quest_marker_util.remove(item_fo.Name)
		end
	end
end

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DemonShireManTimeForgot @
		Comment = 고물상을 도와주기 까지 @
		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.antique_shop_leave_event_zone_name = 'man_time_forgot_antique_shop_leave'
	self.antique_shop_drum_event_zone_name = 'man_time_forgot_antique_shop_drum'
	self.antique_shop_event_zone_name = 'man_time_forgot_antique_shop'

	-- 드럼통 오브젝트 이름
	self.antique_shop_drum_name = 'obj_factory_barrel'
	-- 쓰레기 오브젝트 이름
	self.antique_shop_trash_name = 'obj_sack'

	-- 아이템 스펙 이름
	self.item_spec_name = controller.ds_commemorative_plaque_item_spec_name

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_bed_side_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('man_time_forgot_bed_side') end
	self.get_action_end_marker = function(num) return field:GetMarker('man_time_forgot_action_end_' .. num) end

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_loser = controller.get_loser
	self.get_antique_shop = function() return get_character('antique_shop') end

	-- 오브젝트 풀을 가져오는 함수
	self.get_dead_effect_pool = controller.get_dead_effect_pool

	-- 고물상 드럼통 갯수
	self.drum_num = 3

	-- 고물상에서 특정 구역에 모아놓은 드럼통의 갯수
	self.drum_enter_count = 0

	-- 고물상 쓰레기 갯수
	self.trash_num = 7

	-- 고물상에서 치운 쓰레기 갯수
	self.trash_destroyed_count = 0

	-- 드럼통 가져다 놓을 구역 범위
	self.attack_range = nil

	-- coroutine req id list
	self.req_id_list = {}

	-- 섹션 이벤트 프로그레스
	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		antique_shop_acting = 1
	}

	-- 섹션 이벤트 현재 프로그레스
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_dead_effect_pool()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	local loser = self.get_loser()
	local bed_side_marker = self.get_bed_side_marker()

	loser.Position = bed_side_marker.position
	character_util.set_direction(loser, bed_side_marker.direction)
	character_util.set_emotion(loser, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(loser, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	character_util.add_listener(loser, self.controller)

	local antique_shop = self.get_antique_shop()

	character_util.set_direction(antique_shop, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(antique_shop, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(antique_shop, { naem = 'cross_arm' })
	character_util.add_listener(antique_shop, self.controller)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	local loser = self.get_loser()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(loser, self.controller)

	local antique_shop = self.get_antique_shop()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(antique_shop, self.controller)
	antique_shop.Interactable.Talk = ''

	local zone = field:GetZone(self.antique_shop_event_zone_name)
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(zone.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	-- Pushable로 만들었던 드럼통을, 다시 상호작용 불가능하게
	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]

		if fo.Name == self.antique_shop_drum_name then
			fo.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectBehaviour.Instance
			fo.Pushable = CS.Oak.NonPushable.Instance
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()

	self:dispose_attack_range()

	self:dispose_req_id()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local loser = self.get_loser()
	local antique_shop = self.get_antique_shop()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, loser) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_loser, self))
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, antique_shop) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_antique_shop, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_progress ~= self.progress.antique_shop_acting then
		return false
	end

	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.antique_shop_leave_event_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_antique_shop_leave_zone, self)
				return true
			end
		elseif e.FieldObject.Name == self.antique_shop_drum_name then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.antique_shop_drum_event_zone_name then
				self.drum_enter_count = self.drum_enter_count + 1
				self:clear_check()
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.current_progress ~= self.progress.antique_shop_acting then
		return false
	end

	if e.FullLeave then
		if e.FieldObject.Name == self.antique_shop_drum_name then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.antique_shop_drum_event_zone_name then
				self.drum_enter_count = self.drum_enter_count - 1
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if self.current_progress ~= self.progress.antique_shop_acting then
		return false
	end

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'interacting' then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.trash_destroy, self, e.Sender))
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

-- 패잔병에 상호작용 했을 때
function local_class:interact_loser()
	local func_name = 'interact_loser'
	local req_id = self:get_new_req_id(func_name)

	local loser = self.get_loser()

	-- 패잔병에 인터랙트 시 원라인
	-- 패잔병 (down, attack, cross_arm) : 마계 전쟁이 끝나? 흥! 어림도 없는 소리!
	character_util.set_direction(loser, 'down')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(loser, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_37' })

	if req_id ~= self:get_req_id(func_name) then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_direction(loser, 'left')

-- 고물상에 상호작용 했을 때
function local_class:interact_antique_shop()
	local antique_shop = self.get_antique_shop()

	party_util.align_to_target(antique_shop, 'down', 1, 'linear')

	-- 고물상에 도착해서 NPC에게 인터랙트 하면 이벤트 발생.
	-- 고물상 주인 (down, tired, cross_arm) : 이번 범람으로 고물들이 온통 뒤죽박죽이 됐어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(antique_shop, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(antique_shop, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(antique_shop, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_38', skip = true })

	-- 고물상 주인 (idle 상태로 left, right 번갈아 본 후 곧바로 -> down, tired cast2) : 이러면 장사를 할 수가 없는데… 좀 도와줄 수 있겠나?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(antique_shop)
	character_util.set_direction(antique_shop, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(antique_shop, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(antique_shop, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(antique_shop, { name = 'cast2' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(antique_shop, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_39', skip = true })

	-- 고물상 주인 (down, smile, idle) : 정리해주면 내가 아껴놨던 보물을 주지!
	character_util.set_emotion(antique_shop, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.remove_anim(antique_shop)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(antique_shop, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_40', skip = true })

	-- 선택지 출력
	-- 도와준다. -> 이벤트 이어짐.
	-- 그만둔다. -> 컨트롤 풀림. 이후 고물상 주인에게 인터랙트 시 동일 이벤트 진행.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'ds_man_time_forgot_40_1', 'mercy' }, { 'ds_man_time_forgot_40_2', 'brutal' }
	})

	if choose_result == 2 then
		-- 그만둔다 선택 시
		character_util.set_emotion(antique_shop, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim(antique_shop, { name = 'cross_arm' })
		return
	end

	-- 도와준다 선택 시 이벤트
	-- 고물상 주인 (down, idle, nod) : 좋아, 어려울 건 없어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(antique_shop)
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, antique_shop, { name = 'nod', count = 2 }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, antique_shop, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_41',
																					   skip = true })
	})

	-- 고물상 주인 (right, tired, release) : 여기저기 뒤섞인 쓰레기들은 치우고,
	character_util.set_direction(antique_shop, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(antique_shop, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(antique_shop, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(antique_shop, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_42', skip = true })

	-- 고물상 주인 (left, idle, release) : 드럼통은 왼쪽 위에 모아주면 돼.
	character_util.set_direction(antique_shop, 'left')
	character_util.remove_emotion(antique_shop)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(antique_shop, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_43', skip = true })

	-- 이후 컨트롤 풀림. 고물상 주인에게 인터랙트 시 원라인 출력.
	-- 고물상 주인 (down, idle, idle) : 쓰레기들은 치우고, 드럼통은 왼쪽 위에 모아줘.
	character_util.set_direction(antique_shop, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim(antique_shop)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(antique_shop, self.controller)
	antique_shop.Interactable.Talk = 'ds_man_time_forgot_44'

	local zone = field:GetZone(self.antique_shop_event_zone_name)
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(zone.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	-- 드럼통엔 Pushable, 쓰레기엔 Interactable 를 설정하여 상호작용 가능하게
	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]

		if fo.Name == self.antique_shop_drum_name then
			fo.Pushable = CS.Oak.UnitPushable()
		elseif fo.Name == self.antique_shop_trash_name then
			fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.Interactable()
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()

	self:create_attack_range()

	self.current_progress = self.progress.antique_shop_acting
end

-- 플레이어가 고물상에서 나가려 할 때
function local_class:enter_antique_shop_leave_zone()
	local antique_shop = self.get_antique_shop()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_anim(antique_shop, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(antique_shop, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_45', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(antique_shop)

	local zone = field:GetZone(self.antique_shop_leave_event_zone_name)
	local distance = user_party.Leader.Position - zone.Bounds.center
	local move_direction = nil

	if math.abs(distance.x) >= math.abs(distance.z) then
		move_direction = vector(distance.x, 0, 0).normalized
	else
		move_direction = vector(0, 0, distance.z).normalized
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party.Leader,
		user_party.Leader.Position + (move_direction * 1.5), 4, false)
end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(antique_shop, { key = 'ds_man_time_forgot_47', skip = true })

	-- 고물상 주인 (down, idle, question) : 어디보자… 요즘 그래도 값을 잘 쳐주는 게…

function local_class:trash_destroy(fo)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01', play_pos = fo.Position, type_priority = 'gimmick',
								 player_priority = 'object' })
	self.get_dead_effect_pool():Instantiate(fo.Position)
	fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	self.trash_destroyed_count = self.trash_destroyed_count + 1
	self:clear_check()
end

function local_class:clear_check()
	if self.drum_enter_count >= self.drum_num and self.trash_destroyed_count >= self.trash_num then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.clear_antique_shop_action, self)
	end
end

--region attack_range
function local_class:create_attack_range()
	local drum_zone = field:GetZone(self.antique_shop_drum_event_zone_name)
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.get_x0z(drum_zone.Bounds.center, 0.01),
			vector(drum_zone.Bounds.size.x, drum_zone.Bounds.size.z), CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 76), CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 153))
	self.attack_range:Show()
end

function local_class:dispose_attack_range()
	if self.attack_range then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.attack_range.gameObject)
		self.attack_range = nil
	end
end

--region req_id
function local_class:get_new_req_id(func_name)
	if self.req_id_list[func_name] == nil then
		self.req_id_list[func_name] = 0
	end

	self.req_id_list[func_name] = self.req_id_list[func_name] + 1

	return self.req_id_list[func_name]
end

function local_class:get_req_id(func_name)
	return self.req_id_list[func_name]
end

function local_class:dispose_req_id()
	for key, value in pairs(self.req_id_list) do
		value = value + 1
	end
end
--endregion

return local_class

-- 패잔병에 상호작용 했을 때

]]

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_mother = function() return get_character('ds_demon_female') end
	self.get_kid = function() return get_character('ds_demon_kid_boy') end

	-- 스타피스를 가져오는 함수

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.inter_section_params = nil

end

function local_class:on_guild_castle_sit_event(e)
	if e.IsSittingOn then
		-- 스테이트를 CharacterControllerSitState 로 바꿔준다.
		if not lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerSitState) then
			local direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(e.Chair.FieldObjectBehaviour.StandUpOffset)
			local priority = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.Custom) + 1
			user_party.Leader:SetLockedDirection(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(direction, priority))

			local sit_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerSitState.Create(user_party.Leader, e.Chair, nil)
			message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(sit_state))
		end

		-- Behaviour 의 스테이트를 CharacterSitState 로 바꿔준다.
		if not lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterSitState) then
			local sit_state = CS.Oak.CharacterSitState.Create(user_party.Leader, e.Chair, nil)
			message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(sit_state))
		end
	else
		if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerSitState) then
			if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterSitState) then
				local sit_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState

				xlua.private_accessible(typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterSitState))

				if sit_state.sitState == CS.Oak.CharacterSitState.SitState.Sit then
					user_party.Leader:RemoveLockedDirection(user_party.Leader)
				end
			end

			user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:FinishSitState()
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:interact_mother()
	local mother = self.get_mother()

	-- 엄마(down, tired): 곤란해하고 있는 엄마 npc
	-- 인터렉트 시 엄마 우측으로 정렬
	party_util.align_to_target(mother, 'right', 1, 'arc')

	if self.current_progress < self.progress.interact_mother then
		-- 엄마(down, tired): 어디로 사라져 버린거니…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = 'ds_missing_child_1', skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		character_util.look_at(mother, user_party.Leader)
		character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump(mother, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = 'ds_missing_child_2', skip = true })

		-- 엄마(right, cry, cast): 제… 제 아들이 잠깐 눈을 뗀 사이 사라져버렸어요…

		character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'cry' })
		character_util.set_anim(mother, { name = 'cast' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = 'ds_missing_child_3', skip = true })

		self.current_progress = self.progress.interact_mother
	end

	-- 엄마(right, tired, sing): 저를 좀 도와주시겠어요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(mother, { name = 'sing' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = 'ds_missing_child_4', skip = true })

	-- 선택지

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({

		character_util.remove_anim(mother)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = 'ds_missing_child_5', skip = true })

		-- 엄마(right, tired): 하지만 부디 마음이 바뀐다면 다시 말을 걸어주세요…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = 'ds_missing_child_6', skip = true })

		-- 저를 좀 도와주시겠어요? 부터 반복
	else
		-- 승낙: 도와준다.
		-- 퀘스트 진행
		-- 엄마(right, surprise), (폴짝 뛰며) 정말… 정말 감사합니다! 기사님!

		character_util.normal_jump(mother, '01_player_jump_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = 'ds_missing_child_7', skip = true })

		-- 엄마(right, tired): 아직 어린아이라 멀리가진 못했을 텐데…
		character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = 'ds_missing_child_8', skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(mother, 0.04, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.shake(mother, 0.04, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 엄마(right, cry, release x2): 하지만… 도무지 찾을 수가 없었어요!

		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, mother, { name = 'release', count = 2,

		character_util.remove_anim(mother)
