function local_class:setting_evacuate_refugee()
	if self.res_holder == nil then
		self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

		coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('ondemand/v2_3_futurecastle/ui/stage', 'EvacuateRefugee'), function(p)
			local gaugeObj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)

			self.evacuate_refugee = gaugeObj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.EvacuateRefugee))
			-- 피난민 게이지 최대값 세팅
			self.evacuate_refugee:SetEvacuationPanel(0, self.max_save_count)
			self.evacuate_refugee:OverridePanelDescription()
			self:show_evacuation(true)
		end))
	end
	coroutine.yield()

	local new_string = CS.GameStrings.Instance:Format("ds_main_s28_rescue_count", self.save_count, self.max_save_count)
	self.evacuate_refugee:SetOverridenPanelDescription(new_string)
end

function local_class:increase_save_count(count)

		self.save_count = self.save_count + count
		self.evacuate_refugee:IncreaseSaveCount(count)
		local new_string = CS.GameStrings.Instance:Format("ds_main_s28_rescue_count", self.save_count, self.max_save_count)
		self.evacuate_refugee:SetOverridenPanelDescription(new_string)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_game_safe_02')
	end
end

-- 대피상황 패널을 보여주거나 숨김
function local_class:show_evacuation(show)
	if self.evacuate_refugee ~= nil then
		self.evacuate_refugee:ShowEvacuationPanel(show)
	end
end

function local_class:npc_escape_routine(npc)
	npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	quest_icon_util.remove(npc)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(npc, self.controller)
	local current_saved_count = self.save_count

	self:increase_save_count(1)

	character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'smile' })
	quest_icon_util.remove(npc)
	character_util.hide_weapon(npc, true)
	character_util.stop_shake(npc)
	character_util.look_at(npc, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'sing' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc, { key = 'ds_main_s28_rescue', skip = false })
	character_util.remove_anim(npc)

	local wp_name_list = self.npc_escape_way_points[npc.Name]
	local wp = {}

	for i = 1, #wp_name_list do
		local idx = wp_name_list[i]
		wp[#wp + 1] = field:GetMarker(self.npc_escape_marker_name .. idx).position
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint(npc, wp, 6, true)

function local_class:vampire_researcher_event_ending()
	local portal = get_field_object('red_portal_1')
	message_system:SendSync(portal, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
	local vampire_researcher = self.get_researcher(2)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	local align_pos = self.rescue_marker(5).position + vector(-0.5,0,-6.5)
	party_util.align_party(align_pos, 'right', 1, 'linear')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--테슬라 연결로 도어 개방 시 도어 앞쪽으로 존 활성화. 존 진입 시 정지 이벤트.
	--플레이어 정지 상태. 이때 안쪽에서 뱀파이어 연구원이 down, mad, run으로 하단으로 달려 내려오며 하단 대사를 실행한다.
	character_util.set_emotion(vampire_researcher, {name = 'mad'})
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(vampire_researcher, vampire_researcher.Position + vector(0,0,-15),
					6,true, 'stop', 'floor', 'down', true)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			--뱀파이어 연구원 (down, mad, run) : 비켜! 세미나!! 아직 안늦었지?!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(vampire_researcher,
					{key = self.rescue_researchers_script .. 19, bubble_direction = 'rb'})
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(1)
			--플레이어가 뱀파이어 연구원과 맞닿을 시 left, confused, prostrate 자세로 우하단으로 한바뀌 돌며 날아간다.
			--이후 플레이어 shake 2회 이후 mario_jump로 기상. 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.
			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(-0.3,0,0))
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'confused'})
			local fly_time = 0.75
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')
			character_util.spine_rotate(leader, -720, fly_time)
			character_util.jump(leader, 1, fly_time)
			character_util.move_to_async(leader, leader.Position+vector(1,0,-0.5), fly_time)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_trip_03')
			wait_for_sec(fly_time)

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.shake(leader, 0.05, 0.4)
			wait_for_sec(0.8)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.shake(leader, 0.05, 0.4)
			wait_for_sec(0.8)
			character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
			character_util.remove_anim(leader)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
			character_util.mario_jump_async(leader, 'left')
			character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 0, 0)
		end)
	})

	character_util.set_position(vampire_researcher, vector(999,0,999))
	character_util.set_position(self.get_researcher(1), vector(999,0,999))

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

return local_class

function local_class:main_progress_exception()
	local clear_flag_obj = get_field_object('[GIMMICK]clear_flag_base')
	local disable_npc_list = {
		'elder',
		'elder_son',
		'demon_rep',
		'rep_assistant',

		'vamp_noble_5',

		'rescue_required_npc_3_3',
		'head_chef',
		'part_time_chef_1',
		'part_time_chef_2',
		'part_time_chef_3',
		'part_time_chef_4',
	}

	if clear_flag_obj then
		clear_flag_obj.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end

	for i = 1, #disable_npc_list do
		local npc = get_character(disable_npc_list[i])
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
	end

	--yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self, 0)

function local_class:create_drop_items()
	local drop_items = {}

	for i = 1, #self.drop_item_settings do
		local handle_name = self.drop_item_settings[i].fo_name
		local drop_item = self:create_drop_item(self.drop_item_settings[i])
		drop_item.Position = vector(drop_item.Position.x, 1, drop_item.Position.z)
		drop_items[handle_name] = drop_item
	end

	return drop_items
end

function local_class:create_drop_item(spec)
	local handle_name = spec.fo_name
	local item_id = spec.id
	local item_scale = spec.scale

	local fo = get_field_object(handle_name)
	return drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = fo.Position,
		target_pos = fo.Position,
		itemid = item_id,
		notforinven = true,
		skip_text = true,
		sprscale = item_scale,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
	})
end

function local_class:turn_off_candle()
	local candle = get_field_object('mansion_candle_1')
	candle.UnityGameObject.transform:GetChild(0).gameObject:SetActive(false)
	candle.UnityGameObject.transform:GetChild(1).gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then
		return
	end

	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

		self:disable_all_monsters()

		self.elder_wine = self.controller:create_drop_item(self.elder_wine_spec)
		self.elder_wine.Position = vector(self.elder_wine.Position.x, 1, self.elder_wine.Position.z)

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.co_play_stage_intro, self)
	end

	--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.debug_loop, self))

function local_class:debug_loop()
	while not self.game_ended do
		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.Q) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.co_play_mansion_intro, self))
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.elder_wine ~= nil then
		self.elder_wine:ConsumeComplete()
		self.elder_wine = nil
	end

	self.game_ended = true
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
end

	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:disable_all_monsters()
	-- 멘션 외부
	self:disable_monster_group(self.outdoor_monsters)

	-- 멘션 내부
	self:disable_monster_group(self.indoor_monsters)
end

function local_class:disable_monster_group(monster_group)
	for i = 1, #monster_group do
		for j = 1, monster_group[i].count do
			character_util.set_active_state(get_character(monster_group[i].name .. j), 'disabled')
		end
	end
end

function local_class:enable_monster_group(monster_group)
	for i = 1, #monster_group do
		for j = 1, monster_group[i].count do
			local monster = get_character(monster_group[i].name .. j)
			character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'enabled')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(monster, 1, 1)
			self.get_shadow_appear_effect():Instantiate(monster.Position)
		end
	end
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if e.CameraGrid.name == 'mansion_inner_1' then
		local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

		if main_quest_progress.InnerProgress == 27 then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.co_play_mansion_intro, self)
		end
	elseif e.CameraGrid.name == 'outdoor' then
		field:RemoveTint(self.controller.tint_key, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
end
--endregion

		local num_of_each_row = self.mansion_intro_monsters[i].unit

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GameOverEvent), 'on_game_over_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent), 'on_field_object_revived_event')

	if not self:playable_main_quest_progress() then
		return
	end

	-- 이전 섹션에서 넘어 왔으면 바로 마커 세팅
	local is_prev_section = self.controller.starting_inner_progress <= 0
	if is_prev_section then
		self:active_quest_marker(false)
		self.is_show_mansion_quest_marker = true
	else
		music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'combat' })
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'field', mix = 2 })
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then
		return
	end

	if not self:playable_main_quest_progress() then
		return
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.setting_evacuate_refugee, self))

	self.controller:turn_off_candle()

	-- 필요한 몬스터들 모습 감춤
	for i = 1, #self.hidden_monsters do
		local monster = get_character(self.hidden_monsters[i])
		character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'enabled')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(monster, 0, 0)
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(monster, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end

	-- 대합장에 있던 NPC들 위치 재배치

		'elder',
		'elder_son',
		'demon_rep',
		'rep_assistant',
		'vamp_noble_6',
		'vamp_noble_5'
	}

	for i = 1, #npc_list do
		local npc = get_character(npc_list[i])
		local marker = npc.Name .. '_pos_2'
		character_util.set_position(npc, field:GetMarker(marker).position)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'cast' })
	end

	-- 쉐이크 및 퀘스트 아이콘 세팅
	local deactive_quest_icon_npc_list = { 1, 2, 3, 6, 7 }
	for i = 1, #self.shaking_npc_list do
		local npc = get_character(self.shaking_npc_list[i])
		character_util.shake(npc, 0.03, 999999)

		if table_util.contain_value(deactive_quest_icon_npc_list, i) then
			quest_icon_util.set_quest_accepted(npc)
		else
			quest_icon_util.set_quest_cleared(npc)
		end
	end

	local disable_list = {
		'vamp_noble_1',
		'vamp_noble_3',
		'vamp_noble_2'
	}

	for i = 1, #disable_list do
		local npc = get_character(disable_list[i])
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
	end

	-- 주방장 세팅
	local head_chef = self.get_head_chef()
	character_util.add_color(head_chef, 'default_tint', unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)

	local light = self.get_holdable_light()
	light.Position = vector(-187, 0.6, 30)
	light.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 1, 0.5), vector(0.8, 1, 0.8))
	light.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	self.lamp_effect = self.get_twinkle_fx_pool():Instantiate(light.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.5)
	quest_icon_util.set_quest_cleared(light)

	local elder_son_key = self.get_elder_son_key()
	self.key_effect = self.get_twinkle_fx_pool():Instantiate(elder_son_key.Position + unity_class.vector3.up)
	elder_son_key.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	-- 느낌표 없어야 하는 NPC 세팅
	quest_icon_util.remove(get_character('vamp_noble_6'))
	quest_icon_util.remove(get_character('vamp_noble_5'))

	-- 어두운 공간 문 다시 닫혀 있도록
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('jump_scare_door_1'))

	-- 엘더 아들 방 문 상호작용 가능하도록
	local door = self.get_elder_key_door()
	door.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	-- 주방 박스 세팅
	local box_count = 2
	for i = 1, box_count do
		local box = self.get_kitchen_box(i)
		box.Position = vector(-157, 0, 15 - i)
	end

	end

	--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.debug_loop, self))
end

function local_class:debug_loop()
	while not self.game_ended do

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.epilogue, self))
			-- sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
			-- 	party_util.align_party(vector(-195.6142, 0, 27.74208), 'left', 0, 'linear')
			-- end)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GameOverEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent))

	if self.key_effect ~= nil then
		self.key_effect:Dispose()
		self.key_effect = nil
	end

	if self.lamp_effect ~= nil then
		self.lamp_effect:Dispose()
		self.lamp_effect = nil
	end

	if self.deep_open_effect ~= nil then
		self.deep_open_effect:Dispose()
		self.deep_open_effect = nil
	end

	if self.evacuate_refugee ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.evacuate_refugee.gameObject)
		self.evacuate_refugee = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'inner_battle_zone_3') and
			self:playable_main_quest_progress() then
		if not self.seen_jump_scare_2 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.co_jump_scare_2, self))
		end
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'inner_battle_zone_7') and
			self:playable_main_quest_progress() then
		if not self.seen_jump_scare_5 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jump_scare_5, self))
		end
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'deep_dark_zone')
			and not self.open_jump_scare_door and self:playable_main_quest_progress() then
		if not self:is_holding_lamp() then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
				self:show_evacuation(false)
				character_util.move_distance(user_party.Leader, vector(0, 0, 0.75), nil, 1, true, true)
				character_util.move_distance_async(self.get_sohee(), vector(0, 0, 0.75), nil, 1, true, true)

				self:turn_light_off()
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
				field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_rescue_vamp_town_s2_19' })
				screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
				party_util.align_party(vector(-194.5, 0, 34), 'up', 0, 'linear')
				wait_for_sec(0.25)
				self:dispose_dark_closed()
				screen_util.fade_in_async(0.4, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
				self:show_evacuation(true)
			end)
			return true
		end
		self:turn_light_off()

		return true
	elseif string.find(e.Zone.Name, 'jump_scare_zone_3_') then
		if self.seen_jump_scare_3 == false then
			return true
		end

		if not self:playable_main_quest_progress() then
			return true
		end

		if self:is_holding_lamp() and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, e.Zone.Name) then
			if not self.has_seen_jump_scare_3_zones[e.Zone.Name] then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jump_scare_4, self, e.Zone.Name))
			end
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'deep_dark_zone') and
			self:playable_main_quest_progress() then
		self:dispose_dark_closed()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if e.CameraGrid.name == 'mansion_inner_1' and self:playable_main_quest_progress() then
		field:Tint(self.controller.tint_key, unity_class.color.black, 0, 0.5)
		if not self.is_show_mansion_quest_marker then
			self:active_quest_marker(false)
			self.is_show_mansion_quest_marker = true
		end
		return true
	elseif e.CameraGrid.name == 'mansion_inner_2' and self:playable_main_quest_progress() then
		if not self.is_show_mansion_quest_marker then
			self:active_quest_marker(false)
			self.is_show_mansion_quest_marker = true
		end
		return true
	elseif e.CameraGrid.name == 'basement' and self:playable_main_quest_progress() then
		self:active_quest_marker(true)
		self.is_show_mansion_quest_marker = false
		return true
	elseif e.CameraGrid.name == 'outdoor' and self:playable_main_quest_progress() then
		field:RemoveTint(self.controller.tint_key, 0)
		if self.is_show_mansion_quest_marker then
			self:deactive_quest_marker()
			self.is_show_mansion_quest_marker = false
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target_name = e.Target.Name

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_head_chef()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interacted_to_head_chef, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_holdable_light()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_lamp_tip, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_elder_son_key()) then
		if self.is_battle_ghost_at_the_door then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.acquire_key, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_flower_pot_narration, self)
		end

		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_elder_key_door()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_door, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('demon_rep'))
			or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('rep_assistant')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.saved_demon_rep_group, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('elder'))
			or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('elder_son')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.saved_elder_group, self)
		return true
	end

	if table_util.contain_value(self.chefs, target_name) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.saved_chefs, self)
		return true
	end

	if table_util.contain_value(self.normal_rescue_npc, target_name) then
		local npc = get_character(target_name)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.npc_escape_routine, self, npc))
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	local switch_fo = get_field_object('jump_scare_switch_1')

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, switch_fo) and e.IsTurningOn
			and not self.open_jump_scare_door then
		self.open_jump_scare_door = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reached_jump_scare, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_game_over_event(_)
	-- 게임 오버 됐을 때 UI 꺼준다.
	self:show_evacuation(false)

	return true
end

function local_class:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	-- 리더 부활하면 UI 다시켜줌
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then

	local main_quest_id = 286

-- 마커 세팅
function local_class:active_quest_marker(is_in_basement)
	for i = 1, #self.marker_npc_list do
		if not self.marker_npc_list[i].escape then
			-- 그룹은 총
			if self.marker_npc_list[i].target == 'demon_rep_group' then
				-- 첫번째 있는 놈에게 마커
				local npc = get_character(self.demon_rep_group[1])
				if ui_quest_marker:IsActiveMarker(npc.Name) then
					quest_marker_util.remove(npc.Name)
				end
				if not is_in_basement then
					ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(npc.Name, '286', true, npc)
				end
			elseif self.marker_npc_list[i].target == 'elder_group' then
				-- 첫번째 있는 놈에게 마커
				local npc = get_character(self.elder_group[1])
				if ui_quest_marker:IsActiveMarker(npc.Name) then
					quest_marker_util.remove(npc.Name)
				end
				if not is_in_basement then
					ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(npc.Name, '286', true, npc)
				end
			elseif self.marker_npc_list[i].target == 'basement' then
				-- 퀘스트 마커 먼저 지워주고
				local exit_name = 'basement_inner_1'
				if ui_quest_marker:IsActiveMarker(exit_name) then
					quest_marker_util.remove(exit_name)
				end

				for j = 1, #self.chefs do
					local npc = get_character(self.chefs[j])
					if ui_quest_marker:IsActiveMarker(npc.Name) then
						quest_marker_util.remove(npc.Name)
					end
				end

				-- 각 상황 별로 퀘스트 마커 배치
				if not is_in_basement then
					local exit_fo = get_field_object(exit_name)
					ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(exit_name, '286', true, exit_fo)
				else
					local npc = get_character(self.chefs[i])
					ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(npc.Name, '286', true, npc)
				end
			else
				local npc = get_character(self.marker_npc_list[i].target)
				if ui_quest_marker:IsActiveMarker(npc.Name) then
					quest_marker_util.remove(npc.Name)
				end
				if not is_in_basement then
					ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(npc.Name, '286', true, npc)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:deactive_quest_marker()
	for i = 1, #self.marker_npc_list do
		if self.marker_npc_list[i].target == 'demon_rep_group' then
			local npc = get_character(self.demon_rep_group[1])
			if ui_quest_marker:IsActiveMarker(npc.Name) then
				quest_marker_util.remove(npc.Name)
			end
		elseif self.marker_npc_list[i].target == 'elder_group' then
			local npc = get_character(self.elder_group[1])
			if ui_quest_marker:IsActiveMarker(npc.Name) then
				quest_marker_util.remove(npc.Name)
			end
		elseif self.marker_npc_list[i].target == 'basement' then
			local exit_name = 'basement_inner_1'
			if ui_quest_marker:IsActiveMarker(exit_name) then
				quest_marker_util.remove(exit_name)
			end

			local npc = get_character(self.chefs[1])
			if ui_quest_marker:IsActiveMarker(npc.Name) then
				quest_marker_util.remove(npc.Name)
			end
		else
			local npc = get_character(self.marker_npc_list[i].target)
			if ui_quest_marker:IsActiveMarker(npc.Name) then
				quest_marker_util.remove(npc.Name)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_marker_npc(name)
	for i = 1, #self.marker_npc_list do
		if self.marker_npc_list[i].target == name then
			return self.marker_npc_list[i]
		end
	end

	return self.marker_npc_list[1]
end

function local_class:show_lamp_tip()
	quest_icon_util.remove(self.get_holdable_light())

	self:show_evacuation(false)
	self.has_seen_light_tip = true

	-- 나레이션 - 밝게 빛나는 전등이다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_rescue_vamp_town_s2_20_1' })

	-- 선택지
	-- 1) 전등을 가져간다. / 2). 그만둔다.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'ds_rescue_vamp_town_s2_20_2', 'mercy' }
	, { 'ds_rescue_vamp_town_s2_20_3', 'normal' } })

	--그만둔다.
	if choose_result == 2 then
		return
	end

	-- 이제 어두운 곳도 밝게 비춰서 볼 수 있습니다
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_rescue_vamp_town_s2_20' })

	self.seen_jump_scare_3 = true
	self.get_holdable_light().Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(0.8, 1, 0.8))
	self.get_holdable_light().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.lamp_effect:Dispose()
	self.lamp_effect = nil
	command_util.execute_holdup(user_party.Leader, self.get_holdable_light(), user_party.Leader.Position)

	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Throw | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)
	self:show_evacuation(true)

	local door_name = 'battle_zone_door_4_'
	for i = 1, 2 do
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(door_name .. i))
	end
end

function local_class:show_flower_pot_narration()
	self:show_evacuation(false)
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_rescue_vamp_town_s2_26' })
	self:show_evacuation(true)
end

function local_class:acquire_key()
	self:show_evacuation(false)

	local key_interactable = self.get_elder_son_key()
	key_interactable.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	party_util.align_party(key_interactable.Position - vector(0.25, 0, 0),
			'right', 0.75, 'linear')

	-- 플레이어 left, idle, eat를 실행.
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- fx_object_twinkle_single 사라지며, 플레이어 key_type1 스프라이트를 손에 든 채 left, smile, victory_get 실행.
	self.key_effect:Dispose()
	self.key_effect = nil

	eat_sfx:Stop()

	screen_util.item_get_event(
			20656,
			'ds_rescue_vamp_town_key_title',
			'ds_rescue_vamp_town_key_subtitle',
			'ds_rescue_vamp_town_key_desc'
	)

	self.is_get_elder_son_door_key = true
	self:show_evacuation(true)
end

function local_class:interact_door()
	if not self.is_get_elder_son_door_key then
		self:show_evacuation(false)
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_rescue_vamp_town_key_door_1' })
		self:show_evacuation(true)
		return
	end

	local door = self.get_elder_key_door()
	door.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	local key = self:create_drop_item(20656, user_party.Leader.Position)

	key.ConsumeTarget = door
	key:Fly()
	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	-- 음..... 왜 message_system으로 안되는거지?
	door:OnEvent(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('elden_door', false))
end

function local_class:create_drop_item(id, pos_to_spawn, scale, show_on_character)
	local should_show_on_character = lua_helper.get_or_default(show_on_character, true)
	local drop_item_data = {
		itemid = id,
		pos = pos_to_spawn,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		notforinven = true,
		sprscale = scale,
		showoncharacter = should_show_on_character
	}

	return drop_item_util.create_item(drop_item_data)
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if table_util.contain_key(self.battle_group_data, e.BattleGroupName) then
		local group_data = self.battle_group_data[e.BattleGroupName]

		for i = 1, #group_data do
			local npc = get_character(group_data[i])
			character_util.add_listener(npc, self.controller)
			quest_icon_util.set_quest_cleared(npc)
		end

		return true
	end

	if e.BattleGroupName == 'inner_battle_6' then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.cleared_inner_battle_5_battle, self))
		return true
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'inner_battle_7' then
		self.is_battle_ghost_at_the_door = true
		character_util.add_listener(get_character('elder'), self.controller)
		character_util.add_listener(get_character('elder_son'), self.controller)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'transition_complete' then
		self:show_evacuation(true)
		self:dispose_dark_closed()
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'transition_start' then
		self:show_evacuation(false)
	end
end

function local_class:reached_jump_scare()
	-- 화로 던질 수 있도록 수정
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 어두운거 풀어준다.
	self:dispose_dark_closed()
end

-- breakable 사이 숨어있다가 튀어나와 시작되는 전투
function local_class:co_jump_scare_2()
	self.seen_jump_scare_2 = true

	local battle_gate_count = 3
	for i = 1, battle_gate_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('inner_battle_3_door_' .. i))
	end

	for i = 1, 12 do
		local field_object = get_field_object('inner_battle_2_breakable_' .. i)
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = field_object
		damage_info.target = field_object
		damage_info.damage = CS.Oak.DamageConstants.ObjectImpact

		command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
	end

	local monster_name = 'inner_shadow_group_3_'
	local num_monters = 3
	local jump_move_marker_name = 'inner_battle_3_jump_'

	local jump_contexts = {}

	for i = 1, num_monters do
		local monster = get_character(monster_name .. i)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(monster, 1, 0.5)
		self.get_shadow_appear_effect():Instantiate(monster.Position)
		field_ui_manager:SetUI(monster, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

		local jump_marker = field:GetMarker(jump_move_marker_name .. i)
		local jump_pos = jump_marker.position
		local last_dir = jump_marker.dirction

		table.insert(jump_contexts, util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.jump_move(monster, jump_pos, 6, 1, true, last_dir)
			character_util.convert_to_monster(monster, 'inner_battle_3', 'inner_battle_zone_3')
			command_util.execute_monster_notice(monster, user_party.Leader, 'battle')

function local_class:jump_scare_4(zone_name)
	self.has_seen_jump_scare_3_zones[zone_name] = true

	local ghost_data_list = self.appear_npcs_on_each_jump_scare_3_zones[zone_name]
	local ghost_name = 'jump_scare_3_'

	local coroutines = {}

	for i = 1, #ghost_data_list do
		table.insert(coroutines, util.cs_generator(function()
			local ghost_data = ghost_data_list[i]
			local ghost = get_character(ghost_name .. ghost_data.id)

			character_util.set_direction(ghost, ghost_data.dir)

			local target_pos = ghost.Position + ghost_data.dist

			local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(
					ghost.Position + (ghost_data.dist / 2) + vector(0, 0.1, 0),
					vector(ghost_data.range_x, ghost_data.range_z))
			attack_range:Show()

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			attack_range:Hide()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_03')
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(ghost, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			character_util.set_active_state(ghost, 'enabled')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(ghost, 1, 0.1)

			character_util.move_to(ghost, target_pos, 0.5, nil, true, false)
			local duration = 0.5
			local time_passed = 0
			local leader_crashed = false
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = time_passed / duration

				local collide_fos = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(user_party.Leader.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

				if collide_fos:Contains(ghost) and not leader_crashed then
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
					damage_info.sender = ghost
					damage_info.target = user_party.Leader
					damage_info.notMortal = true
					damage_info.noCritical = true
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction_util.to_vector3(ghost.Direction)
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong * 2
					damage_info.damage = math.floor(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.2)
					command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
					leader_crashed = true
					coroutine.yield()
					command_util.execute_holdup(user_party.Leader, self.get_holdable_light(), user_party.Leader.Position, 0, false)

					character_util.spine_deviate_local(user_party.Leader, direction_util.to_vector3(ghost.Direction) * 0.3, 0.3, 0.2)
					character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(user_party.Leader)
					character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(user_party.Leader)
				end

				local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
				time_passed = time_passed + dt
				collide_fos:Dispose()
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			time_passed = 0
			character_util.set_position(ghost, target_pos)

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(ghost, 0, 0.1)
			character_util.set_active_state(ghost, 'disabled')
		end))
	end

	wait_all(coroutines)
end

function local_class:calc_dist(dir, ghost_pos, target_pos)
	if (dir & CS.Oak.Direction.Side) ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		return ghost_pos.x - target_pos.x
	else
		return ghost_pos.z - target_pos.z
	end
end

function local_class:npc_escape_routine(npc)
	npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	quest_icon_util.remove(npc)

	local get_marker_npc = self:get_marker_npc(npc.Name)
	get_marker_npc.escape = true
	quest_marker_util.remove(get_marker_npc.target)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(npc, self.controller)
	local current_saved_count = self.save_count

	self:increase_save_count(1)

	character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'smile' })
	quest_icon_util.remove(npc)
	character_util.hide_weapon(npc, true)
	character_util.stop_shake(npc)
	character_util.look_at(npc, user_party.Leader)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'sing' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc, { key = 'ds_main_s28_rescue', skip = false })
	character_util.remove_anim(npc)

	local wp_name_list = self.npc_escape_way_points[npc.Name]
	local wp = {}

	for i = 1, #wp_name_list do
		local idx = wp_name_list[i]
		table.insert(wp, field:GetMarker(self.npc_escape_marker_name .. idx).position)
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint(npc, wp, 6, true, nil, nil, 'down', true)
	local fade_duration = 2.5
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, fade_duration)
	wait_for_sec(fade_duration)
	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')

	if self.save_count == self.max_save_count and current_saved_count == self.max_save_count - 1 then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
		self:show_evacuation(false)

		if not self.is_epilogue_started then
			self:epilogue()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:epilogue()
	self.is_epilogue_started = true

	-- 멘션 외부의 몬스터 목록
	local blocking_npcs = {
		'shadow_spirit_blocking_30',
		'shadow_spirit_blocking_31',
		'shadow_spirit_blocking_24',
		'shadow_spirit_blocking_25',
		'shadow_spirit_blocking_29',
		'shadow_spirit_blocking_26',
		'shadow_spirit_blocking_28',
		'shadow_spirit_blocking_27',
	}

	for i = 1, #blocking_npcs do
		character_util.set_active_state(get_character(blocking_npcs[i]), 'disabled')
	end

	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_gimmick_jingle_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.set_position(knight, field:GetMarker('knight_epilogue_pos').position)
	character_util.set_position(sohee, field:GetMarker('sohee_epilogue_pos').position)
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'down')

	local npc_names = {
		'elder',
		'elder_son',
		'demon_rep',
		'rep_assistant',
		'part_time_chef_2',
		'head_chef',
		'part_time_chef_1',
		'butler'
	}

	local epilogue_pos_marker_name = '_epilogue_pos'

	local npcs = {}

	for i = 1, #npc_names do
		local npc = get_character(npc_names[i])
		local marker = field:GetMarker(npc_names[i] .. epilogue_pos_marker_name)
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, 0)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'up')
		character_util.set_position(npc, marker.position)
		table.insert(npcs, npc)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		name = 'ondemand/v2_39_demonshire/audio:bgm_demonshire_vampirezone', state = 'event' })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local script_key = 'ds_rescue_vamp_town_s3_'
	-- 원로 (up, smile, cast2) : 우리들을 구해줘서 정말 고맙네.
	character_util.set_anim(npcs[1], { name = 'cast2' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npcs[1], { key = script_key .. 1, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(npcs[1])

	-- 소히 (down, attack, cast2) : 감사 인사는 됐어, 그것보다 모두 이 위험한 곳을 빠져나가야 해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, { name = 'cast2' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = script_key .. 2, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

	-- 원로 아들 (up, attack, throw) : 그럼 우리들은 어디로 가야 하는 거지?
	character_util.set_anim(npcs[2], { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npcs[2], { key = script_key .. 3, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(npcs[2])

	-- 소히 (down, attack, cross_arm) : 광장에 그림자를 피해 온 다른 사람들이 전부 모여 있어, 통치자도 함께.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false }, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = script_key .. 4, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

	-- 원로 (up, idle, nod) : 알겠네, 모두 광장으로 가지!
	character_util.nod_twice(npcs[1])
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npcs[1], { key = script_key .. 5, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npcs[1])

	local prison_quest_id = 307
	local sun_lab_id = 309

	local prison_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(prison_quest_id)
	local sun_lab_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(sun_lab_id)

	local is_prison_rescued = (prison_quest_progress ~= nil) and prison_quest_progress.IsComplete
	local is_sun_lab_rescued = (sun_lab_quest_progress ~= nil) and sun_lab_quest_progress.IsComplete

	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'attack' })

	-- 307, 309 quest 클리어 시
	if is_prison_rescued and is_sun_lab_rescued then
		-- 소히 (가디언 바라보며, release, attack) : 자, 전부 구했으니 우리도 광장으로 돌아가자!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s28_cleared', skip = true })

		local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(286)
		if main_quest_progress ~= nil and main_quest_progress.InnerProgress == 27 then
			yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_quest, main_quest_progress, 1)
		end

		-- 클리어하지 않은 스테이지 남은 경우
	else
		-- 소히 (가디언 바라보며, release, attack) : 자, 다음 장소로 이동하자!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s28_not_cleared', skip = true })
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_clear_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')

	CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToLobby(true)
end

function local_class:turn_light_off()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_light_turn_off_01')

	-- 캐싱할 이팩트들 nil이 아니라면 dispose
	self:dispose_dark_closed()

	if self:is_holding_lamp() then
		local light = self.get_holdable_light()
		self.dark_open_effect = self.get_dark_open_effect():Instantiate(light.Position - vector(0, 1, 1.5), unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(25, 0, 0)), light.transform)
		self.dark_open_effect.transform.localScale = vector(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
	else
		self.dark_closed_effect = self.get_dark_closed_effect():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.Transform.parent)
	end

end

function local_class:is_holding_lamp()
	local fo = self.get_holdable_light()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(fo.Holdable, typeof(CS.Oak.NonHoldable)) then
		return false
	end
	return lua_helper.reference_equals(fo.Holdable.Holder, user_party.Leader)
end

function local_class:dispose_dark_closed()
	if self.dark_closed_effect ~= nil then
		self.dark_closed_effect:Dispose()
		self.dark_closed_effect = nil
	end

	if self.dark_open_effect ~= nil then
		self.dark_open_effect:Dispose()
		self.dark_open_effect = nil
	end
end

return local_class

			if user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and

function local_class:move_to_grid(x, z)
	if self.goblin_moving then
		return
	end

	if x < 0 or x > 2 then
		return
	end

	if z < 0 or z > 2 then
		return
	end

	if self.current_x == 2 and self.current_z == 0 then
		return
	end

	local backup_x = self.current_x
	local backup_z = self.current_z
	local backup_target_pos = self.current_target_pos

	self.current_x = x
	self.current_z = z

	self.goblin_moving = true

	self.current_target_pos = field:GetMarker('sdp_shadow_goblin_'..self.current_x..'_'..self.current_z).position

	if x == 2 and z == 0 then

		self.goblin_moving = false
		self.current_x = backup_x
		self.current_z = backup_z
		self.current_target_pos = backup_target_pos

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.goblin_run_to_the_corner, self))
	else

		self.moving_order_complete = true

	end

	if self.goblin_first_move then
		self.goblin_first_move = false
	end
end

function local_class:area_1_game_routine()
	local shadow_goblin = self.get_shadow_goblin()
	self.area_1_game_loop = true
	self.area_1_game_clear = false
	if self.attack_range_renderer == nil then
		self.attack_range_renderer = CS.Oak.GhostGuardAttackRangeRenderer(shadow_goblin, self.goblin_attack_distance, self.goblin_attack_angle)
	end

	while self.area_1_game_loop == true do

		if not self.goblin_blockabe then
			if self.goblin_moving and not self.move_start then
				self:goblin_move(shadow_goblin)
			elseif not self.move_start then
				self:moving_order(shadow_goblin)
				self:goblin_catch_guardian()
			end

			if self.area_1_game_loop == false then
				break
			end

			if not self.move_start and self.area_1_game_loop then
				if self.attack_range_renderer ~= nil then
					self.attack_range_renderer.AttackRange:Show(0)
					self.attack_range_renderer:Update(shadow_goblin)
				end
				character_util.look_at(shadow_goblin, user_party.Leader)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

end

	end

	camera_util.move_async(shadow_goblin.Position, 0.5)

		'up',

function local_class:moving_order(shadow_goblin)
	local diff = (user_party.Leader.Position - shadow_goblin.Position):GetX0z()
	local leader_x_diff
	local leader_z_diff

	local near_ground_brazier_num = 0
	local holdup_brazier = false

	near_ground_brazier_num = self:check_near_ground_brazier()

	if near_ground_brazier_num == 3 then
		self.near_fire_count = 2
	elseif near_ground_brazier_num == 0 then
		self.near_fire_count = 0
	else
		self.near_fire_count = 1
	end

	if self.near_fire_count == 0 then
		return
	elseif self.near_fire_count == 2 then
		if (self.current_x == 0 and self.current_z == 0)
				or (self.current_x == 0 and self.current_z == 2)
				or (self.current_x == 2 and self.current_z == 0) then
			return
		end
	else
		diff = (self.get_brazier().Position - shadow_goblin.Position):GetX0z()
	end


	leader_x_diff = self:get_leader_x_diff(diff)
	leader_z_diff = self:get_leader_z_diff(diff)

	if diff.magnitude < self.near_fire_distance then
		self.move_count = self.move_count + 1

		if leader_x_diff > leader_z_diff then
			if self.current_x < 2 and diff.x < 0 then
				if diff.z < -1 then
					self:move_to_grid(self.current_x, self.current_z + 1)
				else
					self:move_to_grid(self.current_x + 1, self.current_z)
				end
			elseif self.current_x > 0 and diff.x > 0 then
				self:move_to_grid(self.current_x - 1, self.current_z)
			end
		elseif leader_x_diff < leader_z_diff then
			if self.current_z == 0 and diff.z < 0 then
				self:move_to_grid(self.current_x, 1)
			elseif self.current_z == 1 and diff.z > 0 then
				if self.current_x == 2 then
					self:move_to_grid(self.current_x - 1, self.current_z)
				else
					if self.goblin_first_move then
						if self.current_x == 1 then
							self:move_to_grid(self.current_x - 1, self.current_z)
						else
							self:move_to_grid(self.current_x, self.current_z - 1)
						end
					else
						self:move_to_grid(self.current_x, 0)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if self.goblin_moving then
			return
		end

		if self.current_x < 2 and diff.x < 0 then
			if diff.z < -1 then
				if self.current_z == 2 then
					if self.current_x == 1 then
						self:move_to_grid(self.current_x - 1, self.current_z)
					elseif self.current_x == 0 then
						self:move_to_grid(self.current_x + 1, self.current_z)
					end
				else
					self:move_to_grid(self.current_x, self.current_z + 1)
				end
			else
				self:move_to_grid(self.current_x + 1, self.current_z)
			end

		elseif self.current_x > 0 and diff.x > 0 then
			self:move_to_grid(self.current_x - 1, self.current_z)
		elseif self.current_z == 0 and diff.z < 0 then
			self:move_to_grid(self.current_x, 1)
		elseif self.current_z == 1 and diff.z > 0 then
			if self.current_x == 2 then
				self:move_to_grid(self.current_x, self.current_z + 1)
			else
				self:move_to_grid(self.current_x, 0)
			end

		end

		if self.goblin_moving then
			return
		end

		if unity_class.mathf.Abs(diff.z) < unity_class.mathf.Abs(diff.x) then
			if self.current_z == 0 then
				self:move_to_grid(self.current_x, 1)
			else
				if self.current_z == 2 then
					self:move_to_grid(self.current_x, self.current_z - 1)
				else
					if self.current_x == 2 and self.current_z == 1 then
						self:move_to_grid(self.current_x, self.current_z + 1)
					else
						self:move_to_grid(self.current_x, 0)
					end
				end

			end
		else
			if self.current_z == 0 or self.current_z == 1  then
				if diff.z > 0 then
					self:move_to_grid(self.current_x + 1, self.current_z)
				else
					self:move_to_grid(self.current_x, self.current_z + 1)
				end
			else
				if self.current_x == 0 then
					self:move_to_grid(self.current_x + 1, self.current_z)
				elseif self.current_x == 2  then
					self:move_to_grid(self.current_x - 1, self.current_z)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_leader_x_diff(diff)
	if unity_class.mathf.Abs(diff.x) < (self.x_diff / 2) then
		return 0
	else
		return (unity_class.mathf.Abs(diff.x) - (self.x_diff / 2)) / self.x_diff
	end
end

function local_class:get_leader_z_diff(diff)
	if unity_class.mathf.Abs(diff.z) < (self.z_diff / 2) then
		return 0
	else
		return (unity_class.mathf.Abs(diff.z) - (self.z_diff / 2)) / self.z_diff
	end
end

function local_class:check_holdup_brazier(braizer)
	local holdup_braizer
	if user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		holdup_braizer = user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		if holdup_braizer ~= nil then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(holdup_braizer, braizer) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	local i = 0
	if lua_helper.type_compare(braizer.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) then
		i = 1
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:check_near_ground_brazier()
	local shadow_goblin = self.get_shadow_goblin()
	local xz_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(self.get_brazier().Position - shadow_goblin.Position)
	local magnitude = xz_vector.magnitude
	local distance = 0
	local fire_index_plus = 0

	distance = self.near_ground_fire_distance

	if magnitude < distance then
		fire_index_plus = fire_index_plus + 1
	end

	return fire_index_plus
end

function local_class:check_next_pos_near_ground_brazier(next_pos)
	local xz_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(self.get_brazier().Position - next_pos)
	local magnitude = xz_vector.magnitude
	local distance = 0
	local fire_index_plus = 0

	local holdup_braizer_1 = self:check_holdup_brazier(self.get_brazier())

	if holdup_braizer_1 then
		distance = self.near_holdup_fire_distance
	else
		distance = self.near_ground_fire_distance
	end

	if magnitude < distance then
		fire_index_plus = fire_index_plus + 1
	end

function local_class:character_move_async(character, speed)

	self:goblin_evasion_ment()

	end

function local_class:goblin_catch_guardian()
	local shadow_goblin = self.get_shadow_goblin()
	local xz_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party.Leader.Position - shadow_goblin.Position)
	local magnitude = xz_vector.magnitude
	local distance = 2

	local braizer
	if user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		braizer = user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		if braizer ~= nil then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(braizer, self.get_brazier()) then
				return
			end
		end
	end

	if magnitude < distance then
		self.area_1_game_loop = false
		if self.attack_range_renderer ~= nil then
			self.attack_range_renderer.AttackRange:Hide()
		end
		yield_return_func(self.reset_in_section_1, self)
		return
	end

function local_class:goblin_evasion_ment()

	-- 그림자 고블린 (right, idle, idle) : 으아악!! 불은 싫어!!
	-- 03_runaway_01 + 02_goblin_hit_01
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_goblin_hit_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(shadow_goblin, { key = self.string_key..3, skip = false })
end

function local_class:move_to_ease_in(target, pos, duration, speed, is_fo)
	local init_pos = target.Position
	local distance = pos - init_pos
	if duration == nil then
		duration = distance.magnitude / speed
	end

	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = timer / duration
		local process = 1 - math.cos(math.pi * 0.5 * progress)

		if is_fo then
			target.Position = init_pos + distance * process
		else
			character_util.set_position(target, init_pos + distance * process)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
		timer = timer + dt
	end

	if is_fo then
		target.Position = init_pos + distance
	else
		character_util.set_position(target, init_pos + distance)
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:sdp_800_target_chase()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.sdp_800_chase_flag = true
	local sdp_800 = self.get_sdp_800()
	sdp_800.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.2, 0, 0.2))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('sdp_section_2_entrance_door', false))
	local enter_pos = sdp_800.Position + vector(4.5,0,-1)
	party_util.align_party(enter_pos, 'right', 0.5,'arc')

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local speed = 1.5

	-- 스위치 눌림 판별을 위해 캐싱
	local switch_1 = get_field_object('sdp_section_2_switch_1')
	local switch_2 = get_field_object('sdp_section_2_switch_2')

	local switch_1_behaviour = switch_1.FieldObjectBehaviour
	local switch_2_behaviour = switch_2.FieldObjectBehaviour

	--부끄럼쟁이 유령 (right, attack, idle) : 날 그런 눈으로 쳐다보지 마…
	camera_util.move_async(sdp_800.Position, 0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(sdp_800, {name = 'attack'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_disappear_03')
	character_util.set_direction(sdp_800, 'right')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sdp_800, { key = self.sdp_script .. 1, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	--부끄럼쟁이 유령 (right, attack, idle) : 부끄럽단 말이야…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sdp_800, { key = self.sdp_script .. 2, skip = true })
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	local dash_sfx = nil
	local detection_dist = 0.5
	-- 파티 리더에게 접근
	while self.sdp_800_chase_flag do
		local dist_to_player = (leader.Position - sdp_800.Position).sqrMagnitude
		character_util.look_at(sdp_800, leader)

		if not switch_1_behaviour.IsPressed or not switch_2_behaviour.IsPressed then
			-- 눈이 마주쳤을 때 판단
			if sdp_800.Direction == direction_util.get_opposite(leader.Direction) then

				if not self.look_at_flag then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
					self.look_at_flag = true
				end
			else
				self.look_at_flag = false
			end

			if not self.look_at_flag then
				if dist_to_player < detection_dist then
					if dash_sfx ~= nil then
						dash_sfx:Stop()
						dash_sfx = nil
					end

					-- 붙잡혔을 때 리셋 이벤트
					self:detected_event(sdp_800)
				else
					if dash_sfx == nil then
						dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_ghost_appear_01', loop = true })
					end

					character_util.set_emotion(sdp_800, { name = 'attack' })
					character_util.set_anim(sdp_800, { name = 'walk', loop = true })
					local dir = (leader.Position - sdp_800.Position).normalized
					CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(sdp_800, dir, speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)
				end
			elseif self.look_at_flag then
				--범위안에서 바라보고 있을 경우
				if dash_sfx ~= nil then
					dash_sfx:Stop()
					dash_sfx = nil
				end
				character_util.set_emotion(sdp_800, { name = 'blush' })
				character_util.set_anim(sdp_800, { name = 'cast', loop = true })
			end
		else
			if dash_sfx ~= nil then
				dash_sfx:Stop()
				dash_sfx = nil
			end
			-- 스위치를 동시에 두개 눌러서 문이 열렸을 때 연출
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.cleared_event, self, sdp_800)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 붙잡혔을 때 리셋 이벤트
function local_class:detected_event(fo)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	self.sdp_800_chase_flag = false

	character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'shoot', loop = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed', loop = true })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('sdp_section_2_entrance_door', false))

	party_util.position_party(field:GetMarker('sdp_section_2_start').position, 'down', 'arc')
	character_util.set_position(fo, field:GetMarker('sdp_section_2_ghost_pos').position)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)

	party_util.remove_animation()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 스위치를 동시에 두개 눌러서 문이 열렸을 때 연출
function local_class:cleared_event(fo)
	self.sdp_800_chase_flag = false
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(fo, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'blush' })

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('sdp_section_2_entrance_door', false))
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	wait_for_sec(4)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	--부끄럼쟁이 유령 (right, blush, idle) : 으으… 더 이상 쫓아다닐 힘도 없어….
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fo, { key = self.sdp_script .. 3, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	--부끄럼쟁이 유령 (right, attack, idle) : 볼 일 다 봤으면, 빨리 나가! 부끄럽단 말이야…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fo, { key = self.sdp_script .. 4, skip = true })

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

return local_class

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_joypad_event(e)

	if self.section_3_game_play and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection) then
		if self.input_delay <= 0 then
			self.input_direction = e.Stick4WayDirection
			self.input_delay = 0.25
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_push_direction_key, self))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.key_delay_timer, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.section_3_start_zone_name and not self.current_section_start then
		self.current_section_start = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.section_start_event, self)
		return true
	elseif zone_name == self.section_3_orc_order_1_zone_name and not self.current_section_end and not self.interact_state then
		if self.orc_order_progress == 1 then
			self.interact_state = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.orc_come_n_order, self))
			return true
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.section_3_orc_order_2_zone_name and not self.current_section_end and not self.interact_state then
		if self.orc_order_progress == 2 then
			self.interact_state = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.orc_come_n_order, self))
			return true
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.section_3_orc_order_3_zone_name and not self.current_section_end and not self.interact_state then
		if self.orc_order_progress == 3 then
			self.interact_state = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.orc_come_n_order, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if e.FullLeave then
		if (zone_name == self.section_3_orc_order_1_zone_name
				or zone_name == self.section_3_orc_order_2_zone_name
				or zone_name == self.section_3_orc_order_3_zone_name) and not self.current_section_end then
			if self.orc_order_progress >= 1 and self.orc_order_progress <= 3
					and not self.orc_order_complete[self.orc_order_progress] then
				if self.interact_state then
					self.is_leave_test_zone = true
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_sdp_console(4)) then
		if not self.interact_state then
			self.interact_state = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_console, self)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_event(e)

	if string_helper.start_with(e.SwitchObject.Name, self.sdp_section_3_ending_switch_name) then

		if not self.current_section_end and not self.interact_state then
			self.current_section_end = true
			self.interact_state = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.section_end_event, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:orc_come_n_order()
	local orc = self.get_orc()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 오크 오는 연출
	self:orc_align()

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 시험


	-- 오크 : 저를 잘 따라 하세요, 회원님!
	-- 오크 : 쉴 틈 없습니다! 다음 동작!
	-- 오크 : 자! 얼마 안 남았어요! 마지막까지!
	if self.orc_order_progress == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_fat_ogre_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(orc, { key = self.string_key..3, skip = true })
	elseif self.orc_order_progress == 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(orc, { key = self.string_key..4, skip = true })
	elseif self.orc_order_progress == 3 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(orc, { key = self.string_key..5, skip = true })
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(orc, { key = self.string_key .. (self.orc_order_progress + 5), life_time = 1, skip = false })

	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(orc, { name = 'release', count = 3, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- state 변경
	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Create(user_party.Leader)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

	-- UI를 DPad로 초기화
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)

	self.interact_state = false

	self.exercise_loop = true

	self.section_3_game_play = true

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_exercise_ending, self))
end

function local_class:check_exercise_ending()
	while self.exercise_loop do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.orc_order_complete[self.orc_order_progress] and self.section_3_game_play then

		self.orc_order_progress = self.orc_order_progress + 1

		yield_return_func(self.orc_jump_to_next_point, self)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

		self.orc_detail_order_progress = 1

		self.input_delay = 0

		local orc = self.get_orc()

		self.section_3_game_play = false

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		if self.orc_order_progress > 3 then
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			self:orc_last_ment()
		end

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()

		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, false)

	end
end

function local_class:check_push_direction_key()

	if #self.direction_list[self.orc_order_progress] >= self.orc_detail_order_progress then
		if self.direction_list[self.orc_order_progress][self.orc_detail_order_progress] == self.input_direction then

			self.req_id = self.req_id + 1

			self.orc_detail_order_progress = self.orc_detail_order_progress + 1

			character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, true)

			self:guardian_training()
		else
			self.section_3_game_play = false

			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, false)

			self.exercise_loop = false

			self:reset_in_section_3()
			return
		end
	end

	if #self.direction_list >= self.orc_order_progress and #self.direction_list[self.orc_order_progress] < self.orc_detail_order_progress then
		self.orc_order_complete[self.orc_order_progress] = true

		return
	end
end

function local_class:key_delay_timer()
	while self.input_delay > 0 do
		self.input_delay = self.input_delay - unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:guardian_training()

	local cur_req_id = self.req_id

	if self.input_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		self.input_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None

		self.knight_ani_play_state = true
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'success', loop = false })

		local time = spine_util.get_animation_duration(user_party.Leader, 'success')

		while time > 0 do
			time = time - unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if cur_req_id ~= self.req_id and (self.orc_order_progress ~= 3 and self.orc_detail_order_progress ~= 4) then
				cur_req_id = self.req_id
				time = 0

				cur_req_id = self.req_id
				time = 0
				self:call_other_ani(false, cur_req_id)
				return
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

	elseif self.input_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		self.input_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None

		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged' })

		self.knight_ani_play_state = true
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_energy_fist_01')
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'gauntlet_combo_attack', loop = false })

		local time = spine_util.get_animation_duration(user_party.Leader, 'gauntlet_combo_attack') -- + 0.3

				cur_req_id = self.req_id

function local_class:orc_jump_to_next_point()
	local orc = self.get_orc()
	local orc_order_pos_2 = self.get_orc_order_pos(2)
	local orc_order_pos_3 = self.get_orc_order_pos(3)

	if self.orc_order_progress == 2 then
		character_util.set_direction(orc, 'down')
		local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })
		character_util.move_to_async(orc, orc.Position + vector(0, 0, -3), 0.7)
		run_sfx:Stop()
		run_sfx = nil
		character_util.move_to(orc, orc.Position + vector(0, 0, -3), 0.5)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.mario_jump_async(orc, 'right', 0.5, 1.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		character_util.set_direction(orc, 'right')
	elseif self.orc_order_progress == 3 then
		character_util.set_direction(orc, 'left')
		character_util.move_to(orc, orc.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0), 0.8)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.mario_jump_async(orc, 'left', 0.8, 1.2)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		character_util.set_direction(orc, 'up')
		local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true, parent = attacker })
		character_util.move_to_async(orc, orc.Position + vector(0, 0, 6), 0.9)
		character_util.move_to_async(orc, orc.Position + vector(-3.5, 0, 0), 0.5)
		run_sfx:Stop()
		run_sfx = nil
		character_util.set_direction(orc, 'right')
	end
end

function local_class:orc_align()
	local orc = self.get_orc()
	local orc_order_pos_1 = self.get_orc_order_pos(1)
	local orc_order_pos_2 = self.get_orc_order_pos(2)
	local orc_order_pos_3 = self.get_orc_order_pos(3)
	local wp_1_pos

	if self.orc_order_progress == 1 then
		-- party align
		party_util.align_party(orc_order_pos_1 + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 'right')

		wp_1_pos = orc_order_pos_1
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(orc, {wp_1_pos},
				2, false, nil, 'floor', 'right')
	elseif self.orc_order_progress == 2 then
		-- party align
		party_util.align_party(orc_order_pos_2 + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 'right')

	elseif self.orc_order_progress == 3 then
		-- party align
		party_util.align_party(orc_order_pos_3 + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 'right')

	end
end

function local_class:reset_in_section_3()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	party_util.remove_emotion()

	self.orc_detail_order_progress = 1
	self.interact_state = false
	self.input_delay = 0

	self.req_id = 0

	self.current_section_start = false

		self.sfx_star_piece = nil
	end
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.sdp_console()) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.console_interact_routine, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_star_piece_get_event(e)
	if star_piece_util.has_star_piece(self.star_piece_name) and
			self.current_progress == self.progress.sdp_switch then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.escape_routine, self))

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:escape_routine()
	self.current_progress = self.progress.sdp_star_piece

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local spin_duration = 0.15

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--나레이션 박스 : 가디언(은)는 긴급탈출보석(을)를 썼다!
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_sdp_foundation_nar_17' })

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_shield_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, {name = 'surprise'} )

	local dir_key = {
		'left',
		'up',
		'right',
		'down'
	}
	local count = 0
	local spin_func = function()
		for i = 1, 23 do
			count = i % 4 + 1
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			character_util.set_direction(leader, dir_key[count])
			wait_for_sec(spin_duration)
		end
	end

	--스핀
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(spin_func, self))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	party_util.position_party(self.get_escape_pos(), 'down', 'arc')

	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

end

--콘솔 선택 시 이벤트
function local_class:console_interact_routine()

	local align_pos = self.sdp_console().Position
	party_util.align_party(align_pos, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	--『SDP 구역 현 상황 : 불안전 연구소 방침에 따라 ‘락다운 조치’를 진행합니다.』
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_sdp_foundation_s4_1' })

	--『락다운 프로토콜을 실행하시겠습니까?』
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_sdp_foundation_s4_2' })

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { 'ds_sdp_foundation_choose_1', 'mercy' }, { 'ds_sdp_foundation_choose_2', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--락다운 프로토콜을 시작합니다
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_01')
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_sdp_foundation_s4_3' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_08')

		--화면 2초동안 쉐이크. 이후 나레이션 박스 출력.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
		camera_util.shake(0.15, 2)
		wait_for_sec(2)

		--도어 잠금.
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.first_door_name, false))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.third_door_name, false))

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_02')
		--"연구소 격리 완료.
		--SDP 구역 현 상황 : 안전"
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_sdp_foundation_s4_4' })

		--사용자의 안전을 위해, SDP - 999 ‘긴급탈출보석’ 사용을 승인합니다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ds_sdp_foundation_s4_5' })

		self.sfx_star_piece:Dispose()
		self.sfx_star_piece = nil

		local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
		message_system:SendSync(star_piece, CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(self.sdp_console().Position))

		self.current_progress = self.progress.sdp_switch
	end

end

--endregion

function local_class:section_enter_4_setting()

	if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 0 then
		-- door state stay는 유니티 컨포넌트 기능으로...
		-- 이후 섹션에서는 이전 클리어된 섹션 처리하도록 하자...
		self.controller:researchers_setting_after_pre_section()
		self.controller:turn_on_light_effect()
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.first_door_name, false))
	self.sfx_star_piece = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character'):Instantiate(self.sdp_console().Position + vector(0,1.5,-0.5))
end

	self.quest_progress = nil
