-- 스테이지 입장 시 셋팅 될 것들, 이벤트 구독 또는 NPC, Obj 상호작용 등록
function local_class:enter()
	-- 현재 스테이지가 맞는지 확인 꼭 할 것.
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_throw_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self ,typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
	-- 코스튬 얻는 석판 기믹에 석판 놓을떼미디 빋는 이벤트
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.Events.StoneBoardDirectingFinishedEvent), 'on_stoneboard_directing_finished_event')

	self:start_setting()

	local treasure_hunter = self.get_treasure_hunter()
	local basic_rifle_id = 9030011;
	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData');
	local rifle_data = item_data:GetSpec(basic_rifle_id).Data;
	local rifle_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(rifle_data, 'ShootOffset', 0.5);

	-- ShootHelper 로드
	local pattern_info = { columns = 1 }
	local proj_data = game_data_service.GetData('ProjectileData')
	local proj_spec = proj_data:GetSpec('rifle_bullet'):Clone()

	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, treasure_hunter)
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, proj_spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)

	self.first_stairs_pos = self.get_first_area_stairs().Position

	local stone = stage_progress.StonePieces
	if stone < 3 then
		stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.get_first_area_stairs().Name, 'disabled')

		if stone == 2 then
			if self:get_user_stone_piece_count() == 0 then
				self.check_enter_2_stone_event = true
			else
				self.no_first_marker = true
			end
		end
	else
		local brazier = self.get_brazier(1)

		command_util.execute_burn(nil, brazier, true)

		brazier = self.get_brazier(2)

		command_util.execute_burn(nil, brazier, true)

		self:quest_marker_setting(false)
	end

	local stone_piece = get_field_object('ds_1_3_stone_piece_3')
	if stone_piece ~= nil then
		stone_piece.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

	local fo = nil
	for i = 1, 4 do
		fo = get_field_object('three_trials_activity_3_wall_'..i)
		if fo ~= nil then
			character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'disabled')
		end
	end

	-- 메인 진행도 7이면 마커 변경
	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_num)

	if main_quest.InnerProgress == 7 then
		self:quest_marker_setting(true)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.star_piece_name, 'enabled')
end

-- 스테이지 퇴장 시 이벤트 구독 취소, 객체 nil로 해제
function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self ,typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	if self.earthquake_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.earthquake_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.earthquake_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.move_rock_sfx ~= nil then
		self.move_rock_sfx:Stop()
		self.move_rock_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.other_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.other_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.other_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	-- twinkle 이펙트 삭제
	if self.twinkle_effect_list[1] ~= nil then
		self.twinkle_effect_list[1]:Dispose()
		self.twinkle_effect_list[1] = nil
	end

	if self.twinkle_effect_list[2] ~= nil then
		self.twinkle_effect_list[2]:Dispose()
		self.twinkle_effect_list[2] = nil
	end

	if self.twinkle_effect_list[3] ~= nil then
		self.twinkle_effect_list[3]:Dispose()
		self.twinkle_effect_list[3] = nil
	end

	if self.twinkle_effect_list[4] ~= nil then
		self.twinkle_effect_list[4]:Dispose()
		self.twinkle_effect_list[4] = nil
	end

	if self.twinkle_effect_list[5] ~= nil then
		self.twinkle_effect_list[5]:Dispose()
		self.twinkle_effect_list[5] = nil
	end

	-- 코스튬 얻는 석판 기믹에 석판 놓을떼미디 빋는 이벤트
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.Events.StoneBoardDirectingFinishedEvent))

	if self.pooled_bullet ~= nil then
		self.pooled_bullet:Dispose()
		self.pooled_bullet = nil
	end

	self.shoot_helper = nil

	-- 이팩트 지우기
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.effects) do
		if self.effects[i] ~= nil then
			self.effects[i]:Dispose()
		end
	end

	self.activity_1_game_over = true
	self.activity_1_game_loop = false
	self.activity_2_game_loop = false

	self.shoot_helper = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_treasure_hunter(), self.controller)

	self.activity_1_game_loop = false
	self.activity_2_game_loop = false

	self.activity_1_spike_block_start_pos_list = nil
	self.activity_2_spike_block_start_pos_list = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	--
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_joypad_event(e)
	if self.activity_2_game_loop == true and self.one_input_limit == false and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection) then
		self.input_direction = e.Stick4WayDirection
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.activity_1_1_zone_name
			and self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_1_1 then
		self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_1_2
		--탐험가 : 분명히 전설의 성배가 이안에 있을거야.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_treasure_hunter(), { key = self.string_key..101, skip = false })
		return true
	elseif zone_name == self.activity_1_2_zone_name
			and self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_1_2 then
		self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_1_3
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.area_1_enter_earthquake_event, self))
		return true
	elseif zone_name == self.activity_1_3_zone_name and self.interact_check == false then
		local stair_5 = self.get_area_stairs(5)
		if user_party.Leader.Position.z < stair_5.Position.z + 0.5 and user_party.Leader.Position.z > stair_5.Position.z - 0.5 then
			self.interact_check = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.go_from_area_1_to_area_2, self, false)
		else
			self.interact_check = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.go_from_area_1_to_area_2, self, true)
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.activity_2_1_zone_name
			and self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_2_1 then
		self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_2_2
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.pre_puzzle_event_in_area_2, self)
		return true
	elseif zone_name == self.activity_2_play_zone_name
			and (self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_2_3
			or self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_2_4)
			and self.cur_activity_2_state == self.activity_2_state_enum.none then
		local check = self:check_first_line_rock()
		if check == false then
			--sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_play_zone_in_area_2, self)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_play_zone_in_area_2, self))
			return true
		end
		return false
	elseif (zone_name == self.activity_2_trap_zone_1_name or zone_name == self.activity_2_trap_zone_2_name
			or zone_name == self.activity_2_trap_zone_3_name or zone_name == self.activity_2_trap_zone_4_name)
			and self.activity_2_trap_on == false then
		local check = self:check_first_line_rock()
		if check == false then
			self.activity_2_trap_on = true
			return true
		end
		return false
	elseif zone_name == self.activity_2_2_zone_name and self.activity_2_game_clear == false then
		self.activity_2_game_clear = true
		return true
	elseif zone_name == self.activity_3_start_zone_name and self.interact_check_in_activity_3 == false then
		if self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_3_1
				or self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_3_2 then
			self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_3_2
			if self.activity_3_event == false then
				self.interact_check_in_activity_3 = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.limit_movement, self))
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	elseif zone_name == self.activity_3_end_zone_name and self.bright_bridge == true and self.interact_check_in_activity_3 == false then
		self.interact_check_in_activity_3 = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.hide_bridge_effect, self)
		return true
	elseif zone_name == self.update_marker_zone_1_name then
		self:quest_marker_setting(false)
		return true
	elseif zone_name == self.update_marker_zone_2_name then
		self:quest_marker_setting(true)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_treasure_hunter()) then
		if self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.none then
			local stone_count = stage_progress.StonePieces
			if stone_count == 2 and self.interact_check == false then
				self.interact_check = true
				if self:get_user_stone_piece_count() == 0 then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.set_2_stone_piece_after_event, self, true))
				else
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.reply_2_stone_piece_after_event, self))
				end
			elseif stone_count < 2 then
				-- 탐험가(left,tired,question) : 이 석판 조각을 놈들에게 빼앗기면 안 될텐데…
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, { key = self.string_key..1, skip = false })
			end
			return true
		elseif self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.meet_treasure_hunter and
				self.interact_check == false then

			if self.first_talk_with_hunter == false then
				self.first_talk_with_hunter = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_treasure_hunter, self)
			else
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.treasure_hunter_request, self, true, e.Target)
			end
		elseif self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_2_3 then
			-- 탐험가(right,idle,idle) : 주인이라… 이 표지판의 언어대로면 VAMPIRE LORD인가?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, { key = self.string_key..40, skip = true })
		elseif (self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_3_1
				or self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_3_2)
				and self.interact_check == false then
			self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_3_2
			self.interact_check = true
			-- 탐험가(right,scared,idle) : 제길, 여기까지 와서 포기해야하는 건가?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, { key = self.string_key..102, skip = false })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_first_area_stairs()) then
		if self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.meet_treasure_hunter and
				self.interact_check == false then

			if self.first_talk_with_hunter == false then
				self.first_talk_with_hunter = true

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.treasure_hunter_request, self, true, e.Target)

		self.interact_check_in_activity_3 = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.try_exit_area_4, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_area_stairs(4)) and self.interact_check == false then
		self.interact_check = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.go_from_area_3_to_area_4, self)

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.tap_count = self.tap_count + 1
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.swipe_qte_right_success = true
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.swipe_qte_left_success = true
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_stoneboard_directing_finished_event(e)
	if self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.none and e.CurrentFill > 0 then
		if e.CurrentFill == 2 then

			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.set_2_stone_piece_after_event, self, false))
		elseif e.CurrentFill == 3 then

			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.set_3_stone_piece_after_event, self))
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	if string.find(e.Target.Name, 'three_trials_pot_') then
		self.activity_3_throwing = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)

	-- 브레이커블 오브젝트 파괴 시
	if string.find(e.FieldObject.Name, 'three_trials_pot_') then
		self.activity_3_throwing = false
		if self.bright_bridge == false and self.interact_check_in_activity_3 == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_effect_by_fo, self, e.FieldObject))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	local security_bot = self.get_security_bot()

	-- 란이 강난사콩에 맞았을 때
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, security_bot) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hit_security_bot, self))
	end
end

function local_class:hit_security_bot()
	local security_bot = self.get_security_bot()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(security_bot)

	-- 피격 이팩트
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(security_bot.Bounds.center)

	-- 로봇이 쓰러진다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_01')
	character_util.set_anim(security_bot, { name = 'dead2', sfx_key = '01_hit_comic_01', loop = false }, {name = 'dead'})

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(security_bot)

function local_class:start_setting()
	local treasure_hunter = self.get_treasure_hunter()
	local treasure_hunter_first_pos = self.get_treasure_hunter_first_pos()

	character_util.set_active_state(treasure_hunter, 'enabled')

	local stone = stage_progress.StonePieces
	if stone < 3 then
		character_util.set_position(treasure_hunter, treasure_hunter_first_pos)

		character_util.set_direction(treasure_hunter, 'left')

		character_util.set_emotion(treasure_hunter, { name = 'scared' })

		character_util.shake(treasure_hunter, 0.04, 9999)

		stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.star_piece_name, 'enabled')

		if stone == 2 then
			if self:get_user_stone_piece_count() > 0 then
				character_util.stop_shake(treasure_hunter)
				character_util.set_direction(treasure_hunter, 'right')
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(treasure_hunter)
			end
		end
	else
		character_util.set_position(treasure_hunter, treasure_hunter_first_pos + vector(0, 0, -1))
		character_util.set_anim(treasure_hunter, { name = 'question', loop = false })
		character_util.set_direction(treasure_hunter, 'left')

		self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.meet_treasure_hunter

		self.first_talk_with_hunter = false

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key..3, treasure_hunter.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), true)
	end

	character_util.add_listener(treasure_hunter, self.controller)

	local sign_board = self.get_ending_sign_board_1()
	if sign_board ~= nil then
		character_util.set_active_state(sign_board, 'disabled')
	end
	sign_board = self.get_ending_sign_board_2()
	if sign_board ~= nil then
		character_util.set_active_state(sign_board, 'disabled')
	end

	-- save spike block move end pos
	local spike_block_index = 1
	for i = 0, 16 do
		if #self.activity_1_spike_block_start_pos_list < 17 then
			local block = self.get_spike_block(spike_block_index + i)
			if block ~= nil then
				table.insert(self.activity_1_spike_block_start_pos_list, block.Position)
			end
		end
	end

	spike_block_index = 22
	for i = 0, 11 do
		local block = self.get_spike_block(spike_block_index + i)
		if block ~= nil then
			if #self.activity_2_spike_block_start_pos_list < 12 then
				table.insert(self.activity_2_spike_block_start_pos_list, self.get_spike_block(spike_block_index + i).Position)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:quest_marker_setting(inside)
	local stone = stage_progress.StonePieces

	if self.no_first_marker == true then
		return
	end

	if stone >= 2 then
		if inside then
			local treasure_hunter = self.get_treasure_hunter()

			if self.check_enter_2_stone_event == false then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key..3,
						treasure_hunter.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), true)
			elseif self.check_enter_2_stone_event == true then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key..5, treasure_hunter.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), true)
			end
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key..4)
		else
			local outer_marker_pos = self.get_underpass_outer_pos()

			outer_marker_pos = outer_marker_pos + vector(2, 0, 1.5)

			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key..4,
					outer_marker_pos, true)
			if self.check_enter_2_stone_event == false then
				quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key..3)
			elseif self.check_enter_2_stone_event == true then
				quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key..5)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_user_stone_piece_count()
	local stone_piece = CS.Oak.User.Me:GetItem(self.stone_piece_item_id)
	if stone_piece ~= nil then
		return stone_piece.Amount
	end

	return 0
end

function local_class:set_2_stone_piece_after_event(no_put_stone_piece)
	local treasure_hunter = self.get_treasure_hunter()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(treasure_hunter, self.controller)

	if no_put_stone_piece then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		self.check_enter_2_stone_event = false

		quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key..5)

		party_util.align_party(treasure_hunter.Position, 'right')
	end

	character_util.stop_shake(treasure_hunter)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(treasure_hunter)

	-- 탐험가에게 카메라 이동
	camera_util.move_async(treasure_hunter.Position, 0.5)

	-- 탐험가(right,idle,idle): 응?
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(treasure_hunter, 'right')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(treasure_hunter, { key = self.string_key..2, skip = true })
	-- 탐험가(right,surprise,idle)(jump1회): 이럴수가!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_emotion(treasure_hunter, { name = 'surprise' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(treasure_hunter, { key = self.string_key..3, skip = true })

	-- 석판쪽으로 카메라 이동후 다시 탐험가쪽으로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(treasure_hunter.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5), 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	camera_util.move_async(treasure_hunter.Position, 0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')

	-- 탐험가(right,smile,release) : 자네가 석판 조각을 모아온 건가?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(treasure_hunter, { key = self.string_key..4, skip = true })

	-- 가디언(left,smile,idle)nod2회

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(user_party.Leader)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(treasure_hunter)

	-- 탐험가(right,idle,idle): 이 조각을 마저 끼워보게!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(treasure_hunter, { key = self.string_key..5, skip = true })

	-- 탐험가가 해당 별위치로 나머지 석판조각을 던져준다.
	local stone_piece = get_field_object('ds_1_3_stone_piece_3')
	if stone_piece ~= nil then
		--01_swing_01 + 01_throw_01
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(treasure_hunter, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		local end_pos = treasure_hunter.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
		if no_put_stone_piece then
			end_pos = treasure_hunter.Position + vector(1, 0, -1)
		end

		sp_util.sine_move(stone_piece, { from = treasure_hunter.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.2),
										 to = end_pos,
															   duration = 0.5, height = 0.8 })
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	self.interact_check = false
end

function local_class:talk_with_treasure_hunter()
	local treasure_hunter = self.get_treasure_hunter()

	party_util.align_party(treasure_hunter.Position, 'right')

	if self.controller.cur_event_state ~= self.controller.event_state_enum.meet_treasure_hunter then
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(treasure_hunter)
	end

	if self.interact_check == false then
		self.interact_check = true
	end

	-- 탐험가(right,surprise,idle) jump1회
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(treasure_hunter, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim(treasure_hunter)
	-- 탐험가(right,smile,release) : 이봐! 혹시 이 미궁을 탐험 해볼 생각인가?
	-- 탐험가(right,smile,idle) : 내 정보에 의하면 이 아래 엄청난 보물이 있네! (new)
	character_util.set_emotion(treasure_hunter, { name = 'smile' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(treasure_hunter, { key = self.string_key..6, skip = true })

	-- 탐험가(right,idle,idle) : 내가 입수한 지도에 의하면 이 아래 엄청난 보물이 있지만.
	-- 탐험가(left,sleep_deep,question) : 마음 같아선 혼자 독차지하고 싶지만. (new)
	character_util.set_direction(treasure_hunter, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(treasure_hunter, { name = 'sleep_deep' })

function local_class:treasure_hunter_request(retry, target)
	local treasure_hunter = self.get_treasure_hunter()

	if self.interact_check == false then
		self.interact_check = true
	end

	-- party align
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_treasure_hunter()) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			party_util.align_party(treasure_hunter.Position, 'right')
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_first_area_stairs()) then
			party_util.align_party(self.get_first_area_stairs().Position, 'up')
			character_util.set_direction(treasure_hunter, 'left')
		end
	end

	if not retry then
		-- 탐험가(right,idle,idle) : 이곳에는 함정이 너무 많아서 혼자는 위험할 거야.
		-- 탐험가(right,attack,idle): 무수한 함정들이 도사리고 있으니 준비를 철저히 하게. (new)
		character_util.set_emotion(treasure_hunter, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(treasure_hunter, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(treasure_hunter, { key = self.string_key..9, skip = true })
	else
		-- 탐험가(right,idle,idle) : 다시 도전할 용기가 생겼나? 나와 함께 가지!
		-- 탐험가(right,idle,idle) : 어떤가? 모험을 떠날 준비는 됐나? (new)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(treasure_hunter, { key = self.string_key..13, skip = true })
	end

	local choose_list = {
		-- 동행한다.
		-- 준비는 끝났다. (new)
		{ self.string_key..10, 'mercy' },
		-- 아직 준비가 안됐다.
		--  (new)
		{ self.string_key..11, 'normal' },
	}

	--  (new)

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_list)

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 탐험가(right,idle,idle):좋았어! 모험을 떠나볼까!
		-- 탐험가(right,smile,victory_get) : 좋았어! 모험을 떠나볼까! (new)
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_emotion(treasure_hunter, { name = 'smile' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		character_util.set_anim(treasure_hunter, { name = "victory_get", loop = false })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(treasure_hunter, { key = self.string_key..12, skip = true })

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_walk_06')

		-- fade out
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

		character_util.remove_relate_event(treasure_hunter, self.controller)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(treasure_hunter)

		self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_1_1

		for i, v in ipairs(self.controller.current_party_member) do
			self.controller.current_party_member[i] = nil
		end

		-- 파티원들 저장 후 비활성화
		for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
			local member = user_party[i]
			character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
			member.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			table.insert(self.controller.current_party_member, member)
		end

		self:enter_area_1(false, false)
	elseif choose_result == 2 then

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(treasure_hunter)
	end
	self.interact_check = false
end

function local_class:move_base_spike_block()
	local move_distance_x_1 = 31
	local spike_block_index = 1
	local spike_block_list = {}
	local spike_block_end_pos_list = {}

	-- 지연
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	self.activity_1_last_block_pos = self.get_spike_block(10).Position + vector(7.5, 0, 0.5)

	local duration_1 = 8.8

	for i = 0, 11 do
		table.insert(spike_block_list, self.get_spike_block(spike_block_index + i))
		table.insert(spike_block_end_pos_list, self.get_spike_block(spike_block_index + i).Position + vector(move_distance_x_1, 0, 0))
	end

	local timer_1 = 0

	while timer_1 < duration_1 and self.activity_1_game_over == false and self.activity_1_game_clear == false do
		if self.activity_1_game_clear == true then
			break
		end

		for i = 1, 12 do
			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.activity_1_spike_block_start_pos_list[i], spike_block_end_pos_list[i], timer_1 / duration_1)

			spike_block_list[i].Position = cur_pos

			-- check rock
			for j = 1, 15 do
				local small_rock = self.get_activity_1_small_rock(j)
				if small_rock.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
					if (spike_block_list[i].Position.z > (small_rock.Position.z - 0.5) and spike_block_list[i].Position.z < (small_rock.Position.z + 0.5))
							and (spike_block_list[i].Position.x > (small_rock.Position.x - 0.55) and spike_block_list[i].Position.x < (small_rock.Position.x + 0.5)) then
						self.get_dead_effect():Instantiate(small_rock.Position)
						stage_util.set_fo_active_state(small_rock.Name, 'disabled')
					end
				end
			end
		end

		timer_1 = timer_1 + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	spike_block_list = {}
	spike_block_end_pos_list = {}
end

function local_class:activity_1_game_routine()
	self.activity_1_game_loop = true
	self.activity_1_game_over = false

	while self.activity_1_game_loop == true do
		if self.activity_1_game_move_block == true then
			self.activity_1_game_move_block = false
			self.move_rock_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_push_rock_01'
			, loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default', parent = self.get_spike_block(11) })
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_base_spike_block, self))
		end
		if self.controller.cur_event_state ~= self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_1_5 then
			if user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP <= 1 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fail_to_escape, self))
				self.activity_1_game_loop = false
				self.activity_1_game_over = true
			end

			self:check_collision_spike_block()
		else
			self.activity_1_game_loop = false
			self.activity_1_game_over = false
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:check_collision_spike_block()

	if self.activity_1_middle_event == true then
		return
	end

	if self.activity_3_event == true then
		return
	end

	if self.activity_3_coll_spike_progress == true then
		return
	end

	local collide_fos = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(
			user_party.Leader.Bounds.center, user_party.Leader.Bounds)

	local coll = false
	local spike_block_index = 1
	if self.activity_3_check_coll_loop == true then
		spike_block_index = 34
		local block = nil
		for i = 0, 3 do
			block = self.get_spike_block(spike_block_index + i)
			if collide_fos:Contains(block) then
				coll = true
				break
			end
		end
	elseif self.activity_3_check_coll_loop ~= true then
		spike_block_index = 1
		local block = nil
		for i = 0, 14 do
			block = self.get_spike_block(spike_block_index + i)
			if collide_fos:Contains(block) then
				coll = true
				break
			end
		end

		if coll == false then
			spike_block_index = 38
			for i = 0, 5 do
				block = self.get_spike_block(spike_block_index + i)
				if collide_fos:Contains(block) then
					coll = true
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end


	collide_fos:Dispose()

	if coll then
		if self.activity_3_check_coll_loop ~= true then
			self.activity_1_game_loop = false
			self.activity_1_game_over = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.fail_to_escape_by_spike_block, self))
		else
			self.activity_3_coll_spike_progress = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.fail_to_escape_by_spike_block, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_first_line_rock()
	local next_position = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local small_rock = self.get_activity_3_small_rock(i)
		if (next_position.z > (small_rock.Position.z - 0.5) and next_position.z < (small_rock.Position.z + 0.5))
				and (next_position.x > (small_rock.Position.x - 0.5) and next_position.x < (small_rock.Position.x + 0.5)) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:enter_play_zone_in_area_2()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local treasure_hunter = self.get_treasure_hunter()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(treasure_hunter, self.controller)

	local start_pos = nil

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local safe_pos = self.get_activity_3_start_safe_pos(i)
		if user_party.Leader.Position.z > (safe_pos.z - 0.5) and
				user_party.Leader.Position.z < (safe_pos.z + 0.5) then
			start_pos = safe_pos
		end
	end

	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

	if start_pos ~= nil then

		self.cur_activity_2_state = self.activity_2_state_enum.start

		-- safe zone
		character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, start_pos, 0.5, nil, false, true, false)

		--party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()

		if self.activity_2_first_enter == false then

			self.activity_2_first_enter = true
		end

		self.activity_2_trap_on = false

		self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_2_4

		self.activity_2_game_loop = true

		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.activity_2_game_routine, self))
	else
		self.cur_activity_2_state = self.activity_2_state_enum.trap

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()

function local_class:activity_2_game_routine()
	self.activity_2_game_loop = true
	self.is_game_over = false
	self.input_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
	self.input_delay = 0.1	-- 연속 입력 방지

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--self:enter_play_zone_game_ui_setting(false)

	--주인공 충돌 Behaviour 교체
	local user_crash_behavior = user_party.Leader.CrashBehaviour	-- 이전 상태 저장
	user_party.Leader.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- state 변경
	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Create(user_party.Leader)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

	-- UI를 DPad로 초기화
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	while self.activity_2_game_loop == true do

		-- 게임오버 처리
		if self.is_game_over then
			return
		elseif self.activity_2_game_loop == true then
			--조작 처리
			if self.input_delay > 0 then
				self.input_delay = self.input_delay - unity_class.time.deltaTime --조작 불가능 시간 줄이기
				if self.input_delay <= 0 then
					self:user_move_end()
					self:check_activity_2_zone()
					self.one_input_limit = false
					if self.cur_activity_2_state == self.activity_2_state_enum.trap then
						self.cur_activity_2_state = self.activity_2_state_enum.trap
						self.input_delay = 0
						self.activity_2_game_loop = false
						self.input_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
						user_party.Leader.CrashBehaviour = user_crash_behavior
						self:reset_in_area_2(false)
						break
					elseif self.cur_activity_2_state == self.activity_2_state_enum.ending then
						self.cur_activity_2_state = self.activity_2_state_enum.ending
						self.input_delay = 0
						self.activity_2_game_loop = false
						self.input_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
						user_party.Leader.CrashBehaviour = user_crash_behavior
						self:clear_area_2()
						break
					elseif self.cur_activity_2_state == self.activity_2_state_enum.none then
						self.input_delay = 0
						self.activity_2_game_loop = false
						self.activity_2_trap_on = false
						self.input_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
						self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_2_3
						character_util.add_listener(self.get_treasure_hunter(), self.controller)
						self:enter_play_zone_game_ui_setting(true)
						user_party.Leader.CrashBehaviour = user_crash_behavior
						party_util.reset_controllers()
						field_ui_manager:Show()
						break
					end
				end
			elseif self.input_direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
				self:user_action(self.input_direction)
			end
		end

		self.input_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
		coroutine.yield()
	end

end
-- 유저의 행동 처리
function local_class:user_action(direction)
	local direction_vector = self:direction_to_vector(direction)
	local prev_position = self:round_position(user_party.Leader.Position);	--이전 위치
	local next_position = prev_position + direction_vector
	local next_next_position = next_position + direction_vector
	local user_next_position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	local user_action_type = {
		none = 0,
		move = 1,
		push = 2
	}
	local final_user_action = user_action_type.none
	local block = self:get_block(next_position)

	-- 플레이어 행동 처리
	if self:is_activity_2_area(next_position.x, next_position.z) then
		if block == nil then
			final_user_action = user_action_type.move
		end
	end

	-- 행동 개시
	if final_user_action == user_action_type.move then
		local dir = (next_position - user_party.Leader.Position).normalized
		user_party.Leader.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.user_move, self, next_position, self.leader_move_duration))
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'walk', loop = true })
		user_next_position = next_position
	end

	if final_user_action ~= user_action_type.none then
		self.input_delay = self.leader_move_duration + 0.1
	else
		self.input_delay = 0.001	-- 연속 입력 방지
	end
end

function local_class:user_move(next_position, duration)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_game_move_01', volume = 0.6 })

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		self:move_by_one_frame(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position, next_position, 4)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local new_pos = self:round_position(user_party.Leader.Position)
	user_party.Leader.Position = new_pos
end

function local_class:move_by_one_frame(fo, pos_from, pos_to, speed)
	local dir = (pos_to - pos_from).normalized
	--fo.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
	CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
			fo,
			dir,
			speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)
end

function local_class:user_move_end()
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
end

function local_class:round_position(pos)
	return vector(math.floor(pos.x + 0.5), math.floor(pos.y + 0.5), math.floor(pos.z + 0.5))
end

function local_class:is_activity_2_area(next_position_x, next_position_y)
	if next_position_y < -70.5 then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:get_block(pos)
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local small_rock = self.get_activity_3_small_rock(i)
		if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(small_rock.Bounds, pos) then
			return small_rock
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:check_activity_2_zone()

	--field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad, user_party.Leader)
	--field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)

	if not self.activity_2_trap_on then

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_direction(treasure_hunter, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(treasure_hunter, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_anim(treasure_hunter, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- fall
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_fall_down_01')
	user_party.Leader:SetRotation(-1000, 1)
	user_party.Leader:SetScale(unity_class.vector3.zero, 1)

	treasure_hunter:SetRotation(1000, 1)
	treasure_hunter:SetScale(unity_class.vector3.zero, 1)

	local current_party_member = {}
	for i = 0, user_party.Count -1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		table.insert(current_party_member, member)
	end
	table.insert(current_party_member, treasure_hunter)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.move_obj, self, current_party_member,
					user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 0.5, vector(-1, 0, 0)))

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.remove_emotion(treasure_hunter)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	-- fade out circular
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	character_util.convert_to_npc(treasure_hunter)

	self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.activity_passage_3_2

	user_party.Leader:SetRotation(0, 0)
	user_party.Leader:SetScale(unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	treasure_hunter:SetRotation(0, 0)
	treasure_hunter:SetScale(unity_class.vector3.one, 0)

	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(treasure_hunter)
	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, entry_activity_area_3 + vector(1, 0, -1.5))
	character_util.set_position(treasure_hunter, entry_activity_area_3 + vector(3, 0, -1))
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(treasure_hunter, 'right')


	character_util.add_listener(treasure_hunter, self.controller)

	-- fade in circular
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')
end

function local_class:limit_movement()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	local treasure_hunter = self.get_treasure_hunter()

	if self.bright_bridge == false then

		-- 탐험가(left,surprise,release)(jump1화): 안돼! 자네 위험하다네!
		character_util.look_at(treasure_hunter, user_party.Leader)
		character_util.set_emotion(treasure_hunter, { name = 'surprise' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(treasure_hunter, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(treasure_hunter, { key = self.string_key..69, skip = false })

		-- 가디언 뒤로 물러남
		character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader,
				user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
				1, nil, false, true, false)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(treasure_hunter)
		character_util.set_direction(treasure_hunter, 'right')

	end

	self.interact_check_in_activity_3 = false

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:crossing_the_invisible_bridge()
	local treasure_hunter = self.get_treasure_hunter()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- party align
	party_util.align_party(treasure_hunter.Position + vector(1, 0, -1), 'left')

	self.activity_3_event = true
	self.activity_3_check_coll_loop = false

	-- 퀘스트 마커 삭제
	--quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key..1)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	local land_pos = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(3, 0, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	character_util.remove_emotion(treasure_hunter)

	-- 가디언 앞으로 점프
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.move_to(treasure_hunter, land_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0), 0.5)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(treasure_hunter, 'right', 0.5, 1.2)

	-- 탐험가, 파티 follow

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	self.interact_check_in_activity_3 = false

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key..2,
			self.get_entry_ending_scene().Position + vector(0, 1, 0), true)

function local_class:interact_ending_area_hole(target_pos)
	local treasure_hunter = self.get_treasure_hunter()

	party_util.align_party(target_pos, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-------- get jump duration
	info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo.Create(target_pos, 2, false, CS.Oak.Direction.None)
	info.yMode = CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Flying
	duration = info:GetDuration(user_party.Leader.Position)
	duration = duration * 0.5
	--------

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'cast2' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump_move(user_party.Leader, target_pos, 2, 1.5, false)

	wait_for_sec(duration)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

	user_party.Leader:SetScale(unity_class.vector3.zero, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	------ get jump duration
	local info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo.Create(target_pos, 2, false, CS.Oak.Direction.None)
	info.yMode = CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Flying
	local duration = info:GetDuration(treasure_hunter.Position)
	duration = duration * 0.5
	------

	character_util.set_emotion(treasure_hunter, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(treasure_hunter, { name = 'cast2' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump_move(treasure_hunter, target_pos, 2, 1.5, false)

	wait_for_sec(duration)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

	treasure_hunter:SetRotation(20, 0.2)

	treasure_hunter:SetScale(unity_class.vector3.zero, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self:go_from_area_4_to_ending_area()

	self.interact_check = false
	self.find_ending_area_hole = true
end

function local_class:play_ending_event()
	local entry_activity_ending_area = self.get_entry_ending_area()
	local treasure_hunter = self.get_treasure_hunter()
	local security_bot = self.get_security_bot()
	local security_agent = self.get_security_agent()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

	-- 탐험가(right,surprise,idle) : 여…여기가 진짜 보물의 방?
	character_util.set_emotion(treasure_hunter, { name = 'surprise' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(treasure_hunter, { key = self.string_key..86, skip = true })

	-- 로봇(left,mad,idle)(jump 1회) : 침입자 발견! 침입자 발견!
	character_util.set_emotion(security_bot, { name = 'mad' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(security_bot)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security_bot, { key = self.string_key..87, skip = true })

	-- 경비 봇이 다가옴
	self.other_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_14', loop = true })
	character_util.move_to_async(security_bot, entry_activity_ending_area + vector(4, 0, 0),
			2.5, nil, false, true, false)

	if self.other_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.other_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.other_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	--wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 로봇이 칼을 빼어든다
	security_bot.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'zulfiqar_sword')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_equip_weapon_01')
	character_util.set_anim(security_bot, { name = 'sword_idle' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(treasure_hunter)

	-- 탐험가 총 장착
	treasure_hunter.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'basic_rifle')

	-- 로봇(left,mad) attack 반복 : 어리석은 침입자! 나는 전 세계의 검술 데이터를 가지고 있다.
	character_util.set_emotion(security_bot, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(security_bot, { name = 'attack', count = 99,
														 sfx = '02_auto_stinger_01', keep_anim = true })
	--character_util.set_anim(security_bot, { name = 'sword_idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security_bot, { key = self.string_key..88, skip = true })

	-- 로봇(left,mad) attack 반복 : 나의 칼부림을 견딜 수 있는 침입자는 지금까지 아무도 없었다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(security_bot, { key = self.string_key..89, skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	local wp_1_pos = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 1)
	local wp_2_pos = wp_1_pos + vector(2, 0, 0)
	local wp_3_pos = wp_2_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(treasure_hunter, {wp_1_pos, wp_2_pos, wp_3_pos},
			2.3, false, nil, 'floor', 'right')

	-- 탐험가가 가디언 뒤에서 총을 장전 한다.
	character_util.set_anim(treasure_hunter, { name = 'rifle_reload', sfx_name = '02_gun_reload_01', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 카메라 줌인
	camera_util.move_async(treasure_hunter.Position, 0.5)

	camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 탐험가가 총을 빼어들고 로봇을 쏜다.
	--self:treasure_hunter_shoot()
	self:Shoot(treasure_hunter, security_bot, 0.1, vector(0.15, 0, 0))

	while self.hit_bot == false do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('shot_scene')

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 로봇이 쓰러진다.
	-- 로봇(left,dead,dead):비…비겁한…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security_bot, { key = self.string_key..90, skip = true })

	security_bot.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.remove_anim(treasure_hunter)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)

	-- 경비원(left,idle,walk) : [shout](?) 이게 무슨 소리야?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security_agent, { key = self.string_key..91, bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(0, 300), skip = false })

	-- 오른쪽에서 뱀파이어 경비가 나온다. 경비(빨간원)이 오른쪽 시야밖에서 걸어나온다.
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(security_agent, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(security_agent, security_bot.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0.5),
			1.5, nil, false, true, false)
	character_util.set_direction(security_agent, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--경비(left,mad,idle)(jump1회) : 아니 도대체 무슨 일이야!
	character_util.set_emotion(security_agent, { name = 'mad' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(security_agent)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security_agent, { key = self.string_key..92, skip = true })

	-- bgm
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'bgm', 'stop', 'true' }))
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'event', name = 'bgm_trickery_theme', mix = 1})

	-- treasure_hunter emoticon question
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(treasure_hunter, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(treasure_hunter, nil, 'question')

	-- 탐험가(right,idle,idle): 분명히 내가 알기로는 성배 같은 귀중한 보물들이 있을 텐데?
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(treasure_hunter)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(treasure_hunter, { key = self.string_key..93, skip = true })

	-- 경비(left,mad,release) : 여긴 그냥 창고야! 보물같은게 있을리 없잖아!
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(security_agent, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security_agent, { key = self.string_key..94, skip = true })

	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })

	-- 경비(left,mad,idle) : 보안장치는 죄다 작동시키고 보안 로봇까지 고장 내다니!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security_agent, { key = self.string_key..95, skip = true })

	-- 경비(left,mad,idle)(jump1회) : 이게 다 얼마인지 알아? 전부 청구할 테니 각오해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(security_agent)
	--경비대사와 동시에 탐험가(right,scared,idle)
	character_util.set_direction(treasure_hunter, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(treasure_hunter, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.remove_anim(treasure_hunter)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security_agent, { key = self.string_key..96, skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'scared' })

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 탐험가(right,scared,idle)(jump1회): 나…나는 급한 볼일이 생긴 것 같군! (run)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(treasure_hunter)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(treasure_hunter, { key = self.string_key..97, skip = true })

	-------------------------------------

	-- (임의) 기사 돌아볼
	--character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	--character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	--
	--
	--character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	--character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'tired' })

	------------------------------------------

	local end_mark = self.get_ending_room_exit_pos()
	-- 탐험가가 경비를 가로질러 기믹구멍쪽으로 간다.
	wp_1_pos = treasure_hunter.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
	wp_2_pos = vector(end_mark.x + 1, 0, treasure_hunter.Position.z)
	character_util.set_anim(treasure_hunter, { name = 'run', loop = true })
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(treasure_hunter, 'right')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
	character_util.move_to(treasure_hunter, wp_2_pos, 2, nil, false, false, false)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.treasure_hunter_check_robot_body, self))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 경비(right,mad,release) : 거기 서! (run)
	character_util.set_direction(security_agent, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(security_agent, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(security_agent, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security_agent, { key = self.string_key..98, skip = true })

	-- 경비가 탐험가를 쫓아간다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_01')
	character_util.set_anim(security_agent, { name = 'run', loop = true })
	character_util.move_to(security_agent, vector(end_mark.x + 1, 0, security_agent.Position.z),
			1.3, nil, true, false, false)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(treasure_hunter)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.security_agent_check_end_point, self))

	while self.security_agent_hide == false do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(treasure_hunter, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(security_agent, 'disabled')

	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_ending_sign_board_1(), 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_ending_sign_board_2(), 'enabled')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	local fo = self.get_first_area_stairs()
	if fo ~= nil then
		fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 1})

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'bgm', 'play' }))

	-- 퀘스트 종료
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

function local_class:treasure_hunter_check_robot_body()
	local end_mark = self.get_ending_room_exit_pos()
	local treasure_hunter = self.get_treasure_hunter()
	local security_bot = self.get_security_bot()

	local v = vector(0, 0, 0)
	if(direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right) then
		v = vector(1, 0, 0)
	elseif(direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left) then
		v = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	elseif(direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up) then
		v = vector(0, 0, 1)
	elseif(direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down) then
		v = vector(0, 0, -1)
	end

function local_class:random_earthquake(earthquake_count)
	-- 낙석 sfx
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_02', type_priority = 'event'
	, player_priority = 'object', loop = false })

	for _ = 1, earthquake_count do
		local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(-5, 5)
		local rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(-3, 3)
		local cur_rock = self.get_fx_landslide_brown_small():Instantiate(
				stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z),
				unity_class.quaternion.identity,
				stage_camera.transform)
		cur_rock.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8

		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end
end

function local_class:start_random_earthquake()
	-- 낙석 sfx
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_02', type_priority = 'event'
	, player_priority = 'object', loop = false })

	local delay = 0

	while self.earthquake_effect do
		local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(-5, 5)
		local rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(-3, 3)
		local cur_rock = self.get_fx_landslide_brown_small():Instantiate(
				stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z),
				unity_class.quaternion.identity,
				stage_camera.transform)
		cur_rock.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8

		delay = unity_class.random.Range(4, 8) * 0.1

		wait_for_sec(delay)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

function local_class:Shoot(shooter, target, hit_delay, hit_offset)

	--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_02')
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.15, 'shot_scene')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(shooter, {name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false}, {name = 'attack'})
	wait_for_sec(0.05)

	self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetObject(target, vector(0, 0, 0.05), -1, true, 0)
end

function local_class:move_obj(fo, pos, duration, weight_pos)

	local timer = 0
	if type_util.is_array(fo) then

		if weight_pos ~= nil then

			local start_pos_list = {}
			local end_pos_list = {}
			for i = 1, table_util.get_size(fo) do
				table.insert(start_pos_list, fo[i].Position)
				table.insert(end_pos_list,
						pos + vector(weight_pos.x * (i - 1), 0, weight_pos.z * (i - 1)))
			end

			while timer < duration do

				for i = 1, table_util.get_size(fo) do
					local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos_list[i], end_pos_list[i], timer / duration)

					fo[i].Position = cur_pos
				end

				timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			fo.Position = end_pos

			start_pos_list = nil
			end_pos_list = nil
		end

	else
		local start_pos = fo.Position
		local end_pos = pos

		while timer < duration do
			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, timer / duration)

			fo.Position = cur_pos

			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		fo.Position = end_pos
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:interact_hannibal()
	local hannibal = self.get_hannibal()
	local hannibal_table = self.get_hannibal_table()

	-- 한니발 캐릭터(ds_hannibal) 독방 내부에 left, idle, idle 상태로 배치된 상태.
	-- 플레이어는 대화 존 안쪽에서 한니발 인터렉트 가능. 인터렉트 시 한니발 z축에 맞춰 플레이어 정렬 후 대화 진행.
	party_util.align_party(hannibal_table.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 'left', 1, 'linear')

	if self.current_progress < self.progress.interact_hannibal then
		self.current_progress = self.progress.interact_hannibal

		-- 죄수 (right,idle, idle) : 또 알지도 못하는 녀석이 나에게 감히 말을 거는 건가?

																bubble_direction = 'lt' })

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(hannibal, hannibal.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1, false)

		-- 죄수 (left,sleep_deep,idle) : 너는 이 땅 위에 태양이 몇 개라고 생각하나?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
		character_util.set_emotion(hannibal, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hannibal, { key = 'ds_time_of_silence_12', skip = true,
																bubble_direction = 'lt' })

		-- 인공 태양도 포함인가요?
		-- 찾아보면 더 있지 않을까요?
		-- 태양이 뭐예요?
		choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'ds_time_of_silence_12_1', 'mercy' }, { 'ds_time_of_silence_12_2', 'intellect' },
			{ 'ds_time_of_silence_12_3', 'brutal' }
		})

		-- 죄수 클로즈업 소리치는 말풍선
		-- 죄수(left,mad,idle)(jump1회):멍청한 놈! 태양은 단 하나 뿐이다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
		camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 0.5)
		character_util.set_emotion(hannibal, { name = 'mad' })
		character_util.normal_jump(hannibal, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hannibal, { key = 'ds_time_of_silence_13', skip = true,
																bubble_type = 'shout', bubble_direction = 'lt' })

		-- 죄수(left,idle,idle): 그렇다면 너에게 묻겠다…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_03')
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)

-- 스파인 아이템 생성/던지기
function local_class:drop_spine(data)
	local drop_pos = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'pos')
	local target_pos = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'target')
	local spine_name = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'spine_name')
	local spine = self.controller.optimized_npcs[spine_name]
	local height = 1.5

	local duration = 0.5
	local time_passed = 0

	if target_pos == nil then
		character_util.set_position(spine, drop_pos)
	else
		character_util.spine_rotate(spine, 360 * 3, duration)

		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local position = vector_util.lerp(drop_pos, target_pos, progress)
			local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

			position.y = position.y + y
			character_util.set_position(spine, position, true)

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		character_util.spine_rotate(spine, 0, 0)
		character_util.set_position(spine, target_pos)
	end
end

-- 스파인 아이템 획득
function local_class:fly_spine(target, spine_name, duration, item_name_text)
	local spine = self.controller.optimized_npcs[spine_name]
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0.2)

	local time_passed = 0
	local start_position = spine.Position

	character_util.spine_rotate(spine, 360 * 3 * (duration / 0.5), duration)

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local position = vector_util.lerp(start_position, target.Position, progress)

		character_util.set_position(spine, position)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_get_drop_item_01')
	self.get_get_effect_pool():Instantiate(target.Position)

	if item_name_text then
		floating_text_util.activate_for_text(target, item_name_text, 0,
			{ 116, 135 ,140, 255 }, { 0, 0, 0, 160 })
	end

	character_util.spine_rotate(spine, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(spine, vector(999, 0, 999))
end

function local_class:attach_spine(fo, spine_name)
	local bone_follower = self.controller.optimized_npcs[spine_name].Transform.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))

	bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
	bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = fo.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation
	bone_follower:SetBone('[base]weapon1_side')

	return bone_follower
end

function local_class:detach_spine(bone_follower)
	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(bone_follower)
end
--endregion

	if self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.event_end_1 or self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.event_end_2 then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_grand_mother()) then
			if self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.event_end_2 then

				-- 할머니(right, idle, idle) : 영감… 사랑해요…

				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, { key = self.string_key..111, skip = false })

			elseif self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.event_end_1 then

				-- 할머니(down, idle, idle) : 영감… 부디 그곳에선 행복하세요…
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, { key = self.string_key..109, skip = false })

			end

			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_grand_son()) then

			-- 손주(right, smile, idle) : 도와주셔서 감사드립니다!

			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_carpenter(1))
				and self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.event_end_1 then

			-- 인부1(left, tired, idle) : 할머니한테 저런 사연이 있었을 줄이야. 나무를 자르기 좀 미안한데…
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, { key = self.string_key..107, skip = false })

			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_carpenter(2))
				and self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.event_end_1 then

			-- 인부2(left, tired, idle) : 우리… 할머니가 자주 다니시는 위쪽 공원으로 나무를 옮겨드리는 건 어떨까?

			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.controller.ring_handle_name))
				and self.interacted_object == false then
			self.interacted_object = true
			-- 각 아이템 인터렉트
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.check_grandma_item, self, self.controller.event_item_enum.ring)
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.controller.apple_basket_handle_name))
				and self.interacted_object == false then
			self.interacted_object = true
			-- 각 아이템 인터렉트
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.check_grandma_item, self, self.controller.event_item_enum.apple_basket)
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.controller.camera_handle_name))
				and self.interacted_object == false then
			self.interacted_object = true
			-- 각 아이템 인터렉트
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.check_grandma_item, self, self.controller.event_item_enum.camera)
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.controller.diary_handle_name))

		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..48 })
	end
	self.interacted_object = false
end

function local_class:read_grandfather_diary()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 다시 일기 읽기 시도하면 파티 정렬
	local item_object = get_field_object(self.diary_handle_name)
	party_util.align_party(item_object.Position, 'down')

	local select = -1
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local branches = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.TalkBranch)

	-- 일기를 본다.
	local tb_1 = CS.Oak.TalkBranch()
	tb_1.Text = game_string:GetString(self.string_key..51)
	tb_1.Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy
	tb_1.Callback = function()
		wait_for_branch = false
		select = 0
	end
	branches:Add(tb_1)

	-- 그만둔다.
	local tb_2 = CS.Oak.TalkBranch()
	tb_2.Text = game_string:GetString(self.string_key..52)
	tb_2.Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal
	tb_2.Callback = function()
		wait_for_branch = false
		select = 1
	end
	branches:Add(tb_2)

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if select == 0 then
		-- 나레이션 : 미안하오. 세니아. 임신한 당신을 두고 전쟁터로 떠나야 하는 나를 용서해 주시오.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..53 })
		-- 나레이션 : 후에 무사히 돌아오면, 못다 한 프러포즈를 다시 해주겠다고 약속드리리다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..54 })
		-- 나레이션 : 우리가 서로 사랑을 맹세하며 심었던 나무 앞에서 훗날 다시 만납시다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..55 })
		-- 나레이션 : 오오 세니아, 나의 사랑! 세상에 하나뿐인 나만의 태양이여! 앞으로도 평생… 당신과 함께 하고 싶소!
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..56 })
	end

	self.interacted_object = false

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

return local_class

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_grand_son()) then
		if self.controller.cur_event_state <= self.controller.event_state_enum.see_situation then
			-- 손주(left, tired, idle) : 할머니…
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, { key = self.string_key..6, skip = false })
			return true
		elseif self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.carpenter_request then
			-- 손자와의 대화
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_grandson, self, true)
			return true
		elseif self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.grandson_request then
			-- 손자의 부탁
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.grandson_request, self, true)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_citizen_male(1)) then
		if self.controller.cur_event_state <= self.controller.event_state_enum.grandson_request then
			-- 주민1(right, attack, idle) : 너희 할머니 좀 어떻게 해봐! 맨날 저러셔!
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, { key = self.string_key..4, skip = false })
		end
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_citizen_male(2)) then
		if self.controller.cur_event_state <= self.controller.event_state_enum.grandson_request then
			-- 주민2(left, attack, idle) : 나무가 대체 뭐가 대수라고…!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, { key = self.string_key..5, skip = false })
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:start_event(citizen_talk)
	local grand_mother = self.get_grand_mother()
	local carpenter_1 = self.get_carpenter(1)
	local carpenter_2 = self.get_carpenter(2)

	self.first_event_watching = true

	if citizen_talk then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.other_citizens_talk, self))
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	-- 인부1(left, attack, attack) : [shout]
	character_util.set_emotion(carpenter_1, { name = 'attack' })
	if self:check_character_in_camera(carpenter_1) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = self.string_key..1, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = false })
	else
		if citizen_talk then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1,
					{ key = self.string_key..1, bubble_type = 'shout', offset = vector(0, 0, -3), skip = false })
		else
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = self.string_key..1, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = false })
		end
	end

	if self.cut_talking == true then
		self.first_event_watching = false
		return
	end

	-- 할머니(right, attack, idle) : [shout]
	character_util.set_emotion(grand_mother, { name = 'attack' })
	if self:check_character_in_camera(grand_mother) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_mother, { key = self.string_key..2, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = false })
	else
		if citizen_talk then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_mother,
					{ key = self.string_key..2, bubble_type = 'shout', offset = vector(0, 0, -2), skip = false })
		else
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_mother, { key = self.string_key..2, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = false })
		end
	end

	if self.cut_talking == true then
		self.first_event_watching = false
		return
	end

	-- 인부2(left, attack, idle) : [shout]
	character_util.set_emotion(carpenter_2, { name = 'attack' })
	if self:check_character_in_camera(carpenter_2) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = self.string_key..3, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = false })
	else
		if citizen_talk then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2,
					{ key = self.string_key..3, bubble_type = 'shout', offset = vector(0, 0, -2), skip = false })
		else
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = self.string_key..3, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = false })
		end
	end

	if self.cut_talking == true then
		self.first_event_watching = false
		return
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.first_event_watching = false
end

function local_class:carpenter_asks()

	local grand_mother = self.get_grand_mother()

	local carpenter_2 = self.get_carpenter(2)

	party_util.align_party(hill_center_pos + vector(2, 0, 0), 'right')

	self.cut_talking = true

	while self.first_event_watching == true do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_citizen_female(1), 'disabled')

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(carpenter_2, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = self.string_key..11, skip = true })
	--할머니(right, attack, release) : 사랑하는 그이가 여기로 돌아오기 전까진…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_mother, { key = self.string_key..12, skip = true })
	--할머니(right, attack, release) : 아무도 나무에 손끝 하나 대지 마!
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(grand_mother, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_mother, { key = self.string_key..13, skip = true })

function local_class:grandson_request(replay)
	local grand_son = self.get_grand_son()
	local citizen_male_1 = self.get_citizen_male(1)
	local citizen_male_2 = self.get_citizen_male(2)

	if replay == true then
		party_util.align_party(grand_son.Position, 'down', 1)
	end

	-- 손주(left, idle, idle) : 부탁이에요! 할머니를 도울 방법을 함께 찾아주세요!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(grand_son)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..36, skip = true })

	local select = -1
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local branches = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.TalkBranch)

	-- guardian : 응! 도와줄게
	local tb_1 = CS.Oak.TalkBranch()
	tb_1.Text = game_string:GetString(self.string_key..37)
	tb_1.Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy
	tb_1.Callback = function()
		wait_for_branch = false
		select = 0
	end
	branches:Add(tb_1)

	-- guardian : 미안. 지금은 바빠
	local tb_2 = CS.Oak.TalkBranch()
	tb_2.Text = game_string:GetString(self.string_key..38)
	tb_2.Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal
	tb_2.Callback = function()
		wait_for_branch = false
		select = 1
	end
	branches:Add(tb_2)

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if select == 0 then

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.nod_twice(user_party.Leader)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 손주(down, smile, idle) : 감사합니다!
		character_util.set_emotion(grand_son, { name = 'smile' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..39, skip = true })

		-- 손주(left, idle, question) :  할머니랑 할아버지가 했던 약속이라면…
		character_util.set_direction(grand_son, 'left')
		character_util.remove_emotion(grand_son)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim(grand_son, { name = 'question', loop = false })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..40, skip = true })
		-- 손주(left, idle, question) : 아마도 할머니 집에서 뭔가 찾을 수 있을 것 같아요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..41, skip = true })
		-- 손주(down, idle, idle) : 안으로 들어가 보죠.
		character_util.remove_anim(grand_son)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..42, skip = true })

		-- 손자, 할머니 집으로 이동
		local wp_1_pos = grand_son.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
		local wp_2_pos = wp_1_pos + vector(0, 0, 4)
		character_util.move_waypoint(grand_son, {wp_1_pos, wp_2_pos},
				0.8, false, nil, 'floor', 'up')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_door_push_01')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(grand_son, 0, 0.5)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 손자 NPC 이동
		character_util.set_position(grand_son, vector(26, 0, 126))
		character_util.set_active_state(grand_son, 'disabled')

		-- 시민 상호작용 해제
		character_util.remove_relate_event(citizen_male_1, self.controller)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(citizen_male_2, self.controller)

		-- 손자에게 있던 퀘스트 마커 삭제
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key..1)

		stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.get_grandma_home_outer().Name, 'enabled')

		-- 집 입구에 퀘스트 마커 셋팅
		local home_out_marker = field:GetMarker('old_woman_home_out')
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key..2, home_out_marker.position + vector(0, 0.5, 1), true)

		self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.follow_grandson

		-- 다음 섹션으로
		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	elseif select == 1 then
		-- 손주(down, tired, idle) : 그렇군요… 어떡하지…
		character_util.set_direction(grand_son, 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(grand_son, { name = 'tired' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..43, skip = true })

		if replay == false then
			character_util.add_listener(grand_son, self.controller)
		end
	end
end


-- 카메라 화면에 해당 캐릭터가 잡혔는지 확인, y축은 무시함
function local_class:check_character_in_camera(character)
	local cam_half_height = stage_camera.Size
	local cam_half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth

	local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition

	if character.Position.x < camera_pos.x + cam_half_width and
			character.Position.x > camera_pos.x - cam_half_width and
			character.Position.z < camera_pos.z + cam_half_height and
			character.Position.z > camera_pos.z - cam_half_height then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	--
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.marker_off_zone then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key..2)
		self.enable_equip_sfx = true
	elseif zone_name == self.old_woman_home_zone and self.in_the_house == false then
		if self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.follow_grandson then
			self.in_the_house = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.mumble_grandson, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.home_enter_zone then
		if self.controller.cur_event_state <= self.controller.event_state_enum.grandfather_stuff or
				self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.find_diary then
			local home_out_marker = field:GetMarker('old_woman_home_out')
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key..2,
					home_out_marker.position + vector(0, 0.5, 1), true)

			return true
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.old_woman_home_zone and self.in_the_house == true then
		self.in_the_house = false
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_grand_son()) then
		if self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.follow_grandson then
			-- 손주(left, eat, idle) : 뭔가 도움이 될만한 게…
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, { key = self.string_key..44, skip = false })
			return true
		elseif self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.find_diary then
			-- 손주(right, idle, idle) : 어서 읽어보죠!
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, { key = self.string_key..112, skip = false })
			return true
		elseif self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.grandfather_stuff then
			-- 손주(left, idle, eat) : 변장할 만한 물건이…
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, { key = self.string_key..71, skip = false })
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.controller.ring_handle_name))
			and self.interacted_object == false then
		self.interacted_object = true
		-- 각 아이템 인터렉트
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.check_grandma_item, self, self.controller.event_item_enum.ring, e.Target)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.controller.apple_basket_handle_name))
			and self.interacted_object == false then
		self.interacted_object = true
		-- 각 아이템 인터렉트
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.check_grandma_item, self, self.controller.event_item_enum.apple_basket, e.Target)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.controller.camera_handle_name))
			and self.interacted_object == false then
		self.interacted_object = true
		-- 각 아이템 인터렉트
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.check_grandma_item, self, self.controller.event_item_enum.camera, e.Target)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.controller.diary_handle_name))
			and self.interacted_object == false then
		self.interacted_object = true
		-- 각 아이템 인터렉트
		if self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.follow_grandson then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.check_grandma_item, self, self.controller.event_item_enum.diary, e.Target)
		elseif self.controller.cur_event_state >= self.controller.event_state_enum.find_diary then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.read_grandfather_diary, self, true)
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:grandson_watching_over()
	local grand_son = self.get_grand_son()

	-- 손주(down, tired, idle) : 엇… 절 도와주시는 거 아니었나요?
	character_util.set_direction(grand_son, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(grand_son, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.remove_anim(grand_son)
	if self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.find_diary then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..45, screen_pos = vector(-100, 300), skip = true })
	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..45, skip = true })
	end

	character_util.move_to(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5), 1, nil, false, true, false)
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5), 1, nil, false, true, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 원상태로...
	character_util.remove_emotion(grand_son)
	if self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.follow_grandson or
			self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.grandfather_stuff then
		character_util.set_direction(grand_son, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(grand_son, { name = 'eat', loop = true })
