	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_grand_son(), { key = self.string_key..44, skip = false })
end

function local_class:check_grandma_item(item_enum, item_object)
	local grand_son = self.get_grand_son()
	local start_pos = grand_son.Position
	local wp_1_pos = nil
	local wp_2_pos = nil
	local end_pos = nil
	local last_dir = nil

	if item_enum == self.controller.event_item_enum.ring then
		-- 나레이션 박스 표시. 「예쁜 결혼반지가 놓여있다.」
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..46 })

	elseif item_enum == self.controller.event_item_enum.apple_basket then
		-- 나레이션 박스 표시. 「평범한 과일 바구니다.」
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..47 })

	elseif item_enum == self.controller.event_item_enum.camera then
		-- 나레이션 박스 표시. 「오래된 카메라가 놓여있다.」
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..48 })

	elseif item_enum == self.controller.event_item_enum.diary then
		party_util.align_party(item_object.Position, 'down')
		wp_1_pos = grand_son.Position + vector(3, 0, 0)
		wp_2_pos = wp_1_pos + vector(0, 0, 2)
		end_pos = wp_2_pos + vector(0, 0, 0)
		last_dir = 'right'

		character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		character_util.remove_anim(grand_son)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.look_at(grand_son, user_party.Leader)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		if self.controller.cur_event_state ~= self.controller.event_state_enum.find_diary then
			-- 일단 손주 NPC 대충 움직임
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(grand_son, {wp_1_pos, wp_2_pos, end_pos},
					3, false, nil, 'floor', last_dir)
		end

		-- 손주(left, idle, idle) : 이건… 할아버지의 일기장이에요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..49, skip = true })
		-- 손주(left, idle, idle) : 할머니가 읽고 계셨나 봐요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..50, skip = true })

		local read = self:read_grandfather_diary(false)

		if read == true then
			-- 제자리 이동
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(grand_son, {wp_2_pos, wp_1_pos, start_pos},
					3, false, nil, 'floor', 'left')
			character_util.remove_emotion(grand_son)
			character_util.set_anim(grand_son, { name = 'eat', loop = true })
		end
	end
	self.interacted_object = false
end

function local_class:read_grandfather_diary(retry)
	local grand_son = self.get_grand_son()

	-- 다시 일기 읽기 시도하면 파티 정렬
	if retry == true then
		local item_object = get_field_object(self.controller.diary_handle_name)
		party_util.align_party(item_object.Position, 'down')
	end

	if self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.follow_grandson then
		self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.find_diary
	end

	local select = -1
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local branches = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.TalkBranch)

	-- 일기를 본다.
	local tb_1 = CS.Oak.TalkBranch()
	tb_1.Text = game_string:GetString(self.string_key..51)
	tb_1.Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy
	tb_1.Callback = function()
		wait_for_branch = false
		select = 0
	end
	branches:Add(tb_1)

	-- 그만둔다.
	local tb_2 = CS.Oak.TalkBranch()
	tb_2.Text = game_string:GetString(self.string_key..52)
	tb_2.Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal
	tb_2.Callback = function()
		wait_for_branch = false
		select = 1
	end
	branches:Add(tb_2)

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if select == 0 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_01')

		-- 나레이션 : 미안하오. 세니아. 임신한 당신을 두고 전쟁터로 떠나야 하는 나를 용서해 주시오.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..53 })
		-- 나레이션 : 후에 무사히 돌아오면, 못다 한 프러포즈를 다시 해주겠다고 약속드리리다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..54 })
		-- 나레이션 : 우리가 서로 사랑을 맹세하며 심었던 나무 앞에서 훗날 다시 만납시다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..55 })
		-- 나레이션 : 오오 세니아, 나의 사랑! 세상에 하나뿐인 나만의 태양이여! 앞으로도 평생… 당신과 함께 하고 싶소!
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..56 })

		if self.read_grandfa_diary == false then

			-- 손자, 기사를 바라봄
			character_util.set_direction(grand_son, 'right')
			character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')

			-- 손주 멘트
			-- 손주(left, idle, idle) : 할아버지와 이런 약속을 했었다니…
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_swing_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..57, skip = true })
			-- 손주(left, tired, idle) : 할머니가 너무 불쌍해요. 어떡하면 좋지…
			character_util.set_emotion(grand_son, { name = 'tired' })
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..58, skip = true })
			character_util.remove_emotion(grand_son)

			self:discus_with_grandson()

			self.read_grandfa_diary = true

			if retry == true then
				-- 제자리 이동
				local wp_1_pos = grand_son.Position + vector(0, 0, -2)
				local wp_2_pos = wp_1_pos + vector(-3, 0, 0)
				character_util.move_waypoint_async(grand_son, {wp_1_pos, wp_2_pos},
						3, false, nil, 'floor', 'left')
				character_util.remove_emotion(grand_son)
				character_util.set_anim(grand_son, { name = 'eat', loop = true })
			end
		end
	elseif select == 1 then
		self.interacted_object = false
		return false
	end

	self.interacted_object = false
	return true
end

function local_class:discus_with_grandson()
	local grand_son = self.get_grand_son()
	local select_1_index = 1
	local select_2_index = 2

	local choose_list = {
		-- 할머니께 진실을 알려드리자.
		{ self.string_key..59, 'normal' },
		-- 포기하면 편해지는 법이야.
		{ self.string_key..60, 'brutal' },
		-- 우리가 할아버지를 대신해 드리자!
		{ self.string_key..61, 'mercy' },
	}

	while true do

		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_list)

		if choose_result == select_1_index then

			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'tired' })
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'cross_arm', loop = false})

			-- 손주(left, attack,idle) :안돼요! 그랬다가 할머니가 충격 먹고 쓰러지면 어떡해요?!
			character_util.set_emotion(grand_son, { name = 'attack' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..62, skip = true })
			character_util.remove_emotion(grand_son)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

			table.remove(choose_list, choose_result)

			select_1_index = -1
			if select_2_index == 2 then
				select_2_index = 1
			end

		elseif choose_result == select_2_index then

			character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, true)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'doyagao' })

			-- 손주(left, attack,idle) :어떻게 그런 말을…! 할머니가 불쌍하지도 않으세요?!
			character_util.set_emotion(grand_son, { name = 'attack' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..63, skip = true })
			character_util.remove_emotion(grand_son)

			character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, false)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

			table.remove(choose_list, choose_result)

			select_2_index = -1

		elseif choose_result == #choose_list then

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'smile' })
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

			-- 손주(left, idle, question) : 할아버지를 대신한다라…
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.set_anim(grand_son, { name = 'question', loop = false })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..64, skip = true })

			-- 손주(left, smile, idle) : 좋은 생각이에요!
			character_util.remove_anim(grand_son)
			character_util.set_emotion(grand_son, { name = 'smile' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..65, skip = true })

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

			-- 손주(right, smile, idle) : 할아버지를 대신해서, 할머니한테 못다 한 프러포즈를 해드린다면…
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..66, skip = true })

			-- 손주(right, smile, idle) : 할머니도 분명히 기뻐하실 거예요!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..67, skip = true })

			-- 손주(right, idle, question) : 그럼 프러포즈를 하기 전에 우선…
			character_util.remove_emotion(grand_son)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.set_anim(grand_son, {name = 'question', loop = false})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..68, skip = true })

			-- 손주(right, idle, question) : 할아버지로 변장할 물건이 필요하겠네요.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..69, skip = true })

			-- 손주(right, idle, idle) : 전 이 방을 좀 더 찾아볼 테니까, 다른 데를 찾아봐주시겠어요?
			character_util.remove_anim(grand_son)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..70, skip = true })

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			-- 퀘스트 마커 셋팅
			local box_fo_1 = get_field_object(self.controller.box_1_handle_name)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key..3, box_fo_1, true)
			local fake_box_1_fo = get_field_object(self.controller.fake_box_1_handle_name)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key..4, fake_box_1_fo, true)
			local box_fo_2 = get_field_object(self.controller.box_2_handle_name)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key..5, box_fo_2, true)

			-- 일기장 찾으면 할아버지 방 물건들 인터렉트 활성화
			stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.controller.box_1_handle_name, 'enabled')
			stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.controller.fake_box_1_handle_name, 'enabled')
			stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.controller.box_2_handle_name, 'enabled')

			self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.grandfather_stuff

			character_util.add_listener(grand_son, self.controller)

			-- 문 열기
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.grandpa_room_door_name, false))

			-- 다음 섹션으로
			yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	choose_list = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('DemonShireWaittingEndSection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DemonShireWaittingEnd @
		Comment = 할아버지 옷을 찾고 프로토즈 진행 후 클리어 @
		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]

-- 사용할 초기 변수의 값 또는 객체 정의
function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'demonshire_1_1'

	-- string key
	self.string_key = 'ds_waitting_end_'

	-- marker key
	self.marker_key = 'ds_waitting_end_marker'

	-- 할머니, 손자
	self.get_grand_mother = function() return get_character('waitting_end_grand_mother')  end
	self.get_grand_son = function() return get_character('waitting_end_grand_son')  end

	-- 인부 1, 2
	self.get_carpenter = function(num) return get_character('waitting_end_carpenter_' .. num) end

	-- 주민 (남) 1, 2
	self.get_citizen = function(num) return get_character('waitting_end_spectator_male_' .. num) end

	-- 이벤트 존 정보
	-- 할머니 집 입구 존
	self.home_enter_zone = 'waitting_end_home_enter_zone'
	-- 집 안에서 이전 마커 삭제 체크하는 존
	self.marker_off_zone = 'waitting_end_marker_off_zone'
	-- 할머니 집 존 입장 체크
	self.old_woman_home_zone = 'waitting_end_finding_item_zone'
	-- 프로포즈 전 이벤트 존 (집 안)
	self.before_propose_zone_name = 'waitting_end_before_propose_zone'

	-- effect
	self.get_dead_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead') end

	-- door
	self.grandpa_room_door_name = 'waitting_end_grandpa_room_door'

	-- etc
	-- 리더 저장 용도
	self.saved_leader = nil
	-- 기사가 변경할 할아버지 변장 스파인
	self.knight_male_grandfa_name = 'waitting_end_knight_male_grandpa'
	self.knight_female_grandfa_name = 'waitting_end_knight_female_grandpa'

	-- 프로포즈 정답 카운트 수
	self.propose_answer_count = 3

	self.read_grandfa_diary = false

	-- star piece
	self.star_piece_name = 'waitting_end_star_piece'

	-- flag
	-- 아이템 상호작용 한 상태 체크
	self.interacted_object = false
	-- fake 아이템 획득 유무
	self.get_grandpa_item_1 = false
	self.get_grandpa_item_2 = false
	-- 집 안 입구에 있다는 플래그
	self.in_the_house_entrance = false
	-- 집 안에 있다는 플래그
	self.in_the_house = false
	-- 쓰레기 찾은 것 체크
	self.find_trash_1 = false

	self.grand_son_finding_sfx = nil

	self.city_sfx = nil

	self.enable_equip_sfx = true
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

-- 스테이지 입장 시 셋팅 될 것들, 이벤트 구독 또는 NPC, Obj 상호작용 등록
function local_class:enter()
	-- 현재 스테이지가 맞는지 확인 꼭 할 것.
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	-- npc setting
	local hill_center_pos = self.controller.get_hill_area_center_pos()
	local grand_mother = self.get_grand_mother()
	local carpenter_1 = self.get_carpenter(1)
	local carpenter_2 = self.get_carpenter(2)

	grand_mother.Position = hill_center_pos + vector(-1, 0, -1)
	carpenter_1.Position = hill_center_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)
	carpenter_2.Position = hill_center_pos + vector(1, 0, -1)

	character_util.set_emotion(carpenter_1, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_emotion(grand_mother, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_emotion(carpenter_2, { name = 'attack' })

	-- 할아버지 방 물건들 인터렉트 활성화
	stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.controller.box_1_handle_name, 'enabled')
	stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.controller.fake_box_1_handle_name, 'enabled')
	stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.controller.box_2_handle_name, 'enabled')

	if self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.none then
		-- 집 입구에 퀘스트 마커 셋팅
		local home_out_marker = field:GetMarker('old_woman_home_out')
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key..2,
				home_out_marker.position + vector(0, 0.5, 1), true)

		self:home_setting()
	elseif self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.grandfather_stuff then
		self.in_the_house = true
	end

	--- 바닥에 떨어진 사운드 처리
	self.banana_sfx_func = function(num)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_tentacle_01')
	end

	self.can_sfx_func = function(num)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
	end

	self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.grandfather_stuff

	return true
end

function local_class:start()

end

-- 스테이지 퇴장 시 이벤트 구독 취소, 객체 nil로 해제
function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.grand_son_finding_sfx ~= nil then
		self.grand_son_finding_sfx:Stop()
		self.grand_son_finding_sfx = nil
	end


	if self.city_sfx ~= nil then
		self.city_sfx:Stop()
		self.city_sfx = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_grand_mother(), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_grand_son(), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_carpenter(1), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_carpenter(2), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_citizen(1), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_citizen(2), self.controller)
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.marker_off_zone then
		-- 퀘스트 마커 셋팅
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key..2)

		if self.get_grandpa_item_1 == false then
			local box_fo_1 = get_field_object(self.controller.box_1_handle_name)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key..3, box_fo_1, true)
		end

		if self.get_grandpa_item_2 == false then
			local box_fo_2 = get_field_object(self.controller.box_2_handle_name)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key..5, box_fo_2, true)
		end

		if self.find_trash_1 == false then
			local fake_box_1_fo = get_field_object(self.controller.fake_box_1_handle_name)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key..4, fake_box_1_fo, true)
		end

		self.enable_equip_sfx = true

		return true
	elseif zone_name == self.old_woman_home_zone and self.in_the_house == false then
		if self.controller.cur_event_state >= self.controller.event_state_enum.follow_grandson and
				self.controller.cur_event_state <= self.controller.event_state_enum.grandfather_stuff then
			self.in_the_house = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.mumble_grandson, self))
			return true
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.before_propose_zone_name and
			self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.ready_propose then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_grandson_at_home, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.home_enter_zone then
		if self.controller.cur_event_state <= self.controller.event_state_enum.grandfather_stuff or
				self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.find_diary then

			local home_out_marker = field:GetMarker('old_woman_home_out')
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key..2,
					home_out_marker.position + vector(0, 0.5, 1), true)

			quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key..3)
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key..4)
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key..5)

			return true
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.old_woman_home_zone and self.in_the_house == true then
		self.in_the_house = false
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_grand_son()) then
		if self.controller.cur_event_state == self.controller.event_state_enum.grandfather_stuff then
			-- 손주(left, idle, eat) : 변장할 만한 물건이…
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, { key = self.string_key..71, skip = false })
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.controller.ring_handle_name))
			and self.interacted_object == false then
		self.interacted_object = true
		-- 각 아이템 인터렉트
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.check_grandma_item, self, self.controller.event_item_enum.ring)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.controller.apple_basket_handle_name))
			and self.interacted_object == false then
		self.interacted_object = true
		-- 각 아이템 인터렉트
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.check_grandma_item, self, self.controller.event_item_enum.apple_basket)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.controller.camera_handle_name))
			and self.interacted_object == false then
		self.interacted_object = true
		-- 각 아이템 인터렉트
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.check_grandma_item, self, self.controller.event_item_enum.camera)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.controller.diary_handle_name))
			and self.interacted_object == false then
		self.interacted_object = true
		-- 각 아이템 인터렉트
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.read_grandfather_diary, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.controller.box_1_handle_name)) and self.interacted_object == false then
		self.interacted_object = true
		-- 상자 인터렉트
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.find_grandfather_stuff, self, self.controller.box_1_handle_name)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.controller.fake_box_1_handle_name)) and self.interacted_object == false then
		self.interacted_object = true
		-- 페이크 상자 인터렉트
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.find_grandfather_stuff, self, self.controller.fake_box_1_handle_name)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.controller.box_2_handle_name)) and self.interacted_object == false then
		self.interacted_object = true
		-- 페이크상자 인터렉트
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.find_grandfather_stuff, self, self.controller.box_2_handle_name)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:read_grandfather_diary()
	-- 다시 일기 읽기 시도하면 파티 정렬
	local item_object = get_field_object(self.controller.diary_handle_name)
	party_util.align_party(item_object.Position, 'down')

	local select = -1
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local branches = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.TalkBranch)

	-- 일기를 본다.
	local tb_1 = CS.Oak.TalkBranch()
	tb_1.Text = game_string:GetString(self.string_key..51)
	tb_1.Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy
	tb_1.Callback = function()
		wait_for_branch = false
		select = 0
	end
	branches:Add(tb_1)

	-- 그만둔다.
	local tb_2 = CS.Oak.TalkBranch()
	tb_2.Text = game_string:GetString(self.string_key..52)
	tb_2.Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal
	tb_2.Callback = function()
		wait_for_branch = false
		select = 1
	end
	branches:Add(tb_2)

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if select == 0 then
		-- 나레이션 : 미안하오. 세니아. 임신한 당신을 두고 전쟁터로 떠나야 하는 나를 용서해 주시오.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..53 })
		-- 나레이션 : 후에 무사히 돌아오면, 못다 한 프러포즈를 다시 해주겠다고 약속드리리다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..54 })
		-- 나레이션 : 우리가 서로 사랑을 맹세하며 심었던 나무 앞에서 훗날 다시 만납시다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..55 })
		-- 나레이션 : 오오 세니아, 나의 사랑! 세상에 하나뿐인 나만의 태양이여! 앞으로도 평생… 당신과 함께 하고 싶소!
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..56 })
	elseif select == 1 then
		--character_util.remove_relate_event(grand_son, self.controller)
		self.interacted_object = false
		return false
	end

	self.interacted_object = false
	return true
end

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat', loop = true })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	local item_1_end_pos = nil

		item_1_end_pos = object_box.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		eat_sfx:Stop()

		character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'tired' })

		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.string_key..113 })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_tree_01')
		drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(self.controller.drop_item_banana, 0, 1)
		drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(self.controller.drop_item_soylent_can, 0, 1)

		stage_util.set_fo_active_state(find_item_name, 'disabled')
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key..4)

		self.find_trash_1 = true

		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

		self.interacted_object = false

		return

	elseif find_item_name == self.controller.box_2_handle_name then

		item_start_pos = object_box.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
		item_1_end_pos = object_box.Position + vector(-0.3, 0.9, -1)

		self.controller.drop_item_clothes = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = item_start_pos,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			itemid = self.controller.drop_item_clothes_num, notforinven = true, sprscale = 0.5
		})

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
		sp_util.sine_move(self.controller.drop_item_clothes, { from = item_start_pos, to = item_1_end_pos,
																   duration = 0.5, height = 0.8 })

		self.get_grandpa_item_2 = true

	-------------------------

	if find_item_name == self.controller.box_1_handle_name then

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		self.controller.drop_item_clothes.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		screen_util.item_get_event(self.controller.drop_item_clothes_name, 'ds_waitting_end_clothes_title',
				'ds_waitting_end_clothes_subtitle', 'ds_waitting_end_clothes_desc')

		quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key..5)

		stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.controller.box_2_handle_name, 'disabled')
	end

	if self.get_grandpa_item_1 == true and self.get_grandpa_item_2 == true then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key..4)
		stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.controller.fake_box_1_handle_name, 'disabled')

		self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.ready_propose
	end

	self.interacted_object = false
end

function local_class:meet_grandson_at_home()
	local hill_center_pos = self.controller.get_hill_area_center_pos()
	local home_center_pos = self.controller.get_home_center_pos()
	local grand_son = self.get_grand_son()

	self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.before_propose

	-- 파티 정렬
	party_util.align_party(home_center_pos, 'right')

	-- 가디언이 left 방향을 바라보며, smile 이모션으로 release 액션을 2번 행한다.
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.grand_son_finding_sfx ~= nil then
		self.grand_son_finding_sfx:Stop()
		self.grand_son_finding_sfx = nil
	end

	-- 손주 NPC가 eat 액션을 멈추고, 손주 NPC 머리 위에 『느낌표!』 아이콘이 표시 된다.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(grand_son)
	character_util.set_direction(grand_son, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(grand_son, { name = 'smile' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(grand_son, nil, 'notice')

	--아이콘이 사라지면, 손주NPC가 플레이어의 왼쪽으로 다가 와 선다.
	local wp_1_pos = vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x - 1, grand_son.Position.y, grand_son.Position.z)
	local wp_2_pos = vector(wp_1_pos.x, wp_1_pos.y, user_party.Leader.Position.z)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(grand_son, {wp_1_pos, wp_2_pos},
			2.5, false, nil, 'floor', 'right')

	-- 손주(right, smile, jump) : 할아버지 옷을 찾으셨다고요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(grand_son)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..75, skip = true })
	-- 손주(right, smile, idle) : 다행이다! 그거라면 할아버지로 변장할 수 있겠어요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..76, skip = true })
	-- 손주(right, smile, idle) : 이제 할머니한테 가서 프러포즈를 해드리죠!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..77, skip = true })
	-- 손주(right, smile, idle) : 아까 일기장 마지막 부분에 적혀있던 멘트 기억하시죠?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..78, skip = true })
	-- 손주(right, smile, idle) : 그 멘트 그대로 말씀드리면, 할머니께서 분명히 기뻐하실 거예요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..79, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(user_party.Leader)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_equipping_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	-- fade out
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	self.in_the_house = false

	self:set_hill_npcs()

	party_util.position_party(hill_center_pos + vector(1, 0, 0), 'left', 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:start_propose()
end

	local grand_mother = self.get_grand_mother()

function local_class:start_propose()
	local grand_mother = self.get_grand_mother()
	local grand_son = self.get_grand_son()

	self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.proposing

	-- 손주 인터렉트 해제
	character_util.remove_relate_event(grand_son, self.controller)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	self.get_dead_effect():Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position)

	local saved_leader_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
	self.saved_leader = get_party_leader()

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(get_party_leader(), 0, 0)

	local grandfa_knight = nil

	if user_util.has_knight_male() then
		grandfa_knight = get_character(self.knight_male_grandfa_name)
	else
		grandfa_knight = get_character(self.knight_female_grandfa_name)
	end

	character_util.set_position(grandfa_knight, saved_leader_pos)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(grandfa_knight)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.city_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_city_02', loop = true })

		-- 그새 나를 잊은 게요?
		{ self.string_key..83, 'brutal' },
	}

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(normal_choose_list)

	if choose_result == 1 then
		if self.city_sfx ~= nil then
			self.city_sfx:Stop()
			self.city_sfx = nil
		end

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_waypoint', state = 'event' })
		character_util.set_emotion(grandfa_knight, { name = 'smile' })
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.set_anim(grandfa_knight, { name = 'sing', loop = true })

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_mother, { key = self.string_key..84, skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_mother, { key = self.string_key..85, skip = true })

	-- 할머니(right, smile, idle) : 당신이 오길 얼마나 기다렸다고요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_mother, { key = self.string_key..86, skip = true })

	-- 손주(left, smile, jump) : 할아버지! 어서 프러포즈를!
	character_util.set_emotion(grand_son, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.normal_jump(grand_son)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_son, { key = self.string_key..87, skip = true })

	-- 프로포즈 씬
	-- 선택지
	local propose_choose_list = {
		-- 오오 세니아, 나의 사랑!
		{ self.string_key..88, 'normal' },
		-- 세상에 하나뿐인 나만의 태양이여!
		{ self.string_key..89, 'normal' },
		-- 앞으로도 평생… 당신과 함께 하고 싶소!
		{ self.string_key..90, 'normal' },
	}
	local propose_order = {1,1,1}

	local choose_result = nil

	local choose_answer_count = 0

	while choose_answer_count < self.propose_answer_count do
		choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(propose_choose_list)

		if choose_result == propose_order[choose_answer_count + 1] then
			choose_answer_count = choose_answer_count + 1

			character_util.set_emotion(grandfa_knight, { name = 'smile' })
			if choose_answer_count == 1 then
				-- 01_rustle_01 + 01_gatcha_point_01
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
				character_util.set_anim(grandfa_knight, { name = 'cast', loop = true })
			elseif choose_answer_count == 2 then
				-- 01_swing_01 + 03_dialogue_emphasize_01
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
				character_util.set_anim(grandfa_knight, { name = 'cast2', loop = true })
			elseif choose_answer_count == 3 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
				character_util.set_anim(grandfa_knight, { name = 'sing', loop = true })
			end

			character_util.set_emotion(grand_son, { name = 'smile' })
			character_util.set_emotion(grand_mother, { name = 'smile' })

			table.remove(propose_choose_list, choose_result)
		else
			character_util.set_emotion(grand_son, { name = 'scared' })

			character_util.set_emotion(grandfa_knight, { name = 'scared' })
			character_util.remove_anim(grandfa_knight)

			-- 할머니(right, tired, idle) : 으응…? 내가 기억하던 거랑 좀 다른데?
			character_util.set_emotion(grand_mother, { name = 'tired' })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grand_mother, { key = self.string_key..91, skip = true })
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	normal_choose_list = nil
	propose_choose_list = nil

	self:after_propose(grandfa_knight)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(false))

	-- 퀘스트 종료
	--이벤트 종료 후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀. 명성치 안보이게 처리
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, true, false)
end

	character_util.add_listener(grand_mother, self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(grand_son, self.controller)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field' })

	self.controller.cur_event_state = self.controller.event_state_enum.event_end_1
end

function local_class:change_to_original_knight()
	local grandfa_knight = nil
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if user_util.has_knight_male() then
		grandfa_knight = get_character(self.knight_male_grandfa_name)
	else
		grandfa_knight = get_character(self.knight_female_grandfa_name)
	end

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(grandfa_knight, { name = 'eat', loop = true })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	eat_sfx:Stop()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	self.get_dead_effect():Instantiate(grandfa_knight.Position)

	local saved_leader_pos = grandfa_knight.Position

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(grandfa_knight, 0, 0)

	character_util.set_active_state(grandfa_knight, 'disabled')

	character_util.set_active_state(leader, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(leader, saved_leader_pos)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(leader, 1, 0)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
end

return local_class

--region 이벤트 콜백
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local first_door = self.get_first_door()
	local second_door = self.get_second_door()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, first_door) and self.has_earned_first_mansion_key then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.co_open_door, self, first_door, 20655))
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, second_door) and self.has_earned_second_mansion_key then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.co_open_door, self, second_door, 20656))
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_first_key_interactable()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.co_on_interacted_first_key, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_second_key_interactable()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.co_on_interacted_second_key, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_mansion_entrance()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'werewolf_interacted_mansion_entrance' })
		end)
	end

	if self:is_gossiping_vamp_group(e.Target.Name) then
		local group_idx = self:find_vamp_group_from_name(e.Target.Name)
		local event_data = self.gossiping_vampire_auto_event_data[group_idx][self.event_type.screenplay]

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.co_gossiping_vampire_interacted, self, group_idx, event_data)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 2 then
		if e.Params[0] == self.detected_by_guard_key and not self.is_detected then
			-- CharacterControllerScreenplayState 상태인 경우엔, early termination
			local current_leader_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
			local screenplay_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState
			if lua_helper.type_compare(current_leader_state, screenplay_state) then
				return
			end
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.co_player_detected_by_guard, self, e.Sender, self.detected_by_guard_key)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	self.current_entered_event_zone = e.Zone.Name

	local is_full_entered = e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader)

	if not is_full_entered then
		return
	end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if self:is_wolf_event_zone(zone_name) and not self:has_entered(zone_name) then
		self.auto_event_entered_state[zone_name] = true
		local routine = self.auto_event_zone_routine_dict[zone_name]
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(routine, self))
	end

	if self:is_gossiping_vamp_event_zone(zone_name) and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete
			and self:is_main_quest_progress_satisfied() then
		local group_idx = self:find_vamp_group_from_name(zone_name)
		local event_data = self.gossiping_vampire_auto_event_data[group_idx][self.event_type.auto]

		if not self:get_event_flag_by_idx(group_idx) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.co_vampire_gossiping, self, group_idx, event_data))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 14 then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 3 then
			self:init_gossiping_npcs()
			self:init_mansion_front_guards()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_2_1 then
		self:parse_auto_event_progress()

		self:create_drop_items_for_zone_event_4()

		self:init_npc_in_stage()

		-- 물건 꾸러미 사이로 들어가지 못하도록 wall_invisible 설정
		local stocks = get_field_object('wolf_stocks')
		stocks.Position = vector(27.7, 0, 22.24)
		stocks.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(unity_class.vector3.one * 2)

	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_name_2_4 then
		self:init_mansion_guards()
		self:init_mansion_keys()
		self:init_mansion_door()
		self:init_gossiping_npcs()
	end
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_2_4 then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	end

	-- 캐싱된 커스텀 스프라이트 제거.
	self:dispose_custom_sprites()

	-- 캐싱된 이펙트들 제거
	self:dispose_particles()

	if self.vampire_boots ~= nil then
		self.vampire_boots:ConsumeComplete()
		self.vampire_boots = nil
	end

	if self.first_key_twinkle ~= nil then
		self.first_key_twinkle:Dispose()
		self.first_key_twinkle = nil
	end

	if self.second_key_twinkle ~= nil then
		self.second_key_twinkle:Dispose()
		self.second_key_twinkle = nil
	end

	-- 캐싱된 포션 아이템 제거
	if self.potion_item ~= nil then
		self.potion_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.potion_item = nil
	end

	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

function local_class:dispose_custom_sprites()
	if #self.custom_sprite_cache == 0 or self.custom_sprite_cache == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.custom_sprite_cache do
		self.custom_sprite_cache[i]:ConsumeComplete()
		self.custom_sprite_cache[i] = nil
	end

	self.custom_sprite_cache = nil
end

function local_class:dispose_particles()
	if #self.particles == 0 or self.particles == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.particles do
		self.particles[i]:Dispose()
		self.particles[i] = nil
	end

	self.particles = nil
end

--region 자동 이벤트 관련 함수
function local_class:parse_auto_event_progress()
	local current_progress = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.auto_event_key)
	local is_nothing_saved = current_progress == -1

	if is_nothing_saved then
		return
	end

	self.current_auto_event_progress = current_progress
end

function local_class:save_auto_event_progress()
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.auto_event_key, self.current_auto_event_progress)
end

			animation = 'cast',
			talk = self.auto_event_script .. 28
		},
		[self.werebeast_name .. 6] =
		{
			position = self:get_npc_marker_pos_by_idx(self.werebeast_name .. 6, 1),
			direction = 'right',
			emotion = 'tired',
			animation = 'idle',
			talk = self.auto_event_script .. 29
		},
		[self.werebeast_name .. 7] =
		{
			position = self:get_npc_marker_pos_by_idx(self.werebeast_name .. 7, 1),
			direction = 'right',
			emotion = 'tired',
			animation = 'cast',
			talk = self.auto_event_script .. 30
		},
		[self.vampire_blocking_name .. 1] =
		{
			position = self:get_npc_marker_pos_by_idx(self.vampire_blocking_name .. 1, 1),
			direction = 'right',
			emotion = 'idle',
			animation = 'idle',
			add_listener = true
		},
		[self.vampire_blocking_name .. 2] =
		{
			position = self:get_npc_marker_pos_by_idx(self.vampire_blocking_name .. 2, 1),
			direction = 'right',
			emotion = 'idle',
			animation = 'idle',
			add_listener = true
		},
	}

	local event_zone_name = 'wolf_zone_event_'
	local get_field_objects_collided_by = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy

	local zone_idx = 1
	for _, value in pairs(self.auto_event_progress) do
		local zone_name = self.auto_event_event_progress_dict_by_zone_name[value]
		local zone = field:GetZone(zone_name)
		local collided_list = get_field_objects_collided_by(zone.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local has_completed_event = ((self.current_auto_event_progress & value) == value)
		local table_to_pass = nil

		if has_completed_event then
			table_to_pass = post_auto_event_npc_state_table
		else
			table_to_pass = pre_auto_event_npc_state_table
		end

		self.auto_event_entered_state[zone_name] = has_completed_event

		for j = 0, collided_list.Count - 1 do
			local collided = collided_list[j]
			local character_init_data = table_to_pass[collided.Name]

			if self:is_character(collided) and character_init_data ~= nil then
				self:init_npc_by_event_state(collided, character_init_data)
			end
		end
		collided_list:Dispose()

		zone_idx = zone_idx + 1
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:init_npc_by_event_state(npc, table)
	if table.position ~= nil then
		character_util.set_position(npc, table.position)
	end
	character_util.set_direction(npc, table.direction)
	character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = table.emotion })
	character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = table.animation, loop = true })

	if table.talk ~= nil then
		npc.Interactable.Talk = table.talk
	end

	if table.add_listener ~= nil then
		character_util.add_listener(npc, self)
	end

	if table.crashBehaviour ~= nil then
		npc.CrashBehaviour = table.crashBehaviour
	end

	if table.callback ~= nil then
		table.callback()
	end
end

function local_class:get_npc_marker_pos_by_idx(name, idx)
	return field:GetMarker(name..'_' ..idx).position
end

function local_class:create_drop_items_for_zone_event_4()
	local center_pos = field:GetMarker('wolf_stocks_pos').position
	local start_layer = 1
	local num_total_layer = 2
	local num_sprites_each_layer = num_total_layer + 1

	local item_spec_to_spawn = {
		{ id = 20585, size = 1, show_on_character = false },
		{ id = 20585, size = 1, show_on_character = false },
		{ id = 20585, size = 1, show_on_character = false },
		{ id = 20583, size = 1.45, show_on_character = true },
		{ id = 20584, size = 1.45, show_on_character = true },
	}

	function adjust_sprite_pos(loop_index)
		return (0.25 * (loop_index - 1))
	end

	local item_spec_idx = 1
	for i = start_layer, num_total_layer do
		local adjusted_pos = adjust_sprite_pos(i)
		local spawn_pivot = center_pos +
				vector((adjusted_pos), 0,  (((start_layer - 1) * 2) + 0.25)  + (adjusted_pos))

		for j = 1, num_sprites_each_layer do
			local item_spec = item_spec_to_spawn[item_spec_idx]
			local spawn_pos = spawn_pivot + vector(0.5 * (j - 1), 0, 0)
			local drop_item = self:create_drop_item(item_spec.id, spawn_pos, item_spec.size,
					item_spec.show_on_character)
			drop_item.SpriteTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0.055 + (0.43 * (i - 1)), 0)
			drop_item.ShadowTransform.localPosition = drop_item.SpriteTransform.localPosition
					- vector(0, 0.04, 0.03)
			table.insert(self.custom_sprite_cache, drop_item)

			item_spec_idx = item_spec_idx + 1
		end

		num_sprites_each_layer = num_sprites_each_layer - 1
	end

	local did_seen_event_4 = (self.current_auto_event_progress & self.auto_event_progress.zone_4_finished)
			== self.auto_event_progress.zone_4_finished
	if did_seen_event_4 and not self:has_portion() then
		local potion_id = 20587
		local potion_spawn_pos = vector(27.75, 0.84, 23)
		self.potion_item = self:create_drop_item(potion_id, potion_spawn_pos, 1)

		local twinkle_fx_pool = self.get_twinkle_fx_pool()
		local particle = twinkle_fx_pool:Instantiate(self.potion_item.SpriteTransform.position)
		self.particles[#self.particles + 1] = particle

		local potion_interactable = self.get_pickable_potion()
		potion_interactable.Position = vector(28, 0, 22.5)
	end
end

function local_class:create_drop_item(id, pos_to_spawn, scale, show_on_character)
	local should_show_on_character = lua_helper.get_or_default(show_on_character, true)
	local drop_item_data = {
		itemid = id,
		pos = pos_to_spawn,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		notforinven = true,
		sprscale = scale,
		showoncharacter = should_show_on_character
	}

	return drop_item_util.create_item(drop_item_data)
end

--region NPC 공용 함수들
function local_class:is_character(fo)
	local type = fo:GetType()
	local result = false

	cast(fo, typeof(CS.Oak.Character))

	if lua_helper.type_compare(fo, typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then
		result = true
	end

	cast(fo, type)

	return result
end
--endregion

	if self.auto_event_entered_state[zone_name] == nil then

function local_class:init_mansion_guards()

function local_class:init_mansion_keys()
	self.has_earned_first_mansion_key = self:has_earned_mansion_key(self.first_mansion_key)
	self.has_earned_second_mansion_key = self:has_earned_mansion_key(self.second_mansion_key)

	local key_hitbox_size = CS.Oak.Hitbox(2 * unity_class.vector3.one)
	local twinkle_pool = self.get_twinkle_fx_pool_single()
	local effect_spawn_pos_adj = vector(0, 1, 0)

	if not self.has_earned_first_mansion_key then
		local first_key = self.get_first_key_interactable()
		local effect_spawn_pos = first_key.Position + effect_spawn_pos_adj
		first_key.Hitbox = key_hitbox_size
		first_key.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		self.first_key_twinkle = twinkle_pool:Instantiate(effect_spawn_pos)
	end

	if not self.has_earned_second_mansion_key then
		local second_key = self.get_second_key_interactable()
		local effect_spawn_pos = second_key.Position + effect_spawn_pos_adj
		second_key.Hitbox = key_hitbox_size
		second_key.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		self.second_key_twinkle = twinkle_pool:Instantiate(effect_spawn_pos)
	end
end

function local_class:init_mansion_door()
	if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		self.get_mansion_entrance().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end
end

function local_class:co_player_detected_by_guard(guard, event_name)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.is_detected = true
	local is_guard_down_to_leader = guard.Position.z < user_party.Leader.Position.z
	if is_guard_down_to_leader then
		guard.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 2)
	end

	character_util.set_anim(guard, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	character_util.set_emotion(guard, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.look_at(user_party.Leader, guard)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard, { key = self.detected_by_guard_script_key, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	local reset_point_name = guard.FieldObjectController.ResetMarkerName
	local reset_point = field:GetMarker(reset_point_name)
	local direction_vec = direction_util.to_vector3(reset_point.direction)
	local opposite = direction_util.get_opposite(reset_point.direction)
	party_util.align_party(reset_point.position + direction_vec, opposite, 0, 'arc')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 순찰 패트롤 좌표랑 상태 다 리셋 시키도록
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'reset', event_name }))
	if is_guard_down_to_leader then
		guard.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 0)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.is_detected = false
end

function local_class:save_auto_event_progress(new_state)
	self.current_auto_event_progress = self.current_auto_event_progress | new_state
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.auto_event_key, self.current_auto_event_progress)
end

function local_class:has_portion()
	local is_custome_state_saved = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.has_portion_key) == 1
	local has_seen_auto_event = ((self.current_auto_event_progress & self.auto_event_progress.zone_4_finished)
			== self.auto_event_progress.zone_4_finished)

	return is_custome_state_saved and has_seen_auto_event
end

	local potion_id = 20587
	return self:create_drop_item(potion_id, spawn_pos, 1)

function local_class:cache_sprite(item)

function local_class:play_qte(dir)
	self.qte_success = false
	message_system:Subscribe(self.current_section, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(dir)

	while not self.qte_success do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.current_section, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 0)
end

	local spawn_pos = key_interactable.Position
	local key_target_pos = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	eat_sfx:Stop()
	self:acquire_key_async(20656, spawn_pos, key_target_pos,
			'ds_golden_key', 'wolf_golden_key_sub_title')

	self:earned_mansion_key(self.second_mansion_key)
end

function local_class:acquire_key_async(key_id, spawn_pos, target_pos, item_spec_name, title)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')
	local key = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = key_id,
		pos = spawn_pos,
		target = target_pos,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		notforinven = true,
		sprscale = 0.6,
		showoncharacter = false
	})

	key.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	key:Fly()

	screen_util.item_get_event(
			item_spec_name,
			title,
			'wolf_key_title',
			'wolf_key_desc'
	)
end

function local_class:has_earned_mansion_key(key)
	if (key == nil or (key ~= self.first_mansion_key and key ~= self.second_mansion_key)) then
		return false
	end

	return quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, key) == 1
end

function local_class:earned_mansion_key(key)
	if key == self.first_mansion_key then
		self.has_earned_first_mansion_key = true
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.first_mansion_key, 1)
	elseif key == self.second_mansion_key then
		self.has_earned_second_mansion_key = true
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.second_mansion_key, 1)
	end
end

--region 2_4 이누이트 맨션에 관하여 수근거리는 뱀파이어들

function local_class:init_gossiping_npcs()
	if self.quest_progress.IsComplete or not self:is_main_quest_progress_satisfied() then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		for j = 1, 2 do
			local character = get_character(self.gossiping_vampire_name .. i .. '_' .. j)
			local init_marker = field:GetMarker(character.Name)
			character_util.set_position(character, init_marker.position)
			character_util.set_direction(character, init_marker.direction)
			character_util.set_active_state(character, 'enabled')
		end
	end
end

function local_class:init_mansion_front_guards()
	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_mansion_guard_by_idx(1), 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_mansion_guard_by_idx(2), 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_mansion_guard_by_idx(3), 'enabled')
end

function local_class:is_main_quest_progress_satisfied()
	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
	local is_satisfied = main_quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 14

	return is_satisfied
end

function local_class:is_wolf_quest_progress_satisfied()
	return self.starting_inner_progress >= 3
end

function local_class:co_vampire_gossiping(group_idx, event_data)
	self:set_event_flag_true_by_idx(group_idx)

	local vamp_1 = self.get_gossiping_vampire_by_group_and_idx(group_idx, event_data[1].index)
	local vamp_2 = self.get_gossiping_vampire_by_group_and_idx(group_idx, event_data[2].index)
	local script_key_1 = event_data[1].script_key

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vamp_1, { key = script_key_1, skip = false })

	character_util.add_listener(vamp_1, self)
	character_util.add_listener(vamp_2, self)
end

function local_class:co_gossiping_vampire_interacted(group_idx, event_data)
	local vamp_1 = self.get_gossiping_vampire_by_group_and_idx(group_idx, event_data[1].index)
	local vamp_2 = self.get_gossiping_vampire_by_group_and_idx(group_idx, event_data[2].index)
	local script_key_1 = event_data[1].script_key
	local script_key_2 = event_data[2].script_key

	character_util.remove_relate_event(vamp_1, self)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(vamp_2, self)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vamp_2, { key = script_key_1, skip = true })
	self:co_player_finds_mansion()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vamp_1, { key = script_key_2, skip = true })
end

function local_class:co_player_finds_mansion()
	local mansion_pos = field:GetMarker('wolf_mansion_inner').position
	local camera_move_duration = 1
	camera_util.move_async(mansion_pos, camera_move_duration)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(camera_move_duration)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
end

function local_class:is_gossiping_vamp_group(name)
	return string.match(name, self.gossiping_vampire_name) ~= nil
end

function local_class:is_gossiping_vamp_event_zone(name)
	return string.match(name, self.vamp_gossip_zone_name) ~= nil
end

function local_class:find_vamp_group_from_name(name)
	local matched = string.match(name , '[0-9]')
	return tonumber(matched)
end

function local_class:has_seen_all_gossiping()
	local has_seen_group_1_gossip = self.gossip_flag.has_seen_group_1_gossip
	local has_seen_group_2_gossip = self.gossip_flag.has_seen_group_2_gossip
	local has_seen_group_3_gossip = self.gossip_flag.has_seen_group_3_gossip

	return has_seen_group_1_gossip and has_seen_group_2_gossip and has_seen_group_3_gossip
end

function local_class:get_event_flag_by_idx(idx)
	if idx == 1 then
		return self.gossip_flag.has_seen_group_1_gossip
	elseif idx == 2 then
		return self.gossip_flag.has_seen_group_2_gossip
	elseif idx == 3 then
		return self.gossip_flag.has_seen_group_3_gossip
	end
end

function local_class:set_event_flag_true_by_idx(idx)
	if idx == 1 then
		self.gossip_flag.has_seen_group_1_gossip = true
	elseif idx == 2 then
		self.gossip_flag.has_seen_group_2_gossip = true
	elseif idx == 3 then
		self.gossip_flag.has_seen_group_3_gossip = true
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

			animation = 'idle',

		},
		[vamp_name .. 2] = {

		}
	}

-----------------------------------------------------------

function local_class:on_event(e)

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

	elseif self:is_vampire_blocking(e.Target) then

	end

-----------------------------------------------------------
-- 연출용 메소드 넣는 구역
-----------------------------------------------------------
function local_class:co_pick_up_potion()
	-- 나레이션 출력.
	-- 뱀파이어들이 버린 물건을 줍겠습니까?
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.script_key .. 1 })

	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ self.script_key .. 2, 'mercy' },
		{ self.script_key .. 3, 'normal' }
	})

	-- 아니오 선택 시 이전 상태로 복귀.
	if player_choice == 2 then
		return
	end

	--예 선택 시 아이템 플레이어에게 흡수됨. 이후 아이템 획득 연출 실행.
	local potion = self.controller.potion_item
	potion.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
	wait_for_sec(1.2)
	potion:Fly()
	self.controller.position_item = nil

	-- 이 섹션에서는 particles 테이블의 1번이 twinkle 임이 보장된다.
	local twinkle_particle = self.controller.particles[1]
	twinkle_particle:Dispose()
	self.controller.particles[1] = nil

	local spec_name = 'ds_blood_potion'
	-- 아이템 명 : 혈액 포션
	local title = 'wolf_sub_title'
	-- 상단 메시지 : 늑대 수인 보증!
	local sub_title = 'wolf_potion_title'
	-- 비릿한 야채 냄새가 납니다.
	local title_desc = 'wolf_title_desc'

	-- 아이템 획득 연출
	screen_util.item_get_event(spec_name, title, sub_title, title_desc)

	-- 인터렉터블 멀리 날려버림.
	local potion_interactable = self.controller.get_pickable_potion()
	potion_interactable.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	character_util.set_active_state(potion_interactable, 'false')

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.controller.has_portion_key, 1)
end

function local_class:co_interacted_vampires_blocking_isle()
	-- 두 뱀파이어 중심열에 정렬하고 대화 이벤트 시작
	local vamp_top = self.controller.get_vampire_blocking_by_idx(1)
	local vamp_bottom = self.controller.get_vampire_blocking_by_idx(2)

	local align_pos = (vamp_top.Position + vamp_bottom.Position) / 2

	party_util.align_party(align_pos, 'left', 1, 'arc')

	-- 뱀파이어 1 (left, attack, idle) : 뭐야 당신. 이 앞에 용건이라도 있어?
	character_util.set_direction(vamp_top, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(vamp_bottom, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(vamp_top, { name = 'attack' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vamp_top, { key = self.script_key .. 4, skip = true })

	-- 이후 플레이어 선택지 출력
	local branch = {}

	--‘혈액 포션에 분노하는 수인들’ 에서 혈액 포션 스프라이트를 획득했다면 해당 선택지 활성화.
	if self.controller:has_portion() then
		--혈액 포션을 보여준다. (초록)
		table.insert(branch, { self.script_key .. 5, 'mercy' })
	end
	--물러선다. (흰색)
	table.insert(branch, { self.script_key .. 6, 'normal' })

	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event(branch)
	if not self.controller:has_portion() or player_choice == 2 then
		character_util.set_emotion(vamp_top, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_direction(vamp_top, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(vamp_bottom, 'right')
		return
	end

	local potion_sprite_name = 'bob_healing_potion2'

	--플레이어 right, attack, get 과 함께 손에 bob_healing_potion 을 들려 보여준다.
	local potion_id = 20587
	local potion_spawn_pos = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0.7)
	local potion = self.controller:create_drop_item(potion_id, potion_spawn_pos, 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'attack' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_saloon_01')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'get' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	potion:ConsumeComplete()

	--플레이어 right, attack, release 2회를 실행.
	local leader_release_anim_data = { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 }
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, leader_release_anim_data)

	--뱀파이어 1 (left, attack, idle) : 뭐야. 당신도 사기당한 거야?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vamp_top, { key = self.script_key .. 7, skip = true })

	--뱀파이어 2 (left, tired, idle) : 뱀파이어로 보이진 않는데…
	character_util.set_emotion(vamp_top, { name = 'tired' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vamp_top, { key = self.script_key .. 8, skip = true })

	--플레이어 right, attack, release 2회를 실행.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, leader_release_anim_data)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	--뱀파이어 1 (left, smile, idle) : 사기를 당한 건 확실해 보이네. 어서 들어와.
	character_util.set_emotion(vamp_top, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vamp_top, { key = self.script_key .. 9, skip = true })

	character_util.remove_relate_event(vamp_top, self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(vamp_bottom, self.controller)

	--이후 뱀파이어 2인 하단으로 정렬하여 플레이어 통로 개방됨.
	local vamp_move_speed = 2
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local vamp_top_wp = {
				self.controller:get_npc_marker_pos_by_idx(vamp_top.Name, 2),
				self.controller:get_npc_marker_pos_by_idx(vamp_top.Name, 3),
				self.controller:get_npc_marker_pos_by_idx(vamp_top.Name, 4)
			}

			character_util.set_anim(vamp_top, { name = 'walk' })
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(vamp_top, vamp_top_wp, vamp_move_speed, false)
			character_util.remove_anim(vamp_top)
			character_util.set_direction(vamp_top, 'up')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local vamp_bottom_wp = {
				self.controller:get_npc_marker_pos_by_idx(vamp_bottom.Name, 2),
				self.controller:get_npc_marker_pos_by_idx(vamp_bottom.Name, 3),
				self.controller:get_npc_marker_pos_by_idx(vamp_bottom.Name, 4)
			}

			character_util.set_anim(vamp_bottom, { name = 'walk' })
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(vamp_bottom, vamp_bottom_wp, vamp_move_speed, false)
			character_util.set_direction(vamp_bottom, 'up')
			character_util.remove_anim(vamp_bottom)
		end),
	})

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:is_vampire_blocking(fo)
	return string.match(fo.Name, 'wolf_vampire_blocking_')
end

return local_class

function local_class:co_werewolf_get_bullied()

	camera_util.move_async(innuit.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 0.75)

	-- 이누이트 1 (right, attack, idle) : 갑자기 길을 막다니… 용건이라도 있어?

function local_class:hero_landing(fo)
	character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'enabled')
	local pos = field:GetMarker('wolf_lei_hero_landing').position
	local jump_height = 10
	character_util.set_position(fo, pos + vector(0, jump_height, 0), true)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(fo, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false }
	, { name = 'sleep_deep' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_duration = 0.4
	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, fo.Position.y, 0)
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		if start_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
			character_util.set_position(fo, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
		else
			character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(fo.Position)
	character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
end

function local_class:throw_potion_to_wolf(start_pos, target_pos, duration, item)
	local transform = item.SpriteTransform
	local shadow = item.ShadowTransform
	local time_passed = 0
	local total_rotating_degree = 720

	self.is_potion_moving = true

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = (time_passed / duration)

		if progress >= 0.45 and self.cur_hold_potion_move_state == self.hold_potion_move_state.init then
			self.cur_hold_potion_move_state = self.hold_potion_move_state.hold
		end

		if self.cur_hold_potion_move_state ~= self.hold_potion_move_state.hold then
			local updated_pos = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress
					+ vector(0, math.sin(math.pi * progress), 0)
			item:SetPosition(updated_pos)
			local rotated = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right)
					* unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(total_rotating_degree * progress, unity_class.vector3.forward)
			transform.localRotation = rotated
			shadow.localRotation = rotated

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime * self.slow_mo_time_scale
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.is_potion_moving = false
end
--endregion

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_1, { key = self.script_key .. 9, skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_2, { key = self.script_key .. 10, skip = true })

	--경비병 1 (right, idle, idle) : 다르지. 기본적으로 그곳 사람들은 인성 자체가…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_1, { key = self.script_key .. 11, skip = true })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--이후 플레이어 left, attack, jump 1회 실행하며 머리 위로 emoticon_bubble_exclamation 출력.
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.normal_jump(user_party.Leader, '01_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party.Leader, nil, 'notice')
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	--집주인의 진짜 종족에 대해 알게 되었다!
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = self.script_key .. 12 })

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @

end

--region event

end

function local_class:co_faced_innuit_scammer()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	self:disable_gossiping_vampires()

	self.has_entered_innuit_room = true

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	self.blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', loop = true })

	local party_align_marker = field:GetMarker('wolf_player_mansion_align')
	local party_align_pos = party_align_marker.position
	local party_align_dir = party_align_marker.direction
	party_util.align_party(party_align_pos, 'down', 0.75, 'arc')

	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	camera_util.move_async(innuit.Position, 0.75)

	-- 플레이어 1타일 up, walk로 이누이트에게 접근.
	local player_move_speed = 0.75

	-- 이누이트 (up, idle, idle) : 흠… 이제 구걸도 뭔가 잘 안 통하네…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(innuit, { key = self.script_key .. 1, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	self.controller:play_qte('up')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_04')
	character_util.move_distance_async(user_party.Leader, vector(0, 0, 1),
					2, nil, true, true)

	-- 이누이트 (up, idle, idle) : 뭔가 새로운 사업 아이템이 필요한데…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(innuit, { key = self.script_key .. 2, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	self.controller:play_qte('up')

	character_util.move_distance_async(user_party.Leader, vector(0, 0, 1),
					2, nil, true, true)

	-- 이누이트 (up, idle, idle) : 이제 뱀파이어들에게 다 팔아버린 것 같으니… 역으로 늑대들한테…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(innuit, { key = self.script_key .. 3, skip = true })

	-- 이후 플레이어 이누이트를 바라보며 boong_attack_ready 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'boong_attack_ready', loop = false })

	-- 이누이트 (right, idle, idle) : 응? 무슨…
	character_util.set_direction(innuit, 'right')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(innuit, { key = self.script_key .. 4, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	self.turbo_tap_count = 0
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(3)

	while self.turbo_tap_count ~= 1 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	-- 이후 플레이어 이누이트를 향해 boong_attack 실행. 내지르는 타이밍에 맞춰 이누이트 피격 이펙트 + FX_lasthit 출력.
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'boong_attack', scale = 1.5, loop = false })
	local effect_spawn_pos = (user_party.Leader.Position + innuit.Position) / 2
	self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(effect_spawn_pos)
	camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(innuit)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(innuit, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.33)

	-- 이누이트 (right, damaged, dead) : 무, 무슨…!
	-- 상단 대사와 함께 right, damaged, dead로 쓰러진다.
	character_util.set_emotion(innuit, { name = 'damaged' })
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.set_anim(innuit, {name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01'})
			wait_for_sec(0.8)
			character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
			wait_for_sec(1.033)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_03')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(innuit, { key = self.script_key .. 5, skip = true })
		end),
	})

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 이후 플레이어 이누이트를 홀더블하여 들어올린다. 동시에 이누이트 down, surprise, embarrassed.
	innuit.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	innuit.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = nil
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_holdup_01')
	command_util.execute_holdup(user_party.Leader, innuit, user_party.Leader.Position)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 이후 플레이어 down, idle, walk로 하단으로 퇴장. 퇴장하면서 이누이트 대사 출력.
	character_util.move_distance_async(user_party.Leader, vector(0, 0, -3), nil, 2,
			true, true)

	-- 파티원이 있을 경우 파티원도 이동하도록 한다.
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_distance(user_party[i], vector(0, 0, -2), nil, 2,
				true, true)
	end

	character_util.move_distance_async(user_party.Leader, vector(0, 0, -1), nil, 2,
			true, true)

	-- 플레이어, 이누이트 사라지며 화면 페이드 아웃.
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_distance_async(user_party.Leader, vector(0, 0, -3), nil,
					2, true, true)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			self.blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(2)
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		end)
	})

	self.controller.get_mansion_entrance().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	-- 경비원들 전부 비활성화
	for i = 1, 24 do
		character_util.set_active_state(self.controller.get_guard_by_idx(i), 'disabled')
	end

	self:co_brought_innuit_to_lei()
end

function local_class:co_brought_innuit_to_lei()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	character_util.set_emotion(innuit, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(innuit, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_direction(innuit, 'right')

	camera_util.move_async(vector(72, 0, -12), 0)

	-- 플레이어 위치 이동
	local player_brought_innuit_marker = field:GetMarker('wolf_player_align')
	party_util.align_party(player_brought_innuit_marker.position + vector(1.5, 0, 0),
			'left', 0, 'linear')

	-- 페이드 인 시 해당 위치에 레이가 right, tired, cast 로 배치.
	local lei = self:get_initialized_lei()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--레이 (right, tired, cast) : 그 아이… 도대체 어디에…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lei, { key = self.script_key .. 7, skip = true })

	--플레이어 화면 좌측에서부터 right, attack, embarrassed 상태인 이누이트를 홀더블로 들고 등장한다.

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local player_move_distance_vec = vector(6, 0, 0)
			local player_move_speed = 2
			-- 파티원이 있을 경우 파티원도 이동하도록 한다.
			for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
				character_util.move_distance(user_party[i], player_move_distance_vec, nil,
						2, true, true)
			end
			character_util.move_distance_async(user_party.Leader, player_move_distance_vec, nil,
					player_move_speed, true, true)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.75)
			-- left, smile, jump 1회 실행.
			character_util.set_direction(lei, 'left')
			character_util.set_emotion(lei, { name = 'smile' })
			character_util.normal_jump_async(lei, '01_player_jump_01')
		end)
	})

	-- 들고 있던 오브젝트를 내려놓음
	local throw_dir_vec = vector(1, 0, 0)
	local throw_pos = (user_party.Leader.Position + lei.Position) / 2
	local throw_init_speed = 5
	character_util.remove_anim(innuit)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	self:throw_current_hold_target(user_party.Leader, throw_dir_vec, throw_pos, throw_init_speed, false)
	innuit.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(innuit.Position)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 레이 (left, smile, idle) : 인간! 그 아이를 데리고 와줬구나!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lei, { key = self.script_key .. 8, skip = true })

	-- 이누이트 이후 jump 하여 기상.
	character_util.shake_and_wakeup(innuit, 'left', 2, 'attack', true)
	character_util.set_direction(innuit, 'left')

	local req = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('idle', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, true)
	local state = CS.Oak.CharacterMarionetteState.Create(innuit, req)
	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(state)
	state.CurrentAction = CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped
	message_system:SendSync(innuit.FieldObjectBehaviour, state_change_event)

	-- 스파인 애니메이션 강제 리셋
	character_util.remove_anim(innuit)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 이누이트 (left, attack, release) : 너! 갑자기 사람을 쳐?! 우리 경비 어디있어?!

function local_class:throw_current_hold_target(fo, dir_vec, pos, initial_speed, play_sfx)
	local cur_hold_target = fo.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget

	if cur_hold_target ~= nil then
		command_util.execute_throw(fo, cur_hold_target, dir_vec, pos, initial_speed, play_sfx)
	end
end

function local_class:create_diary(spawn_pos)
	local diary_id = 20606
	local diary_scale = 0.7

	local diary = self.controller:create_drop_item(diary_id, spawn_pos, diary_scale)
	return diary
end

function local_class:play_quest_complete()
	local display_items = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.IItem)
	local common_rewards = self.quest_spec.CommonRewards
	for i = 0, common_rewards.Count - 1 do
		local quest_reward = common_rewards[i]
		local item_place_holder = quest_reward.Item

		if item_place_holder ~= nil then
			local item = nil

			if CS.Oak.ItemSpecId.IsAsset(item_place_holder.ItemId) then
				item = CS.Oak.Item.Create(CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(item_place_holder.ItemId), nil, nil, nil,
						item_place_holder.Amount)
			else
				item = CS.Oak.Item.Create(CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(item_place_holder.ItemId), nil, nil,
						item_place_holder.Level, item_place_holder.Amount)
			end

			display_items:Add(item)
		end
	end

	local complete = false
	stage.FieldUIQuestComplete:PlayQuestComplete(self.quest_progress, function()
		complete = true
	end, display_items)

	while not complete do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:disable_gossiping_vampires()
	for i = 1, 3 do
		for j = 1, 2 do
			local character = get_character(self.controller.gossiping_vampire_name .. i .. '_' .. j)
			local init_marker = field:GetMarker(character.Name)
			character_util.set_position(character, init_marker.position)
			character_util.set_direction(character, init_marker.direction)
			character_util.set_active_state(character, 'disabled')
		end
	end
end

		end,

		end,
	}

	-- item
	-- 사용할 아이템들 id
	self.item_id = {
		comics = 21425,
	}

	self.items = {
		data = nil,
		add_item = function(this, item_id, unique_id, pos, target_pos, scale, create_on_character, dont_show_loot_text, local_scale)
			if this.data == nil then
				this.data = {}
			end

			create_on_character = lua_helper.get_or_default(create_on_character, false)
			target_pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(target_pos, nil)
			local_scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(local_scale, nil)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = pos,
				item_id = item_id,
				spr_scale = scale,
				unique_id = unique_id,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				show_on_character = create_on_character,
				skip_text = dont_show_loot_text,
				target = target_pos
			})

			if local_scale ~= nil then
				item.SpriteTransform.localScale = local_scale
				item.ShadowTransform.localScale = local_scale
			end

			table.insert(this.data, item)
		end,
		pop_item = function(this, unique_id)
			if this.data ~= nil then
				for i, item in ipairs(this.data) do
					if item.UniqueId == unique_id then
						local pop_item = item

						table.remove(this.data, i)

						return pop_item
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end,

		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.data ~= nil then

function local_class:on_brazier_on_off_event(e)
	local brazier_1 = self.field_object.brazier(1)
	local brazier_2 = self.field_object.brazier(2)

	if self.current_state == self.states.puzzle and self.current_day_state == self.day_states.daylight then
		for i = 1, 2 do
			--  화로 꺼짐 체크
			if e.IsTurningOn and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.BrazierObject, self.field_object.brazier(i)) then

				if brazier_1.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning and
						brazier_2.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
					self.current_state = self.states.clear_puzzle

					self.sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(self.play_puzzle_clear_event, self)
