function local_class:play_prisoners_mumbling()
	local group = self.time_conversion:get_group(self.quest_event_name)
	local secret_prisoner_handler = group:get_handler('secret_prisoner')
	local prisoner = secret_prisoner_handler:get_npc()

	self.prisoner_mumble_loop = true

	scene_util.set_direction(prisoner, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(prisoner, self, 'doyagao')

	local wait_for_sec_routine = function(time)
		local s = unity_class.time.time
		while unity_class.time.time - s < time do
			if not self.prisoner_mumble_loop then
				return false
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		return true
	end

	local behaviour = {
		cur_behaviour_idx = 1,
		max_behaviour_idx = 4,

		[1] = {
			route = nil,
			func = function()
				-- 2초 대기
				wait_for_sec(2)

				-- 아이젠(left, doyagao, release): 나가기 위해 애를 쓰는 모습을 보고 있자니….
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prisoner, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'release' }, nil, { key = 'dv_sub_bleach_s1_2_1', skip = false })

				if not self.prisoner_mumble_loop then
					return
				end

				-- 아이젠(left, doyagao, bomb_idle): 자못… 골계스러운 광경이로군.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prisoner, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = false }, nil, { key = 'dv_sub_bleach_s1_2_2', skip = false })

				-- 아이젠(left, doyagao, idle)

				-- 5초 대기
				if not wait_for_sec_routine(5) then
					return
				end
			end
		},
		[2] = {
			route = nil,
			func = function()
				-- 아이젠(left, doyagao, cross_arm): 잠긴 문이 있으면 응당 여는 법이 있을거라 생각하는 모양이지?
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prisoner, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false }, nil, { key = 'dv_sub_bleach_s1_2_3', skip = false })

				if not self.prisoner_mumble_loop then
					return
				end

				-- 아이젠(left, doyagao, release): 섭리란, 섭리에 매달리지 않고서는 살아갈 수 없는 자들을 위해 존재하는 것인데 말이야.

				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prisoner, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'release', one_shot_sfx = false }, nil, { key = 'dv_sub_bleach_s1_2_4', skip = false })

				if not self.prisoner_mumble_loop then
					return
				end

				-- 아이젠(left, doyagao, idle)

				-- 5초 대기
				if not wait_for_sec_routine(5) then
					return
				end
			end
		},
		[3] = {
			route = nil,
			func = function()
				-- 기사 성별 체크해서 대사 출력
				local sub_idx = 1
				if not user_util.has_knight_male() then
					sub_idx = 2
				end

				-- 남성일 경우
				--   아이젠(left, doyagao, bomb_idle): 그렇게 계속 발버둥 쳐 보게, 여화 소년.
				-- 여성일 경우
				--   아이젠(left, doyagao, bomb_idle): 그렇게 계속 발버둥 쳐 보게, 여화 소녀.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prisoner, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = false }, nil, { key = 'dv_sub_bleach_s1_2_5_' .. sub_idx, skip = false })

				if not self.prisoner_mumble_loop then
					return
				end

				-- 아이젠(left, doyagao, nod 2회): 자네는 인간 치고는… 퍽 흥미로우니 말이야.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prisoner, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'nod', count = 2, one_shot_sfx = false }, nil, { key = 'dv_sub_bleach_s1_2_6', skip = false })

				-- 아이젠(left, doyagao, idle)

				-- 3초 대기
				if not wait_for_sec_routine(3) then
					return
				end
			end
		},
		[4] = {
			route = nil,
			func = function()
				-- 아이젠(left, doyagao, cross_arm): 허점 투성이군. 전부 다.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(prisoner, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false }, nil, { key = 'dv_sub_bleach_s1_2_7', skip = false })

				-- 아이젠(left, doyagao, idle)

				-- 2초 대기
				if not wait_for_sec_routine(2) then
					return
				end
			end
		},
	}

	behaviour.cur_behaviour_idx = 1

	while self.prisoner_mumble_loop do
		if behaviour[behaviour.cur_behaviour_idx].route ~= nil then
			wp_util.move_async(prisoner, behaviour[behaviour.cur_behaviour_idx].route, 4, nil)
		end

		if not self.prisoner_mumble_loop then
			return
		end

		behaviour[behaviour.cur_behaviour_idx].func()

		if behaviour.cur_behaviour_idx == behaviour.max_behaviour_idx then
			behaviour.cur_behaviour_idx = 1
		else
			behaviour.cur_behaviour_idx = behaviour.cur_behaviour_idx + 1
		end

		if not self.prisoner_mumble_loop then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

local util = {}

local alpha_duration = 1.25

-- 밤/낮 시간 전환할 때, 캐릭터를 등장 시켜주는 함수
function util.show_time_conversion(immediately, callback, ...)
	local params = {}

	if type_util.is_table(...) then
		params = ...
	else
		params = table.pack(...)
	end

	local function run_callback()
		if callback ~= nil then
			callback()
		end
	end

	if immediately then
		for i = 1, #params do
			local npc = params[i]
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		run_callback()
		return
	end

	local screen_in_list = {}

	for i = 1, #params do
		local npc = params[i]

		if screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(npc.Position) then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, 0, 0)
			npc.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
			table.insert(screen_in_list, npc)
		else
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, 1, 0)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
			npc.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.1)
		end
	end

	if #screen_in_list <= 0 then
		run_callback()
		return
	end

	start_coroutine(function()
		for i = 1, #screen_in_list do
			local npc = screen_in_list[i]
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, 1, alpha_duration)
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		for i = 1, #screen_in_list do
			local npc = screen_in_list[i]
			npc.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
		end

		run_callback()
	end)
end

function util.hide_time_conversion(immediately, callback, ...)
	local params = {}

	if type_util.is_table(...) then
		params = ...
	else
		params = table.pack(...)
	end

	local function run_callback()
		if callback ~= nil then
			callback()
		end
	end

	if immediately then
		for i = 1, #params do
			local npc = params[i]
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
		end

		run_callback()
		return
	end

	local screen_in_list = {}

	for i = 1, #params do
		local npc = params[i]

		if screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(npc.Position) then
			table.insert(screen_in_list, npc)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
		end
	end

	if #screen_in_list <= 0 then
		run_callback()
		return
	end

	start_coroutine(function()
		for i = 1, #screen_in_list do
			local npc = screen_in_list[i]
			npc.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, 0, alpha_duration)
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		for i = 1, #screen_in_list do
			local npc = screen_in_list[i]
			npc.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
		end

		run_callback()
	end)
end

return util

---@class DreamVillageScreenplayManager
local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageScreenplayManager')

---@class DreamVillageScreenplayController
local sp_controller = newclass('DreamVillageScreenplayController')

function local_class:init()
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

---@return DreamVillageScreenplayController
function local_class:get_sp_controller(requester)
	local new_sp_controller = sp_controller(self, requester)

	return new_sp_controller
end

function local_class:try_add_request(requester)
	return stage.ScreenPlayRecorder:TryAddRequest(requester)
end

function local_class:try_proceed_request(requester)
	return stage.ScreenPlayRecorder:TryProceedRequest(requester)
end

function local_class:remove_request(requester)
	stage.ScreenPlayRecorder:RemoveRequest(requester)
end

function local_class:can_proceed(requester)
	return stage.ScreenPlayRecorder:CanProceed(requester)
end

--region sp_controller

function sp_controller:init(main_controller, requester)
	self.main_controller = main_controller
	self.requester = requester
end

function sp_controller:dispose()
	self.main_controller = nil
	self.requester = nil
end

function sp_controller:start_scene_delayed(func, ...)
	if self.requester == nil then
		logger_util.error('The requester is missing.')

		return
	end

	local args = { ... }

	local coroutine = start_coroutine(function()
		local is_request_added = self.main_controller:try_add_request(self.requester)

		if not is_request_added then
			return
		end

		while not self.main_controller:can_proceed(self.requester) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		local cached_leader = get_party_leader()

		sp_util.enter_scene()

		func(table.unpack(args))

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, cached_leader)

		self.main_controller:remove_request(self.requester)
	end)

	return coroutine
end

function sp_controller:try_start_scene(func, ...)
	if self.requester == nil then
		logger_util.error('The requester is missing.')

		return
	end

	if not self.main_controller:try_proceed_request(self.requester) then
		return false, nil
	end

	local args = { ... }

	local coroutine = start_coroutine(function()
		local cached_leader = get_party_leader()

		sp_util.enter_scene()

		func(table.unpack(args))

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, cached_leader)

		self.main_controller:remove_request(self.requester)
	end)

	return true, coroutine
end

function sp_controller:start_coroutine_delayed(func, ...)
	if self.requester == nil then
		logger_util.error('The requester is missing.')

		return
	end

	local args = { ... }

	local coroutine = start_coroutine(function()
		local is_request_added = self.main_controller:try_add_request(self.requester)

		if not is_request_added then
			return
		end

		while not self.main_controller:can_proceed(self.requester) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		func(table.unpack(args))

		self.main_controller:remove_request(self.requester)
	end)

	return coroutine
end

function sp_controller:try_start_coroutine(func, ...)
	if self.requester == nil then
		logger_util.error('The requester is missing.')

		return
	end

	if not self.main_controller:try_proceed_request(self.requester) then
		return false, nil
	end

	local args = { ... }

	local coroutine = start_coroutine(function()

		func(table.unpack(args))

		self.main_controller:remove_request(self.requester)
	end)

	return true, coroutine
end

--endregion sp_controller

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

---@class DreamVillageStage6MazeController
local local_class = newclass('DreamVillageStage6MazeController')

local nowhere = vector(999, 0, 999)

-- 여러가지 문제가 있지만, 일단 조건이 상당히 꼬여있음...
-- N -> N + 1 (정답)
-- FoMoveEvent를 캐치해 플레이어 위치를 반대쪽의 그리드 안쪽으로 잠시 넣어두고,
-- StageCamera.ResetPositionWithOutGridMove로 내부 그리드 인덱스 / 위치를 정상화
-- 가운데 그리드에 있던 N단계의 아이템은 모두 반대쪽 그리드로 이동, Item Fo는 비활성화
-- N + 1단계의 아이템과 Item Fo를 가운데 그리드에 세팅
-- 다시 플레이어의 위치를 가운데 그리드로 옮기고, 자동으로 StageCamera GridMove가 발동
-- MoveEndEvent가 수신되면 반대쪽 그리드에 세팅된 아이템 해제

-- N -> 1 (오답, N > 1)
-- FoMoveEvent를 캐치해 플레이어 위치를 반대쪽의 그리드 안쪽으로 잠시 넣어두고,
-- StageCamera.ResetPositionWithOutGridMove로 내부 그리드 인덱스 / 위치를 정상화
-- 가운데 그리드에 있던 N단계의 아이템은 모두 반대쪽 그리드로 이동, Item Fo는 비활성화
-- 1단계의 아이템과 Item Fo를 가운데 그리드에 세팅
-- 다시 플레이어의 위치를 가운데 그리드로 옮기고, 자동으로 StageCamera GridMove가 발동
-- MoveEndEvent가 수신되면 반대쪽 그리드에 세팅된 아이템 해제

-- 1 -> 1 (오답)
-- FoMoveEvent를 캐치해 플레이어 위치를 반대쪽의 그리드 안쪽으로 잠시 넣어두고,
-- StageCamera.ResetPositionWithOutGridMove로 내부 그리드 인덱스 / 위치를 정상화
-- 1단계의 아이템을 반대쪽 그리드에 추가로 세팅, Item Fo는 세팅하지 않음
-- 다시 플레이어의 위치를 가운데 그리드로 옮기고, 자동으로 StageCamera GridMove가 발동
-- MoveEndEvent가 수신되면 반대쪽 그리드에 세팅된 아이템 해제

-- N -> Clear (정답)
-- FoMoveEvent를 캐치해 플레이어 위치를 "정답 그리드와 연결된 그리드" 안쪽으로 잠시 넣어두고,
-- StageCamera.ResetPositionWithOutGridMove로 내부 그리드 인덱스 / 위치를 정상화
-- 가운데 그리드에 있던 N단계의 아이템은 모두 "정답 그리드와 연결된 그리드"로 이동, Item Fo는 비활성화
-- 다시 플레이어의 위치를 "정답 그리드"로 옮기고, 자동으로 StageCamera GridMove가 발동
-- MoveEndEvent가 수신되면 "정답 그리드와 연결된 그리드"에 세팅된 아이템 해제

-- Clear -> 1 (롤백)
-- GridLeave/EnterEvent를 캐치해 다음 그리드에 1단계 아이템과 Item Fo를 세팅
-- MoveEndEvent가 수신되면 플레이어/아이템/ItemFo를 모두 가운데 그리드로 이전

function local_class:init()
	self.grids = metatable_helper.inherit({
		container = {},

		types = {
			down = 1,
			left = 2,
			right = 3,
			up = 4,

			center = 5,
			last = 6,
			clear = 7,
		}
	}, {
		get_grid_name = function(key)
			return 'main_s24_maze_grid_' .. key
		end,

		add = function(this, key, handle_key)
			local handle_name = this.get_grid_name(handle_key or key)
			local grid = field_util.get_camera_grid(handle_name)

			this.container[this.types[key]] = grid
		end,

		remove = function(this, type)
			this.container[type] = nil
		end,

		get_grid = function(this, type)
			return this.container[type]
		end,

		get_opposite_grid_type = function(this, type)
			if type < this.types.center then
				return this.types.center - type
			end

			return nil
		end
	})

	self.grids:add('center')
	self.grids:add('left')
	self.grids:add('right')
	self.grids:add('down')
	self.grids:add('up')

	self.field_zone = field_util.get_zone('main_s24_maze_field')

	self.player_party = metatable_helper.inherit({
		members = {
			leader = function()
				return user_party.Leader
			end,
			-- FIXME : 원래는 이것도 외부에서 주입해야 함
			follower = function()
				return get_character('reaper')
			end
		},
		get_cs_party = function()
			return user_party
		end,

		leader_name = 'leader',

		fixed_values = {},
	}, {
		init = function(this)
			for _, getter in pairs(this.members) do
				local member = getter()

				this.fixed_values[member] = {
					position = nil,
					direction = nil,
					ignore_next = false,
				}
			end
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			for key in pairs(this.fixed_values) do
				this.fixed_values[key] = nil
			end
		end,

		teleport_without_leader = function(this, old_pivot, new_pivot)
			for name, getter in pairs(this.members) do
				if name ~= this.leader_name then
					local member = getter()
					local offset = member.Position - old_pivot

					member.Position = new_pivot + offset
				end
			end
		end,

		save_fixed_values = function(this)
			for _, getter in pairs(this.members) do
				local member = getter()
				local values = this.fixed_values[member]

				values.position = member.Position
				values.ignore_next = false

				member.LockedDirection = member.Direction
			end
		end,

		dispose_fixed_values = function(this)
			for _, getter in pairs(this.members) do
				local member = getter()
				local values = this.fixed_values[member]

				member.LockedDirection = direction_constants.none

				values.direction = nil
				values.position = nil
			end
		end,

		contains = function(this, character)
			return this.fixed_values[character] ~= nil
		end,

		execute_fix_member = function(this, member)
			local values = this.fixed_values[member]

			if values.position == nil then
				return
			end

			if values.ignore_next then
				values.ignore_next = false
			else
				values.ignore_next = true

				member.Position = values.position
			end
		end
	})

	local interactable_manager = metatable_helper.inherit({
		container = {},

		next_index = 1,
	}, {
		is_enabled = function(this, key)
			local fo = this.container[key]

			if fo == nil then
				return false
			end

			return fo.ActiveState == active_state_type.enabled
		end,

		spawn = function(this, key, position, texts)
			local fo = this.container[key]

			if fo == nil then
				fo = get_field_object('main_s24_maze_item_interactable_' .. this.next_index)

				this.next_index = this.next_index + 1

				local interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()

				interactable.StringKeys = texts

				fo.Interactable = interactable
				fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

				this.container[key] = fo
			end

			field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.enabled)
			fo.Position = position
		end,

		despawn = function(this, key)
			local fo = this.container[key]

			if fo == nil then
				return
			end

			field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.disabled)
		end,

		move = function(this, key, move_diff)
			local fo = this.container[key]

			if fo == nil then
				return
			end

			fo.Position = fo.Position + move_diff
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			for key, fo in pairs(this.container) do
				field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.disabled)

				this.container[key] = nil
			end

			this.next_index = 1
		end
	})

	self.items = metatable_helper.inherit({
		container = {},

		request_counter = metatable_helper.inherit({
			value = 1,
		}, {
			get_and_proceed = function(this)
				local result = this.value

				this.value = this.value + 1

				return result
			end,

			reset = function(this)
				this.value = 1
			end
		}),

		interactable_manager = interactable_manager,
	}, {
		spawn = function(this, group_key, item_key, item_info, position)
			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				item_id = item_info.id,
				pos = position,
				unique_id = 'main_s24_maze_item_' .. this.request_counter:get_and_proceed(),
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
			})

			if this.container[group_key] == nil then
				this.container[group_key] = {}
			end

			this.container[group_key][item_key] = item

			-- 현재 필드에 존재하지 않는 경우에만 스폰해줌
			-- 1->1의 경우에는 같은 키를 사용하지만
			-- Center 그리드에 세팅되어있던 것을 그대로 유지하고,
			-- 지나가는 이전 그리드에 잠깐 세팅하는 용도이기 때문에 interactable이 붙을 필요가 없음
			-- 이렇게 하면 불필요하게 같은 정보를 담고 있는 interactable이 추가로 생길 필요가 없다.
			if not this.interactable_manager:is_enabled(item_key) then
				this.interactable_manager:spawn(item_key, position, item_info.texts)
			end
		end,

		despawn_group = function(this, group_key, ignore_interactable)
			local group = this.container[group_key]

			if group == nil then
				return
			end

			for item_key, item in pairs(group) do
				quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)

				if not ignore_interactable then
					this.interactable_manager:despawn(item_key)
				end

				group[item_key] = nil
			end
		end,

		move = function(this, origin_group_key, teleport_group_key, move_diff)
			local group = this.container[origin_group_key]

			if group == nil then
				return
			end

			for item_key, item in pairs(group) do
				item.Position = item.Position + move_diff

				this.interactable_manager:move(item_key, move_diff)
			end

			local temp = this.container[teleport_group_key]

			this.container[teleport_group_key] = this.container[origin_group_key]

			this.container[origin_group_key] = temp
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			for key, _ in pairs(this.container) do
				this:despawn_group(key)
			end

			this.interactable_manager:dispose()

			this.request_counter:reset()
		end
	})

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter(key, on_escaped_callback)
	self.current_state = self.states.before_start

	self.data_key = key

	self.on_escaped_callback = on_escaped_callback

	local step_info = self:get_step_info()

	self.grids:add('clear', step_info.clear_grid_name)
	self.grids:add('last', step_info.last_route_grid_name)

	self.current_step_index = 1
	self.next_step_index = -1
	self.current_move_type = self.move_types.none

	self:spawn_items(self.grids.types.center, step_info.route[self.current_step_index].items)
end

function local_class:start()
	self.player_party:init()

	self.current_state = self.states.in_maze

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_field_object_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridMoveEndEvent), 'on_camera_grid_move_end_event')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridMoveEndEvent))

	self.player_party:dispose()

	self.items:dispose()

	self.data_key = nil
	self.on_escaped_callback = nil

	self.grids:remove(self.grids.types.clear)
	self.grids:remove(self.grids.types.last)

	self.current_state = self.states.none
end

function local_class:on_move_field_object_event(e)
	local fo = e.FieldObject

	if not self.player_party:contains(fo) then
		return false
	end

	-- 이동 중에는 move 이벤트를 캐치하지 않을 것
	if self.current_move_type ~= self.move_types.none then
		-- 움직임이 발생했을 때, fixed_party_values가 존재하면 위치를 더 이상 이동하지 못하도록 막고 있다는 것.
		-- CameraGridMoveEndEvent가 호출되기 전에 조작이 들어가서 카메라 시스템의 그리드 이동이 발생하는 것을 막기 위함
		self.player_party:execute_fix_member(fo)

		return false
	end

	local leader = self.player_party.members.leader()

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, leader) then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.cleared and not self.field_zone:Contains(leader.Position) then
		self.on_escaped_callback()

		self:exit()

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.in_maze then
		local center_grid = self.grids:get_grid(self.grids.types.center)

		if center_grid:Contains(leader.Position) then
			return false
		end

		local next_grid_type = nil
		local diff = leader.Position - self:get_grid_pivot(center_grid)
		local abs_x = math.abs(diff.x)
		local abs_z = math.abs(diff.z)

		-- 탈출 방향 판정
		if abs_x > abs_z then
			if diff.x < 0 then
				next_grid_type = self.grids.types.left
			else
				next_grid_type = self.grids.types.right
			end
		else
			if diff.z < 0 then
				next_grid_type = self.grids.types.down
			else
				next_grid_type = self.grids.types.up
			end
		end

		local step_info = self:get_step_info()
		local current = step_info.route[self.current_step_index]

		if current.answer_grid_type == next_grid_type then
			self.next_step_index = self.current_step_index + 1

			local next = step_info.route[self.next_step_index]

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_get_heal_01')

			if next ~= nil then
				-- 다음 단계가 있다면 (N -> N + 1)
				self.current_move_type = self.move_types.correct

				local move_start_grid_type = self.grids:get_opposite_grid_type(next_grid_type)

				self:teleport_party_inside_of_grid(self.grids.types.center,
						next_grid_type, move_start_grid_type)

				self:teleport_items(self.grids.types.center, move_start_grid_type)
				self.despawn_on_move_end_group_key = move_start_grid_type

				self:spawn_items(self.grids.types.center, next.items)

				self:execute_camera_move(next_grid_type, self.grids.types.center)
			else
				-- 다음 단계가 없다면 (N -> Clear)
				self.current_move_type = self.move_types.clear

				-- 여기서는 Last -> Clear으로의 이동일 것임
				self:teleport_party_inside_of_grid(self.grids.types.center,
						next_grid_type, self.grids.types.last)

				self:teleport_items(self.grids.types.center, self.grids.types.last)
				self.despawn_on_move_end_group_key = self.grids.types.last

				self:execute_camera_move(next_grid_type, self.grids.types.clear)
			end
		else
			self.next_step_index = 1

			local next = step_info.route[self.next_step_index]

			if self.current_step_index == self.next_step_index then
				-- 1 -> 1
				self.current_move_type = self.move_types.reset

				local move_start_grid_type = self.grids:get_opposite_grid_type(next_grid_type)

				self:teleport_party_inside_of_grid(self.grids.types.center,
						next_grid_type, move_start_grid_type)

				-- 여기서는 이미 1에 세팅되어있는 것을 활용할 것이기 때문에, 별도로 텔레포트가 필요하지 않음
				self:spawn_items(move_start_grid_type, next.items)
				self.despawn_on_move_end_group_key = move_start_grid_type

				self:execute_camera_move(next_grid_type, self.grids.types.center)
			else
				-- N -> 1
				self.current_move_type = self.move_types.wrong

				local move_start_grid_type = self.grids:get_opposite_grid_type(next_grid_type)

				self:teleport_party_inside_of_grid(self.grids.types.center,
						next_grid_type, move_start_grid_type)

				self:teleport_items(self.grids.types.center, move_start_grid_type)
				self.despawn_on_move_end_group_key = move_start_grid_type

				self:spawn_items(self.grids.types.center, next.items)

				self:execute_camera_move(next_grid_type, self.grids.types.center)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.cleared then
		local clear_grid = self.grids:get_grid(self.grids.types.clear)

		if clear_grid:Contains(leader.Position) then
			return false
		end

		self.next_step_index = 1
		self.current_move_type = self.move_types.cleared_reset
		self.current_state = self.states.in_maze

		local step_info = self:get_step_info()

		self:spawn_items(self.grids.types.last, step_info.route[self.next_step_index].items)
	end

	self.player_party:save_fixed_values()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_move_end_event(e)
	if self.current_move_type == self.move_types.none then
		return false
	end

	self.player_party:dispose_fixed_values()

	if self.current_move_type == self.move_types.cleared_reset then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_maze

		-- 이동이 끝났으니 현재 그리드는 last일 것
		self:teleport_party_to_other_grid(self.grids.types.last, self.grids.types.center)
		self:teleport_items(self.grids.types.last, self.grids.types.center)
	elseif self.current_move_type == self.move_types.clear then
		self.current_state = self.states.cleared
	end

	if self.despawn_on_move_end_group_key ~= nil then
		self.items:despawn_group(self.despawn_on_move_end_group_key,
				self.current_move_type == self.move_types.reset)

		self.despawn_on_move_end_group_key = nil
	end

	self.current_step_index = self.next_step_index
	self.next_step_index = -1

	self.current_move_type = self.move_types.none
end

function local_class:get_step_info()
	return self.step_infos[self.data_key]
end

---@param prev_grid_type number 조작으로 인한 이동 직전까지 있었던 그리드 타입
---@param move_direction number 조작으로 인해 이동하려고 하던 그리드 타입 (사실상 방향 정보, 4방향만 입력해야 함)
---@param teleport_grid_type number 그리드 이동을 시작하려는 그리드 타입
function local_class:teleport_party_inside_of_grid(prev_grid_type, move_direction, teleport_grid_type)
	local leader = self.player_party.members.leader()
	local prev_grid = self.grids:get_grid(prev_grid_type)
	local teleport_grid = self.grids:get_grid(teleport_grid_type)
	local grid_diff = self:get_grid_pivot(teleport_grid) - self:get_grid_pivot(prev_grid)
	local target_pos = nil
	local origin_leader_pos = leader.Position

	if move_direction == self.grids.types.left then
		target_pos = vector(teleport_grid.bounds.min.x + constants.epsilon, 0, leader.Position.z + grid_diff.z)
	elseif move_direction == self.grids.types.right then
		target_pos = vector(teleport_grid.bounds.max.x - constants.epsilon, 0, leader.Position.z + grid_diff.z)
	elseif move_direction == self.grids.types.down then
		target_pos = vector(leader.Position.x + grid_diff.x, 0, teleport_grid.bounds.min.z + constants.epsilon)
	elseif move_direction == self.grids.types.up then
		target_pos = vector(leader.Position.x + grid_diff.x, 0, teleport_grid.bounds.max.z - constants.epsilon)
	end

	leader.Position = target_pos

	stage_camera:ResetPositionWithOutGridMove()

	self.player_party:teleport_without_leader(origin_leader_pos, target_pos)
end

function local_class:execute_camera_move(move_direction, target_grid_type)
	local leader = self.player_party.members.leader()
	local grid = self.grids:get_grid(target_grid_type)
	local target_pos = nil

	-- 여기는 실제로 연결된 그리드로의 이동을 제어할 것이므로, 리더의 x / z의 변경은 없을 것
	if move_direction == self.grids.types.left then
		target_pos = vector(grid.bounds.max.x - constants.epsilon, 0, leader.Position.z)
	elseif move_direction == self.grids.types.right then
		target_pos = vector(grid.bounds.min.x + constants.epsilon, 0, leader.Position.z)
	elseif move_direction == self.grids.types.down then
		target_pos = vector(leader.Position.x, 0, grid.bounds.max.z - constants.epsilon)
	elseif move_direction == self.grids.types.up then
		target_pos = vector(leader.Position.x, 0, grid.bounds.min.z + constants.epsilon)
	end

	leader.Position = target_pos
end

function local_class:teleport_party_to_other_grid(prev_grid_type, teleport_grid_type)
	local leader = self.player_party.members.leader()
	local prev_grid = self.grids:get_grid(prev_grid_type)
	local teleport_grid = self.grids:get_grid(teleport_grid_type)
	local grid_diff = self:get_grid_pivot(teleport_grid) - self:get_grid_pivot(prev_grid)
	local target_pos = leader.Position + grid_diff
	local origin_leader_pos = leader.Position

	-- 옮겼는데 위치가 그리드 밖에 있다면 오차범위 고려해서 안쪽으로 넣어버림
	if target_pos.x < teleport_grid.bounds.min.x + constants.epsilon then
		target_pos.x = teleport_grid.bounds.min.x + constants.epsilon
	elseif target_pos.x > teleport_grid.bounds.max.x - constants.epsilon then
		target_pos.x = teleport_grid.bounds.max.x - constants.epsilon
	elseif target_pos.z < teleport_grid.bounds.min.z + constants.epsilon then
		target_pos.z = teleport_grid.bounds.min.z + constants.epsilon
	elseif target_pos.z > teleport_grid.bounds.max.z - constants.epsilon then
		target_pos.z = teleport_grid.bounds.max.z - constants.epsilon
	end

	leader.Position = target_pos

	stage_camera:ResetPositionWithOutGridMove()

	self.player_party:teleport_without_leader(origin_leader_pos, target_pos)
end

function local_class:teleport_items(prev_grid_type, teleport_grid_type)
	local prev_grid = self.grids:get_grid(prev_grid_type)
	local teleport_grid = self.grids:get_grid(teleport_grid_type)
	local move_diff = self:get_grid_pivot(teleport_grid) - self:get_grid_pivot(prev_grid)

	self.items:move(prev_grid_type, teleport_grid_type, move_diff)
end

function local_class:spawn_items(grid_type, item_infos)
	local target_grid = self.grids:get_grid(grid_type)
	local center_grid = self.grids:get_grid(self.grids.types.center)
	local grid_offset = self:get_grid_pivot(target_grid) - self:get_grid_pivot(center_grid)

	for item_key, item_info in pairs(item_infos) do
		local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s24_maze_' .. self.data_key .. '_' .. item_key)
		local position = center_pos + grid_offset

		self.items:spawn(grid_type, item_key, item_info, position)
	end
end

function local_class:get_grid_pivot(grid)
	return vector_util.get_x0z(grid.bounds.center)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}
